title: Academy Team Lead (9 Month FTC)
descriptionHtml:
What we're all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.

The opportunity.

The Quantexa Academy is a key contributor to driving the self-sufficiency and enablement of Quantexa's customers and partners. We achieve this through online learning, instructor-led training and practical technical programmes that help Quantexa users configure, use and implement our award-winning Decision Intelligence Platform. We are looking for someone to join our Academy Team Lead team on a nine-month maternity cover, delivering high-quality technical learning experiences for our colleagues, customers and partners.

In this fixed-term maternity cover role, you will deliver engaging face-to-face and online training, support learners with technical and learning queries, assess learner work and contribute to the continued development of the Academy's technical curriculum. You will act as a key interface between the Academy, learners, clients and partners, working closely with colleagues across Education Services, Cloud, Delivery, Solution Engineering, Technology Account Partners and Alliances.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Provide timely learner support through online sessions and digital channels, including troubleshooting technical issues and delivering live code demonstrations.

  • Evaluate learner projects and assessments, applying fair and consistent marking criteria and providing timely, constructive feedback.

  • Plan and conduct viva assessments for assigned learners, including where further validation of learner understanding is required.

  • Detect and address plagiarism and inappropriate use of AI in learner submissions in line with Academy processes.

  • Deliver engaging face-to-face and online technical training sessions, ensuring high levels of learner participation and satisfaction.

  • Support the maintenance and improvement of training code, technical environments and program setup, resolving general bugs and issues.

  • Collect and act on learner feedback to support the continuous improvement of Academy programs and learning experiences.

  • Collaborate with the Training and LMS Administrator to support the smooth delivery and administration of training programs.

  • Contribute to the creation and ongoing development of technical education programs, curriculum content and communications for Quantexans, customers and partners.

  • Work with Cloud and Delivery teams on VDI setup, issue resolution, data engineer enablement and alignment of assessment criteria with delivery requirements.

  • Act as a subject matter expert for the Design and Publish Pillar and contribute to projects and initiatives across Education Services.

What you’ll bring

Essential

  • Strong knowledge of data processing pipelines and big data technologies such as Spark, Hadoop and Elasticsearch, alongside proficiency in Scala, Java, Python or other object-oriented languages.

  • Experience delivering engaging technical training and live coding in both face-to-face and online environments, with the ability to explain complex concepts to learners of varying experience levels.

  • Experience assessing technical projects and conducting viva assessments, providing constructive feedback and identifying plagiarism or inappropriate use of AI.

  • Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the confidence to resolve learner, code, platform and training-environment issues.

  • Excellent communication, relationship-building and collaboration skills, with the ability to motivate learners and work effectively with clients, partners, colleagues and stakeholders.

  • Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to balance training, assessment and learner support while adapting to changing programme needs.

  • A proactive, positive and solution-focused approach, contributing to an inclusive and supportive learning environment.

Desirable

  • Experience with front-end development technologies, including HTML, Angular and CSS

  • Experience of maintaining or contributing to technical curricula, training code or learning programs

  • Experience working with cloud-based virtual training environments or VDI setup and issue resolution

  • Knowledge of learning technologies, assessment platforms or Learning Management Systems

  • Quantexa Data Engineer Academy certified

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

title: Account Director, Startups | New Business - France
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.

In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.

About the Role

OpenAI is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Account Director to join our Startups France Go To Market team. You will play a critical role in owning relationships with top startup customers and supporting them in building successfully on the OpenAI platform.

We believe that many of the most disruptive and category-defining AI applications will be created by startups. The Startup Go To Market team’s mission is to help startups harness the power of AI models to drive these advances. You will support startups building effectively with OpenAI’s APIs, and provide access to OpenAI teams and expertise to support their growth.

This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and strategy. You’ll be responsible for serving as the primary relationship owner for a set of strategically important startup customers, as well as working across the OpenAI organisation to help these startups accelerate their progress and be successful using our models. You’ll work cross-functionality with product, research, engineering, support, and solutions architecture to help customers get the most out of our models.

This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage a portfolio of startups accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan.

  • Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects.

  • Own a consumption revenue target.

  • Manage consumption revenue forecasts.

  • Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies.

  • Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering.

  • Serve as an advocate for improving the startup experience building with OpenAI, synthesizing product feedback from insights captured from our work with startups.

  • Closely monitor the industry landscape and startup landscape to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies.

  • Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates.

  • Support the development of company culture.

We're seeking someone with experience in:

  • 6+ years selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service.

  • Designing and executing complex deal strategies.

  • Experience working in or around the startup ecosystem, preferably as either a founder of a startup, an employee of a startup, or someone who worked with startup customers.

  • Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies.

  • Working directly with C-level executives.

  • Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Leading high-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.).

  • Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor.

  • Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future.

  • Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision.

  • Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re willing to experiment with new solutions.

  • Are a strategist. You deeply understand go to market best practices and raise the bar for our organisation. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

title: Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Caseware ist die globale KI-Plattform für Audit und Accounting. Gegründet vor über 35 Jahren in Toronto, nutzen heute mehr als 500.000 Anwender:innen in 130 Ländern unsere Lösungen, und über 36.000 Fachleute weltweit führen Caseware als Skill auf LinkedIn. Als wachstumsstarkes Technologieunternehmen, backed by Hg, beschleunigen wir die Transformation unserer Branche Richtung Cloud und AI, und bauen die nächste Generation von Audit- und Accounting-Workflows. Wenn du in einem Umfeld arbeiten willst, das global skaliert, technologisch vorne liegt und echten Impact liefert, bist du bei uns richtig.

Als Account Executive (m/w/d) bei Caseware wandelst Du Marktinteresse in messbare Ergebnisse. Du gewinnst neue Kunden, baust bestehende Beziehungen gezielt aus und erkennst Potenziale innerhalb deines Kundenportfolios frühzeitig. Mit ausgeprägter Abschlussstärke und einem klaren Gespür für Chancen schaffst du stabile Umsatzströme und nachhaltige Partnerschaften.

📍Es handelt sich um eine unbefristete Vollzeitposition mit Sitz in Düsseldorf (oder Stuttgart) und einem flexiblen hybriden Arbeitsmodell.


Was Du machst:

  • Du treibst den aktiven Vertrieb der Caseware-Lösungen voran, führst beratungsorientierte Gespräche, präsentierst Produkte überzeugend und steuerst den gesamten Sales Cycle souverän. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Marketing, Consulting und Product Management zusammen.

  • Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter, indem du die individuellen Bedürfnisse deiner Ansprechpartner genau verstehst.

  • Du erhöhst den Marktanteil und den ARR in deinem Gebiet, indem du neue Kunden gewinnst, Abschlüsse verlässlich zum Erfolg führst und bestehende Accounts durch Up- und Cross-Selling ausbaust.

  • Du entwickelst strategische Vertriebs- und Account-Pläne und setzt sie konsequent um. Dabei nutzt du bereichsübergreifende Ressourcen gezielt, um Umsatzpotenziale zu erschließen und Verkaufschancen erfolgreich zum Abschluss zu bringen.

  • Du steuerst deine Pipeline strukturiert und diszipliniert und lieferst präzise Forecasts, die klare Entscheidungen ermöglichen und eine verlässliche Entwicklung in Richtung der Vertriebsziele unterstützen.

  • Du stärkst die Marktpräsenz von Caseware und baust dein professionelles Netzwerk aktiv aus, indem du mit wichtigen Entscheidern und relevanten Branchenkontakten im Austausch bist.

  • Du stellst sicher, dass alle Vertriebsaktivitäten, Kundendaten und Vertragsdetails vollständig und korrekt im CRM dokumentiert sind, damit Transparenz und effiziente Abläufe jederzeit gewährleistet sind.


    • Was Du mitbringst:

  • Du kommunizierst überzeugend, trittst souverän auf und schaffst es, schnell tragfähige Beziehungen zu relevanten Stakeholdern aufzubauen.

  • Du hast nachweislich Erfolge in der Gewinnung von Neukunden und im strategischen Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen erzielt.

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im SaaS- oder Tech-Vertrieb mit und hast Vertriebsziele eigenverantwortlich gesteuert und erreicht.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, verlässlich und mit einem hohen Maß an Eigenverantwortung und schaffst damit die Grundlage für nachhaltige Kundenpartnerschaften.

  • Du gehst mit Neugier, Motivation und einer pragmatischen, lösungsorientierten Haltung auf Kunden und ihre Herausforderungen zu.

  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für vertriebliche Potenziale und verstehst, wie sich Kundenbedürfnisse in konkreten Mehrwert übersetzen lassen.

  • Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Audit, Finance oder Accounting sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

    • Was wir Dir bieten:• Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung im Hybrid-Setup: Klare Mischung aus Präsenz- und Remote-Arbeit, gemeinsam definierte Kernzeiten und ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung im Arbeitsalltag. • Attraktives Gesamtpaket: Wettbewerbsfähiges Fixgehalt mit variablen Bestandteilen, ergänzt durch globale und lokale Benefits sowie betriebliche Altersvorsorge. • Internationales Arbeitsumfeld: Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleg:innen aus verschiedenen Ländern und Kulturen, Englisch als Arbeitssprache und verlässliche, strukturierte Abstimmung über Teams hinweg. • Sinnstiftendes Produkt mit Kund:innen-Impact: Caseware unterstützt Organisationen dabei, Audit- und Financial-Reporting-Prozesse effizienter und verlässlicher zu gestalten, mit Cloud- und KI-gestützten Lösungen. • Verantwortung und Entwicklung im Job: Du übernimmst Ownership für relevante Themen, bringst Ideen aktiv ein und entwickelst dich innerhalb der Rolle sowie perspektivisch im Unternehmen weiter, fachlich oder in Richtung Führung. • Healthcare & Wellbeing: Umfassende Gesundheits- und Wellbeing-Leistungen für dich und deine Familie, orientiert an lokalen Standards.
    Über Caseware:Caseware entwickelt Software für Wirtschaftsprüfungen, Unternehmen und öffentliche Einrichtungen. Unsere Teams arbeiten eng zusammen, verbessern bestehende Lösungen und entwickeln neue Produkte, die auf die Anforderungen der Zukunft ausgerichtet sind. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt sind uns wichtig. Wir möchten Teams aufbauen, die unterschiedliche Hintergründe und Perspektiven einbringen. title: Account Executive - France
descriptionHtml:
Prêt(e) à rejoindre la révolution Legal Tech ?

 Vision: Editeur de logiciels SaaS de premier plan, DiliTrust est une entreprise globale spécialisée dans les solutions juridiques et de gouvernance. Notre ambition est d’accompagner nos clients dans la digitalisation rapide de leurs départements juridiques. Avec une croissance annuel à deux chiffres depuis 2020, nous visons à devenir l’un des leaders mondiaux de la Legal Tech. Impact : De la génération de rapports pour les Assemblées Générales à la gestion du cycle de vie des contrats assistée par l'IA, nos équipes réparties dans 8 bureaux à travers le monde (France, les États-Unis, le Mexique, la région MEA, l'Allemagne, l'Espagne, l'Italie et le Canada) sont le moteur de notre succès mondial. Aujourd’hui, nous accompagnons +2 400 clients dans 64 pays, dont 80 % sont des d’entreprises cotées sur les principaux marchés européens, américains et du Moyen-Orient. Reconnaissance: DiliTrust est un pionnier de l’innovation LegalTech, étant la première entreprise du secteur à avoir intégré des fonctionnalités IA dès 2022. Nous sommes également reconnus pour offrir un environnement de travail dynamique et entrepreneurial à nos équipes, certifié chaque année depuis 2019 par les labels "Happy at Work" et "Tech at Work". Votre rôle : En tant qu'Account Executive, vous serez responsable du développement de votre “Territory Plan”, structuré autour de verticales sectorielle (ex : les services financiers, la santé, l’énergie...), composés de clients existants et de prospects. Ce poste représente une opportunité unique pour développer vos compétences en “Solution Selling” auprès de clients prestigieux. Vous serez accompagné(e) dans vos actions commerciales par des équipes dédiées : Business Development Representatives (BDRs), Alliances & Pré-Sales, Account Managers et Marketing.
Vos responsabilités :
  • Elaborer et mettre en oeuvre votre “Territory Plan”, incluant la planification stratégique des comptes clés;
  • Développer et entretenir des relations avec les clients existants et les prospects;
  • Élaborer et présenter les “Use Case” et des propositions de valeur impactantes adaptées aux besoins de digitalisation des clients;
  • Piloter toutes les étapes du processus commercial, de la prospection à la signature du contrat;
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes internes pour maximiser l’efficacité commerciale et la satisfaction client;
  • Représenter DiliTrust lors d’événements majeurs, comme Legal Week à New York;

    • Profil recherché :
  • 4 ans d'expérience réussie en gestion de comptes ou vente dans l'industrie des logiciels d'entreprise;
  • Expérience confirmée en vente de solutions Saas;
  • Track record d'atteinte / surperformance des quotas;
  • Excellente maîtrise des outils CRM pour suivre et gérer l'activité commerciale;
  • Bilingue Anglais (écrit et oral);

    • Compétences recherchées :
  • Capacité démontrée à développer et gérer de manière autonome un territoire commercial, en alignant des solutions complexes avec les besoins spécifiques des clients;
  • Expérience dans la gestion de relations avec des décideurs;
  • Dynamisme, proactivité et forte culture de la performance;
  • Capacité à évoluer dans un écosystème d'interlocuteurs variés;

    • Process de recrutement :
  • Entretien avec un membre de l'équipe TA (30/45 mins)
  • Entretien avec le Team Leader AE ou Head of Sales France (1h)
  • Entretien avec le Chief Sales Officer (1h)
  • Entretien "Role play" (45 mins)

    • Ce que nous vous proposons :
  • Rejoindre une société en pleine croissance dans un environnement International et bienveillant (des bureaux en France, Italie, Espagne, Canada mais aussi Dubaï ou encore Mexico) ;
  • Notre « Charte du Télétravail » qui vous garantit de pouvoir trouver votre équilibre entre « Onsite » et « Remote » ;
  • Enfin, tous les avantages au quotidien que sont CSE, tickets restaurant/restaurant d’entreprise, prime d’intéressement, crèche d’entreprise…

title: Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

As an Account Executive at Ripple Treasury, you will play a key role in our sales team, driving success in a high-growth region. This position offers an outstanding opportunity to work with a world-class team. You will help develop the future of corporate treasury by integrating modern technology with proven financial solutions. 

Your responsibility is to exclusively win new corporate clients for Ripple Treasury. This role requires effective positioning of a curated selection of the Ripple Treasury Platform's core capabilities to each target account, with end-to-end accountability for territory development and full deal lifecycle management.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Achieve new business revenue goals set forth by Managing Director of Europe Sales
  • Win corporate new accounts
  • Develop pipeline consistently across your territory
  • Attend trade shows, industry events, and user events
  • Maintain a deep understanding of your market and its evolving potential
  • Analyse and understand sales growth potential in your assigned territory
  • Stay informed about the treasury industry and competition
  • Collaborate with your manager and sales team to develop competitive strategies
  • Maintain a minimum of 10 days monthly in-office presence

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 

  • 5+ years in New Business SaaS Sales, preferably in enterprise FinTech/Treasury Management Systems
  • Demonstrated large account navigation and complex sales cycle management skills
  • Strong ability to position functionally rich, sophisticated value propositions across multiple business areas
  • Proven ability to execute pipeline generation at scale through outbound, driving and maintaining a 4x pipeline
  • Consistent track record of top sales performance
  • Excellent value based, consultative selling skills
  • Proven organizational and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to travel 25-50%
  • Bachelor's degree in business or equivalent experience preferred

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. 
  • Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

  • Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
  • Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
  • Employee giving match
  • Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

  • R&R days so you can rest and recharge
  • Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
  • Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.

descriptionHtml:

More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. You’ll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 2+ years of experience in outbound business development.

  • 1+ years of experience in a closing capacity.

  • Experience selling a billing tool or similar product.

  • A track record of strong sales performance and hitting targets.

Preferred

You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale.

  • Lucida Medical transferred an AI radiology device to Scarlet in seven weeks and started shipping model updates immediately

Responsibilities

title: Accounting Expert
descriptionHtml:

Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different: - A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries - A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth - Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI - A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently Ready to help shape the future of work? As our new Accounting Expert, you will lead core accounting operations while scaling our financial systems for sustained growth.

You will join the Accounting team within our Finance department, reporting directly to Ramzi, our Accounting Director. You will act as a key technical reference across our local and international entities.

Your mission is to guarantee financial integrity, drive closing cycles toward a consistent, landing, and transform accounting into an automated, scalable machine.


Key responsibilities ✨

  • Collaborate and accelerate the month-end and year-end closing processes (GL, statutory reporting) to achieve a reliable and compliant closing.

  • Drive the automation and optimization of operational accounting flows, bank reconciliations, and complex marketplace/PSP transactions.

  • Participate in group statutory audits and serve as the main technical reference point for auditors and external partners.

  • Strengthen internal control frameworks and procedures across all subsidiaries in alignment with local GAAP.

  • Partner closely with Legal, Operations, and Finance teams to ensure cross-functional alignment.

  • Participate in the enhancement and integration of core ERP and financial tooling (NetSuite) to eliminate manual bottlenecks and boost data integrity.


    • About you 🧑‍🚀

  • Relevant experience (minimum 5+ years) in technical accounting or audit, with a proven track record in a fast-paced or scale-up environment.

  • French on a native level and fluent in english to operate smoothly within an international organization.

  • Strong technical mastery of local GAAP, statutory audit coordination, and balance sheet reconciliation.

  • Proven track record in optimizing ERP systems (Must have NetSuite) and deploying automation workflows, backed by rigorous analytical skills.


    • How to join the mission? 🚀

  • Technical case study, evaluated by Ramzi and the team to assess your technical and operational problem-solving skills. (60 minutes)

title: Accounts Payable & Financial Controller
descriptionHtml:
Als Accounts Payable & Financial Controller ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor de juistheid, volledigheid en tijdigheid van onze financiële administratie — een van de belangrijkste pijlers voor het nemen van beslissingen binnen Crisp. Je combineert de dagelijkse sturing op de crediteurenadministratie met uitdagende controlewerkzaamheden, data-analyses en het automatiseren van onze processen met behulp van moderne tools en AI.

Wat je gaat doen

Je werkt elke dag met een gezellig team vol gedreven mensen. We hebben ervaring in business control, accounting, corporate finance, data analytics, fiscaal recht en auditing. Crisp groeit snel, en de verantwoordelijkheden van ons team dus ook. Zo is geen dag hetzelfde en blijven we onszelf continu ontwikkelen. We sparren veel en staan open voor elkaars mening.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het verwerken en controleren van inkomende facturen en declaraties. Je staat leveranciers te woord, beheert de mailstroom en zet betalingen klaar.

  • Je stuurt een team van werkstudenten en stagiaires aan en zorgt er samen met hen voor dat alle facturen tijdig en correct worden verwerkt.

  • Je ondersteunt bij de maandafsluiting, controleert grootboekrekeningen en helpt mee met ad-hoc analyses en periodieke rapportages.

  • Je denkt actief mee over het slim inrichten van financiële workflows. Je verkent en implementeert mogelijkheden voor procesautomatisering, slimme datakoppelingen en AI-oplossingen (zoals OCR-herkenning en geautomatiseerde factuurverwerking).

  • Je rapporteert aan de Lead Financial Controller, die je ondersteunt in je dagelijkse werkzaamheden en je helpt om door te groeien in je rol.

Dit ben jij

Als ideale kandidaat heb je al een basis aan kennis en ervaring en wil je blijven leren in een vakgebied dat continu verandert en digitaliseert. Je herkent jezelf in het volgende profiel:

  • Je beschikt over een afgeronde hbo- of universitaire opleiding (bijvoorbeeld Finance, Bedrijfseconomie of Accountancy).

  • Je hebt 0-3 jaar relevante werkervaring in een financiële of control-functie.

  • Je hebt ervaring met de crediteurenadministratie en het verwerken en controleren van facturen.

  • Kennis van accountingsoftware (zoals Exact) is een pré.

  • Je bent handig met data en hebt een sterke affiniteit met automatisering en nieuwe technologieën (zoals AI-tools, data-integraties en procesoptimalisatie).

  • Je schrijft en spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

  • Je bent integer, nauwkeurig en risicobewust. Je begrijpt dat een strakke administratie de basis vormt voor goede besluitvorming.

  • Je denkt in kansen en mogelijkheden: je ziet direct waar processen sneller, slimmer of foutlozer kunnen en schroomt niet om dit op te pakken.

Wat wij bieden

  • Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

  • 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden.

  • Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen.

  • Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp.

  • Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL.

  • Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University.

  • Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven.

  • Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor.

  • Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen.

  • En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten.

Onze selectieprocedure

Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter.

Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd.

title: Agentic Marketing Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Growth at Private Equity Insights

Are you excited about solving real, hard problems? Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. You will learn to write copy that makes elite investors act, map the entire market of investors, decide who to target, and deploy AI to outperform a teams of 20+ people.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career, apply.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.

What we offer you

  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way
  • Unlimited growth potential. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our conferences

Your Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will vary; however, some of them will be to:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value to the client.

What we expect from you

You possess an unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency. You have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what you do. You take ownership of everything you do, are proactive and follow through on commitments. Moreover, you’re humble and you share our passion for building and executing new businesses. Furthermore, we expect that you:

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Role is full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week.

Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year.

The start date is flexible.

descriptionHtml:

Die WAITS Software- und Prozessberatungsgesellschaft mbH ist ein IT-Beratungs- und Softwareentwicklungsunternehmen mit Sitz in Köln. Wir verbinden Softwareentwicklung, Geschäftsprozessmanagement und digitale Transformation mit dem praktischen Einsatz moderner KI-Technologien.

  • Sicherstellung von Qualität, Performance und Wartbarkeit der entwickelten Lösungen

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Data Engineers, Softwareentwicklern, Product Ownern und Fachbereichen

  • Einsatz moderner Entwicklungs-, Test- und Deployment-Verfahren

Das bringen Sie mit

Fachliche Anforderungen

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare IT-Qualifikation

  • Mindestens zwei bis drei Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von AI-Agenten oder KI-gestützten Lösungen mit Microsoft Copilot und/oder GitHub Copilot

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit der Konzeption und Implementierung von Copilot-basierten Agentensystemen

  • Praktische Kenntnisse im Data Engineering und in der Entwicklung von Datenpipelines

  • Erfahrung mit ETL-/ELT-Prozessen und Datentransformationen

  • Kenntnisse relationaler Datenbanken, SQL und moderner Data-Warehouse-Lösungen, vorzugsweise Microsoft SQL Server

  • Verständnis von Datenmodellierung, Datenintegration und Datenqualität

  • Erfahrung mit modernen Entwicklungswerkzeugen, Versionsverwaltung und CI/CD

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse und fließende Englischkenntnisse

Wünschenswerte Zusatzkenntnisse

  • Microsoft Copilot Studio und Microsoft 365 Copilot

  • Snowflake als Cloud-Datenplattform

  • dbt Cloud für Datenmodellierung und Datentransformation

  • Data-Vault-Architekturen

  • Microsoft Azure und Azure DevOps

  • Integration von Large Language Models (LLMs), Tool Calling und API-basierten Agentenlösungen

Ihre persönlichen Stärken

Sie arbeiten analytisch, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert. Komplexe technische Herausforderungen gehen Sie eigenständig an und stimmen sich dabei eng mit anderen Entwicklern und Fachbereichen ab.

Sie legen Wert auf wartbare, qualitativ hochwertige Software, kommunizieren verständlich und übernehmen Verantwortung für Ihre Lösungen.

Was Sie bei WAITS erwartet

  • Technisch anspruchsvolle Projekte an der Schnittstelle von KI und datengetriebener Softwareentwicklung

  • Arbeit mit modernen KI-Technologien und Agentenarchitekturen

  • Ein erfahrenes, interdisziplinäres Team aus Softwareentwicklern und Beratern

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte fachliche Zusammenarbeit

  • Remote-Zusammenarbeit innerhalb eines deutschlandweit verteilten Teams

  • Möglichkeiten, eigene technische Ideen und Lösungsansätze einzubringen

Ihre Bewerbung

Sie möchten AI-Agenten nicht nur einsetzen, sondern selbst entwickeln und produktiv in Unternehmensprozesse integrieren?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Bitte senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf mit einer Übersicht Ihrer relevanten Projekterfahrungen ----- interessieren uns konkrete Beispiele für selbst entwickelte AI-Agenten, die verwendeten Copilot-Technologien sowie Ihre Erfahrung mit Datenpipelines und Data-Warehouse-Lösungen.

title: AI Architect - CDI Paris - Theodo
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Au sein de cette practice, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes legacy. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques.
La practice accompagne principalement des scale-ups comme Qonto ou Doctolib et des grands groupes comme Carrefour, Pernod Ricard, Les Mousquetaires, Urgo, Cdiscount ou Edenred. Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit !
Tes futures missions : L’IA générative bouleverse les méthodes de développement logiciel et d’architecture. Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons un·e AI Architect, capable de concevoir une architecture cible et une trajectoire de modernisation IA-powered, en particulier pour des systèmes legacy complexes. En tant qu’AI Architect chez Theodo, ta mission sera de : - Cartographier les dépendances des systèmes legacy - Concevoir une architecture moderne (modulaire, scalable) adaptée à l’IA - Définir un plan de migration progressif et soutenable - Apporter ton expertise dans l’usage des LLM et de la génération de code IA dans les projets client - Tu travailleras avec des équipes produit et tech de 4 à 6 personnes, composées de Software Engineers, Tech Leads et Product Owners, sur des problématiques complexes à fort impact. Exemples de projets IA : - Définition d’une nouvelle architecture logicielle pour un grand acteur public, avec intégration d’un moteur IA pour générer automatiquement des composants front - Migration vers une architecture modulaire d’un backend monolithique dans le retail, en exploitant la génération de code pour accélérer les refontes - Mise en place d’un socle technique pour créer des agents IA internes, interopérables avec des APIs métiers Profil recherché : Nous recherchons un profil senior, passionné par l’architecture logicielle et l’IA générative. Tu as une forte capacité à prendre de la hauteur, modéliser des solutions complexes, et collaborer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires. Tes compétences clés : - Solide compréhension de la théorie du code et des patterns d’architecture - Expérience en prompt engineering (meta-prompts, chain-of-thought, few-shot learning…) - Excellentes capacités d’abstraction et de modélisation Ton background : - Tu es architecte logiciel expérimenté·e - Tu as déjà une immersion d’au moins 6 mois dans l’univers de la génération de code assistée par IA (LLMs, copilots, tooling…)Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

Notre ambition est d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de leur stratégie data ainsi que la recherche et le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle à l’état de l’art. L'entreprise est en pleine croissance : chaque année, Theodo Data & AI enregistre une croissance de plus de 30 % de son chiffre d'affaires, ouvrant ainsi de nouvelles opportunités passionnantes pour les Theodoers !

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Pour participer à la redéfinition de ce que c'est que travailler avec l'IA

  • 5 ans d'avance sur le sujet : Theodo investit massivement sur l'IA appliquée au développement logiciel depuis 2020. Nous ne suivons pas la vague, nous la construisons.
  • Partenariats stratégiques avec Anthropic et Google : un accès direct aux dernières avancées des modèles, aux équipes produits, et aux best practices de l'écosystème.
  • Un positionnement hybride entre conseil et opérations : tu ne fais pas que des slides, tu ne fais pas que du code. Tu construis la stratégie ET tu la mets en œuvre, sur le terrain, avec les équipes du client.
  • Un terrain d'expérimentation unique : nos clients (grands groupes du CAC 40, scale-ups, secteurs régulés) font face à des défis concrets de transformation. Tu seras au cœur de la définition des nouveaux standards du métier.

Ta mission : reconstruire le SDLC avec des agents IA

En tant que Consultant SDLC & IA Agentique, tu interviens chez des clients (scale-ups, grands groupes) pour les aider à intégrer des agents IA dans leur cycle de développement logiciel — de la spec au déploiement.

Tu travailles en binôme avec les équipes engineering du client. Tu n'es pas là pour faire un audit et partir : tu déploies, tu formes, tu mesures.

Ce que tu feras au quotidien

Explorer et comprendre le SDLC client

  • Analyser comment l'équipe travaille : comment les stories arrivent, comment le code est écrit, reviewé, testé, déployé
  • Identifier les étapes où les agents IA peuvent avoir le plus d'impact en termes de productivité ou de qualité

Déployer des agents IA dans le pipeline de delivery

Former les équipes à travailler avec les agents

  • Créer les guides d'adoption adaptés aux différents niveaux (junior dev → tech lead)
  • Être le point de contact de confiance pendant la phase de transition

Mesurer l'impact avec de vrais chiffres

  • Définir les métriques qui comptent (temps de cycle, taux d'adoption, qualité du code généré)
  • Mettre en place la télémétrie IDE et les dashboards de productivité
  • Transformer ces données en recommandations concrètes pour la suite

Profil recherché

  • 5 ans minimum d'expérience en développement de logiciel
  • Diplôme d'ingénieur (ou équivalent grande école / Master en informatique)

Le Partnership Theodo

Chez Theodo, les meilleurs talents ont vocation à devenir Partners du groupe. Le Partnership Theodo, c'est un modèle où ceux qui construisent l'entreprise en deviennent actionnaires et co-dirigeants. C'est un horizon concret, pas une promesse vague : plusieurs dizaines de Partners pilotent aujourd'hui les practices, les entités et les offres du groupe. title: AI Engineer (LLM) - Remote
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to dexter health!!

At dexter health, we build AI-powered software for care teams. Our mission is to reduce administrative workload in healthcare so caregivers can spend more time with patients.

We are looking for a high-agency AI Engineer to help us build new AI features faster and improve the quality, reliability, and speed of existing AI workflows.

This is a hands-on engineering role. Not research. Not prompt-only. You will turn ambiguous product ideas into working, production-ready AI features.

The role is mostly focused on shipping AI product features, with some AI systems and infrastructure work where needed.

You will work closely with product and engineering, but we expect you to take real ownership. You should be comfortable moving fast, making technical decisions under ambiguity, and using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar every day.

Tasks

As our AI Engineer, you will:

  • Build new AI-powered product features from idea to production

  • Improve existing AI workflows for quality, reliability, latency, and user value

  • Design and implement LLM-based workflows, structured outputs, validation logic, and fallback behavior

  • Build evaluation loops, tests, and quality checks for AI-generated outputs

  • Integrate AI capabilities into existing product and backend systems

  • Work with commercial and open-source LLMs without being tied to one specific provider

  • Support self-hosted model workflows where they make sense for quality, speed, cost, or control

  • Debug AI feature failures across inputs, outputs, data, backend logic, and user flows

  • Use AI development tools as a core part of your daily workflow

  • Ship quickly while keeping production quality high

Requirements

We care less about formal seniority and more about speed, intelligence, ownership, and product impact. We like people who operate with founder-like urgency: they figure things out, make progress under ambiguity, and care about outcomes more than titles.

Must-have

  • Strong software engineering skills, especially in Python or a comparable backend language

  • Experience building AI-powered product features or LLM-based workflows

  • Ability to turn ambiguous product ideas into working software quickly

  • Strong understanding of how to design, test, validate, and improve AI outputs

  • Experience integrating AI workflows into production systems

  • Strong debugging instincts across application logic, data, model outputs, and user-facing behavior

  • Experience with evaluation, testing, validation, or quality checks for AI-generated outputs

  • Serious experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar as part of your daily workflow

  • High intelligence, fast learning speed, bias to action, and ownership mindset

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, fast decisions, and a high-trust startup environment

  • Clear written and spoken English

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with frontend or fullstack product development

  • Experience with self-hosted LLMs, model serving, inference optimization, or similar systems

  • Experience with open-source LLMs and related deployment workflows

  • Experience improving latency, cost, quality, or reliability of AI systems

  • Experience with healthcare software, healthcare data, or regulated environments

  • Experience working with structured data extraction, documentation automation, voice workflows, or workflow automation

  • German language skills

  • Knowledge of nursing homes or elderly care workflows

This role is probably not for you if

  • You are mainly looking for an ML research role

  • You are a prompt engineer without strong coding skills

  • You need detailed specifications before making progress

  • You prefer slow, highly structured corporate environments

  • You are mainly looking for management, not hands-on building

  • You want to use AI tools only occasionally instead of as part of your daily workflow

  • You optimize for perfect process over fast, reliable execution

Benefits

  • Remote work

  • Fair compensation based on skills, experience, and location

  • Ownership of important backend systems

  • Work on software used in real healthcare workflows

  • Modern AI-native development workflow

  • Room to grow with the company

Why?

Caregivers spend too much time on documentation, coordination, and administrative work. We build technology that reduces this burden.

AI is core to our product. But useful AI features do not come from demos alone. They need strong engineering, fast iteration, evaluation, production thinking, and deep ownership of the user outcome.

If you want to build AI product features that ship, improve real workflows, use AI tools every day, and take ownership in a fast-moving team, we would like to hear from you.

Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs.

La practice AI Modernisation est l’offre prioritaire du Groupe et porte la vision de Theodo de devenir le leader européen de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel. Notre métier, c’est la migration accélérée par IA de vieux systèmes de legacy vers des langages et framework plus modernes pour réduire les risques business, cybersécurité, de compliance que ces systèmes peuvent présenter. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques.

Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit.

Tes futures missions : En tant que Software Engineer Fullstack chez Theodo, ta mission sera de concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs. Tout au long de tes projets, tu seras accompagné pour monter en compétences et apprendre à écrire du code de qualité, à comprendre les enjeux produit et à intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie d’une application, de la conception au déploiement. Ce que tu vas apprendre en tant que Software Engineer chez Theodo :
  • Comprendre le problème de ton client et y répondre avec un produit performant, maintenable et orienté valeur, en intervenant sur tout le cycle de production, de la conception au déploiement.
  • Produire du code de qualité dans les délais, en intégrant tests, refactoring et standards techniques de l’équipe, quelle que soit la technologie utilisée.
  • Mener des investigations techniques, débugger efficacement et corriger les défauts de manière pérenne, dans tout type d’environnement.
  • Analyser en profondeur des problèmes dans le code pour développer son esprit de résolution de problèmes
  • Travailler avec un LLM pour accélérer les développements
Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :
  • HealthHero : leader européen de la télémédecine, ils souhaitent moderniser leur plateforme française, Qare, en vue d’une fusion avec la plateforme UK. L’objectif est de passer de Loopback2 à Nest pour pouvoir upgrade de Node 10 vers Node 20. Grâce à notre méthode de modernisation accélérée par l’IA, nous passons d’une estimation à 70 semaines sans IA à une migration terminée en 21 semaines et accélérons la vitesse de delivery par 5.
  • Pernod Ricard : souhaitait moderniser une application interne utilisée pour gérer leur campagnes marketing, des millions d’euros en jeu. L’impact de Theodo : 23 semaines pour moderniser complètement l’application de Vue Express vers React Nest avec une réécriture plus pragmatique. Nous avons également effectué la connection à leur nouvel ERP, auparavant impossible sans la migration.

  • Développer des compétences transverses : coaching, recrutement, commercial, management et marketing technique
  • Participer à des groupes d’expertises avec d’autres passionnés (Cybersécurité, Serverless, Performance, GreenIT…)
  • Construire ton parcours sur-mesure pour atteindre tes objectifs : tech lead, senior architecte, évangéliste (spécialiste d’un sujet), CTO ou fondateur d’une entité etc
Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : Nous recherchons avant tout des potentiels plus que des compétences déjà acquises. Si tu n’es pas encore un·e développeur·se chevronné·e, ce n’est pas un frein : ne te retiens pas pour postuler.

title: AI Phone - On-device AI / ML Systems Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About

We are reimagining the phone. AI phones need to be proactive, intuitive, intelligent and low cost. This is a mission critical for rest of the world to adopt intelligence.

There are over 5 billion people using everyday applications such as email, messaging, notes, tasks, and calendars, yet most are not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications and devices that bring intelligence into daily conversations, coordination and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Responsibilities

  • Benchmark model performance on target mobile hardware.

  • Integrate models into Android applications and system services.

  • Optimize inference latency, memory consumption and power usage.

  • Evaluate quantization, compression and model distillation techniques.

title: Analytics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Tired of being told “that’s not your scope”?

Plenty of good analysts hit the same wall: you query the data but never build the pipelines, you’re boxed into one lane, and more scope means waiting your turn. Here, it’s the opposite.

Taptap Send moves billions of dollars a month across 6 of 7 continents. We’re probably the largest, fastest-growing money movement business you’ve never heard of. Cards, wallets, business-to-business payments, institutional payments, and new markets are all launching now, and each needs its data, reconciliations and reporting built from scratch. That’s your work.

The job

You’ll own the external reports the business can’t operate without, then automate them into reliable, reusable dbt models. From day one you’ll work with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product and Data Engineering to make sure every number is modelled correctly.

  • Own external reporting: deliver the datasets behind month-end close and regulatory reporting, on time, every cycle.

  • Automate: turn multi-day manual work into scheduled pipelines, runbooks and dbt models, so it only gets done once.

  • Get ahead of launches: build reports and reconciliations as each product and market goes live, before anyone asks.

  • Be first line for data requests: build models so people and AI agents can answer repeat questions themselves.

  • Keep data trustworthy: build tests, checks and alerts that catch reconciliation breaks and stale data before they become incidents.

  • Share what you know: peer-review code and join our weekly meetups.

Why you’ll want it

Grow as fast as you’re able. We hire for potential, not years of experience. On a lean, talent-dense team, you’ll own real work early and take on more the moment you’re ready.

Go from querying data to designing systems. Data, product or business analyst? You don’t need to be an analytics engineer yet. Build the pipelines behind the numbers, and learn dbt, testing, automation and AI tooling from senior analytics engineers.

Don't get boxed in. Own the reporting, automate it, then take on our biggest problems wherever they sit. Your hiring manager started in Finance and has since worked across Partner Ops, Fraud, Compliance, Reconciliation and Product.

See the whole business. You’ll follow a transfer from the moment a customer taps send, through partner payout and reconciliation, to the report a regulator reads.

Own numbers that matter. Auditors and Finance rely on what you build. This isn’t a dashboard role.

Put more money in families’ hands. Remittances are a lifeline for millions of families and are worth more than all foreign aid. Every report you automate helps us keep transfers cheap and reliable.

You’ll fit if you have

1-2+ years in a data or analytics role

A technical or quantitative degree, or equivalent experience

Strong SQL and experience wrangling messy, complex data

Some experience automating repetitive work (e.g. scripts, scheduled jobs)

A strong sense of ownership: when something is broken, ownerless or late, you step in, fix it, and make sure it doesn’t happen again

Reliability under deadlines, a “no task too small” attitude, and comfort chasing stakeholders

The right to work in the UK

Nice to have: startup or scale-up experience, Python or R, dbt, Looker or Mode, and something you’ve built, at work or on the side, because the manual way annoyed you.

Sound like you? Apply, even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to meet you.

title: Analytics - Future Leaders Graduate Program
descriptionHtml:
Real ownership. Real impact. Build from day one.

Are you an ambitious graduate ready to tackle complex, real-world challenges at the intersection of data, strategy and tech? 

The Future Leaders Graduate Program – Business Analytics at Picnic is a one-year launchpad for exceptional talents. From day one, you join a business team, own a business topic, and become an expert in your field.

At Picnic, we’re building the future of grocery. Using cutting-edge technology and data-driven innovation, we challenge the status quo and build the world’s smartest, most customer-focused supermarket.
We move fast, think big, and turn bold ideas into tangible impact.

Tricks of the trade

  • Lead with ambition: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.
  • Steep learning curve: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll blend hands-on training with immediate execution, you’ll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.
  • Solve real-life puzzles: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.
  • Innovate across borders: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.
  • High-performance environment: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.

From learning to leading

Throughout this one-year program, you’ll own business-critical projects from start to finish right from the get-go, supported by mentorship, learning sessions, and regular feedback.

You’ll strengthen your leadership skills in project management, storytelling, stakeholder communication, and giving and receiving feedback, while sharpening your technical skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.

As your scope grows, so does your responsibility. You might scale your initial project or take on new challenges within the same domain. Either way, there’s always a new challenge to lead and an opportunity to make an impact. That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to grow and lead.

Where you’ll make an impact

From day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:

  • Consumer - Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. Think: Shaping our successful market entry into new cities. Your decisions shape how millions of customers experience Picnic. 
  • Logistics - Build the backbone of Picnics operations. Think: robotic fulfilment, demand forecasting, route optimization across Europe and much more

Your superpowers

You don't wait for permission. You see a problem, build the solution, and bring people with you, before anyone asks. You've probably already started something: a project, a product, a business, an initiative that didn't exist until you made it happen.

More specifically, you:

  • Are about to graduate (or recently graduated) a Masters in a quantitative field: e.g., mathematics, econometrics, engineering, or similar
  • Have experience in high-performance environments: consulting, fast-growth startups, or competitive internships and know what it means to raise the bar
  • Show an entrepreneurial mindset: you build, improve, and take ownership without being asked
  • Think like a builder: hands-on, curious, and driven to challenge the status quo with practical solutions
  • You have already gained basic knowledge in PowerPoint, Python, SQL, Excel or alternative coding languages 
  • EU citizenship or valid EU working permit required.

Many strong candidates (particularly women) talk themselves out of applying because they don't tick every box. If this excites you and you believe you have what it takes, apply. We only hire when we find the right match. That’s why our selection process is intentionally highly selective.

Why Picnic?

  • Grow as we grow. We’re scaling quickly across countries and millions of customers and this is just the start. Grow your impact as we grow; we invest in your path but the driver's seat is always yours
  • Work with other innovators. Work with a driven, energetic team that builds, wins, and celebrates together (think of legendary Friday drinks, our Ski trip and our parties)
  • Kickstart your career. Earn a competitive salary and step into a program designed to launch your long-term future at Picnic

Picnic Perks 

🏆 Rewarding Impact from Day One

You’ll receive an attractive compensation package, designed to reward your ambition, drive, and the direct impact you’ll make from your very first project.

🍎Learning & development 

Our Future Leaders Graduate Program - Business Analytics is designed to offer you a steep learning curve by taking business ownership and end-to-end responsibility early on. You’ll get to learn by doing, while mentored by our Picnic leaders that had a similar journey like you. Next to that, you’ll benefit from other opportunities like Lepaya training for polishing soft skills or Picnic Tech Academy training in case you want to learn new skills other than what you already do in this program. We also offer free access to trained psychologists via our OpenUp partner, and German language classes if you’d like to get your experience in Germany to the next level. 

🗺️Relocation

If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs and a first month's accommodation. 

 🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks 

Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen. We get delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.

⛳All the rest 

At Picnic you get 30 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. We subsidise your Deutschlandticket and with the Lease-a-Bike you can get to work sustainably and healthily. And your phone and laptop are on us, of course.

FAQ

Do I need a quantitative background? It's a strong advantage, but not a hard requirement. If your internships and projects demonstrate real hands-on ownership and data-driven thinking, we'll consider your application. You do need a Master's degree, basic knowledge of Python or SQL, and relevant work experience.

Does the program include rotations? No, intentionally. We believe depth creates ownership, and ownership creates impact. Rather than rotating across teams, you’ll go deep in one area, build real expertise, and gradually expand your scope as your impact grows. If you have topic preferences, tell us during the process.

In what language should I apply? English. Please include your CV and Master's degree transcript or any other relevant test scores (e.g., GMAT)

What are the long-term opportunities after the program? This program is a fast track into a high-impact career at Picnic, it’s an entry point for a long-term future, not a two-year stopover. 

Career paths here are as varied as the people on them. Some grow vertically, building deep expertise and a team around them as their project expands. Others move laterally - from Commercial to Fulfilment, Distribution to Customer, or wherever their strengths and ambitions take them. What they share is real ownership, real impact, and a career they shaped themselves.
