title: AP/AR Operations Manager (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Steuere unsere Accounting Operations und entwickle unsere Finance-Prozesse für die nächste Wachstumsphase weiter.

Black Semiconductor wächst und entwickelt seine Finance-Organisation für die nächste Wachstumsphase weiter. Dafür brauchen wir stabile Accounting-Prozesse, effiziente Abläufe und ein Team, das unser operatives Tagesgeschäft zuverlässig steuert – in unserem HQ in Aachen und über unsere internationalen Gesellschaften hinweg.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst Du die operative Verantwortung für Accounts Payable und Accounts Receivable und sorgst dafür, dass Rechnungs- und Zahlungsprozesse reibungslos funktionieren. Gerade zu Beginn arbeitest Du selbst aktiv im Tagesgeschäft mit und stellst sicher, dass die operativen Abläufe zuverlässig funktionieren. Gleichzeitig baust Du unseren Debitorenbereich auf – einschließlich der zugehörigen Prozesse und der Einführung von SAP S/4HANA Cloud.

Du verbindest operative Umsetzung mit Prozessgestaltung und arbeitest eng mit unserer Senior Managerin Finance & Accounting zusammen. Dabei hast Du den Freiraum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Verbesserungen voranzutreiben und unsere Accounting Operations aktiv mitzugestalten. Dazu gehört auch, digitale Tools weiterzuentwickeln und KI gezielt einzusetzen, um unsere Finance-Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten und manuelle Tätigkeiten zu reduzieren.

Warum diese Rolle?

Mehr als Accounting: Du verbindest operative Finance-Expertise mit Prozessgestaltung und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, wie unsere Accounting Operations heute funktionieren und morgen aufgestellt sind.

Gestaltungsspielraum im Scale-up: Du triffst auf ein wachsendes Unternehmen, in dem Du neue Prozesse aufbauen, bestehende Abläufe hinterfragen, eigene Ideen einbringen und Verbesserungen direkt umsetzt.

Automatisierung mit echtem Impact: Du hast die Möglichkeit, den Einsatz digitaler Tools und KI in unseren Finance-Prozessen voranzutreiben und neue Anwendungsmöglichkeiten zu erschließen, um manuelle Tätigkeiten Schritt für Schritt zu reduzieren.

Nähe zu Finance Leadership: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Senior Managerin Finance & Accounting zusammen und kannst die Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Organisation aktiv mitprägen.

Dein nächster Karriereschritt: Du führst ein kleines AP Team und kannst dich perspektivisch zum Team Lead AP/AR Operations mit wachsender internationaler Verantwortung weiterentwickeln.

Über uns

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Deine Aufgaben

AP/AR Operations: Du steuerst und bearbeitest die Accounts-Payable- und Accounts-Receivable-Prozesse für unser HQ in Aachen und unsere Gesellschaften in Deutschland und den Niederlanden. Gerade zu Beginn arbeitest Du selbst aktiv im Tagesgeschäft AP mit und stellst eine zuverlässige Rechnungsverarbeitung, Kontenabstimmungen und die Klärung offener Posten sicher.

Aufbau des Debitorenbereichs & Prozessoptimierung: Du baust unsere Debitorenprozesse und -strukturen weiter auf, begleitest die Einführung von SAP S/4HANA Cloud für AP / AR und entwickelst bestehende Abläufe mit Blick auf Standardisierung und Skalierbarkeit weiter.

Teamkoordination: Du koordinierst unser kleines AP-Team, priorisierst Aufgaben und sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Team für reibungslose Abläufe im Tagesgeschäft.

Automatisierung & Digitalisierung: Du identifizierst Effizienzpotenziale, entwickelst den Einsatz digitaler Tools weiter und nutzt KI zur Unterstützung und Optimierung unserer Finance-Prozesse, um manuelle Tätigkeiten zu reduzieren und effizientere Abläufe zu ermöglichen.

Zusammenarbeit & Weiterentwicklung: Du unterstützt unsere Senior Managerin Finance & Accounting bei operativen und übergreifenden Finance-Themen und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Accounting Operations aktiv mit.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable oder Accounting Operations

  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Rechnungs-, Zahlungs- und P2P-Prozessen

  • Erfahrungen mit ERP-Systemen; Kenntnisse in SAP S/4HANA Cloud sind ein Plus

  • Erste Führungserfahrung oder Erfahrung in der fachlichen Anleitung und Koordination von Mitarbeitenden

  • Digitale Kompetenz und Interesse daran, KI und digitale Tools im Arbeitsalltag einzusetzen und zur Verbesserung von Finance-Prozessen zu nutzen

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was wir Dir bieten

Entwicklung: Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung für unsere AP Operations. Du gestaltest den weiteren Aufbau unseres Debitorenbereichs und die Weiterentwicklung unserer digitalen Finance-Prozesse einschließlich des Einsatzes von KI aktiv mit. Mit dem Wachstum von Black Semiconductor kann sich Deine Rolle perspektivisch zu einer Teamlead-Position AP /AR mit wachsender internationaler Verantwortung weiterentwickeln.

Beteiligung: Du erhältst virtuelle Aktienoptionen und partizipierst damit am langfristigen Erfolg unseres Unternehmens.

Flexibilität: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit einer Anwesenheit von ca. ein bis zwei Tagen pro Woche in Aachen.

Gesundheit & Zukunft: Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Wir bieten Dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit Versicherungs-, Vorsorge- und weiteren Benefits.

Zukunftsbranche: Arbeite an einer Technologie, die die nächste Generation der Halbleiter-Konnektivität mitgestalten soll.

Unsere Kultur

Menschen vor Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität der Schlüssel - wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ein, damit Karrieren sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind menschenzentriert, damit Du Dich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren kannst.

Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial ist unsere Priorität. Wir bieten Dir die nötige Autonomie, um etwas zu bewirken, und fördern Dein Wachstum durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in Deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion sind die Eckpfeiler unserer Kultur. Wir praktizieren Offenheit und fördern Vertrauen und Respekt. Individualität ist unsere kollektive Stärke, die uns zu Innovationen antreibt und uns voranbringt.

Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen. Wir ermutigen qualifizierte Personen mit beliebigem Hintergrund, sich zu bewerben. Wir fördern ein integratives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, das Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und Wachstum schätzt. Schließ Dich unserem Team an und werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das in der Branche etwas bewirken will.

Kannst Du Dich in dieser Rolle und in unserem Unternehmen wiederfinden? Let's connect.

title: API Consultant (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About Us

We are a fast-growing data-as-a-service provider helping businesses access high-quality business data via a robust REST API. Our platform is trusted by many leading companies in their filed to power intelligent decisions, automation, and AI applications. We are now expanding our sales team with a technically skilled API Consultant to help customers succeed from day one.

Your Role

As an API Consultant, you will be responsible for ensuring customers achieve rapid and sustained success with our API and MCP solution, and just as importantly, for making them excited about it. You will be the face of Statista Connect in front of customers: pitching the solution, building and demoing custom agents live, and turning technical capability into a compelling story that wins hearts and budgets. You'll guide customers from initial setup to advanced use cases, drive adoption by crafting tailored prompts and agents, and help them seamlessly integrate our API solution into their workflows.

This is a hybrid role where technical expertise meets showmanship. If you light up when you get to demo something you built and watch a customer's eyes widen, this role is for you. If presenting to customers feels like a chore you'd rather delegate, it is not.

Key responsibilities

  • Pitching & Demoing (core of the role): Deliver compelling pitches and live demos of Statista Connect to prospects and customers, from analysts to C-level. Independently build and iterate on demo agents, prompts, and workflows tailored to each customer's use case — and use them to create genuine excitement and "I need this" moments in every meeting.

  • Customer Adoption & Enablement: Guide customers from initial setup to advanced use cases with tailored prompts, agents, onboarding flows, documentation, and tutorials — carrying the excitement from the pitch through to daily usage.

  • Data-Driven Engagement: Use product usage data, API analytics, and customer health scores to spot adoption blockers and expansion opportunities, and act on them with proactive guidance, lifecycle outreach, and new pitch angles.

  • Integration Success: Ensure smooth API integrations, resolve blockers quickly, document best practices, and collaborate with engineering on technical challenges.

  • Commercial Support: Identify upsell and expansion opportunities and support sales teams with demos and technical storytelling in renewal and growth conversations.

  • Feedback Loop: Share insights from pitches, demos, and usage data with product and engineering to sharpen the pitch, refine demo agents, and shape the roadmap.

What We're Looking For

  • A Genuine Love of Pitching: Presenting energizes you rather than drains you, you've delivered demos or pitches before and seek out more. (If this doesn't describe you, this role won't be a good fit, and that's okay.)

  • Builder & Storyteller: You prototype agents, workflows, and prompts yourself, hands-on, and know how to turn technical capability into a business value narrative with maximum "wow."

  • API & Integration Experience: Background with API solutions, data integrations, or developer tools, comfortable with REST APIs, JSON, and authentication methods (OAuth, API keys).

  • Customer-Facing Technical Experience: Prior role as Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Developer Advocate, Technical Consultant, or pre-sales-oriented CS, with proven success winning over customers.

  • Analytical & Communicative: Comfortable using product data and health scores to drive decisions, and able to explain technical concepts in a simple, engaging way to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.

  • Problem-Solver: Quick to identify and resolve adoption blockers and guide customers through technical challenges.

  • Fluent proficiency in German

  • Bonus: Pre-sales or solution-selling experience, data pipelines, research background, B2B data solutions, or PLG environment experience.

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Role: Play a key role in customer success and product adoption, directly impacting customer experience and business outcomes.

  • Innovative API Solution: Work with a cutting-edge API / MCP solution at the forefront of the data industry, solving real-world challenges for customers.

  • Collaborative Team: Be part of a passionate, fast-moving team where cross-functional collaboration is at the core of what we do.

  • Growth Opportunities: Shape the customer journey, influence product strategy, and contribute to the company’s expansion while advancing your own career.

  • Competitive Benefits: Enjoy a competitive salary, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities for professional development.

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

title: Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward engineers to be part of our early team at Resonance in Berlin. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent, and we're building our Berlin hub to serve clients across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As an Applied AI Engineer in Berlin, you’ll build the production AI systems behind Resonance’s client engagements across DACH, driving a dramatic acceleration in productivity or a step change in growth for our key clients. You will work at the AI frontier alongside Senior AI Engineers, owning features, integrations and evals end to end. You’ll build and ship agentic systems, from agents and MCP servers into client systems to retrieval and the product around them, working across the stack from data pipelines and the AI layer to the client’s core systems and the interfaces people use. You’ll build evals and observability from day one, take features from first prototype to production, and deploy and extend what we build inside client environments, shipping at pace with the latest AI coding tools. You’ll grow with the firm by contributing to Resonance’s own AI products and shared platform, turning what you learn on each build into reusable components, and taking on more ownership as you grow.

What we’re looking for: You have extreme agency and a bias for action, thrive on ambiguity, and are AI-obsessed, getting hands-on with new models and tools the day they hit the market. You typically have up to four years building software at a startup, a scale-up, a fast-moving product team or your own company. title: Assistant Financial Controller
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Reporting to Sarah Phillips, you’ll own month-end for Flock’s finance team and strengthen the controls around it, running the close and producing the variance analysis and MI that FP&A and our senior team use for budgeting and reporting. We’re automating finance on our new platform and the team uses AI every day, so there’s plenty of room to improve how the work gets done as well as doing it.

It suits a recently qualified accountant with strong core accounting from practice, who has already improved a process or control somewhere and wants to keep growing within the finance team.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the month-end close from start to finish so it lands accurately and on time.

  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and post journals, keeping the ledger clean and well evidenced.

  • Run variance analysis and build the monthly MI pack, explaining what moved and why.

  • Strengthen our financial controls and automate manual steps wherever you find them.

  • Prepare our VAT returns and assist with group reporting.

  • Work with FP&A so the numbers behind budgets and senior reporting are right.

  • Support the annual audit and work alongside our external auditors.

  • Use AI tools in your daily work to speed up reconciliations, analysis and reporting, and share what works with the team.

  • Pick up ad hoc finance projects, including R&D tax claims if you have the experience.

 

What you’ll need

  • An ACA qualification, ideally recently qualified, although we’ll also consider strong ACCA or CIMA candidates.

  • A practice background with hands-on month-end experience, whether from non-audit client work or time in industry. Big 4 or not makes no difference to us.

  • Solid core accounting and close attention to detail, including balance sheet reconciliations, journals and variance analysis.

  • Experience strengthening financial controls or improving a finance process, with an example you can talk us through.

  • Curiosity and ambition, with the drive to push things forward and keep learning.

  • An interest in AI. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should already be using it at work or in your own time and want to do more with it.

Nice to have:

  • Audit experience.

  • Experience using NetSuite.

  • Experience automating finance processes.

  • Exposure to R&D tax claims.

  • Experience in the tech sector.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

 

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

title: Backend Engineer – Real-Time Video
descriptionHtml:
About Stream

Stream powers real-time Chat, Video, Activity Feeds, and AI Moderation for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience.

The role

We're looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the technical direction of Stream Video's media plane and the infrastructure it runs on.

This is a full-time role, hybrid with 3 days a week in our Amsterdam office, or remote from anywhere in the EU.

What you'll work on

Stream Video runs on an SFU we built in Go on top of Pion, plus ingest and recording fleets, all on a global edge network we own across more than one cloud. Nobody at Stream has owned this media plane end to end before. Our central infrastructure team is tuned for request-based services, and video breaks in different ways: live sessions can't be dropped, bandwidth is the biggest cost, and placement is the main lever. That's why this is a Staff role. You'll set the direction for the video backend and its infrastructure with your own roadmap, reporting to our Director of Engineering with a direct line to our CTO. The Video SDK teams own the client side, and you'll work closely with them and with infrastructure. Part of the fleet is mid-move to Kubernetes.

Job responsibilities:

  • Architecture: write the architecture and roadmap for Stream Video's backend and media infrastructure, and decide what ships.

  • Scale livestreaming: architect the SFU and media pipeline (WHIP, WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, SVC), including the path from WebRTC to CDN-backed HLS for very large audiences.

  • Own the fleet: reliability, autoscaling, placement, rollouts, observability and cost for long-lived sessions across clouds, with cost per gigabyte as a first-class metric.

  • Gate production changes: define the validation that decides which changes, including AI-generated ones, reach live media, using behaviour tests on realistic networks, nightly telemetry scans and a public quality benchmark.

  • Take the final escalation: handle the hardest quality, latency and production incidents, and work with enterprise customers on advanced integrations.

  • Raise the bar: mentor senior engineers through design review, code review and hiring.

About you

You've owned systems where a dropped session or a bad rollout is visible to users within seconds, and you think about cost and reliability as much as features. You'd rather write the hard design doc than wait for one. A founder background is an asset here. The team is small, so you'll still write and review plenty of code. If you're looking for a large organisation with a platform team to hand problems to, or a management track, this role won't suit you.

You have:

  • Extensive backend engineering experience, including significant time owning architecture for high-scale production systems

  • Expert proficiency in Go or an equivalent systems language (Rust, C++, Java)

  • A track record owning real-time, stateful or latency-sensitive systems at very high scale

  • Deep knowledge of distributed systems and networking: failure modes, placement, capacity planning and cost

  • Strong experience with real-time media or streaming: WebRTC, SFU/MCU concepts, RTP/RTCP, DTLS, or RTMP, SRT and HLS

  • Clear written communication: design docs and RFCs that others can act on

  • Hands-on experience adopting AI coding and agent tools, and judgement on how to make them safe in production

Bonus points:

  • Built or operated an SFU, or contributed to Pion or another WebRTC stack

  • Moved a stateful fleet to Kubernetes, or ran media workloads across more than one cloud

  • Knowledge of bandwidth estimation, congestion control, simulcast, SVC and codecs (Opus, VP8/VP9, AV1)

  • CockroachDB/PostgreSQL, RocksDB, Raft and Redis at scale

  • Experience at developer tooling, API or SDK companies

  • Founder or early-stage startup experience building real-time products

  • Python or Rust alongside Go

  • Conference talks, technical writing or notable open-source work in real-time media

What makes this role exciting

  • Scope: the infrastructure direction for video is yours to run as a product, with the authority to decide what ships.

  • Impact: Video is Stream's most complex product, and many customers run it alongside Chat, Feeds and Moderation, so this work matters across the company.

  • Stack: Go, Pion, WebRTC, WHIP/WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, Protobuf, CockroachDB/Postgres, RocksDB, Raft and Redis, with Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT Codex in daily use.

  • Starting point: a concrete first 90 days. Ship a validation gate on every infrastructure change that reaches production media, and move part of the fleet to Kubernetes with a cost-per-gigabyte number attached.

Why join Stream?

We're a Series B company with offices in Boulder, Amsterdam, Skopje and Toronto, and a team of 140+ people from 37 nationalities. We're backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston-Werner (co-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co-founder of Algolia).

We'll be straight with you: a startup is more demanding than a large company. There's no fixed playbook, you'll own things end to end, and you'll sometimes pick up work outside your title. That's also what makes it a fast place to grow. If you want real ownership and high scale more than structure and a set career ladder, you'll feel at home here.

What we offer

  • Company equity

  • 28 days paid time off plus Dutch public holidays

  • Pension plan with a company contribution

  • NS Business Card or a company bike, covered

  • Personal development budget of EUR 500 per year

  • Catered lunches in the office

  • MacBook Pro

  • Up to EUR 60 a month toward a gym or sports club membership of your choice

  • Highly skilled migrant (kennismigrant) visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're moving to Amsterdam

This list applies to Netherlands-based employees and is adjusted to your location of residence. If you work remotely from another EU country, you'll be employed through our Employer of Record partner and get company equity plus local benefits depending on your country of employment.

Our culture

Stream is a casual, transparent team that aims high and supports each other. In engineering, we care about ownership and quality, and our goal is to ship stable software. Management stays hands-on, with less middle management and more time spent doing the work. If that sounds like the environment you want next, apply now.

Stream is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on skills and experience, and we don't discriminate based on age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief, political opinion, disability or chronic illness, marital status, working hours, type of contract, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an adjustment at any point in our hiring process, let us know.

Hybrid office policy: applicants based (or relocating to) one of our office locations are expected to work according to the applicable local office attendance policy.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

title: Business Development Representative
descriptionHtml:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

Being a BDR at incident.io means learning to sell from some of the best in the business, while representing a product and account team that make every conversation an easy one to be proud of.

What that looks like day to day

Cold calling is the heart of this role, and most of our meetings get booked over the phone - not because it's easy, but because it's still the fastest way to build real trust with a prospect. We don't copy-paste templates, and we don't spam: every call and every piece of outreach is backed by careful research and planning alongside the AEs you partner with, so the person on the other end knows you're not a random dial.

We're founded by engineers, and that shows up in how BDRs work too, everyone gets unlimited Claude tokens, and our head of business development is a former RevOps leader himself, so there's a real emphasis on testing, measuring, and optimizing your own workflow like an engineer would, not just running the same script on repeat.

BDRs are the bench for our wider GTM team, and your progress here matters beyond just you, it's how we keep the whole GTM engine strong. The path to AE is real, and for those who put in the work, that next step can come faster than you'd expect elsewhere - with the strength of the peer group you're learning from making all the difference.

Who you are

  • You've got a strong why. Whatever got you here - sport, a career switch, a BDR track record that deserved the promotion you didn't get last time, you know exactly what you're chasing, and that's what gets you through the hard days.

  • Cold calling doesn't scare you. A "no" doesn't ruin your afternoon, it's just the next dial.

  • You're genuinely curious about people. You want to know what's keeping a VP of Engineering up at night, not just whether they'll take a meeting.

  • You can write. Not novels, just outreach someone actually wants to open and reply to.

  • You run toward the hard thing. Given the choice between the easy route and the challenging one, you take the challenging one, because you know that's where the bigger payoff is.

  • You're always looking for a better way to work, and that includes using AI properly, testing new tools and workflows, not just running the same playbook because it's familiar.

  • Startup life suits you. Things change, the odd thing is on fire, and you're fine figuring it out as you go with people around to help.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover — we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

title: Business Systems Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Akur8 is a fast-growing InsurTech scale-up on a mission to help insurers make better decisions, faster.

Our SaaS platform turns complex risk data into clear, transparent insights, enabling teams to price risk accurately today and anticipate claims tomorrow.

Powered by advanced analytics and transparent machine learning, Akur8 brings speed, reliability, and clarity to critical insurance decisions — developed by multidisciplinary teams in product, engineering, and actuarial expertise.

Recognized globally, Akur8 has been featured in:

  • CB Insights’ Insurtech 50 (2025)

  • CNBC’s InsurTech Top 150 (2025)

  • InsurTech100 Global Insurtech Top 100 (2025)

  • Professional Equality Index 97/100 (2025)

With 40+ nationalities across 8 global offices, we serve 320+ clients across 4 continents — scaling rapidly in mature insurance markets.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer, assessing all applications fairly based on skills, experience, and potential. Diversity, equality, and inclusion are core to who we are.

You will join Akur8’s Corporate Development team and report to the Business Systems Manager. Akur8 is growing quickly, and our teams need processes, tools and data practices that can keep pace. The Corporate Development team works across the company to support this growth and help our teams work more effectively. As Business Systems Analyst, you will help shape the tools and processes. Your main focus will be Salesforce, alongside tools such as Gong, HubSpot and other applications in our internal stack.

You will work closely with business teams to understand how they work, identify where improvements can be made and turn their needs into practical technical solutions. Over time, you will take increasing ownership of the systems and processes you support.

Why this role matters

With AI, tools and processes evolve fast. We can now build better applications, faster.

We are a scale up that evolves quickly, and you will act directly on the implementation of key departments' processes and ways of working.

In this context this role is central: being the link between business, ideas and software best practice is what will maintain the success of our teams.

Your goal is to help the sales and marketing teams optimize, innovate and make their ideas (and yours) possible, while keeping our application ecosystem coherent.

This will include, but not be limited to, the following responsibilities:

  • Understanding team processes and requirements, identifying gaps and helping stakeholders define clearer ways of working.

  • Translating business needs into clear functional requirements and practical technical solutions.

  • Configuring and implementing new features, processes and tools, while developing your knowledge of relevant technologies.

  • Creating user documentation, training teams and supporting the adoption of new features and processes.

  • Answering questions, investigating issues and identifying opportunities for further improvements.

You will work closely with and receive guidance from the Business Systems Manager. This role offers the opportunity to develop from supporting business systems projects to taking ownership of key applications and processes across Akur8.

This role is based in our Paris office.

We’re looking for someone with a rigorous and curious mindset, and a proven ability to help teams improve and scale their ways of working.

EDUCATIONAL / PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

  • You have 1+ years of experience (including internships/apprenticeships) where you were involved in IT projects functionally and/or technically.

  • You graduated from a Master in engineering school, or management school with IT specialisation, or equivalent.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

  • You have a good understanding of data modelling, and are able (or willing to learn) to read and understand code logic.

  • Salesforce knowledge is welcomed, but what matters is that you understand the automation you build.

SOFT SKILLS

  • You are organized, thorough and able to think clearly through complex topics.

  • You listen carefully, synthesize information and turn detailed analysis into clear, actionable plans that you can help drive forward.

  • You communicate clearly with different stakeholders and can explain complex topics in a practical way.

  • You take ownership of your work and operate with a high degree of autonomy.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills in both French & English and are happy working in a multicultural environment

IMPORTANT: You must possess an employment status that will allow work from our Paris office.

As a newcomer, you'll be joining a diverse, highly skilled and motivated team, with a strong Tech DNA, colleagues that are eager to share their knowledge and passion.

We care about strong teamwork and a positive day-to-day environment. The team regularly connects through optional activities such as team lunches, sports, karaoke, or occasional after-work gatherings.

In addition to this, we will provide you with:

  • Competitive salary + annual bonus

title: CDI -  Junior Digital & Data Marketing Consultant – Paris
descriptionHtml:
Qui sommes-nous?

Artefact est une nouvelle génération de société spécialisée dans le conseil en data et en marketing digital data-driven, dont les 2500 employés répartis sur 27 pays ont pour mission de transformer les données de nos clients en impact business tangible.

La société est née en France en 2014 et à connu une croissance forte, sur son métier historique, le conseil data marketing, mais aussi progressivement sur tous les cas d’usages data appliqués à l’entreprise. Artefact est soutenu par des investisseurs de premier plan (Cinven), européens, et qui visent à bâtir un leader mondial dans son secteur.

Le département Digital & Data Marketing d’Artefact 

Au sein des bureaux parisiens, l’équipe Digital & Data Marketing d’Artefact France est composée de 65 consultants dont le rôle est de construire les stratégies digital marketing les plus adaptées aux enjeux de nos clients, de les déployer et d’en mesurer la performance. 

En fonction des besoins des clients, nous aurons un rôle de conseil (stratégie, diagnostic de performance, modèle opérationnel, feuille de route, …) et/ou un rôle de mise en oeuvre avec les opérations de campagne et le déploiement de mesure du ROI (attribution/incrémentalité/MMM)

Ces projets s’appuient sur une expertise complète des canaux marketing et des plateformes en Paid Social, Paid Search, Programmatique, Retail media, mais aussi sur une expertise avancée et en plein développement du GEO.

Qui recherchons-nous ?

Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons pour accompagner notre croissance un(e) consultant(e) digital & data marketing.

Responsabilités principales

Le/La consultant(e) digital & data marketing pilote, avec une large autonomie, des projets complets de bout en bout. Localisé dans des équipes chez le client ou dans nos bureaux parisiens, il/elle sera supervisé/e par un n+1 (manager, directeur, partner) et il/elle sera amené(e) à possiblement encadrer les consultants juniors.

Pilotage d’un ou plusieurs streams projet

  • Assurer le delivery d’une mission
  • Identifier les points de blocage et identifier des pistes de résolutions
  • Fournir des feedbacks constructifs aux membres plus juniors de l'équipe

Production des livrables de mission

  • Produire de manière autonome des présentations (benchmarks, études de cas/marché, workshops decks, sections steerco) en collaboration horizontale avec les équipes d’experts (Paid Social, Paid Search, …)
  • Rédiger des storylines (messages clés, contenu, stratégie média / d’activation / marketing...)
  • Préparer et animer les interviews et workshops.

Conduite de la relation client

  • Construire une relation de confiance avec les clients en garantissant une qualité de livrables best-in class
  • Démontrer de l'assurance dans les situations d’appel d’offres
  • Identifier de potentielles opportunités business 

Profil :

  • Vous avez 3 à 4 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans un cabinet de conseil ou agence digital & data marketing
  • Vous avez un profil avec une culture ‘business’ x ‘data’ x ‘marketing’ 
  • Vous êtes curieux(se) et passionné(e) par les sujets liés à la data, au marketing, et à l’évolution technologique.
  • Vous avez un état d'esprit analytique et aimez résoudre des problèmes. 
  • Une expérience avec les outils digitaux sera appréciée : Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Business Manager, TikTok Ads, etc
  • Une excellente communication (écrite / orale) en Français et en Anglais est obligatoire. 

Package de rémunération : 42k€ fixe à 50k€ fixe + 4k de variable

Process de recrutement : 

  1. HR
  2. Entretien technique, un(e) Manager ou Directeur + Partner

Inclusion et diversité : 

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.

title: CFO (Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung)
descriptionHtml:
Das Universitäre Zentrum für Zahnmedizin Basel (UZB) vereint Patientenbehandlung, akademische Lehre und Forschung unter einem Dach. Mit rund 300 Mitarbeitenden, rund 100'000 Behandlungen pro Jahr und einem Umsatz von ca. CHF 40 Mio. erbringt das UZB seine Leistungen unter anderem auf Basis von Leistungsaufträgen mit der Universität Basel und dem Kanton Basel-Stadt. Wir suchen eine oder einen CFO mit überzeugenden betriebswirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Kenntnissen. Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung ist neben dem Finanzwissen auch unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln gefragt, um das Unternehmen gesamtheitlich zu steuern und weiterzuentwickeln.

Ihre Verantwortung

  • Sie verantworten die finanzielle Führung des UZB – von der Budget-, Liquiditäts- und Finanzplanung über das Rechnungswesen und die Rechnungslegung nach Swiss GAAP FER bis hin zum Controlling – und stellen ein aussagekräftiges, stufengerechtes Reporting an unsere Leitungserbringer, die Geschäftsleitung und den Verwaltungsrat sicher.

  • Sie sichern die Finanzierung und Liquidität, entwickeln das Risikomanagement und das interne Kontrollsystem weiter und sind Ansprechperson für den Prüfungsausschuss des Verwaltungsrats und die Revisionsstelle.

  • Sie führen und entwickeln die Bereiche Finanzen (rund 10 Mitarbeitende), IT (3), Technischer Dienst (3) und Einkauf mit vier direkt unterstellten Führungspersonen und fördern die Zusammenarbeit über Fachgrenzen hinweg.

  • Sie bringen die Digitalisierung und Weiterentwicklung von Abläufen und Systemen voran und entscheiden bei der laufenden Evaluation einer neuen ERP-Lösung massgeblich mit.

  • Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung tragen Sie auch die gesamtunternehmerische Verantwortung mit und bringen sich in Fragen der Unternehmensentwicklung aktiv ein.

  • Sie beraten die CEO und die Geschäftsleitung als Sparringpartner in allen betriebswirtschaftlichen Fragen und erarbeiten Business Cases für neue Angebote und Projekte.

  • Sie schaffen Entscheidungsgrundlagen für den Dialog mit internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen in einem öffentlich-rechtlich geprägten Umfeld und pflegen den Kontakt zu den relevanten Stakeholdern.

Ihr beruflicher Hintergrund

  • Sie verfügen über substanzielles Know-how in Finanzen und Controlling sowie über Erfahrung in einer verantwortlichen Finanzführungsfunktion.

  • Sie haben einen (Fach-) Hochschulstudium in Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen oder sind Expertin bzw. Experte in Rechnungslegung und Controlling; Erfahrung mit Swiss GAAP FER und SAP ist von Vorteil.

  • Sie haben Führungserfahrung, sind es gewohnt bei Entscheidungsprozessen mitzuwirken und anschliessend die Entscheidungen in ihrem Verantwortungsbereich konsequent umzusetzen. Sie kommunizieren differenziert und transparent, arbeiten pragmatisch und verbinden finanzielle Sorgfalt mit Offenheit für neue Lösungen.

  • Sie verfügen über stilsichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Sie interessieren sich für Digitalisierung und einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit Daten und neuen Technologien.

  • Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen oder in einer öffentlich-rechtlichen Organisation sind willkommen, doch keine Voraussetzung.

Was die Aufgabe auszeichnet

Das UZB ist eine dynamische Institution: 2016 gegründet und seit 2021 um rund 30 % gewachsen. Unsere Strukturen, Prozesse und Systeme lassen sich aktiv mitprägen. Sie verbinden eine finanzielle Schlüsselrolle mit der Möglichkeit, die Weiterentwicklung einer Unternehmung mit gesellschaftlichem Auftrag aus Geschäftsleitungsperspektive mitzugestalten. Die Position verlangt Nähe zum Tagesgeschäft ebenso wie einen verlässlichen Blick auf das Ganze.

We want to help companies use AI to improve the work people rely on every day. We combine consulting, software development and our own products to make that happen. What excites us is seeing a technical idea become something people can count on.

What you will work on

title: Chief of Staff - CDI - Theodo France - Paris
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.

Présentation de Theodo

Avec ses clients, Theodo conçoit, développe et déploie des produits digitaux ingénieux. Le groupe accompagne les entreprises dans leurs transformations digitales en mobilisant des expertises complémentaires en Design, Web, Mobile, Data & IA, Cloud et Serverless.

Grâce à ses différentes entités expertes et sectorielles, Theodo aide ses clients à concevoir des produits innovants, à accélérer leur développement et à répondre à leurs enjeux stratégiques et opérationnels.

Dans un environnement technologique en constante évolution, Theodo s’appuie sur une forte culture entrepreneuriale, une approche orientée résultats et une exigence élevée en matière de qualité et de satisfaction client.

Contexte du recrutement

Dans un contexte de développement et de transformation continue, Theodo France doit poursuivre sa croissance, renforcer son excellence opérationnelle et assurer l’alignement entre ses ambitions stratégiques et leur mise en œuvre au quotidien.

Pour accompagner Noémie Parker dans le pilotage de ses priorités et le développement de Theodo France, nous recherchons un(e) Chief of Staff, véritable bras droit, capable de faire le lien entre la vision stratégique, les décisions de la direction et leur exécution opérationnelle.

Au plus près des enjeux de l’entreprise, tu travailleras sur des sujets transverses à fort impact, en interaction avec les équipes de direction et les responsables opérationnels. Ton rôle sera de fluidifier la prise de décision, de structurer les initiatives prioritaires et de garantir leur bonne exécution.

Tes missions

Ton objectif : démultiplier l’impact de Noémie Parker et contribuer directement à la performance de Theodo France, en apportant un appui stratégique et opérationnel, tout en garantissant la bonne coordination des parties prenantes.

1. Contribuer à la définition et au déploiement de la stratégie

  • Participer à la définition des priorités stratégiques de Theodo France à 12 mois, en lien avec Noémie Parker et les équipes de direction.

  • Analyser les leviers de croissance, les enjeux de performance et les opportunités de développement.

  • Préparer les revues stratégiques et contribuer à la formalisation des plans d’action.

  • Transformer les orientations stratégiques en objectifs clairs, mesurables et partagés par les équipes.

2. Accompagner la direction dans le pilotage opérationnel

  • Préparer et animer les réunions de direction : définition de l’ordre du jour, priorisation des sujets, suivi des décisions et des actions.

  • Structurer les processus de prise de décision et assurer le suivi des priorités.

  • Anticiper les points de blocage et faciliter la résolution des sujets transverses.

  • Organiser les temps forts de la direction : séminaires stratégiques, réunions d’équipe et moments de réflexion collective.

  • Préparer les supports de communication permettant de partager la vision, les priorités et les résultats avec l’ensemble des équipes.

3. Piloter les chantiers stratégiques et transverses

  • Identifier et structurer les projets prioritaires pour le développement de Theodo France.

  • Définir les objectifs, les indicateurs de suivi, les responsabilités et les échéances de chaque chantier.

  • Coordonner les parties prenantes et accompagner les responsables de projets dans leur exécution.

  • Suivre l’avancement des initiatives, identifier les risques et proposer des plans d’action correctifs.

  • Veiller à ce que les décisions prises par la direction se traduisent concrètement en résultats.

4. Contribuer à la performance et à l’excellence opérationnelle

  • Analyser les indicateurs clés de performance de l’activité et identifier les axes d’amélioration.

  • Préparer des analyses et recommandations pour éclairer les décisions de la direction.

  • Accompagner la mise en place de nouveaux processus et outils visant à améliorer l’efficacité collective.

  • Piloter des projets transverses à l’échelle de Theodo France, selon les priorités identifiées par la direction.

  • Faciliter la collaboration entre les différentes équipes et entités pour accélérer l’exécution des projets.

Tes perspectives

En devenant Chief of Staff, tu seras au cœur des décisions et des enjeux de développement de Theodo France.

Tu développeras une compréhension approfondie du fonctionnement d’une entreprise technologique, de la définition de sa stratégie à son exécution opérationnelle. Tu travailleras directement avec la direction sur des problématiques variées, avec un niveau d’exposition élevé et une forte autonomie.

Ce poste te permettra de développer des compétences solides en stratégie, en pilotage de la performance, en gestion de projets complexes et en leadership transverse.

À terme, cette expérience pourra ouvrir la voie à des fonctions de direction opérationnelle, de direction de business unit ou à d’autres rôles de leadership au sein d’un environnement entrepreneurial.

Profil recherché

  • Tu disposes de 3 à 6 ans d’expérience, idéalement avec une expérience significative en conseil en stratégie, en organisation ou en transformation.

  • Tu possèdes un excellent esprit analytique et sais structurer des problématiques complexes pour en tirer des recommandations concrètes.

  • Tu es organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et capable de gérer plusieurs sujets simultanément, sans perdre de vue les priorités.

  • Tu es un(e) véritable doer : tu sais passer de la réflexion à l’action et obtenir des résultats concrets.

  • Tu disposes d’un excellent relationnel et sais interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés, notamment des membres de la direction.

title: Chief of Staff & Operations
descriptionHtml:
About Agent F

Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.

Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.

We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. This role will shape both the company and the way we work.

About the role

You will run the inside of Agent F. Projects get carried through end to end, the inbox and the follow-ups behind it get resolved, finance and administration simply work, and whatever can be automated internally gets automated, on our own technology wherever possible. The point is leverage: leadership stays on C-level sales, product, strategy and investors, and the company runs smoothly underneath.

This is an operating role with a lot of freedom. Some weeks the most important thing is a notary appointment, a filing deadline or a payment; other weeks it is a project that has stalled, a new hire who needs a proper first week, or a workflow that should never have needed a person in the first place. You decide what matters, you make it happen, and you make sure it does not come back.

You will also lay the foundation for what comes next. We expect to grow quickly. The processes, documentation and automations you build now are what let the company double without doubling its administration. Agent F is its own first customer: our finance operations should run on our product, and you will make sure they do.

What you will build and own

  • Project execution. Maintain the company project list. Every project has an owner, a next step and a date. Chase, unblock, close. Report weekly which projects are on track, at risk or done.

  • Inbox and follow-ups. Triage, prepare and resolve what lands with leadership. Track follow-ups across customers, investors, partners and providers so nothing stays open without an owner.

  • Finance operations. Monthly close inputs for the tax advisor, invoice flows, expense and card management, payroll inputs, cash reporting, VAT and filing deadlines. Automate these flows on our own stack first.

  • The second brain. Own the internal knowledge and workflow system and its AI agents. Every recurring task is automated or delegated before it gets a second owner.

  • Legal and admin operations. Contract templates and signatures, notary and registry processes, insurance, the compliance register, data-protection documentation. Work with external counsel; own the follow-through.

  • People operations. Assist in onboarding new hires, keep the hiring process running (scheduling, candidate communication, paperwork) and handle contracts and equity documentation.

  • Investor and board operations. Monthly updates, data room, KPI pack, meeting logistics; the numbers are ready on time.

For example, a new customer contract, a notary appointment for the GmbH and a VAT filing all land in the same week while the CEO is travelling. You would get the contract signed, the appointment prepared and the filing submitted, and then set up the workflow so that the next contract, appointment and filing need no one to chase them.

What you bring

You have five or more years in roles that combined operating responsibility with structure: startup operations, finance operations, consulting followed by an operating role, or a founder’s office in a scaling company. You have run a function end to end and can show processes that still work without you.

You can explain how you took a messy, recurring piece of work and made it disappear (through a process, a tool or an automation) and what it freed up. You are comfortable with numbers, contracts and tools, and you use AI tools to build automations as a matter of course.

Core experience

  • Operations or finance operations in a startup or scaling company, with end-to-end ownership of a function.

  • German administration and accounting: invoices, monthly close inputs, payroll inputs, VAT and filings, working with a tax advisor.

  • Project management across a company: owners, deadlines, status, escalation.

  • Building workflows and automations with modern tools and AI agents; documenting them so others can run them.

  • Working with external counsel, notaries, banks and providers; contracts and signatures.

  • Clear, short written communication in German and English.

Useful additional experience

Experience in a founder’s office or chief-of-staff role; investor reporting and data rooms; people operations and onboarding; experience with accounting or ERP software from the user side.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would take over the project list and the inbox, get the monthly finance operations running on a fixed rhythm, and automate the first two or three recurring flows. You would onboard the next hires and set up the hiring process so that it runs without leadership attention.

We would look for projects that close on time, an inbox with no orphaned items, filings and numbers delivered on schedule, and a growing list of work that no longer needs a person.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in a company that runs smoothly. When something in operations needs a same-day answer (a payment, a filing, a signature, an escalation that landed with leadership), you handle it or find the person who can, and you stay on it until it is done.

Availability during travel and fundraising phases is part of the role. You keep people informed, close loops and improve the process afterwards so that the same situation needs less attention next time.

How you will work

This is a senior founding role reporting to the CEO, with the freedom to decide week by week what the inside of the company needs most. You will work with every function (sales, engineering, marketing) and with our external advisors and providers. You will use AI tools and our own product to automate your work and remain responsible for the result.

Everyone shares responsibility for the whole company and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus.

The role is full-time and based in Berlin. We work from our offices in Neukölln and Mitte and expect regular presence there. Hybrid arrangements with regular days in the Berlin office are possible in exceptional cases. Fluent German is required.

Start a conversation

Tell us about a function you ran end to end and a piece of recurring work you made disappear. What did it look like before, what did you build, and what still runs without you today? A short written example is enough.

title: Chief Product Officer
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

UFORCE has developed and fielded autonomous systems at exceptional speed in response to real operational demand. As we scale across products, markets, customers, and operating locations, we are looking for a Chief Product Officer to own our global product direction and act as the hands-on integrator across strategic R&D, engineering, manufacturing, operations, customers, Ukraine, and Global markets.

This is not a conventional, process-led CPO role. You will develop deep first-hand familiarity with our uncrewed systems and C2 capabilities and spend meaningful time with products, engineers, factories, customers, operators, and deployed teams. You will maintain real-time visibility across our most important product and programme activity, reconcile differing Ukraine and Global priorities, and personally intervene when critical initiatives are blocked.

You will bring clarity and speed without creating an additional layer between users and builders. You will help UFORCE decide what should remain common across markets, what should intentionally diverge, and how shared engineering and manufacturing capacity should be allocated. You will partner closely with our Hardware and Software CTOs, Manufacturing, Delivery, and commercial leaders while preserving clear functional ownership.

The role is based in London and reports directly to our CEO.

What you'll do

  • Own UFORCE’s product vision, strategy, portfolio direction, and product-level priorities across Ukraine and Global markets.

  • Develop deep, first-hand familiarity with our UxV and C2 capabilities, including their performance, limitations, maturity, configurations, technical dependencies, production constraints, customer commitments, and operational use.

  • Maintain a live, company-wide view of material strategic R&D, product development, customer-specific work, engineering commitments, manufacturing activity, deployments, dependencies, blockers, and accountable owners.

  • Act as the hands-on integrator across Product, Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Manufacturing, Delivery, Commercial, customers, and operators.

  • Make explicit decisions about which capabilities should be common across markets, which should intentionally diverge, and how resources should be allocated when priorities compete.

  • Translate operational evidence, customer opportunities, technical constraints, manufacturing realities, and commercial context into rapid product and investment decisions.

  • Evaluate customer-specific development based on its mission impact, strategic value, commercial logic, resource demand, reuse potential, configuration impact, and lifecycle requirements.

  • Connect strategic R&D to clear product intent, operational or market hypotheses, transition paths, and stopping conditions.

  • Establish lightweight visibility, decision, and escalation mechanisms that improve execution speed without introducing unnecessary process or reporting overhead.

  • Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Delivery, customers, and operators to define intended outcomes and acceptance criteria while keeping requirements development collaborative and iterative.

  • Improve product and programme control across hardware and software, including configuration visibility, versioning, dependencies, readiness, and lifecycle decisions.

  • Engage directly in relevant customer meetings, demonstrations, trials, testing, deployments, factory activity, and field operations.

  • Enter the detail and personally unblock priority products or programmes when execution is at risk.

  • Build only the minimum Product organisation required, hiring high-leverage leaders and individual contributors who strengthen technical-operational judgment and execution.

What we're looking for

  • Executive product leadership experience in defence technology, robotics, autonomous systems, aerospace, advanced hardware, industrial technology, or another integrated hardware–software environment.

  • Experience owning product strategy and cross-product decisions across multiple products, platforms, markets, or operating regions.

  • A track record of rapidly learning technically complex products and working directly with engineers, factories, customers, operators, testing teams, deployments, or field operations.

  • Experience leading urgent, cross-functional programmes and resolving execution conflicts across functions, sites, or geographies.

  • Strong judgment in balancing common platform capabilities with deliberate customer-, mission-, or market-specific development.

  • The ability to make hard prioritisation and capacity decisions with incomplete information—and clearly explain what should accelerate, pause, stop, or remain separate.

  • Experience connecting strategic R&D, operational need, customer opportunity, technical feasibility, manufacturing capacity, and commercial value.

  • The technical credibility to challenge product and system assumptions without displacing Engineering’s ownership of architecture, standards, and technical delivery.

  • A history of partnering effectively with senior hardware, software, manufacturing, delivery, and commercial leaders.

  • Direct credibility with demanding customers and operators, grounded in first-hand engagement and evidence rather than reports alone.

  • A low-ego, highly accountable leadership style and a willingness to get into the detail when the mission requires it.

  • Comfort operating amid urgency, ambiguity, changing priorities, and incomplete data.

  • The ability to operate from CEO and board-level portfolio decisions through to detailed product and programme intervention.

  • Based in London or willing to relocate, with the ability to travel regularly to UFORCE engineering, manufacturing, customer, and field locations and engage meaningfully with Ukraine-related teams and priorities.

Nice to have

  • Experience with uncrewed systems, autonomy, command-and-control software, defence platforms, contested operations, or other mission-critical systems.

  • Experience reconciling product and resource priorities across countries, development sites, factories, customer environments, and markets at different levels of maturity.

  • Experience converting strategic R&D or customer-funded development into fielded, supported products.

  • Exposure to government procurement, export and regulatory constraints, interoperability requirements, and deployment into allied defence ecosystems.

  • Experience managing product configuration, versioning, supportability, and lifecycle complexity across integrated hardware–software systems.

  • Evidence of preserving rapid execution while introducing only the minimum structure required for visibility, accountability, and sound decision-making.

  • Experience building or upgrading a lean product organisation without turning Product into a process-heavy intermediary between users and technical teams.

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

Are You?

descriptionHtml:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're hiring a Client Sales Director to lead one of our Client Enterprise Sales teams in Germany. You will manage and develop a senior team of Sales Managers, providing coaching and mentorship, shaping deal strategy, supporting high-stakes negotiations, and designing complex commercial initiatives. You'll build strategic partnerships with enterprise prospects, leading consultative sales cycles and crafting solutions tailored to their specific challenges.

Beyond team leadership, you'll act as a cross-functional connector, partnering closely with Marketing, Product, Operations, Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success to ensure strategic alignment, remove roadblocks, and accelerate outcomes.

This is more than a job. It's a high-impact opportunity for professional and financial growth, with competitive, performance-based compensation. It's ideal for collaborative, entrepreneurial leaders who thrive in dynamic environments and value long-term customer relationships.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Enterprise Deal Execution & Commercial Acumen: Proven track record of navigating complex, multi-stakeholder SaaS sales cycles, building data-driven ROI business cases, and consistently closing six-figure enterprise contracts.
  • Pipeline Generation & Regional Territory Health: Demonstrates proactive outbound prospecting, tight collaboration with SDR partners, and rigorous pipeline inspection to maintain high forecasting accuracy and predictable revenue growth.
  • Executive Presence & Stakeholder Management: Commands high-level conversations with C-suite and senior HR/Total Rewards leaders, establishing credibility, handling objections effectively, and building lasting strategic partnerships.
  • Cross-Functional Orchestration: Effectively aligns cross-functional internal resources—including onboarding, legal, and product teams—to ensure seamless deal execution and post-sale client success.
  • Product Mastery & Solution-Selling: Articulates Wellhub's market value proposition clearly, translating product capabilities and case studies into bespoke executive solutions tailored to enterprise pain points.
  • Industry Representation & Network Expansion: Actively expands Wellhub's regional footprint and brand authority through targeted networking, industry event engagement, and relationship building within the HR community.
  • Mission Alignment & Culture Contribution: Exemplifies a commitment to workplace wellbeing, modeling sustainable high performance, collaborative empathy, and strong alignment with Wellhub's core mission.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Leadership & People Management: Proven experience leading and coaching senior sales managers and high-performing SaaS teams, cultivating a culture of accountability, operational rigor, and consistent quota achievement.
  • Enterprise Revenue Growth: Track record of driving new business acquisition and closing high-value, complex deals, ideally within SaaS, HR consulting, or corporate benefits environments.
  • Executive Presence & Stakeholder Influence: Exceptional ability to build trusted relationships with C-level buyers, navigate intricate decision-making units, and align cross-functional partners to drive strategic outcomes.
  • Data-Driven Strategy & Pipeline Execution: Highly analytical approach to sales metrics and forecasting, leveraging CRM insights to optimize team performance, identify growth levers, and maintain predictability.
  • Persuasive Communication & Fluency: Professional business and technical English fluency, with strong acumen in delivering executive-level presentations, financial business cases, and consultative narratives.
  • Sales Tech & Modern Prospecting Acumen: High technical proficiency across modern sales stacks (e.g., Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, SalesLoft) to scale pipeline generation and streamline sales workflows.
  • Growth Mindset, Agility & Client Centricity: Proactive, outcome-oriented approach with a strong commitment to continuous learning, client advocacy, and navigating change in high-growth, fast-paced environments.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience leading senior sales teams, driving new business growth, and successfully securing significant contracts with complex organizations and advanced English are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. Our offices are in Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Spain, and the UK. You can work from any office or remotely based in any of these countries.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive 30 days paid holiday per year in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.
