title: Commercial Account Executive, Netherlands
descriptionHtml:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organisations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product,  the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organisations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.  

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results. 

About the role

We are hiring for our second Commercial Account Executive to help grow the Commercial business across the Netherlands.

You will help grow the Commercial business in your market by building strong relationships, creating new logo momentum, and working closely with partners and the wider team to expand Horizon3’s reach.

We are looking for experienced sellers who enjoy building. They should be proactive, thoughtful, and comfortable helping markets develop. They should carry the story well, build trust with customers and partners, and help turn ambition into market presence, new logo growth, and long-term opportunity.

How we work

Our Commercial team comes together in the Amsterdam hub to collaborate, learn from each other, and build community around the Commercial business.

At the same time, we work for and in our local markets. That means staying close to customers, partners, and market activity. Travel in-region is part of the role.

In each market, the Commercial seller, Enterprise seller, Partner Manager, Sales Engineer, and Commercial leader may report into different leaders, but they share collective responsibility for helping the market work well and for making Horizon3 successful in the region.

What you will do

  • Grow the Commercial business in your assigned markets through strong customer engagement, partner collaboration, and good market execution

  • Create new logo momentum and build pipeline in a way that fits the local market

  • Build and manage opportunities with good judgement, clear ownership, and strong follow-through

  • Work closely with partners, distributors, MSSPs, Enterprise sellers, Partner Managers, and Sales Engineers to help the market work well

  • Contribute to partner and territory plans and help turn those plans into action

  • Work across Marketing, Channel, Sales Engineering, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, and leadership to move business forward

  • Bring useful market feedback back into the business

  • Represent Horizon3 well with customers and partners

  • Keep building your capability, product knowledge, and commercial effectiveness over time

What success looks like

Success in this role is about helping the market grow and contributing to a strong Commercial motion in-region.

You will be successful if you:

  • Create new logo momentum and help grow the Commercial segment in your markets

  • Build strong relationships with customers, partners, and internal teams

  • Manage opportunities well and help move business forward with consistency and ownership

  • Become productive quickly and continue to grow in impact over time

  • Bring useful market insight back into the business

What we are looking for

We are looking for experienced Commercial sellers who are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and helping build markets.

Strong candidates will bring:

  • More than 4 years of closing experience in IT or cybersecurity sales

  • Experience in Commercial or mid-market sales, ideally in more than one market or in a regionally complex environment

  • Confidence working with partners, distributors, MSSPs, and cross-functional teams

  • Good commercial judgement and the ability to navigate opportunities with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders

  • Strong ownership, follow-through, and comfort with visibility and accountability

  • Curiosity, coachability, and a desire to keep learning and improving

  • Comfort working in a scaling business where structure is still being built

  • Fluency in Dutch, plus strong English

  • A proactive, builder mindset: someone with a point of view who stays close to the market, works well with customers, partners, and the wider team, and looks for better ways to increase reach, efficiency, and impact

Why this role matters

This is a chance to help shape how Commercial grows across EMEA.

If you want a role where you can help build markets, work closely with partners and customers, and play a meaningful part in how a new category develops in-region, this is that role.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

Perks of Horizon3.ai

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid Work: We a hybrid work model in Amsterdam and require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

title: Consultant senior / Manager - Conseil en transformation, organisation et gestion de projet
descriptionHtml:
Pourquoi ce poste existe maintenant

Ad Valoris change de modèle. Depuis vingt ans, nous aidons des directions générales de Suisse romande, publiques et privées, à voir clair, à décider et à embarquer leurs équipes. Depuis 2025, nous pratiquons le conseil augmenté : l'IA nous sert à comprendre mieux, à aller plus loin, pas seulement à produire plus vite.

Le cabinet est en pleine croissance : de nouvelles directions nous confient leurs enjeux et un deuxième bureau ouvre à Lausanne. Nous cherchons deux personnalités prêtes à rejoindre cette aventure humaine : une équipe dynamique et engagée, au sein de laquelle vous pourrez contribuer au développement du cabinet et tracer votre propre parcours.

Ce que vous ferez

Vous rejoignez le cabinet comme consultant-e senior ou manager, selon votre expérience. Sur un mandat, vous pouvez assumer plusieurs responsabilités ; en particulier, vous concevez la démarche de chaque mandat, vous vous assurez qu'elle répond au vrai problème du client et vous gérez la relation avec lui tout au long de la mission.

  • Comprendre avant de proposer. Lire la situation du client, ses acteurs et ses non-dits, avant d'arriver en séance.

  • Résoudre le bon problème. Remettre en cause la commande quand elle ne vise pas le vrai sujet, et défendre une recommandation engagée.

  • Co-construire et faire avancer. Apporter tôt une première version, la faire travailler par le client jusqu'à ce qu'il en soit co-auteur, et animer seul-e des séances, y compris sur des sujets complexes, dans des environnements exigeants et avec des parties prenantes aux sensibilités diverses.

  • Créer de la valeur pour le client. Mieux comprendre, aller plus loin dans l'analyse et concrétiser : ce qui compte, ce sont les progrès durables que le client constate dans son organisation.

  • Faire grandir le cabinet. Transmettre, challenger et accepter de l'être.

Deux points d'entrée, selon votre expérience :

  • Manager (dès 10 ans d'expérience). Architecte de mission dès votre arrivée : vous cadrez et pilotez des mandats de bout en bout, et vous encadrez un ou deux consultants en continuant à produire. Vous prenez part à la conduite du cabinet : méthodes, recrutement, capitalisation. Trajectoire explicite vers un rôle où vous portez le résultat et la croissance de plusieurs comptes.

  • Consultant-e senior (dès 5 ans d'expérience). Autonome sur un périmètre cadré, vous menez vos entretiens et ateliers seul-e ou en équipe, et vous êtes une référence en conseil augmenté. Trajectoire explicite vers le rôle d'architecte de mission.

Le conseil augmenté, tel que nous le pratiquons

Le conseil augmenté, ce n'est pas utiliser l'IA pour produire plus vite. C'est l'utiliser pour comprendre mieux, sans jamais laisser la production avancer plus vite que la compréhension. Le test est simple : qu'avez-vous fait du temps que l'IA a libéré ? Plus de livrables, c'est de la sous-traitance à une machine. Plus de présence chez le client et plus de profondeur d'analyse, c'est du conseil augmenté.

Ce que nous cherchons

  • Un master ou un diplôme d'ingénieur, et cinq à quinze ans d'expérience en conseil en organisation, stratégie, conduite du changement ou pilotage de programmes.

  • Une pratique réelle du conseil augmenté : vous savez dire ce que vous avez écarté dans une réponse de l'IA et pourquoi, et vous refusez de produire ce que vous n’assumez pas.

  • La capacité à trancher avec une information incomplète, et à ajuster ce choix en avançant, à mesure que la situation se précise.

  • De la fiabilité et de la droiture : vous parlez franchement et vous tenez parole.

  • Pour le point d'entrée Manager : des mandats menés de bout en bout, des consultants que vous avez fait grandir, et des relations de confiance avec vos clients.

  • Maîtrise parfaite du français ou équivalent, excellente plume, anglais courant, allemand un atout. Le tissu romand vous est familier.

Ce que nous ne cherchons pas, pour vous éviter de perdre du temps

  • Un-e senior qui veut encadrer sans plus produire. Ici, tout le monde est en séance, les associés compris.

  • Un-e consultant-e qui vit l'IA comme un outil de productivité, ou qui s'en méfie par principe.

  • Un-e spécialiste d'une seule méthode qui veut la plaquer sur chaque client.

Ce que vous trouverez chez nous

  • Des terrains variés : État et collectivités publiques, santé et services à la personne, assurances sociales, formation et recherche, organisations internationales et ONG, énergie et mobilité, services financiers et bancaires, horlogerie et luxe, arômes et parfums, grande distribution, et le tissu industriel romand, des grands groupes aux PME.

  • Une trajectoire lisible : un référentiel de compétences partagé, un parcours collaborateur suivi, et un budget de formation continue renouvelé chaque année.

  • Un environnement augmenté réellement outillé : centre d'excellence IA interne, outils maison, base de connaissances du cabinet.

  • Deux bureaux, Genève et Lausanne, et une vraie souplesse : télétravail et horaires flexibles, présence au bureau pour le travail en commun, équilibre entre vie privée et vie professionnelle pris au sérieux.

Comment nous recrutons

Trois rencontres, une réponse motivée à chaque étape.

  • 1. Trente minutes en visio pour comprendre pourquoi Ad Valoris, et répondre à vos questions.

  • 2. Une heure avec deux de nos collaborateurs : un échange ouvert sur vos motivations et votre projet professionnel, et sur ce que le cabinet peut vous apporter.

  • 3. Une étude de cas avec la direction, tirée d'une situation réelle : avec l'IA, en temps limité, puis en restitution devant les associés.

Nous nous engageons à vous répondre sous dix jours ouvrés après chaque étape.


Candidature

Envoyez votre CV et, à la place de la lettre de motivation, une note d'une page qui répond à cette question : que devient le métier de consultant quand le client a accès à la même IA que nous ? Dites-nous sur quoi vous êtes d'accord avec notre approche, sur quoi vous ne l'êtes pas, et ce que vous apporteriez au cabinet. Appuyez-vous sur au moins une situation que vous avez vécue. Avec ou sans IA, peu importe : ce qui compte, c'est votre avis.

snipKI sorgt dafür, dass KI bei den Menschen ankommt – dass sie positiv angenommen und produktiv und sicher in den Arbeitsalltag integriert wird. Dafür setzen wir auf KI-Enablement und befähigen Mitarbeitende in Mittelstand und Enterprise, KI wirklich zu nutzen. Was uns unterscheidet: Unsere Formate sind brandaktuell und maßgeschneidert – nicht nur auf Unternehmens-, sondern auf Personenebene.

Unser Ziel: Wir wollen DIE KI-Marke im DACH-Raum werden – wenn Menschen an KI denken, sollen sie an snipKI denken. Das braucht Vertrauen und starken Content. Genau deshalb wollen wir zu einer echten Content- und Medienmarke im KI-Bereich werden. Wir wachsen schnell und arbeiten remote-first.

Wie wir arbeiten

KI ist bei uns kein Werkzeug, das wir für einzelne Aufgaben aufrufen, sondern die Ebene, auf der wir arbeiten. Postfach, Kalender, Ablage und unsere Projekt- und Wissenssysteme hängen über Konnektoren an unseren KI-Systemen, Wiederkehrendes läuft als Automation, und jede:r im Team baut sich die eigenen Skills und Agenten dafür selbst.

Dazu kommt das Tempo unseres Themas. Was in der KI-Welt heute passiert, ist in zwei Wochen kalt. Unser Content entsteht in Tagen, nicht in Quartalsplänen.

Deine Mission

Als Content Lead verantwortest du unseren gesamten Content, strategisch und vor allem hands-on. Strategisch heißt: Du entscheidest, welche Kanäle wir aufbauen und welche nicht, und baust sie dann auch. Hands-on heißt: Du produzierst selbst.

Das ist bewusst keine Rolle mit einem Menschen-Team unter dir: Du führst ein Team aus Agenten und Automationen, das du selbst aufbaust. Die Ideen kommen aus dem ganzen Team, du entscheidest, welcher Inhalt auf welchen Kanal gehört, produzierst ihn und sorgst dafür, dass alles aus einem Guss ist. Du hast den vollen Überblick über unseren Content und machst snipKI als Marke sichtbar.

Aufgaben

Diese Kanäle baust du aus, und die nächsten baust du auf

  • Newsletter

  • Die LinkedIn-Profile unserer Gründer und unseres Teams

  • Den LinkedIn-Unternehmensaccount

  • Unseren neuen Podcast (im Aufbau)

  • Und weitere Experimente mit neuen Kanälen

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du produzierst hands-on: Du schreibst stark, erstellst Bilder und schneidest Videos. Den Großteil davon erstellst du KI-gestützt, aber du bist immer der human-in-the-loop und prüfst alles selbst.

  • Du baust dir die Produktionsstrecke selbst: Agenten, Skills und Automationen, die Recherche, Rohentwürfe, Varianten pro Kanal und Wiederverwertung übernehmen.

  • Du baust unseren LinkedIn-Unternehmensaccount aus und entwickelst die persönlichen Profile von Gründern und Team weiter – und dein eigenes natürlich.

  • Du sorgst für Markenkonsistenz und Premium-Qualität über alle Kanäle hinweg.

  • Du recycelst Inhalte und spinnst sie weiter (z. B. einzelne Content-Pieces aus unseren Studien-Daten) und holst Kunden-Testimonials & Case Studies ein – für Website und Social.

  • Du baust unsere neuen Formate mit auf: Podcast, YouTube & Co.

  • Du hältst unseren Content-Stack auf Stand: Du probierst neue Modelle und Systeme aus, wirfst raus, was nicht mehr das Beste ist, und gibst dein Wissen ins Team zurück.

Qualifikation

So arbeitest du mit KI

  • KI ist dein Haupt-Arbeitsmodus, nicht dein Hilfsmittel: Du arbeitest den Großteil deines Tages in KI-Systemen, nicht daneben.

  • Du hast deine Arbeitsumgebung selbst angebunden: Mail, Kalender, Ablage, Projekt- oder Wissenstool hängen über Konnektoren an deinem KI-System.

  • Du baust dir eigene Bausteine statt jedes Mal neu zu prompten: Projekte und Skills. Und du automatisierst Wiederkehrendes.

  • Du hast schon mal etwas gebaut, das du eigentlich nicht bauen kannst: ein kleines Tool, eine Seite, per Vibe Coding zusammengesetzt.

Kein Muss sind n8n, Make oder Programmieren. Wenn du das mitbringst, umso besser. Wenn nicht, reicht die Bereitschaft, dir Automationen selbst zusammenzubauen.

So machst du Content

  • Du hast mindestens einen Kanal selbst von null aufgebaut, ein LinkedIn-Profil, einen Newsletter, einen Podcast oder einen YouTube-Kanal, und kannst sagen, was der Hebel war.

  • Du denkst in Kanal-Logiken statt in Content-Stücken: Dasselbe Thema braucht auf LinkedIn, im Podcast und auf YouTube eine andere Form.

  • Du wählst Themen nach Relevanz und Positionierung, nicht nach Suchvolumen. Vieles, was wir spielen, ist so neu, dass noch niemand danach sucht.

  • Du arbeitest im Takt des Themas: Ein KI-Thema ist nach zwei Wochen kalt.

Und das bringst du außerdem mit

  • Du hast ein hervorragendes Gespür für Sprache und Kommunikation und schreibst exzellent auf Deutsch.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, greifst Ideen auf und spinnst sie eigenständig weiter.

  • Du bist schnell, pragmatisch und lieferst – auch ohne dass alles bis ins Detail vorgegeben ist.

Nice to have

  • Automatisierung mit n8n, Make oder Zapier, oder eigene kleine Tools.

  • Visuelles und redaktionelles Storytelling, Fotografie, Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Ein Gründer- bzw. Macher-Mindset.

Was dich erwartet

  • Volle Ownership: Du entscheidest über Kanäle, Themen und Produktion, nicht über eine Freigabekette hinweg.

  • Die Chance, snipKI von Grund auf als Content- und Medienmarke mitaufzubauen.

  • Arbeiten an der vordersten Front der KI: Budget für die Systeme, die du brauchst, und keine Freigabeschleife, um ein neues Modell auszuprobieren.

  • Ein ambitioniertes, nahbares Team, das genauso arbeitet wie du, und kurze Wege.

  • Remote-first mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten; Teilzeit (20–30 Std.) oder Vollzeit möglich.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – zeig uns am besten direkt ein paar Beispiele deiner Arbeit (Content, Profile, Videos, Bilder).

Und beschreib uns deinen KI-Setup. Ein paar Sätze, ein Screenshot oder ein kurzes Video reichen: Mit welchen KI-Systemen arbeitest du, was hast du angebunden, welche eigenen Skills, Projekte oder Automationen hast du gebaut, und was davon hat dir letzte Woche konkret Arbeit abgenommen.

title: Content Marketing Manager (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Einleitung

Wir suchen neue Kolleg:innen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Weg zur Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht und einem starken Team aus über 60 Kolleg:innen begleiten wir tausende Mandant:innen erfolgreich auf dem Weg zum deutschen Pass. Alle unsere Stellen sind Festanstellungen bei uns vor Ort in Cottbus.

Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich selbst einen Eindruck auf unserer Karriereseite. Denn wir können hier schreiben, was wir wollen, am Ende bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Wir bieten Dir

Du weißt, was du tust, und willst eine Umgebung, in der das auch gefordert wird. Bei Migrando bekommst du volle Verantwortung für Content-Strategie und Umsetzung, ein Team, das abliefert, und eine Reichweite, mit der sich echte Tests lohnen.

  • Modernes Toolset der Extraklasse
    Ahrefs, Searchmetrics, Screaming Frog, Sistrix oder Semrush: Du wählst die Tools, die du für die beste Analyse und Performance brauchst. Bei essenziellen Helfern sparen wir nicht am falschen Ende.
  • Daten statt Bauchgefühl
    Du bekommst den Raum, Hypothesen aufzustellen, A/B-Tests zu strukturieren und Ergebnisse wirklich auszuwerten. Es geht nicht darum, Traffic zu reporten, sondern zu verstehen, was dahintersteckt und was als Nächstes zu tun ist.
  • Große Reichweite
    15.000 Website-Klicks täglich, davon 6.500 auf Blog und News. Dein Content landet nicht im Nirgendwo, er wird gelesen, getestet und verbessert. Du siehst schnell, was funktioniert.
  • Ein Team, das mitdenkt, und kurze Wege
    Design, SEO, Development, Performance Marketing: Du arbeitest direkt mit Spezialist:innen zusammen, die wissen, was sie tun. Keine Hierarchieschleifen, keine langen Mails. Du sprichst direkt mit Kolleg:innen, Teamleads oder der Geschäftsführung, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell.
  • High-End-Hardware nach Wahl
    Egal ob MacBook oder Windows-Tower, du entscheidest. Dazu 4K-Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset und ein ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz mit höhenverstellbarem Tisch.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf das Leben von Menschen. Du unterstützt sie dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Das ist keine trockene Büroarbeit, sondern Arbeit mit echter Bedeutung.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Teilzeit
    Keine Kernzeiten, keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster. Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell: Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Nach deiner Einarbeitung ist gelegentliches Homeoffice aber kein Problem, auch spontan.
  • Spontan frei, wenn das Leben dazwischenkommt
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend, kurzfristiger Arzttermin oder einfach mal eine Auszeit: Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Modernes Altbau-Büro mit Fitnessraum
    Hohe Decken, viel Tageslicht, Pflanzen und ein Innenhof für die Pause zwischendurch, mitten im Herzen von Cottbus. Unser eigener Fitnessraum im Haus steht dir kostenlos und jederzeit zur Verfügung. Einen Einblick in unsere Räume bekommst du auf unserer Website.
  • Team-Events und Feel-Good-Angebote
    Sommerfest am See, Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner: Wir feiern gern. Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht, und früher gehen ist auch kein Problem. Zwischendurch sorgt unsere Feel-Good-Managerin für kleine Auszeiten, von Nacken- und Schultermassagen bis zu kurzen Entspannungs-Sessions.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

In dieser Rolle gestaltest du Inhalte, die gefunden werden, verstanden werden und konvertieren. Du planst, schreibst und optimierst und arbeitest dafür eng mit SEO, Design und Marketing zusammen. Egal ob Landingpage, Ads-Creatives, E-Mail-Kampagne oder CTAs auf unserem Blog.

  • SEO-Texterstellung & Optimierung
    Du erstellst hochwertige, SEO-optimierte Long- und Short-Form-Inhalte, von Fachartikeln über Landingpages bis zu FAQs. Du schreibst nicht für Suchmaschinen, sondern für Menschen, und weißt, dass beides kein Widerspruch ist.
  • Copywriting
    Du schreibst klare, verständliche Texte für Website- und Service-Seiten, Ratgeber, E-Mail-Strecken und Ads. Du weißt, dass der Unterschied zwischen einem guten und einem sehr guten Text oft eine einzige Formulierung ist.
  • Content-Audit & Optimierung
    Du lässt bestehende Inhalte nicht veralten. Du prüfst regelmäßig Performance, Aktualität und SEO-Tauglichkeit, schließt Content-Gaps und verhinderst aktiv Content-Rot.
  • Conversion-Rate-Optimierung
    Du analysierst, wo Nutzer:innen abspringen, formulierst klare Hypothesen und optimierst Inhalte, CTAs und Seitenstrukturen. A/B-Tests sind für dich kein Sonderaufwand, sondern Standard.
  • Landingpage-Entwicklung
    Gemeinsam mit dem Design-Team entwickelst du conversionstarke Landingpages, von der inhaltlichen Konzeption über den Feinschliff in Elementor bis zur Auswertung nach dem Launch.
  • HubSpot-Marketing
    Du baust Landingpages, CTAs, Formulare und Kampagnen mit den Marketing-Tools von HubSpot, platzierst sie in Abstimmung mit dem Team auf der Website und wertest die Ergebnisse gemeinsam aus.
  • Storytelling & neue Formate
    Du denkst Content nicht nur als Artikel. Du entwickelst neue Formate wie interaktive Ratgeber, Info-Seiten oder Conversion-Elemente und erzählst komplexe Themen so, dass sie wirklich ankommen.
  • Performance-Reporting
    Du erstellst Reports zu Traffic, Rankings, Leads und CRO-Kennzahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

Dein Profil

Bei uns zählen keine Abschlüsse oder Zertifikate, sondern echtes Handwerk und praktische Erfahrung. Wir suchen jemanden, der Content nicht nur produziert, sondern strategisch denkt: Warum sucht jemand nach diesem Begriff? Was erwartet die Person zu finden? Und was muss passieren, damit sie bleibt und konvertiert? Bei uns zählt, was du in der Praxis wirklich draufhast, und dein Verantwortungsbewusstsein.

  • Erfahrung im Content Marketing & Storytelling
    Du hast bereits Inhalte entwickelt, die nicht nur gut klingen, sondern gelesen, verstanden und genutzt werden. Du weißt, wie man eine Content-Strategie aufbaut und umsetzt, und kannst das mit erfolgreichen Projekten oder Kampagnen belegen.
  • Festanstellung vor Ort in Cottbus
    Du möchtest fest bei uns angestellt sein und im Team vor Ort in Cottbus arbeiten. Für Freelance-Aufträge oder reine Remote-Stellen sind wir leider nicht die richtige Adresse.
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und starke Schreibskills
    Du schreibst sehr gutes Deutsch und hast ein sicheres Gefühl für klare, verständliche Sprache, auch bei komplexen Themen. Du erkennst, wenn ein Text nicht das tut, was er soll, und weißt, wie man es besser macht. Gutes Englisch ist ein Plus. Einen Nachweis brauchen wir nicht, deine Texte sprechen für sich.
  • Gefühl für SEO & Suchintentionen
    Keyword-Recherche, SERP-Analyse, Suchintention: Das ist für dich Handwerk, das du im Schlaf beherrschst. Du weißt, wann man ein Thema mit einem langen Artikel angeht und wann eine kurze, fokussierte Seite besser rankt.
  • Praxis in Content-Optimierung
    Bestehende Inhalte lässt du nicht einfach liegen. Du schaust in die Zahlen, erkennst Potenziale und verbesserst Texte, Struktur und CTAs Schritt für Schritt.
  • Blick für Nutzerführung & Conversion
    Du siehst Texte immer aus Nutzerperspektive: verständlich, logisch aufgebaut, mit klarem nächsten Schritt. Du weißt, dass ein guter CTA kein Zufall ist.
  • Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit
    Guter Content entsteht selten im Alleingang. Du gibst klares Feedback, holst dir aktiv Input aus Design, SEO und Performance Marketing und weißt, wie man gemeinsam schneller zu besseren Ergebnissen kommt.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität
    Du wartest nicht auf die perfekte Lösung. Du testest neue Formate, optimierst nach und bringst Projekte eigenständig über die Ziellinie.
  • Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe
    Eigentlich wollen wir hier nichts Generisches schreiben, aber dieser Punkt ist uns wichtig: Gute Zusammenarbeit zählt für uns genauso viel wie Know-how. Jemand, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos läuft, ist im Alltag oft wertvoller als jemand mit noch mehr Know-how, mit dem die Kommunikation aber schleppend ist.
  • Nice to have: SEO-Tools
    Sistrix, Ahrefs, Google Search Console: Du hast damit gearbeitet und weißt, wie man die Daten interpretiert.
  • Nice to have: WordPress, Elementor & HubSpot
    WordPress (oder ein Headless-CMS), Elementor und die Marketing-Features von HubSpot sind kein Neuland für dich, und du stimmst dich ganz selbstverständlich mit Designer:innen in Figma ab.

Now, we are setting a new industry standard for how enterprises around the world manage and optimize payments, with more control, visibility and flexibility than ever before.

Our vision is to reimagine payments from the ground up. We are building a deeply integrated meta layer that spans the entire payment lifecycle with a modular architecture. This helps us give leading brands building blocks to craft solutions to most complex operational challenges, tailor seamless customer experiences and grow their business.

We are backed by some of the world’s top investors including Andreessen Horowitz, HV Capital, EQT Ventures and General Catalyst, who share our mission to simplify payment complexity globally.

At Payrails, we’re committed to building a team of exceptional people - not just talented, but driven to build, solve, and deliver at the highest level. Excellence isn’t just a value here; it’s a way of working. We believe that great people thrive in environments where there’s trust, clarity, and shared purpose. We work openly and collaboratively, with deep respect for each other’s craft. Everyone is encouraged to understand the bigger picture - what we’re building, why it matters, and what stands in the way. When people have that context, they move faster, take ownership, and make better decisions. We care about creating a culture where people feel inspired to do their best work and a deep sense of responsibility to help us bring our vision to life. Success at Payrails means staying focused on the problems that matter most, and executing with purpose.

Marketing at Payrails operates with a fast pace and precision. We move quickly, value thoughtful execution, and aim for lasting impact over short-term noise. We’re ambitious about quality - from the way we tell our story, to how we measure results, to the brand experience we deliver at every touchpoint.

 

You’ll be joining a team of hands-on builders who blend creativity with analytical rigor, and who take full ownership of their craft. If you’re excited by the opportunity to shape how an emerging category is defined and want to experiment, learn, and scale what works, you will thrive here.

What we are looking for


  • You bring 5+ years of experience planning and creating content in fast-growing tech or SaaS companies - with a strong track record of shaping narratives, developing brand voice, and building high-quality editorial systems that drive meaningful business results

  • You’re an excellent writer and editor, not just fluent in language, but obsessed with clarity, tone, and structure

You use AI to speed up the work, but you still apply your own judgment, fact-check, and edit so that everything we publish meets our standards for accuracy, voice and quality

descriptionHtml:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

Hims & Hers is seeking an enterprising, dynamic and highly self-sufficient Counsel, International to join our fast-paced International Legal team.

In this role, you will be a key player supporting our European footprint with a primary focus on Germany, while also driving expansion into new European markets through our international launch function. Operating at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and e-commerce, you will tackle novel legal questions, bring clarity to complex regulatory frameworks, and partner closely with business leaders to build compliant, high-growth healthcare experiences across Europe.

You will be a central operational driver for our German and pan-European commercial, telehealth, and pharmacy strategy.

You Will:

  • Support German Operations: Serve as a key legal advisor on day-to-day matters across Germany advising on healthcare and pharmacy regulations, e-commerce compliance, digital health, and marketing.

  • First-Principles Problem Solving: Untangle complex, novel, or undefined regulatory challenges where traditional precedents don't exist. You will help build legal frameworks using first principles rather than off-the-shelf templates.

  • Deliver Actionable, Concise Advice: Cut through ambiguity and synthesise complex legal risks into clear, commercially pragmatic guidance. Your advice will be direct, risk-calibrated, and focused on business value.

  • Navigate Pharmacy & Healthcare Regs: Advise cross-functional teams on German, Dutch, and cross-European pharmacy regulations, telemedicine rules, prescribing workflows, healthcare compliance and privacy. Particular focus on Germany’s AMG and HWG.

  • Commercial Risk & Disputes: Mitigate commercial risk, negotiate key partner/vendor agreements, and assist with advertising and competition matters (including Germany’s unfair competition / UWG litigation environment).

  • Drive Market Expansion & Growth: Partner with the international launch team to scale existing operations and launch Hims & Hers into new European markets, navigating local regulatory, legal, and operational landscapes from scratch.

Who You Are:

  • Qualified Attorney: Admitted to practice in the UK, Germany, or Ireland (other EU jurisdictions considered by exception) with ~5+ years PQE in a top-tier law firm, tech company, or fast-growing digital health/telehealth business.

  • First-Principles Thinker: You thrive on novelty and ambiguity. When faced with a problem that has never been solved before, you dig into core principles to construct creative, compliant paths forward.

  • Pragmatic & Commercial: You balance legal requirements with real-world commercial pressure. You understand what the business values and can move quickly without sacrificing quality or compliance.

  • Exceptional Communicator: You get straight to the point accurately and efficiently. You can explain intricate healthcare or consumer laws to non-lawyers clearly and concisely.

  • Self-Sufficient Operator: You take ownership, run autonomously, and prioritise effectively in a high-velocity environment without needing hand-holding.

Nice to Have:

  • Domain Exposure: Prior experience navigating German and/or European pharmacy regulations, digital health/e-health laws, or Germany's unfair competition landscape is strongly favored. GDPR experience will also be viewed favourably, particularly in a healthcare context.

  • Language Skills: German

Nice to Have:

  • Preferred: Based in London with a hybrid work structure (time spent in our Old Street office collaborating with team members).

  • Flexible: We are also open to exceptional candidates based remotely in Ireland or Germany.

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

title: Creative Strategist (Freelance)
descriptionHtml:
Ce qu'on fait chez Ops Clean 🧪

Ici, on est en guerre contre une industrie opaque qui balance des produits toxiques dans les foyers depuis des décennies. Notre mission : rendre l'entretien de la maison sain, transparent et désirable. Et ça marche — on est passés de 0 à une marque DTC qui cartonne en passant de 0€ à 1M€ de CA en 2 ans.

Mais on ne veut pas juste vendre des sachets de lessive. On veut dominer la conversation sur la santé domestique. Et pour ça, on a besoin d'un cerveau créatif qui pense performance autant qu'organique.

On ne cherche pas quelqu'un qui exécute. On cherche un partenaire créatif qui comprend que chaque scroll est une bataille, que chaque hook a 3 secondes pour gagner, et que chaque euro dépensé en ads doit revenir multiplié.

Vos missions

Ce qu'on attend de toi 🫵

En tant que Creative Strategist, tu seras le lien entre notre expertise produit (santé, éco, transparence) et l'attention de millions de personnes sur TikTok, Reels et Meta Ads.

Stratégie créative organique : Concevoir des formats récurrents à haut potentiel viral — séries "debunk" de produits toxiques, vulgarisation clivante, tests en situation réelle. Tu penses en séries, pas en posts isolés.

Stratégie créative ads : Scruter nos comptes Meta/TikTok Ads, analyser ce qui performe, et proposer des recommandations créatives structurées et actionnables. Identifier les pépites organiques et les transformer en ads. Créer des itérations (variantes de hooks, CTA, angles) pour scaler nos campagnes.

Scripting & copywriting : Rédiger des scripts et briefs calibrés pour la performance — hooks puissants, structure narrative fluide, chaque mot compte. Tu briefes nos créateurs de contenu et nos monteurs jusqu'à la moindre virgule.

Supervision de production : Tu ne montes pas toi-même, mais tu diriges. Tu supervises les créateurs UGC et les monteurs pour garantir que le rendu final respecte ta vision stratégique et les codes natifs des plateformes.

Analyse & itération : L'idée de passer des heures dans les Business Managers Meta/TikTok pour comprendre comment créer LA prochaine créa banger doit te faire kiffer. Tu suis les métriques (Watch time, Hook Rate, ROAS, CPA) et tu pivotes en continu.

Vos compétences

  • Expérience solide en stratégie créative ads, avec une compréhension approfondie des régies publicitaires Meta et/ou TikTok.

  • Tu sais ce qui rend une vidéo virale — tu connais les algos, les formats, les tendances.

  • Capacité à transformer des insights data en idées créatives percutantes.

  • Plume affûtée : tu sais vulgariser des sujets techniques (santé, ingrédients, écologie) en messages simples, accrocheurs, parfois provoc'.

  • Esprit analytique combiné à une forte créativité — tu es aussi à l'aise devant un dashboard que devant un script.

  • Excellentes compétences en communication — tu sais briefer un créateur, challenger un angle, défendre une idée.

Avantages

  • Impact réel : Tu bosses pour une cause qui a du sens — santé publique, transparence, écologie. Pas du bullshit marketing.

  • Autonomie totale : Pas de flicage. On juge sur les résultats, pas sur les heures.

  • Flexibilité : On est basés à Lyon, mais 100% remote c'est cool aussi.

  • Opportunité de partenariat : Si tous les feux sont au vert, on est ouverts à discuter equity/vesting pour que tu sois vraiment dans la team Ops Clean.

  • Accès direct au fondateur : Pas 12 couches de validation. Tu proposes, on teste, on itère.

⚠️ OBLIGATOIRE pour postuler

Pas de lettre de motiv' classique. Envoie-nous :

  1. Une vidéo d'1 min max pour nous expliquer en quoi tu es la personne la mieux placée pour ce poste. Utilise http://loom.com/ pour enregistrer et transmets le lien.

  2. 2-3 réalisations (organiques ou ads) dont tu es vraiment fier·e.

  3. Une petite critique de notre contenu actuel : quel angle "clivant" devrions-nous explorer demain ?

About Wayflyer

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.

You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.

The challenge

Our German market is growing and deal volume is growing with it. We need an analyst who can decide which businesses we fund, turning incomplete information into a clear fund or no-fund call. Some of that information will come from reps and customers.

What you'll actually do

  • Analyse financial and non-financial data on new and existing customers, and quantify the risks of running and funding an eCommerce business

  • Own the day-to-day relationship with our German-speaking sales and CS rep

  • Lead calls with German customers, acting as their trusted point of contact

  • Shadow customer calls at first, then lead them

  • Assess and structure loan opportunities across small, mid-market and enterprise deals, working with sales and operations

  • Present your fund or no-fund recommendation, with amount and payback terms, to managers and directors in our approval meetings, and work with the data and engineering teams on how their projects affect credit risk

What this role could turn into

This is a growing market and you’ll grow with it. You’ll start by owning relationships with our German-speaking reps and shadowing customer calls. From there, this role can lead to:

  • Senior Credit Analyst for the German market, handling escalations and leading customer calls and complex deals

  • Mentoring and coaching new Analysts as the German underwriting team grows, and shaping how we underwrite the market

  • Portfolio management or wider credit risk, with direct exposure to senior leaders through our approval meetings

Who thrives here

You’re curious, high-agency and entrepreneurial. Maybe you’ve run a side business, started a run club or led a university society. You think in first principles, can simplify complex problems, and balance risk with growth. You’re articulate, detail-oriented and a self-starter. You’ll probably end up doing things that aren’t in this job description. That’s not a warning - it’s the point.

We hire for range

  • Fluent/Native German and English is required (note: these will be tested as part of the interview process)

  • 1-2 years in finance, auditing or a related field, or you’re a strong grad. A finance background isn’t essential

  • Comfortable with Excel, Word and PowerPoint. SQL or Python is a plus

  • Experience managing external customer relationships, or underwriting in the German market, is a bonus. CFA is welcome, not expected

Location and working policy

📍Berlin, Dublin or London. You’ll be in the office 4 days a week for your first 6 months, then it becomes flexible under our standard hybrid policy.

The good stuff

25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and a pension. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What You’ll Do

Dive in as the strategic force behind our post-sales customer journey, transforming satisfaction into a powerful engine for growth. As a key player in a nimble, high-impact team, you'll own the customer experience for the DACH market, shaping processes and driving initiatives that directly enhance customer lifetime value and accelerate our market expansion.

title: Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment.

We think AI is what makes the problem solvable; better software alone wasn't enough. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Role

Sona's Customer Success function is being built from the ground up. $Millions of ARR is moving from Implementation to Customer Success, we're heading into our first year of renewals at scale, and there's meaningful seat expansion across the base. We need CSMs who can shape what good looks like, not operate inside a playbook someone else wrote.

You'll own a book of around 20-25 enterprise accounts across social care, hospitality and retail, partnering with Support, Product and Sales to own the post-live customer experience end to end. Some of the accounts you'll inherit are in difficult places, so you'll be rebuilding trust, holding rooms independently and driving outcomes in ambiguity.

We're a high-performance team. Everyone holds an important seat and is expected to perform at an elite level. We have each other's backs, we assume good intent, and we have zero space for internal politics. If that's your default, you'll thrive here.

This is an on-site role. Four days a week you'll be in our London office or out with customers, with one day working from home. Regular travel to customers across the UK is part of the job.

Responsibilities

  • Own senior customer relationships at Director level and above (Operations, Finance, HR), in person as well as over video, and act as the escalation point for your accounts

  • Run the QBR cadence and own renewals end to end, so the value case is made long before the renewal conversation

  • Drive proactive value work: account audits, surfacing unused functionality, and translating product usage into business outcomes

  • Progress seat upsells as customers grow, and flag wider expansion opportunities to AEs

  • Hold difficult conversations with diplomacy, including product feedback that isn't on the roadmap

  • Manage customer-side projects such as integrations and configuration changes, keeping status visible so customers always know where they stand

  • Help shape how Customer Success works at Sona, from health scoring to escalation

Requirements

  • You've owned a book of enterprise SaaS accounts, whether as a CSM, Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales, Implementation Consultant or PM

  • You've held Director-level customer relationships independently and been accountable for the customer health that drives renewal

  • You're commercially fluent around NRR and value realisation, and treat accounts as long-term assets

  • You're confident in complex SaaS products: you can demo, discuss configuration trade-offs and translate capability into business value

descriptionHtml:
Data Scientist | Semiconductor Metrology
Abingdon, UK

Reward and Benefits

  • £42,000 - £55,000 (depending on experience)
  • Annual bonus, 3x salary death in service benefit and private health care BUPA, EMI Share scheme.

If you are a Data Scientist who enjoys turning instrument data into proof of what is possible, why not join us in Abingdon, Oxfordshire, and help prove the analysis methods behind advanced semiconductor metrology systems.

We are looking for an ambitious and adaptable Data Scientist to join our new Data Science team in the Technology department, reporting to the Data Science Lead and working closely with our Modelling Scientist. You will generate and curate data, develop and test new algorithms, and benchmark them against what the instrument can physically deliver. When a method proves itself, you will package it for the Data Analysis team in Engineering, who turn it into robust product software. You will work with real customer use cases and wafer data from Applications Development, and proof-of-concept data from R&D.

We are an AI-first team, so you will use AI tools every day, while checking carefully what they produce. If your passion is speed, evidence and finding out what the data can really tell you, we’d love to hear from you.

What you’ll be doing

  • Generate synthetic data, and build and maintain the demo and performance data libraries
  • Analyse instrument data to quantify noise and limitations, and help establish the information limit, meaning what is physically extractable from the instrument
  • Develop and test new algorithms and analysis methods (for example PCA, percentile methods and machine learning) on real and synthetic data
  • Benchmark methods against the information limit: achievable performance, measurement uncertainty, gauge R&R and drift contributors
  • Write clean, reproducible prototype code with test data and expected performance, ready to hand over to Data Analysis, and build analysis tools used across the Technology department
  • Use AI tools every day to code, explore, analyse and report faster, verify what they produce, and present your results to the team

Education and experience

  • Degree or above in Physics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or a similar subject, or [2] years’ relevant experience in data science or quantitative research

Skills and experience we’re looking for:

  • Data analysis in Python (NumPy, SciPy, pandas, scikit-learn or similar)
  • Heavy, day-to-day use of AI tools in your technical work, such as coding assistants and LLMs, with the judgement to verify their outputs
  • Image or signal processing, ideally on data from scientific instruments
  • Statistics applied to measurement data: uncertainty, repeatability, noise and drift
  • Machine learning methods, and how to validate them properly
  • Clear, reproducible code and reports
  • Explaining results to technical and non-technical colleagues
  • Curious and adaptable, happy to work quickly and test ideas against the evidence

We’d love to see:

  • Atomic Force Microscopy or other nano-characterisation (SEM, FIB, profilometry), or semiconductor metrology
  • Physics-based modelling or simulation
  • Version control (Git) and C#, and experience building agentic or AI-assisted analysis workflows

A bit about us: 

Infinitesima is a privately owned company founded in 2001, as a spin-out of the University of Bristol, by CTO Professor Andrew Humphris. Our dynamic team of scientists and engineers is focussed on enabling the next generation of semiconductor devices through delivery of innovative products to customers around the world. 

Our strength lies in the varied perspectives that come from different cultures, experiences, and identities. We believe that true innovation is fuelled by collaboration, locally and globally. We strive to foster an environment where everyone can contribute meaningfully and thrive. If you require adjustments to take part in the recruitment process, please let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

We dress casually so informal attire is absolutely fine for onsite interviews. We want you to feel comfortable when you meet us and if there's anything else we can do to support your journey, just let us know.

title: Database Engineering Intern
descriptionHtml:

title: Deputy Superintendent Pharmacist
descriptionHtml:
As our pharmacy continues to grow, this is an exciting opportunity to bring your clinical expertise, regulatory knowledge and leadership experience to an ambitious and evolving business. Working closely with our Superintendent Pharmacist, you will help shape the future of our pharmacy, strengthen professional standards and support the delivery of safe, effective patient care at scale.

We are looking for someone who is confident in their clinical and regulatory knowledge, understands the importance of patient safety and is ready to take on a position with significant accountability, influence and leadership.

What is the Job?

At Montu, every prescription represents a patient waiting for treatment that can make a genuine difference to their quality of life.

Our pharmacy processes over 50,000 prescriptions each month, with continued month-on-month growth of approximately 10%. As our operation continues to scale, the Deputy Superintendent Pharmacist will work in close partnership with the Superintendent Pharmacist across all areas of clinical and regulatory governance.

You will take a leading role in the day-to-day clinical operation of the pharmacy, providing specialist regulatory expertise in Schedule 2 Controlled Drugs, supporting professional standards and ensuring patient safety remains central to everything we do.

You will provide clear clinical and regulatory guidance, identify and manage risks, support inspections and audits, and contribute to the ongoing development of our pharmacy systems, processes and governance frameworks.

You will also deputise for the Superintendent Pharmacist when required, helping to balance the demands of a high-volume pharmacy operation with the professional, legal and regulatory standards expected of us.

What Will You Be Doing?

Clinical Governance and Regulatory Compliance

  • Work alongside the Superintendent Pharmacist to maintain clinical governance and professional standards across Montu Pharmacy.

  • Support compliance with GPhC standards, MHRA regulations and all relevant statutory and professional requirements.

  • Lead the day-to-day clinical operation, providing clear guidance and direction to clinical and operational teams.

  • Take an active role in regulatory inspections, audits and compliance reviews, ensuring the pharmacy remains inspection-ready.

  • Identify, assess and manage regulatory risks, implementing appropriate corrective and preventative actions.

  • Review and maintain pharmacy policies, procedures and governance frameworks.

  • Maintain oversight of professional accountability, patient safety and regulatory reporting requirements.

Controlled Drugs Governance (Schedule 2)

  • Act as a specialist in Schedule 2 Controlled Drugs regulation, working alongside the Superintendent Pharmacist to ensure compliance with relevant legislation.

  • Oversee appropriate systems and controls for the safe storage, handling, dispensing, recording and management of Controlled Drugs.

  • Ensure accurate, auditable records are maintained, with effective monitoring and reconciliation processes.

  • Identify and address potential compliance risks, incidents and discrepancies.

  • Support the development of Controlled Drugs governance processes that remain effective as prescription volumes increase.

Professional Leadership and Team Development

  • Provide clinical leadership alongside the Superintendent Pharmacist to a pharmacy workforce of over 100 colleagues.

  • Support the maintenance of professional standards and competencies across the pharmacy.

  • Oversee competency frameworks, training requirements and ongoing professional development.

  • Work with pharmacy leaders to promote accountability, patient safety and continuous improvement.

  • Provide guidance on complex clinical, professional and regulatory matters.

  • Collaborate with operational leadership to maintain accuracy, efficiency and patient-centred care.

Pharmacy Operations, Systems and SOPs

  • Maintain oversight of pharmacy systems, processes and Standard Operating Procedures.

  • Ensure operational practices remain compliant, efficient and appropriate for the scale of the business.

  • Identify opportunities to improve patient safety, dispensing accuracy and operational efficiency.

  • Support the implementation of pharmacy technology, automation and system improvements.

  • Ensure appropriate governance is maintained when introducing new processes, technologies and services.

  • Work closely with operational teams to balance prescription volumes, service delivery and regulatory requirements.

Strategy and Business Growth

  • Work alongside the Superintendent Pharmacist, General Manager of Pharmacy, Medical Director and senior leadership team to support the clinical and regulatory strategy.

  • Provide regulatory expertise when evaluating new services, products and business opportunities.

  • Support regulatory readiness for pharmacy expansion and operational growth.

  • Help develop scalable governance frameworks that support increasing prescription volumes.

  • Contribute to decisions relating to pharmacy systems, technology and automation.

  • Ensure regulatory considerations remain central to business planning and operational decision-making.

Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for an experienced pharmacist with the expertise, confidence and ambition to make a meaningful contribution to the leadership of our pharmacy.

You will have strong clinical judgement, excellent regulatory knowledge and a thorough understanding of the professional standards required within a complex, high-volume pharmacy environment.

You will be particularly confident in Schedule 2 Controlled Drugs legislation and compliance, with the ability to provide clear, practical guidance to both clinical and non-clinical colleagues.

This role requires someone who can see the bigger picture. You will understand the importance of operational performance, commercial awareness and business growth, while ensuring patient safety and regulatory compliance are never compromised.

You will be comfortable joining a growing business, building relationships across teams and bringing fresh perspectives to the way we work. Above all, we are looking for someone who leads by example, communicates effectively, remains calm under pressure and has the confidence to challenge, influence and make informed decisions.

What Experience Will You Need?

Essential

  • Current registration with the General Pharmaceutical Council (GPhC).

  • Extensive knowledge of GPhC Standards for Pharmacy Professionals and relevant pharmacy legislation.

  • Demonstrable knowledge of Schedule 2 Controlled Drugs regulation and compliance in practice.

  • Experience leading clinical pharmacy operations within a high-volume or complex environment.

  • Strong understanding of MHRA regulations, including relevant requirements relating to importing, wholesaling and medicines storage.

  • Strong knowledge of pharmacy governance, risk management and Standard Operating Procedures.

  • Experience supporting regulatory inspections, audits and compliance frameworks.

Within your first 12 months, you will have:

  • Strengthened Schedule 2 Controlled Drugs governance, ensuring processes remain compliant, auditable and scalable.

  • Supported the development and maintenance of robust pharmacy governance frameworks.

  • Helped establish clear professional competency, training and development standards.

  • Played an active role in preparing for and supporting regulatory inspections and audits.

  • Identified and supported meaningful improvements to pharmacy systems, technology and automation.

  • Contributed to shaping the clinical and regulatory strategy of Montu Pharmacy

title: Developer Experience / DevEx
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

About the Software organisation at Fractile

Developer Experience sits within the Software organisation at Fractile, which is responsible for developing a full software stack for our groundbreaking AI inference systems. That's everything from ML compilers, device drivers and systems firmware, application level runtime and ecosystem integrations, ML and compute libraries, great developer tooling and a full portfolio of simulators, through to datacenter scale workload deployment solutions. At Fractile, we know that a fantastic software stack is a critical and central part of any AI inference solution and it sits at the heart of everything we're doing.

About the team and role

The Developer Experience team at Fractile helps shape how our customers interact with the Fractile inference accelerator. We work across the company to identify, create, and present information on how the system is being used, as well as providing the tooling to help optimise our customers' usage of the system, while keeping a shallow learning curve.

As a member of the Developer Experience team you will need to understand the current state of development for inference hardware. You will need to be able to identify what will work well for engineers wanting to identify potential opportunities for performance improvements, while knowing what tooling will fit into an existing LLM engineer's workflow with the minimal amount of disruption and effort.

About you

We're looking for someone who is self-driven and capable of identifying tooling opportunities, designing those tools, and delivering them in a way which will fit in with an LLM engineer's existing toolset. You will have worked in this area before, possibly as an FDE or at a company that provides inference services using their own models, and have the ability to develop new tools that are designed to be functional and easy to learn and use.

Key Requirements

  • Experience with inference frameworks such as JAX and/or PyTorch

  • Experience of software development in Python, Rust, C/C++, or a similar language

  • Experience monitoring and optimising code written in CUDA, ROCm, OpenCL, or similar

  • Experience monitoring and optimising LLM deployments with 50+ billion parameters

  • Experience working with stakeholders across multiple teams

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

title: DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands.

About SkinVision

Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin spot assessments and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. High-risk cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need.

DevOps at SkinVision

As a DevOps Engineer at SkinVision, you will play a key role in building, scaling, and securing the infrastructure that powers our AI-driven health platform. You’ll design and maintain our cloud-based systems in AWS, implement CI/CD pipelines, enhance observability using Datadog, and drive operational excellence through automation and monitoring.

Your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of a medical-grade system that serves users globally. You’ll collaborate closely with backend, ML, and product teams to ensure smooth delivery, rapid deployments, and resilient operations — ultimately enabling us to deliver life-saving technology with confidence.

Beyond hands-on expertise with AWS and modern DevOps tooling, we’re looking for someone who thinks architecturally. You’ll get to know our current setup, form your own view of how it should evolve, and help define a target vision for our infrastructure, then drive its implementation. Day-to-day operational work is part of the role, but we value someone who thinks before building and takes ownership of where our infrastructure goes next.

What you will do

Cloud Infrastructure & Automation

  • Design, build, and manage AWS-based infrastructure, ensuring high availability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

  • Implement and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.

  • Automate environment provisioning, configuration, and deployments using CI/CD pipelines.

  • Ensure system resilience, security, and performance through automated monitoring and alerting.

CI/CD & Deployment

  • Design and optimize CI/CD pipelines to support rapid, reliable, and safe deployments across environments.

  • Manage deployment workflows using Argo CD and Kubernetes.

  • Collaborate with developers and ML engineers to streamline build, test, and release processes.

  • Integrate automated testing, rollback strategies, and version control into the deployment lifecycle.

Observability & Monitoring

  • Build a comprehensive observability stack using Datadog for metrics, logs, traces, and alerts.

  • Define service-level objectives (SLOs), service-level indicators (SLIs), and dashboards for system performance.

  • Proactively detect and resolve performance bottlenecks, capacity issues, and reliability risks.

  • Create automated health checks and ensure visibility across production systems.

Security & Compliance

  • Implement security best practices for AWS, containers, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Manage identity, access, and secret handling (IAM, Secrets Manager, Parameter Store).

  • Ensure compliance with medical device standards and data privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA).

  • Partner with the Information Security Officer to embed security controls across infrastructure and deployments.

Reliability & Incident Management

  • Lead incident response and root cause analysis for infrastructure or deployment-related issues.

  • Establish SLAs and operational runbooks for production environments.

  • Continuously improve system reliability through chaos testing, redundancy, and fault tolerance.

  • Mentor engineers on DevOps principles, observability practices, and infrastructure automation.

Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture

  • Assess the current infrastructure and deployment setup, and form a well-reasoned view of how it should evolve.

  • Define and maintain a target architecture for our cloud platform, balancing reliability, scalability, security, and cost.

  • Translate the target vision into a practical roadmap and drive its implementation incrementally, alongside day-to-day operations.

  • Document and communicate architectural decisions, aligning with engineering and leadership on technical direction.


Essential skills

  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure roles.

  • Strong expertise with AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, Lambda, etc.).

  • Expert in Kubernetes and Argo CD, deploying and managing production-grade custom Helm charts with secure, automated GitOps workflows in EKS

  • Advanced knowledge of CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar).

  • Proficiency in Datadog for observability, monitoring, and alerting.

  • Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, or Go.

  • Experience managing infrastructure with Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible.

  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals, load balancing, and API gateway configuration.

  • Excellent problem-solving and incident management skills.

Desirable skills

  • Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, MedTech, or FinTech.

  • Familiarity with multi-environment architecture (staging, pre-prod, production) and blue-green deployments.

  • Exposure to event-driven systems, message queues, and data streaming (Kafka, SNS/SQS).

  • Understanding of Zero Trust networking and cloud security best practices.

  • Experience in cost optimization and performance tuning in AWS.

Qualifications

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or Terraform Associate are a plus.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary, additional benefits, and a hybrid working policy

  • A vibrant, dynamic, and rapidly growing scale-up in Amsterdam

  • An enthusiastic, professional, and international team

  • Regular team events, including off-sites and fun activities

  • Unlimited skin checks for you

title: DevSecOps Lead- London
descriptionHtml:
About Hiya

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

About the Position

The Lead DevSecOps Engineer is a leadership and individual contributor role responsible for maturing our security posture across all engineering departments. You will lead the design and implementation of automated, platform-based security solutions, enabling teams to build secure software while maintaining velocity. You will partner closely with Core Tech, Product, and Engineering leadership to define our security roadmap and culture.

We’re excited about you because you are a trailblazer who balances high-level strategy with hands-on technical execution. You are comfortable building from near-scratch, thrive on educating others, and possess a "platform" mindset that prioritizes empowering developers over acting as a gatekeeper.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and execute a multi-quarter security roadmap for the entire engineering organization.

  • Develop and maintain platform-level security tools that enable automated, self-service security for feature teams.

  • Partner with Core Tech to integrate security primitives into our standard CI/CD and cloud deployment workflows.

  • Conduct cross-team discovery to assess current security posture and identify high-risk technical debt.

  • Mentor junior and peer engineers, fostering a culture where security is integrated into the "you build it, you run it" philosophy.

  • Stay ahead of evolving threat landscapes, specifically regarding supply chain risks and large-scale AI infrastructure.

  • Own and mature our existing detection, SIEM, and incident-response tooling as part of building out the broader security platform — this role inherits live systems, it isn't a blank canvas.

  • Act as a security collaborator to IT on AI-usage risk (data exposure via connectors/agents, prompt injection) — distinct from, and in addition to, securing the AI systems Hiya builds as a product.

Qualities that will make you successful:

  • Deep understanding of cloud-native architecture (AWS) and modern security best practices.

  • Proven experience designing "self-service" platforms that developers actually want to use.

  • Strong communication skills—the ability to turn complex security concerns into decisions engineers and stakeholders can act on.

  • High proficiency in at least one modern language and familiarity with agent-based/AI-assisted development tools.

  • Pragmatism—knowing when to accept calculated tech debt in favor of high-impact outcomes.

  • A leadership style rooted in empathy, collaborative debate, and commitment to team decisions.

  • Builds systems, documentation, and team capability that outlast you — we're wary of highly productive engineers who leave behind bespoke, unmaintainable tooling that has to be scrapped when they move on.

The person in this role must embody Hiya’s key values of Serving our customers, Doing rather than observing, Improving ourselves and our business, Owning and holding ourselves accountable for success, and Leading by showing up with a point of view, engaging in open discussion, listening respectfully to others opinions and committing to decisions.

The requirements listed in the job descriptions are guidelines. You don’t have to satisfy every requirement or meet every qualification listed. If your skills are transferable we would still love to hear from you.

How We Work

Hiya is not a passive environment. We expect people to take ownership, form opinions, and engage directly with hard problems.

We work with a high degree of transparency and autonomy. Context is shared openly, and decisions are discussed, challenged, and then made. Once a call is made, we commit and move forward.

You'll be expected to work through ambiguity, weigh tradeoffs, and take responsibility for results, while keeping a high bar for quality and customer trust.

Every team member at Hiya is expected to live our core values:

  • Serve, our customers and partners by holding a high bar for trust and quality

  • Own, share in success and open up to failures

  • Lead, listen, show up with a point of view but commit entirely once a decision has been made

  • Improve, even if it means changing course or contradicting ourselves

  • Do, rather than observe

We're building a team with diverse perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We evaluate candidates through a business lens and believe that diversity and unique viewpoints make our company stronger, more dynamic, and a great place to build a career.
