Director, Development Cost & Capital Planning (EMEA) 

Location: London, hybrid, with regular travel to project locations across EMEA

About Nscale

At Nscale, we are building the infrastructure for Europe’s AI revolution. Nscale is developing cutting-edge sovereign generative AI solutions, powered by a new generation of high-performance, sustainable data centres and GPUs built specifically for AI workloads. 

The growth of artificial intelligence is driving unprecedented global demand for compute and GPU infrastructure. Nscale is positioned at the heart of this transformation — building the platforms that will enable the next decade of innovation. 

Nscale is working closely with the world’s most advanced AI technology providers, integrating next-gen compute hardware and GPU clusters in both partner and Nscale built facilities. This is a unique opportunity to join Nscale’s journey, play a key role in delivering transformative AI infrastructure, and help shape a company scaling globally with a key focus in the EMEA region.

The Role

The Director, Development Cost & Capital Planning is accountable for establishing cost certainty, capital planning, development risk and commercial viability across Nscale's EMEA Development portfolio from site identification (Gate 0) through due diligence (Gate 1) to development sanction and ‘shovel-ready’ transition into Delivery (Gate 2).

The role owns L0 Indicative Estimates, L1 Estimated Budgets and L2 Schematic Design Budget for every EMEA opportunity, consolidating the development, energy, design, construction, procurement and AI infrastructure workstream budgets into a single Total Development Cost (TDC) providing the commercial and financial foundation for site selection, land and lease acquisitions, Colocation leases, underwriting business cases, investment committee approvals and project approvals.

Operating as an individual contributor at first, the role will personally prepare estimates, cost models, risk registers, benchmarking and investment-grade business cases while establishing the systems, governance and processes required for future growth. The role will develop to manage a high performing team supporting the Development function as it expands across the EMEA region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Development Cost Planning & Estimating - Own L0, L1 and L2 estimates across the EMEA portfolio, maintaining the Total Development Cost (TDC), proforma and development cost baseline through Gate 2. Where early stage budgets have missing elements, propose and agree estimates and placeholders with the project team.
  • Investment Underwriting & Business Case Development - Provide CAPEX, contingency, cash flow and cost-risk inputs to support acquisitions, business cases and Investment Committee approvals.
  • Development Risk Management and Contingency Planning - Maintain project risk registers and govern contingency in accordance with Nscale policy.
  • Site Selection & Land Acquisition Support - Support site screening, due diligence and acquisition decisions through cost, risk and abnormality assessments.

descriptionHtml:
Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day. 

Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritized, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organized, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.  

Position Purpose

The Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health will provide strategic and technical leadership for RTSL's portfolio to reduce preventable maternal deaths and improve sexual and reproductive health outcomes. The role will lead the development and implementation of a multi-country program that strengthens government capabilities to identify and address barriers to quality care, translate data into action, and deliver measurable improvements in health outcomes.

The Director will have overall accountability for the strategy, resources, quality, performance, and results of the maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, leading a multidisciplinary team and working closely with governments, technical partners, and colleagues across RTSL to design, implement and scale evidence-informed approaches. The role requires deep expertise in sexual, reproductive and maternal health, strong program leadership, and the ability to translate technical evidence into practical, sustainable health system improvements.

Work Location: 100% Remote with travel as stated. 

Duration: Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership and Portfolio Management

  • Set the strategic direction, priorities and implementation approach for RTSL's maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, exercising delegated authority to make program investment, resource allocation, and partnership decisions within approved organizational parameters and in alignment with country priorities.
  • Oversee a multi-country portfolio, with accountability for program planning, budget development and management, resource allocation, performance and delivery against strategic objectives.
  • Lead and manage a multidisciplinary team, establishing clear responsibilities and performance expectations, overseeing staffing and talent development, addressing performance and capacity gaps, and building the capabilities needed for sustained program delivery.

Technical Leadership and Program Development

  • Provide expert technical leadership across maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, including maternal death surveillance and response, quality maternal care, family planning, and adolescent pregnancy prevention.
  • Lead the development and adaptation of evidence-informed approaches that connect data-driven learning with targeted improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.
  • Guide the design and implementation of country programs, identifying opportunities to strengthen government leadership, institutional capabilities and sustainable approaches to improving health outcomes.
  • Drive innovation and collaboration across RTSL's technical teams, drawing on expertise in PHC delivery, digital health, measurement and financing to address priority health system bottlenecks.

Country Engagement and Strategic Partnerships

  • Lead senior-level engagement with Ministries of Health and national partners to identify priorities, shape country strategies and secure government ownership of programs and results.
  • Develop and manage strategic partnerships with donors, multilateral agencies, technical institutions and implementing partners, identifying opportunities for collaboration, investment and program expansion, and representing RTSL in high-level technical and policy discussions.

Performance, Learning and Accountability

  • Maintain overall accountability for portfolio performance and results, establishing clear performance expectations and monitoring mechanisms, and using evidence and implementation learning to inform strategic decisions, address delivery challenges, and adapt approaches.
  • Oversee the generation, synthesis and dissemination of evidence and practical learning to inform policy, program improvement and scale-up across countries.

Qualifications

Education

  • Advanced degree in medicine, public health, sexual and reproductive health, obstetrics and gynecology, or a related field.

Experience

  • At least 15 years of relevant global health experience, including substantial technical and leadership experience in sexual, reproductive and maternal health in low- and middle-income countries.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and leading complex, multi-country programs, including strategic planning, budget oversight and accountability for results.
  • Extensive experience engaging senior government officials, donors and international partners, with the ability to build relationships and influence strategic decisions.

Skills & Abilities

  • Recognized technical expertise in maternal survival and reproductive health, with a strong understanding of evidence-based interventions, health service delivery and health system strengthening.
  • Proven ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams and manage programs across different countries and organizational functions.
  • Strong understanding of data-driven program improvement, implementation challenges and approaches to translating evidence into sustainable results.
  • Excellent strategic thinking, judgement, communication and leadership skills, with the ability to navigate complex political and operational environments.
  • Fluency in English required; proficiency in French desirable.
  • Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30% during program start-up and up to 25% thereafter.

Compensation and Benefits

Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. We do everything possible to ensure our employees are connected and set up for success. 

The salary range for applicants based in the US is $150,000 to $170,000 annually. The exact offer will be determined by various factors, such as the candidate's skills and experience relative to the requirements of the role. For applicants based outside the US, salaries are set according to national labor rates for the international NGO sector.  

In addition to a competitive salary, Resolve to Save Lives provides a generous package of benefits, including:

CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. title: Engineering Manager - Hands-on (CDI)
descriptionHtml:
🏗️ À propos de Bricks

Chez Bricks, on construit la façon la plus simple d’investir dans l’immobilier, à partir de 10 €. Aujourd’hui, plus de 670 000 membres utilisent notre plateforme.

Quelques jalons : passage chez Capital (M6) en 2022, Tony Parker investisseur et ambassadeur, record européen de vitesse de levée avec 5 M€ collectés en 5 secondes, puis plus de 20 M€ en 10 jours auprès de notre communauté.

En 2025, Bricks a collecté 176 M€, soit +90 % en un an, tout en atteignant la rentabilité.

Derrière cette croissance, il y a un produit B2C régulé, des flux financiers réels, des enjeux forts de sécurité, de fiabilité et de cohérence des données. Ce qui part en production peut être utilisé par des milliers d’investisseurs dans les heures qui suivent.

Côté Engineering, on fonctionne avec une équipe autonome, proche du produit et du business. On attend de chacun qu’il comprenne les problèmes en profondeur, prenne des décisions et contribue directement à la qualité de ce qu’on construit.

Vos missions

🧩 Le job

Tu rejoindras une équipe Engineering de 10 ingénieurs, avec un CTO qui code au quotidien. Côté Produit : 2 Designers et 2 PM.

L’équipe grandit, les enjeux aussi. On cherche aujourd’hui un Engineering Manager qui travaillera étroitement avec le CTO, à la fois sur le management de l’équipe, son organisation et les sujets techniques structurants.

Tu participeras aux roadmaps Engineering, à la composition des squads, à la définition des objectifs et aux prochains recrutements, tout en restant proche du code et du produit.

Chez Bricks, devenir manager ne veut pas dire s’éloigner de la technique : tu dois pouvoir entrer dans une discussion d’architecture, challenger une décision, faire une code review utile ou débloquer un sujet complexe.

🧱 Ce que tu vas owner

👉 Construire l’organisation Engineering avec le CTO : faire évoluer la composition des équipes, les objectifs, les façons de travailler et participer activement aux recrutements.

👉 Manager et faire progresser les ingénieurs au quotidien : 1:1, feedback, accompagnement, progression, exigence technique. Comprendre ce qui bloque quelqu’un et l’aider à passer au palier suivant.

👉 Rester connecté au code et au produit. Tu ne coderas pas nécessairement toute la journée, mais tu dois pouvoir entrer dans la codebase, participer aux reviews et prendre part aux décisions d’architecture.

👉 Créer les conditions pour que l’équipe shippe vite et bien. Identifier les blocages, arbitrer, clarifier les responsabilités et faire évoluer le process uniquement lorsqu’il apporte de la valeur.

👉 Maintenir un haut niveau d’exigence technique. Modélisation du domaine, architecture, qualité des données, sécurité, performance : tu aides l’équipe à prendre les bonnes décisions là où elles comptent vraiment.

🛠️ La stack

Tu dois être suffisamment proche de notre environnement technique pour pouvoir intervenir réellement dans les discussions et dans le code :

👉 TypeScript end-to-end. Les types sont de la documentation qui s’exécute.

👉 Node monolithe, Screaming Architecture.

👉 Postgres (NeonDB) avec Graphile pour les queues ACID. Redis pour ce qui doit être rapide.

👉 Zod, Kysely, ts-pattern - type-safety du front à la DB.

👉 Better Auth.

👉 Railway pour l’infra.

👉 Github CI, Datadog, K6.

👉 React Native + RN Web côté front : une seul codebase web + mobile.

Tu n’as pas besoin d’avoir utilisé exactement chacune de ces technos. En revanche, Node/TypeScript et une vraie profondeur backend sont importants : on cherche quelqu’un capable de challenger techniquement l’équipe, pas seulement de la manager.

🤖 IA-first mindset

L’IA est partout dans notre quotidien. 100**% des workflows passe par elle** : Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Cursor, Automations, etc.

Et pour un Engineering Manager, l’enjeu va plus loin que sa propre utilisation : tu dois comprendre comment l’IA transforme la façon de manager, coder, de reviewer, de tester, de recruter et de faire progresser une équipe Engineering.

Si tu vois encore l’IA comme secondaire, ce poste n’est pas pour toi.

Vos compétences

🎯 Tu fitteras si...

👉 Tu as d’abord été Senior Software Engineer et tu n’as pas quitté la technique en devenant manager. Tu aimes toujours le code, tu restes proche des sujets techniques et tu peux encore mettre les mains dedans quand c’est nécessaire.

👉 Tu sais construire et faire vivre une équipe Engineering. Recruter, intégrer, faire progresser, donner du feedback et faire évoluer les responsabilités font partie du rôle.

👉 Tu as une forte expérience backend Node /TypeScript en environnement produit.

👉 Tu sais prendre de la hauteur. Au-delà du management individuel, tu réfléchis à la composition des équipes, aux responsabilités, aux recrutements et à la façon dont l’organisation doit évoluer.

👉 Tu sais quand ralentir et quand shipper. Tout ne mérite pas 3 semaines de réflexion, mais tout ne mérite pas non plus un quick fix.

👉 Tu es pragmatique et tu préfères construire une organisation adaptée au contexte plutôt qu’appliquer un playbook tout fait.

👉 Tu reconnais tes erreurs sans en faire un drame. Tu peux changer d’avis quand quelqu’un apporte de meilleurs arguments.

👉 La fintech, l’investissement ou l’immobilier t’intéresse : gros bonus si tu investis toi-même.

❌ Tu ne fitteras pas si...

👉 Tu veux sortir de la technique en devenant manager.

👉 Tu cherches un rôle principalement centré sur le delivery, les cérémonies et le suivi de process.

👉 Tu veux appliquer un modèle d’organisation tout fait, sans l’adapter au contexte.

👉 Tu as besoin d’une séparation nette entre management, technique et produit.

👉 Tu veux être le point de passage de toutes les décisions techniques. Ici, ton rôle est aussi de faire grandir des ingénieurs autonomes, pas de décider à leur place.

Avantages

L'offre

👉 CDI, temps plein.

👉 Un produit B2C utilisé par 700 000+ membres, ce que ton équipe construit a un impact concret et immédiat.

👉 Un rôle au cœur de l’organisation Engineering : tu travailleras directement avec le CTO et auras un impact réel sur la façon dont l’équipe se structure et évolue.

👉 Une boîte ambitieuse, rentable et en forte croissance

👉 Salaire compétitif, MacBook Pro de ton choix, tout le matériel qu’il te faut.

👉 Hybride Montpellier : office-first (2j/sem de remote) ou remote-first (~2j/mois au bureau).

Déroulement des entretiens

  1. Pré-qualification téléphonique avec notre recruteuse

  2. Echange manager avec Denis, notre CTO (1h)

  3. Entretien technique : cadrage technique et implémentation d'une fonctionnalité

  4. Entretien team-fit (1h)

  5. Rencontre avec Cédric, notre fondateur (45 min)

  6. Offre

title: Engineering Manager, Platform Integration, Robot Software
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Wayve is building embodied AI that can drive any vehicle, anywhere. Within Robot Software, the Platform Integration team brings together the software and interfaces that enable our AI Driver to operate on new development platforms.

The team owns early vehicle software integration, drive-by-wire and the vehicle facing software drivers. We work across software, hardware, controls and operations to bring up new vehicle variants, improve their reliability and establish repeatable processes for validation and handover.

As Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the engineers responsible for this work, shaping both the team’s technical direction and its development. Your team will help Wayve scale across vehicles and OEM programmes by building reusable software interfaces and making integration more predictable.

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll be accountable for the team’s delivery, engagement, resourcing, roadmap and performance. You’ll coach engineers, support their career development, lead hiring and build a team with clear ownership and high standards.

Working with the team, you’ll set direction across vehicle interfacing software and integration practices. You’ll help the team balance immediate programme needs with longer-term investments in architecture, tooling and reliability.

You’ll also coordinate dependencies across teams, make priorities and trade-offs clear, and resolve risks early. The role combines software engineering leadership with practical delivery and execution.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

Leading and developing engineers: Set clear expectations, run effective one-to-ones, provide regular feedback, manage performance and support career progression.

Building the team: Own hiring and onboarding, develop the skills needed for future programmes and build a collaborative culture across locations.

Setting direction and priorities: Maintain the team’s mission, ownership boundaries and roadmap, balancing programme commitments with improvements that make future integrations easier.

Delivering new vehicle integrations: Lead planning and execution from early preparation and bench integration through vehicle bring-up, validation and handover. Secure the resources and cross-team support needed for delivery.

Owning vehicle-facing software: Guide the architecture and development of Vehicle Driver and drive-by-wire components, building robust interfaces that reduce bespoke changes for each vehicle variant.

Improving reliability and release quality: Establish measurable reliability targets, use field feedback to prioritise improvements, and build strong ownership of testing, releases and escalated issues. Invest in sustainable over the air updatable infrastructure.

Making integration repeatable: Develop playbooks, tooling, runbooks and knowledge-transfer practices so subsequent vehicles can be commissioned and supported independently.

Driving technical collaboration: Review designs and work closely with software, hardware, controls, safety and operations teams, as well as customers and suppliers where needed, to resolve integration challenges.

🙌 You should apply if:

You have a strong track record of leading and developing software or systems engineering teams, including coaching, hiring, performance management and career development.

You have owned a team roadmap and delivered complex engineering programmes through others, managing priorities, resources, dependencies and technical risk.

You have practical experience developing and integrating embedded or robotics software in a physical product.

You can guide architectural decisions and review designs for software that interacts with hardware, balancing immediate delivery with maintainability and reuse.

You understand the challenges of bringing up new hardware and software platforms, including testing, fault diagnosis, validation and operational handover.

You build strong ownership of reliability and quality, using metrics and lessons from real-world operation to drive improvements.

You communicate clearly and can align teams with different priorities around shared technical outcomes.

Experience with automotive systems, drive-by-wire, CAN or automotive Ethernet, vehicle controls, or bench and hardware-in-the-loop testing is desirable.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Programming and hiring manager interview; 2 hours total)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (programming, systems & domain-specific interviews; 3 hours total)

  • Final interview: Wayve value alignment (45 mins)

 

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

   

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Engineering Manager, Release Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

 

About Superhuman

Superhuman is the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.

 

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Developer Experience/Release Engineering team in Berlin. You will own how code travels from a developer’s commit to millions of users across Superhuman’s products: Grammarly, Superhuman Docs, and Superhuman Mail.

As our product suite grows, so do the number of engineers contributing to it and the number of surfaces we release on (web, desktop, mobile, browser extensions, APIs). Our team makes shipping fast, safe, and boring. The team builds and runs the CI/CD platform, release pipelines, and rollout tooling that let product teams deploy many times a day with confidence; it enables engineers to be productive, use new technologies to optimize the SLDC, and push on green many times a day.

You will lead a team of engineers working at the intersection of developer productivity, infrastructure, and reliability. You will partner with Product Engineering, SRE, Platform/Infrastructure, and Security to increase release speed and safety. This role is hands-on: you will help set the technical direction and stay close to the work.

As an Engineering Manager, Release Engineering, you will:

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Engineers; hire great people and build a strong, inclusive team culture in Berlin and across a distributed organization.

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for CI/CD, build, and release systems that scale with company growth and the number of products and surfaces we ship.

  • Drive faster, safer delivery: improve lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and time to restore, and make these measures visible to engineering leadership.

  • Build and operate release tooling, including progressive rollouts, canaries, feature flags, automated rollback, and release health monitoring.

  • Coordinate release trains and launches across all our products, working with Product, QA, Support, and Marketing to ensure major launches land smoothly.

  • Partner with SRE, Infrastructure, and Security to keep the delivery platform reliable and compliant, including supply chain security, artifact integrity, and access controls.

  • Reduce friction for product engineers: cut build and test times, eliminate flaky tests and pipelines, and offer self-service paths so teams can ship without waiting on us.

  • Act as an escalation point and Incident Commander for release-related incidents, and lead blameless postmortems that turn into lasting fixes.

  • Balance near-term pipeline fixes with foundational investments, and make clear tradeoffs in a fast-moving environment.

  • Stay hands-on where it matters: review designs, help debug tough pipeline problems, and set a high engineering bar.

 

Qualifications

  • Have 5+ years of software, DevOps, or release/build engineering experience, and 2+ years managing engineers (or engineering managers) with a record of hiring, developing, and retaining talent.

  • Bring hands-on depth in CI/CD systems and build tooling (for example, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Buildkite, Bazel, or similar) and can reason independently about pipeline architecture and trade-offs.

  • Know cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and Kubernetes or another container orchestration system.

  • Have shipped and operated release systems at scale, using progressive delivery, feature flags, canary releases, and safe rollback.

  • Understand release practices across multiple surfaces (web, desktop, mobile, browser extensions, or backend services).

  • Know infrastructure as code (eg Terraform) and observability tooling, and use delivery metrics (DORA) to guide decisions.

  • Have experience as an Incident Commander and running blameless postmortems.

  • Know the basics of software supply chain security: dependency management, artifact signing, and secrets handling.

  • Have experience managing people in a distributed or remote setting, and can collaborate effectively with Product, SRE, Security, QA, and Support.

  • Operate well in ambiguity, set a high engineering bar, and empower senior engineers to own technical decisions.

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

 

Compensation and Benefits

  • Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback.

title: ERP Administrator (Odoo)
descriptionHtml:
Location: Reading, Berkshire (Hybrid – minimum 3 days per week on-site)

ABOUT XYZ REALITY

──────────────────────────────

XYZ Reality are the creators of the world's first and only engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution, purpose built for the construction industry. Not only have we created this holographic technology, that sits within The Atom, a smart, site-safe headset/hardhat, but we implement it on projects, utilising the power of AR to ensure that all schemes are completed in line with delivery timescales and budgets.

XYZ works across the UK, US and Europe with major clients and construction companies to deliver large-scale projects.

THE ROLE

──────────────────────────────

This role sits within the Production team at our NPI facility in Reading, Berkshire, reporting to the Procurement Manager and on-site at least three days per week.

You will be the internal owner of the business systems that production, quality, procurement and logistics run on, with our ERP at the centre.

You'll make our ERP the single system of record for stock, BOMs, builds and serial-level traceability. The systems you build must scale with the business: what is built now must support materially higher volumes, more products and more people, without adding headcount or manual workarounds.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

──────────────────────────────

• Own our ERP end to end: requirements, configuration, data quality, testing, releases and ongoing improvement.

• Map how the business works today across goods-in, stores, build, test, despatch and returns; define the target process and data model and hold the line on requirements as the system evolves.

• Own purchasing, supplier and item-master data the Procurement function depends on; own integrations and data flows between ERP, finance, CRM and support systems, including returns (RMA) workflows.

• Implement serial-level traceability so component and build history is queryable for containment, warranty and field-failure investigation; own engineering change control and quality records under ISO 9001.

• Build and maintain the production reporting pack, yield, scrap, rework, throughput, stock accuracy and on-time despatch, turning data into insight the team can act on.

• Identify and deliver process automation and system improvement opportunities as production scales, eliminating manual re-keying, paper records and offline spreadsheets.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

──────────────────────────────

  • Extensive experience with Odoo.

  • Demonstrable experience implementing or migrating an ERP or MRP system in a manufacturing environment, ideally as the internal owner rather than an external consultant.

  • Strong understanding of manufacturing data structures: item masters, BOMs, routings, work orders, serialisation and lot control.

  • Data migration experience including extraction, cleansing, mapping and reconciliation.

  • Advanced Excel essential; SQL, Power BI or equivalent desirable. Right to work in the UK without sponsorship.

KEY EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

──────────────────────────────

• Requirements gathering and process mapping capability, with the discipline to document thoroughly rather than work from memory.

• Experience of systems integration and API-based data flows.

• Understanding of ISO 9001 documented information and traceability requirements; exposure to NCR, root cause analysis and corrective action processes.

• A track record of identifying and delivering practical process improvements, with the benefit clearly evidenced.

• Self-directed and comfortable owning a programme with senior sponsorship.

• Scripting or automation capability (Python, Power Automate or similar) — desirable.

BENEFITS

──────────────────────────────

• 🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays

• 🩺 Private healthcare with Vitality

• 🎄 Christmas shutdown days on top of leave allowance

• 🪙 Annual salary reviews

• 🥳 Summer & Christmas staff parties

• 💰 Employee referral scheme

• 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme

• 🚀 Make a real-world impact of revolutionising the construction industry

title: Expansion Associate (H/F) - 100%
descriptionHtml:
Tu n'abandonnes pas au premier refus, ni au dixième. Tu traites une liste le vendredi après-midi avec le même soin que le lundi matin, et tu mènes à terme ce que tu as commencé, pour que rien ne reste en suspens et que rien ne vieillisse en silence dans un coin. Tu n'as besoin de personne derrière ton épaule pour tenir ton niveau d'exigence. Et quand un cas ne rentre pas dans le processus, tu le signales au lieu de bricoler une solution.

Si tu te reconnais dans ces lignes, tu es au bon endroit.

En tant qu'Expansion Associate, tu es le chasseur ou la chasseuse d'appartements de Room Estate en Suisse romande, avec un accent sur Genève. Tu es responsable de l'acquisition d'appartements de A à Z : tu passes le marché au crible, tu évalues chaque appartement sous l'angle du coliving, tu le visites sur place, tu postules en notre nom, tu relances et tu accompagnes le dossier jusqu'à la signature du bail. C'est un rôle pour les personnes qui passent à l'action, et c'est précisément sa force : fréquence, ténacité et sens des responsabilités dans un processus clairement défini. Notre principe directeur : la croissance naît d'un tri des annonces à haute fréquence, d'une évaluation rigoureuse et de relances systématiques, pas de coups de chance. Tu travailles en étroite collaboration avec notre responsable de l'équipe Acquisition, qui tranche les cas d'appréciation, et ton travail se mesure à ce qui compte au final : les chambres acquises, les baux signés et la qualité de ce que tu ramènes.

Tasks

  • Tu passes les portails immobiliers au crible de manière systématique, chaque jour et avec un regard sûr pour ce qui convient.

  • Tu évalues chaque appartement sous l'angle du coliving : plan, état, immeuble, et la question de savoir si la propriété est prête à jouer le jeu.

  • Tu organises les visites et tu te rends sur place pour vérifier sur l'objet réel ce que promet l'annonce.

  • Tu postules en notre nom et tu positionnes Room Estate comme le locataire que toute régie souhaite avoir.

  • Tu relances jusqu'à ce qu'une décision soit prise. Aucun dossier ne s'enlise.

  • Tu accompagnes le dossier jusqu'à la signature et tu contrôles le bail à l'aide de notre liste de contrôle : points critiques, clauses manquantes et écarts par rapport à l'annonce.

  • Tu tiens le suivi des dossiers à jour : chaque objet saisi, chaque statut traçable.

Requirements

  • Sens des responsabilités et autonomie. Tu fais avancer un processus de bout en bout à une fréquence élevée et à un rythme fiable, tu vas au bout de chaque suivi et tu ne laisses aucun dossier s'enliser. C'est le cœur de ce rôle.

  • Maîtrise du français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, dans les échanges avec les régies et les propriétaires.

  • Ténacité et sens de la négociation, le marché locatif genevois dit souvent non, et cela ne te déstabilise pas.

  • Un œil pour les plans, tu vois d'emblée si le coliving fonctionne dans un appartement et combien de chambres sont réalistes.

  • Rigueur dans le travail avec des listes de contrôle, tu vas au bout de chaque point plutôt que de faire les choses à peu près, et tu repères les écarts. Aucune connaissance spécialisée en droit du bail n'est requise.

  • Permis de conduire catégorie B et disponibilité pour des visites régulières à Genève, dans la région lémanique et dans le reste de la Suisse romande.

  • Anglais courant, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, notre langue de travail interne.

BONUS

  • Expérience dans le secteur immobilier suisse (formation en gérance immobilière, cours USPI, activité de courtage)

  • Réseau existant auprès des régies et des propriétaires à Genève et dans la région lémanique

  • Expérience dans l'univers du coliving ou des appartements meublés avec services

  • Connaissances de base du droit du bail suisse

  • Allemand

Benefits

  • Salaire fixe plus bonus progressif pour chaque chambre acquise, sans plafond : plus tu acquiers de chambres, plus tu gagnes par chambre.

  • Bureau à Lausanne, avec la possibilité de télétravailler certains jours

  • Équipement de ton choix (ordinateur portable, écran, accessoires)

  • Des processus et des listes de contrôle documentés, et un·e responsable d'équipe à qui reviennent les exceptions, pour que tu puisses faire ta part avec précision au lieu d'improviser

  • Un rôle qui t'appartient : tu ne fais pas partie d'une équipe d'acquisition, tu es l'acquisition en Suisse romande

  • Une équipe internationale et solidaire, avec une vraie culture de l'apprentissage

  • Budget de formation continue (cours, livres, conférences)

  • Une vraie évolution : ton ambition détermine jusqu'où tu iras, tes résultats à quelle vitesse. Ton périmètre de responsabilité grandit avec les deux.

Chez Room Estate, tu bénéficies de vraies responsabilités et d'un feedback direct, sans micromanagement ni langue de bois. On se tutoie, on se dit les choses, et nous sommes exigeants : tu as le droit de l'être tout autant avec nous.

Des séminaires d'équipe, une fête d'été annuelle et une collaboration étroite avec des collègues de différents pays font partie de l'aventure et élargissent ton réseau personnel et professionnel. Mais l'essentiel est simple : nous voulons progresser chaque jour et nous cherchons des personnes qui le veulent aussi. Ici, tu assumes un rôle qui compte, dans un environnement international, et tu contribues activement à façonner l'avenir du coliving en Europe.

Rejoins Room Estate et construis avec nous l'avenir du logement. 🚀

title: Field Marketing Lead
descriptionHtml:
About the role

As Field Marketing Lead, you make sure our global strategy has local impact: every region turns our positioning, campaigns and content into pipeline in its own market.

Scope

Field marketing takes our global strategy into each market through four areas: pipeline support, partner marketing, events, and content. You'll build and lead a team of 3 Field Marketing Managers (North America, France & MEA, Italy, Spain & DACH).

The team is still being formed, and you'll help hire the regional roles. Success means pipeline sourced and influenced in every region, with field plans that stay aligned with global priorities.

Core responsibilities

Lead the team across the four areas

  • Pipeline support: make sure pipeline is generated locally and tracked through every GTM activation, with processes agreed with the sales, BDR and sales enablement managers.
  • Partner marketing: build the system that turns partner relationships into visibility, co-marketing, joint GTM motions and shared events, alongside our partnerships team.
  • Events: apply the global event strategy locally and bring regional feedback back into the global plan.
  • Content: localize global content, feed local insight back to the global content team, and design the media and PR activation program each region runs.

Cross-functional coordination

  • Coordinate across departments and functions so global plans and regional execution stay in sync.

Team, budget and reporting

  • Help hire the regional Field Marketing Managers, then coach them and set shared playbooks so every region works the same way.

Who you work with

  • Reports to: Global Head of Marketing

  • Daily collaboration: Global Head of Marketing, Content and Product Marketing leads, regional sales leaders
  • Key stakeholders: Sales leadership, Alliances & Legal Expertise, Revenue Ops

What we're looking for

  • 10+ years in B2B marketing, including at least 5 in field marketing and experience hiring and managing a team across several regions.
  • A B2B SaaS background: you know long sales cycles, complex buying committees and enterprise buyers.
  • You've built a multi-region field marketing plan and budget, and defended it with numbers.
  • Strong grasp of pipeline metrics and attribution, and proficient in HubSpot or a comparable CRM.
  • Experience across events, partner marketing, ABM and content.
  • PR and media relations experience, ideally running a media program across several markets.
  • Fluent English. French, Italian, Spanish or German is a plus.

What really sets you apart

  • Leader who still does the work: you coach your team and step in when a region needs an extra pair of hands.

  • Builder: you set up processes and playbooks where none exist yet.
  • Collaborative and proactive: you spot what needs doing and act before anyone asks.
  • AI in your daily work: you use it to analyse results, plan campaigns and move faster.

Recruitment process

1.Phone screening with Talent Acquisition 2.First interview with our Global Head of Marketing 3.Field marketing strategy case 4.Team and stakeholder interviews, including sales leadership 5.Final interview with our CEO or another key stakeholder

title: Founders Associate – Operations (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Vestlane und die Rolle

Vestlane ist die Plattform für Onboarding, KYC/AML und Tax Compliance für Private-Market-Fonds. Fondsmanager und Fondsadministratoren in ganz Europa wickeln über Vestlane ihre KYC-, AML- und Zeichnungsprozesse ab, in über 14 Jurisdiktionen und über den gesamten Investor-Lifecycle hinweg. Wir sind zertifiziert und für die regulatorische Realität spannender Akronyme gebaut – von GwG, BaFin, AMLR, RTS, CSSF bis hin zu DORA, RAIF, AIFMD, MiFID uvm.

Du willst sehen, wie ein B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen wirklich funktioniert? Du willst die Welt von Venture Capital und Private Equity von innen kennenlernen, ohne den Umweg über drei Jahre Investment Banking? Du baust lieber einen Prozess, der ein Problem dauerhaft löst, als es jede Woche neu zu lösen? Du arbeitest mit KI-Tools und Automatisierung so selbstverständlich wie andere mit Excel? Dann ist diese Rolle für dich!

Als Founders Associate arbeitest du direkt mit unserem COO zusammen, der Operations und Go-to-Market verantwortet. Du übernimmst die operativen Themen, die heute auf seinem Tisch liegen – von Prozessen und Tooling über Finance und Compliance bis HR – und bist nah dran an jeder Entscheidung, die das Unternehmen bewegt. Echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins, direkter Draht zu Steuerberatung, Dienstleistern und Partnern, und ein Überblick über ein wachsendes SaaS-Unternehmen, den dir kein Konzern bietet. 2–3 Tage pro Woche arbeitet ihr gemeinsam vor Ort im Raum Erfurt/Weimar, an einem Arbeitsplatz, den du von Anfang an mit aufbaust; den Rest flexibel aus dem Home-Office.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Die interne Maschine bauen (dein Schwerpunkt): Du dokumentierst, standardisierst und automatisierst unsere internen Abläufe – von einem Wiki, das tatsächlich gelesen wird, über KI-Agenten für wiederkehrende Aufgaben bis zur Verwaltung unserer Tool- und Vendorlandschaft (Verträge, Zugänge, Kosten). Du erkennst, wo wir Zeit verlieren, und beseitigst die Ursache.

  • Entscheidungen vorbereiten: Du baust Analysen und Entscheidungsvorlagen für COO und CEO – Unit Economics, Markt- und Wettbewerbsrecherchen, Investorenreporting – und lieferst Zahlen statt Meinungen.

  • Finance und Accounting unterstützen: Du übernimmst die vorbereitende Buchhaltung, prüfst und stellst Rechnungen, bereitest Zahlungsläufe vor, arbeitest unserer Steuerberatung zu und hältst Kosten- und Liquiditätsübersichten aktuell.

  • Compliance-Operations am Laufen halten: Du pflegst Nachweise und Richtlinien für ISO 27001 und SOC 2, bereitest Audits vor und hältst unsere Subprozessorenliste und Fristen in Ordnung.

  • Hiring und HR mittragen: Du schreibst Stellenanzeigen, screenst Bewerbungen, koordinierst Interviews und sorgst dafür, dass neue Kolleg:innen sauber onboarded werden – von Arbeitsvertrag und Equipment bis zum ersten Tag. Daneben hältst du unsere HR-Prozesse und -Tools in Ordnung.

  • Verträge und Angebote im Griff behalten: Du bereitest Angebote vor, hältst unsere Pipeline in Salesforce aktuell und behältst Kunden-, Partner- und Auftragsverarbeitungsverträge im Blick – Versionen, Fristen, Unterschriften.

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsrecht oder vergleichbar) oder eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung. Ob frisch von der Uni oder mit ein bis zwei Jahren Erfahrung aus Startup, Beratung oder Finanzbranche: Praktika und Werkstudententätigkeiten zählen, Haltung zählt mehr.

  • Sehr sicher in Excel/Google Sheets, strukturiert in Dokumentation und Projektmanagement. Erfahrung mit Salesforce, Buchhaltungs- oder Automatisierungstools (z. B. Zapier, Make, n8n) ist ein Plus.

  • Du arbeitest mit KI-Tools (Claude, ChatGPT o. ä.) nicht nur zum Texten, sondern um Prozesse zu bauen – und du weißt, wo du selbst prüfen musst.

  • Fließendes Deutsch und gutes Englisch – Partner, Dienstleister und Teile des Teams arbeiten auf Englisch.

  • Präzision und Pragmatismus: Du arbeitest selbstständig, fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist, und weißt, wann es auf jedes Detail ankommt – und wann nicht.

  • Du hast kein Problem damit, morgens eine Rechnung zu prüfen und nachmittags ein Bewerbungsgespräch zu organisieren. Breite ist für dich kein Mangel an Fokus, sondern die Chance, das ganze Unternehmen zu verstehen und zu Lernen.

  • Interesse an Fonds, Finanzregulierung oder Compliance ist willkommen, Vorwissen keine Voraussetzung – das bringen wir dir bei.

  • Du siehst dich als Unternehmer:in innerhalb von Vestlane, nicht als Zuarbeiter:in. Du willst heute Verantwortung und morgen Führung, und du willst dir beides erarbeiten, indem du etwas aufbaust.

Vorteile

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit COO und CEO, keine fünf Ebenen zwischen dir und den Entscheidungen

  • Vollzeit, unbefristet, Start ab sofort möglich

  • Kompetitives Gehaltspaket

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Bezahlte Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen

  • 2–3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort im Raum Erfurt/Weimar an einem Arbeitsplatz, den du mit dem COO gemeinsam aufbaust, sonst Home-Office; dazu Office-Möglichkeiten an unseren weiteren Standorten und flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Moderne Tools und KI im täglichen Einsatz

  • Ein Team, das Compliance ernst nimmt, weil Compliance das Produkt ist, kein Kostenfaktor

Abschluss

Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze dazu, warum gerade diese Rolle und warum gerade Vestlane. Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Wir prüfen deine Bewerbung persönlich und melden uns innerhalb von zwei Wochen.

Der Prozess ist bewusst kurz und hat zwei Schritte: ein 30-minütiges Kennenlerngespräch, in dem es um dich, deinen Weg und die Frage geht, ob wir zueinander passen. Danach bekommst du kurz vor dem zweiten Termin eine kleine praktische Aufgabe aus dem echten Alltag, die du uns in 45 Minuten vorstellst – damit du siehst, was dich erwartet, und wir sehen, wie du arbeitest und wie du Ergebnisse auf den Punkt bringst. Insgesamt weniger als anderthalb Stunden Gesprächszeit, und du bekommst nach jedem Schritt zeitnah Rückmeldung.

title: Founding Account Executive (Italian Speaker)
descriptionHtml:
About Sona

Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here (https://www.sona.ai/careers).

About the Role

We're hiring a Founding Account Executive to win Sona's first customers in Italy and open the market for us. This is a senior, seller-first role, and you'll run every conversation with prospects in Italian, from the first call to the close.

Our expansion into Europe is starting now and ramps up through 2027 across key markets. Italy is one of them, and you'll own the go-to-market launch there. Colleagues across Sona will be running the product, operations and other launch activities, so your focus is winning customers, building partnerships and creating the collateral to sell. With no sales team in market yet, you'll work with less support than a typical AE, and the team around you will grow as the market does.


Day to day, you'll decide which Retail and Hospitality accounts to go after, from mid-market through to enterprise, and run consultative sales conversations yourself. You'll also build what a new market needs, including partnerships and Italian-language collateral. The platform is already localised for Italy, and you'll have product and solutions support.

title: Founding implementation strategist [ERP + AI]
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR

  • We're building the SAP/NetSuite of the AI era for mid-sized companies in the real-world economy, starting with their supply chain operations (buy, sell, stock, produce)

  • Founding deployment strategist: you deploy two things into real factories, in the same project, the ERP that runs their operations, and the AI agents that work inside it. Every client goes from signed contract to go-live on the date we promised, running on Piston, with agents already doing part of the work

  • A rare shape: someone who has led client projects that landed in industrial companies, who is genuinely AI-native, and who will write the deployment playbook for the team and our system integrator partners

  • €3M Pre-seed (Top-tier VCs)

What this role is (and isn't)

Most ERP deployments are people moving data around for a year. Incumbents quote six figures for it, and the client gets the same software they had, just newer. Ours run in eight to twelve weeks and deliver two things at once: a new ERP that runs buying, selling, stock and production, and AI agents inside it that read the orders, recompute the production load, prepare the purchases, and ask a human only when it matters.

This is not a product or a sales role, you are a deployment strategist. In one project, you replace a company's ERP and you put AI agents to work inside it.

Why now

Since day one, the founders have run every deployment themselves. Clients are now coming in faster than we can handle, and we need someone to own deployments. You work directly with Eric, CEO, who also leads product. That puts you as close as it gets to what success means at Piston: the success of our clients.

What you'll do

  • Deploy the ERP, with AI. The client's sales, purchasing, stock and production move onto Piston: data migrated from their old ERP and their Excel files, configuration built from their own documents, training, go-live. AI does the heavy lifting, you do the judgment.

  • Put the first AI agents live, during the ERP deployment. You decide what each agent does on its own, what it hands to a human for approval, and you make sure it's still running three months later.

  • Write the deployment playbook. Every go-live feeds a playbook that our next deployment hires and our system integrator partners will follow.

  • Map where the client's time goes. On site, you find the work that eats people's days: re-keying orders, chasing suppliers, rebuilding the same Excel every month. That map is the backlog of the next agents.

  • Teach humans to work with agents. The people you deploy with have never supervised software that acts on its own. You show them how to trust it, check it and correct it.

  • Hold the date and the budget. You size each deployment before the contract and protect that budget.

  • Use the tools engineers build for you. Our engineers build the tools that let you deploy on your own: AI-assisted data migration from the client's old ERP and Excel files, and a builder for screens and agents. You tell them what slows you down, they make it disappear.

  • Agentify your own work. On top of the tools our engineers build, you create your own agents for the deployment itself: configuration checks, test scenarios, training material, status reports. Every manual step you repeat twice becomes an agent for the next deployment.

What you bring

You bring the energy to deploy AI at scale in industrial companies. You learn fast from discovery, and you're as comfortable with founders and leadership teams as with operators on the shop floor.

Must have

  • Customer-facing project experience. Two years or more managing client projects in an industrial environment, typically in consulting (operations, supply chain, transformation). You've held deadlines, managed stakeholders, and delivered.

  • AI-native, for real. You use LLMs every day, and you've built things with them: automations, agents, prompts that run in production (Claude, GPT, n8n, Make, scripts, whatever works). You know what an agent can do alone, where it breaks, and where a human must stay in the loop.

  • Listening before configuring. You translate what people say into what the system and the agents must do, and you notice when the two don't match.

  • At ease in front of clients: Plant directors, finance, shop-floor operators. You can hold a room, and say no in it.

  • A full load, gladly. Around 150 project days a year, several deployments running at once.

  • Fluent English and French, both required. Our first clients work in French, our team writes in English, and you may support our deployments in the United States.

Nice to have

  • You've automated a real operations process end to end, with measurable hours saved

  • You've already taken a complex B2B software live

  • Comfortable with AI

  • You've worked around manufacturing or food operations: lots, BOMs, production orders, campaigns

  • Seed / Series A experience, where nobody's job description holds for long

Talent beats checklists. If you're intrigued, apply anyway.

How we'll measure success

  • ERP go-lives on the date we promised

  • Days spent against the plan we sold

  • Agents still running three months after launch, and the hours of work they take off the client's hands

What you'll get

  • World-class peers

  • The first hire of our deployment team: you write the playbook that future hires and our system integrator partners will follow, and you grow with the team it builds

  • A front-row seat on how AI agents change the way real companies operate

  • Regular company offsite (2–4 times per year) in great locations

  • Ideal equipment and setup

  • Remote-first (France), about 20% of your time on client sites

Process

We value efficiency and clarity. The entire process takes no more than 2 weeks:

  1. 30-minute intro call with Florian (CRO)

  2. 60-minute deployment deep dive with Eric (CEO)

  3. 30-min cultural-fit interview with Eugène (CTO)

  4. 2 days paid assessment, on a real client situation.

  5. Offer: If it's a match, we move fast.

Interested? Tell us about a client project you led, and something you automated with AI. A short, personal note goes a long way, AI-generated cover letters don't.

title: FPGA Engineer - Electronic Warfare
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As an FPGA Engineer within our Electronic Warfare team, you will design and implement the real-time digital signal processing that turns raw RF into actionable effect — from receiver channelization and threat detection through to jamming waveform generation. You will own the RTL at the heart of our EW and SIGINT systems, working hand-in-hand with the RF hardware, embedded software and algorithm teams to take a signal chain from concept and simulation to silicon, to the lab, and into the field.

Responsibilities

  • RTL Design & Implementation: Design and implement signal-processing datapaths in VHDL or SystemVerilog — digital down-conversion, channelizers, filtering, FFT and detection chains — from specification through to validation.

  • Real-Time DSP in Fabric: Implement detection, direction-finding, classification and waveform generation under hard latency and throughput budgets, translating algorithm intent into fixed-point hardware.

  • RF & Data Converter Interfacing: Own the digital interface to the RF front-end — high-speed converters (JESD204B/C), multi-channel clocking, synchronization and calibration paths.

  • Hardware/Software Partitioning: Define the split between programmable logic and on-chip processors, and the register and streaming interfaces the embedded software team builds against.

  • Timing Closure & Resource Budgets: Drive constraints, timing closure, and resource, power and thermal budgets on production hardware.

  • Bring-up, Integration & Validation: Lead FPGA bring-up on new boards, bench validation against performance targets with RF instrumentation, and over-the-air testing alongside the systems team.

  • Technical Coordination: Collaborate across RF hardware, embedded, GNC and ML teams on system integration and technical interfaces.

title: Graduate / Junior Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
About THG Ingenuity 

THG Ingenuity is a proprietary Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) technology, robotics, and operations platform built for global ecommerce. Developed through more than two decades of operating ecommerce and retail services at scale, its software and automation capabilities have been engineered, tested, and refined through the real-world demands of managing complex commerce operations. Today, THG Ingenuity provides an integrating operating environment that enables brands to intelligently optimise the entire commerce lifecycle from browsing and checkout to AI inventory management and forecasting, automated fulfilment, carrier control, and customer experience. The platform comprises: 

  • THG Fulfil: The fulfilment operating system for global ecommerce. Delivered via a proprietary SaaS and Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model, THG Fulfil orchestrates every stage of checkout, fulfilment, delivery, and customer experience through an integrated system. 
  • THG Studios: The UK's most innovative creative hub, helping brands create content that connects, experiences that engage, and IP that scales, all from its end-to-end, in-house facilities.  
  • THG Commerce: A cloud-native technology stack enabling retailers and brands to create intelligent, AI-powered, digital shopping experiences, while integrated marketplace and social commerce functionality allows brands to reach customers across every sales channel 

With its expertise in building and scaling brands, THG Ingenuity is uniquely positioned to bring pertinent, pragmatic, and global know-how across all aspects of commerce. 

The Role

We are seeking a talented and commercially astute Data Scientist to join our dynamic team tackling Fraud, Payments and Finance. In this multi-focus role, you will be responsible for protecting our global e-commerce operations from fraud, optimising our payments performance and driving profitability and automation initiatives within Finance.

Working with vast, complex datasets, the work will involve combatting online fraud using our award-winning THG Detect platform and driving payments optimisation by increasing authorisation rates, while also using the latest AI software and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure to build complex data solutions and applications.

This role requires a blend of strong technical skills, commercial acumen, and effective communication to translate complex data insights into tangible business value.

Responsibilities:

  • Optimise Fraud Detection: Continuously improve automated decision-making in our in-house THG Detect platform using machine learning and decision rules.
  • Enhance Payment Performance: Lead data-driven initiatives to boost payment authorisation rates, optimise transaction routing, and reduce costs.
  • Drive Profitability within Finance: Lead automation and profitability initiatives across different areas of Finance.
  • Communicate Performance: Report on all aspects of fraud, payments and finance performance to stakeholders at all levels, including C-level management.
  • Drive System Improvements: Collaborate with Fraud, Payments, Finance and Engineering teams to scope and implement enhancements to detection systems and data pipelines.
  • Innovate & Automate: Proactively identify opportunities to improve detection capabilities, drive profitability, increase payment success, and enhance team efficiency through automation.

Requirements:

  • Proficient with SQL & Python
  • Proficient in a data visualisation software (Tableau/Looker/PowerBI/e.t.c.)
  • Experience using a variety of machine learning algorithms
  • Able to communicate effectively; using data to tell a story and drive business change
  • Experience within Google Cloud preferential

title: GRC Specialist (German-speaking)
descriptionHtml:
Remote from the UK, Germany, Austria, Poland, Montenegro or Serbia. C1 German Language is essential

At Secfix, we’re at the forefront of automating security compliance in Europe. We help companies get and stay ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, and SOC 2 fast and easy and reduce hundreds of hours of manual work.

Secfix is run by a 100% remote team with hubs in Munich, Berlin and London. We’re a high-performing team looking for passionate, execution-focused, owners to help us automate security and compliance for modern companies and become the European compliance automation leader.

We’ve just raised our $12M Series A and are backed by top VCs, including Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital.

About the Role

We're hiring a GRC Specialist (Governance Risk and Compliance) to strengthen our compliance function as Secfix scales into more frameworks, mid-market customers, and a growing compliance team. This role sits at the intersection of compliance delivery, content, and team support. You'll own the compliance knowledge that lives inside our platform, run internal audits, support our customer success team, and act as the compliance voice for customers, auditors, and product. You'll work closely with our co-founder & CISO and our CS Lead. This is a high-impact role with real influence on how Secfix delivers compliance: both as a service to customers and as content inside our app.

What You'll Do:

You will own one of the most important pillars of Secfix: the quality and breadth of our compliance offering. We don't (and can't afford to) micro-manage. We've built strong foundations and will give you full context on what works. You can test new approaches, but at the end of the day, you have full ownership of how you deliver results (with a strong support network from within and outside the company). You will:

  • Build and maintain compliance frameworks in the Secfix platform (ISO 27001, TISAX, SOC 2, GDPR, NIS 2, DORA, ISO 27017/27018, ISO 42001, C5, and more as we expand)

  • Own internal audits for our customers end to end, from kickoff through to the final report they take into their external audit

  • Keep several audits moving at once and keep every one on schedule

  • Implement ISO 27001 and adjacent frameworks end-to-end for customers

  • Own the quality of compliance content in the platform (including creating policies, automated checks, evidence templates, Compliance enable playbooks for our CSMs, security awareness trainings and more)

  • Close framework gaps and incorporate auditor feedback into both team practice and platform improvements

  • Partner with product and engineering to translate compliance gaps into structured product work

  • Collaborate closely with CS, Product, and Founders to align compliance, customer, and roadmap priorities

  • Deepen relationships with our existing certification partners and train auditors on the Secfix platform so they can confidently use it during customer audits

To be qualified for this role, you must have the following:

  • German (C1/C2) and English (fluent) are a must for this role

  • 3+ years of hands‑on information security and GRC experience

  • Led at least 1 successful ISO 27001 certification projects as an implementer and/or auditor at a startup or mid-market company

  • You have run at least 2 internal audits before.

  • Hands on experience with a GRC platform like Secfix, or similar GRC platforms

  • Real depth in at least one framework beyond ISO 27001 (TISAX, SOC 2, GDPR, NIS2, or similar).

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to break down ambiguous initiatives into concrete deliverables, prioritizes ruthlessly, and ships

  • Excellent written communication, especially in producing clear, precise compliance content for diverse audiences (auditors, founders, engineers)

  • Strong ownership mindset: operates as an individual contributor without waiting for direction

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent hands-on technical experience.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience in a startup environment is a plus

Interview Process:

title: Growth Marketer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:

People who build lose nearly a quarter of their working time to things that have nothing to do with building. Ferdinand, an electrician and engineer who had founded companies before, started Benetics AI in 2022 to give that time back. Our first product is a voice assistant for the construction site. It works in over 100 languages and every dialect, and nobody has to type.

More than 500 companies in 10+ countries use Benetics AI: electricians, HVAC installers, timber builders, roofers and solar installers. We are bootstrapped, cash-flow positive and growing in triple digits.

About the role

We are looking for a growth marketer who likes making things and getting them in front of the right people. You will own campaigns across our channels, with Meta, Google and organic social as the main ones today: you plan them, make the content and build the AI workflows behind them. You will work closely with marketing, product and sales, using customer feedback and campaign results to decide what to make next.

What we're looking for

  • High quality bar: Strong judgment and a track record of shipping work that stands out, from ad copy to short-form video.

  • Audience & account-driven: Deeply understand the trades we serve and use what customers and sales tell you to shape every campaign.

  • Multi-channel experience: Hands-on depth across several channels, today mostly Meta Ads, Google Ads and organic social.

  • Content creation & repurposing: Create posts and short-form video, and turn customer stories and product demos into formats that fit each channel.

  • Test and scale: Test clear hypotheses on audiences, messages and creative, and feed what you learn into the next round.

  • Marketing analytics: Track spend and lead quality across channels with input from sales, and keep reporting simple and useful.

  • AI builder: Build AI workflows and agents that turn customer insights and performance data into new copy, images and video, share them with the team, and keep human review where it matters.

  • Sets & hits goals: Own the goals for your channels, measured on cost per lead and lead quality, and decide what to cut and what to scale.

  • Velocity: Move quickly from idea to launch and adapt as channels and tools change.

  • Language & location: Excellent German and English, spoken and written, and based in Zurich, working from our office on site

Experience

  • 3 to 5 years in growth or performance marketing, with campaigns you ran hands-on and can talk through.

  • Experience at a B2B tech company; small businesses or the construction trades as an audience are a plus.

  • Experience with HubSpot and with connecting creative or marketing tools through automation is helpful.

Why Benetics AI

  • A profitable, bootstrapped company with no investor setting the plan.

  • Ownership of your channels and the workflows behind them, with room to test and improve how we work.

  • Close work with marketing, product and sales, with customer feedback and product knowledge feeding into your content and campaigns.

  • Freedom to pick your tools and automate routine work.

How we hire
