title: Mechanical Systems Engineer - Landing Gear (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

We are looking for a Mechanical Systems Engineer to help us develop and integrate the Landing Gear System of our fully battery-electric aircraft (CS-23). You will take a leading role in defining, integrating and certifying the retractable landing gear system of a clean-sheet battery-electric aircraft, including extension/retraction actuation, wheels & brakes, tires, steering, anti-skid functions and associated indication sub-systems. Your work will span the full system development lifecycle, from system-level requirements, architecture and functional analysis through preliminary and detailed design, supplier involvement, prototype assembly support, ground & flight testing and certification. You will work closely with overall aircraft design, structures, flight physics, avionics, and other engineering teams to ensure optimal system integration and will play a key role in the detailed definition of the overall aircraft.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Define and derive system-level requirements for the landing gear system based on CONOPS, aircraft-level requirements and applicable regulations.

  • Perform system-level functional analysis, including functional decomposition and identification of system interfaces.

  • Contribute to the definition and development of the landing gear system to achieve the required level of maturity at each aircraft design phase.

  • Define and manage functional and physical interfaces between the landing gear system and other aircraft systems and structures.

  • Define system-level verification and validation strategies, including support for ground and flight test campaigns and qualification testing of landing gear equipment and assemblies.

  • Collaborate with partners and suppliers as a technical interface for landing gear system integration.

  • Support Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA) and system safety activities in accordance with ARP4754A, ARP4761A and applicable certification requirements.

  • Support system integration, verification, testing and certification activities.

 

Your Profile:

  • Engineering degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.

  • 5+ years of aerospace experience, with a focus on aircraft retractable landing gear systems.

  • Experience with systems engineering, including requirements definition, functional analysis and system integration.

  • Experience across the aircraft development lifecycle, including EASA/FAA Part 23 or 25 certification.

  • Experience working in an EASA Part 21J organization, or international equivalent.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; another European language is a plus.

  • Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight.

  • Experience with electric or hybrid-electric aircraft and strong understanding of aircraft systems is a plus.

  • Experience working in an aerospace startup or new aircraft development programme would be beneficial.

  • Previous CVE or equivalent technical authority responsibility for landing gear systems on CS-23 aircraft program is a plus.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

title: Mixed-signal IC Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago is an AI and computer hardware company whose mission is to drive the course of history forward. We do so by accelerating breakthroughs at the intersection of AI and semiconductors.

Founded in 2024 by AI researchers and physicists with deep expertise in photonics, electronics, software, mathematics, and machine learning, Arago brings together a lean team of engineers and scientists from the world’s top companies and research labs.

Composed of nine nationalities and operating from hubs in France, North America, and Israel, we believe in great science and fast achievements. Our work is guided by these core principles:

  1. Do great things: we deliver work we’re proud to sign our name to.

  2. High velocity: speed matters. We move quickly, one step at a time.

  3. One unit: we’re all in this together, with relationships grounded in trust, respect, and camaraderie.

Arago is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent US and European deeptech venture firms and exited founders.

What you’ll do

Design, integrate, and deliver high-performance digital subsystems within mixed-signal ICs, enabling control, calibration, and high-speed data movement in analog-centric environments — owning the flow from RTL to physical implementation and tape-out.

Responsibilities

  • Design and verify digital subsystems that interface directly with high-speed analog and mixed-signal circuits — including calibration engines, control FSMs, data converters, and multiplexing logic.

  • Contribute to the design of analog components at the digital-analog interface: calibration circuits, DACs/ADCs, comparators, and others.

  • Integrate and customize external IP blocks (e.g., GPIOs, LVDS I/Os, serial interfaces), ensuring compliance with analog signal and timing requirements.

  • Lead the digital implementation flow for mixed-signal blocks: from RTL to synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, timing closure, physical signoff, and tape-out.

  • Collaborate closely with analog, layout, and system teams to co-optimize digital-analog boundaries, resolve cross-domain issues, and ensure robust high-speed performance.

  • Contribute to the development of high-speed serial I/O subsystems — experience in the design and implementation of SerDes blocks is a significant advantage.

  • Language: English at a proficient level. French is a plus.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong experience in digital RTL design (Verilog/SystemVerilog), particularly for mixed-signal systems involving high-speed calibration/control loops, converters, multiplexers, and serial/parallel data paths.

  • Experience with analog IC development environments (Virtuoso or equivalent).

  • Deep understanding of digital-analog integration challenges, including timing closure, noise coupling, clock domain crossing, and analog-aware floorplanning in high-speed environments.

  • Proven ability to drive digital blocks from design through verification, synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, and tape-out, especially in the context of analog or RF ICs.

  • Skilled in integrating and adapting external IPs such as GPIOs, LVDS, SPI/I²C interfaces; experience with high-speed serializers/deserializers (SerDes) is a highly valued plus.

  • Proficient with industry-standard EDA toolchains for both front-end (design/verification) and back-end (physical implementation), with a strong grasp of mixed-signal layout constraints.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered at the earliest stage of the company (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Relocation bonus and coverage of moving expenses for relocation within 20 minutes of the company’s location.

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

  • Reimbursement of 50% of the public transport subscription fee.

  • A high-paced, multicultural (with 9 nationalities), and engineering-led environment.

descriptionHtml:
English version

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s'engager au sein d'une institution où la science et l'innovation construisent un avenir plus durable. C'est une école d'excellence où chacun a la possibilité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d'ingénieurs de France et reconnue à l'international, notre école, membre de l'Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en s'engageant activement face aux grands enjeux industriels, numériques et environnementaux. En nous rejoignant, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 membres du personnel et 2 500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : allier excellence académique, recherche de pointe et impact sociétal positif.

L'Institut Mines-Télécom rassemble les plus grandes Écoles françaises pour relever les grands défis industriels, numériques, énergétiques et environnementaux. Avec ses huit Grandes Écoles publiques et ses deux Graduate Schools affiliées, il constitue le premier institut public dédié à la formation des ingénieurs et des managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable en formant les leaders qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Le département d'électronique flexible développe des connaissances technologiques et scientifiques dans le domaine de l'électronique souple. Le département dispose d'une solide expertise dans la caractérisation électrique et mécanique des matériaux et des interfaces. Ses activités sont regroupées au sein d'une plateforme de 660 m². Cette plateforme technologique rassemble des installations et des équipements technologiques dédiés aux activités de R&D en micropackaging, micro- et nano-électronique, au sein d'une salle blanche de 220 m² en classe 1000 et de 400 m² en classe 10 000.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que stagiaire, le/la candidat(e) réalisera des innovations et des activités de recherche dans le domaine de l’électronique. Au sein du département d’électronique flexible (FEL) du Centre de Microélectronique de Provence (CMP), le/la candidat(e) combinera passion des science et désir d’impact sociétal.

Ce stage fait partie du projet de recherche Sens-CO qui met en partenariat l’Université Gustave Eiffel, l’Ecole polytechnique et l’Ecole des mines de Saint-Etienne. Ce projet vise à développer un capteur de gaz NOx et COx portable pour un monitoring environnemental en continu. La résistance interne du capteur varie avec la concentration de gaz mesurée. Le rôle du CMP est d’obtenir précisément la valeur de cette résistance à travers un circuit électronique et de permettre la corrélation avec la concentration en gaz ainsi que le traitement et l’envoi des données par communication sans contact. Ce circuit doit permettre une mesure portable et nécessite donc d’être réalisé sur un substrat flexible.

Le/la candidat(e) devra ainsi, à partir d’un design réalisé sur PCB rigide, transposer cette interface de capteur de gaz sur un substrat souple en tenant compte des enjeux liés à ces méthodes. Compte tenu de la grande valeur des résistances à mesurer, le PCB final devra permettre :

· Une mesure précise de grandes valeurs de résistance

· Un faible-bruit et résistance aux interférences électromagnétiques, en tenant compte de l’agencement des composants pour permettre de garantir une flexibilité maximale.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons :

Vous êtes actuellement en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur en spécialisation génie électrique, électronique, systèmes embarqués ou domaines associés.

Vous devez :

· Présenter un fort intérêt pour l’électronique, les systèmes embarqués et la fabrication (soudure, routage et réalisation de circuits électronique).

· Présenter une expérience avec les outils de conception de circuits électriques ainsi qu’en conception de PCB et qu’en compatibilité électromagnétique.

Une approche expérimentale et une connaissance de conception de circuits imprimés sont essentielles.


🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre les Mines de Saint-Etienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l'excellence, avec la conviction qu'ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c'est l'opportunité de trouver :

  • Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un cadre de travail accueillant et un solide réseau international (T.I.M.E., EULiST).

  • Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle représentant 11 millions d'euros par an, principalement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique, La Rotonde, engagé depuis 25 ans dans la médiation scientifique et accueillant plus de 50 000 visiteurs par an.

  • Frais de transports en commun pris en charge à hauteur de 75% (sous conditions),

  • Foyer du personnel (activités sportives, culturelles, avantages CE sur des loisirs et temps de convivialité),

  • 1 jour de congé par mois (à poser sous réserve de l'accord du tuteur)

descriptionHtml:

Want a closer look before you apply? Explore our Careers site to learn more about our people, culture, and benefits.

Summary

As a Partner Success Manager (PSM), you will play a critical role in driving the success of the OneStream partner ecosystem. You’ll be responsible for developing, supporting and growing all skillsets within a portfolio of strategic partners. This role blends relationship management, enablement strategy, and operational excellence to help partners build a scalable, high performing and self-sufficient practice. 

The Partner Success position bridges the gap between OneStream’s internal teams—such as customer success, partner alliances and partner enablement —and its partners, managing the functional and technical aspects of partner implementations, making sure partner needs are addressed promptly and thoroughly, and fostering lasting relationships to enhance the partner experience. This includes project tracking, partner health and growth, partner program tier levelling, measurement through scorecards, OnePass utilization and ensuring skill level certifications. 

Orchestrating engagements centrally with project involvement will strengthen the understanding of how and when to engage the wider CSRC teams and provide opportunities for enablement/training of our partners. 

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

Partner Relationship & Support 

  • Act as the primary point of contact for implementation partners, ensuring the partner has the necessary resources and both technical and functional support. 
  • Own regular partner status calls to discuss partner project delivery status and delivery concerns. 
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with partners to drive success of OneStream implementations and partner success. 
  • Provide guidance on overall partner health and future planning with the partner. 
  • Serve as a co-liaison with Partner Alliances between partners and internal teams (Support, Remote Consulting, Partner Enablement, Engineering, Customer Success), focusing on creating value for the partner by guiding them to appropriate teams and processes when needed. 
  • Alert Partner Alliances and other internal leadership concerns related to the delivery of project timelines mitigating risk. 
  • Provide input to Partner Delivery Managers on the leveling of partners based on experience working with specific implementation partners and their perceived skillsets. 
  • Maintain clear and concise communication with partners and internal stakeholders. 
  • Responsible for driving the partners to develop and maintain a COE function within their practices.

Project Oversight & Functional Support 

  • Monitor and support partner led implementations to ensure adherence to project delivery and partner success. 
  • Review projects plans and provide recommendations to project timelines and go-live success. 
  • Seek opportunities to increase customer satisfaction and adoption via Functional enablement to our partners. Recommend the use of enablement materials to partners based on customer requirements and expectations. 
  • Review partner cases and their nature to ensure they are utilizing their internal COE correctly. 
  • Review and identify key deliverables for partner success. 

Enablement 

  • Develop and deliver partner Seismic pages with functional information, new features and solution content. 
  • Actively engage partners with COE with online (i.e.Navigator) courses, content and enablement materials. 

Process Improvement 

  • Identify opportunities to improve partner processes and develop strategies to improve efficiency. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve proactive enablement and proactive services and develop strategies and new services to prevent customer escalations. 
  • Create SOP documentation on engaged projects and look to role this out further for governance on projects 
  • GAP analysis with alliances to help build a more robust framework for our partners for processes and active projects/project management. 

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in fields such as (but not limited to) Accounting, Business, Finance, Information Systems, Mathematics, or CIS, or equivalent work experience. 
  • Minimum 2 years of experience with project management, stakeholder management, or account management. 
  • Minimum 5 years of experience consulting or Functional account management for software implementations for CPM/EPM platforms. 

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Master’s degree in business, Accounting, Finance, or Information Technology.  
  • A professional accounting designation (e.g. CPA, CMA, CGA, CA), advanced degrees (MBA, MFA), and/or other professional designations or certifications (applicable to accounting/finance and information technology) 
  • Project management, program management or account management expertise. 
  • Prior experience in Partner Success or Customer Success. 
  • Deep experience with SQL, C#, VB.net, or Visual Basic. Any object-oriented programing a plus. 
  • Prior experience and expertise in Scalability and Performance of EPM/CPM products. 
  • Prior experience with Azure based SaaS platforms. 
  • Prior experience using Telemetry tools to monitor EPM/CPM applications. 
  • Prior experience with any of the following products is a plus: 
    • SAP Outlooksoft BPC or SAP BOFC (Cartesis). 
    • Hyperion Planning, Hyperion Essbase, Hyperion Financial Management (HFM). 
    • FDM (Financial Data Quality Management) or UpStream. 
    • IBM Cognos. 
    • Other EPM solutions. 
    • Other GSI/RSI partner implemented SaaS solutions i.e. BlackLine, Trintech, Workiva etc.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Excellent project skills related to product implementation. 
  • Excellent customer service skills. 
  • An ability to effectively communicate concise functional guidance and recommendations. 
  • Ability to develop trust and strong relationships. 
  • Ability to deliver difficult feedback regarding product implementations and project status.

Dein Einstieg als Mitunternehmer:in

Wir möchten BeginnerBudget künftig gemeinsam mit dir als Gesellschafter:innen weiterführen. Dabei bringt jede Person ihre Stärken ein und verantwortet einen eigenen Bereich.

Deine Mitgesellschafter:innen bleiben aktiv an deiner Seite. Wir kümmern uns um die weiteren Unternehmensbereiche und treiben auch die betriebswirtschaftliche Entwicklung voran, beispielsweise durch Kalkulation, Planung und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Abläufe. Wichtige strategische Entscheidungen treffen wir gemeinsam.

Langfristig übernimmst du eine führende Rolle innerhalb unserer gemeinsamen Unternehmensführung. Wie sich die Verantwortungsbereiche weiterentwickeln, gestalten wir zusammen.

Wie wir deinen Einstieg, die Unternehmensbeteiligung und deine Vergütung ausgestalten, besprechen wir persönlich.

Dein Verantwortungsbereich

  • Du wirst das Gesicht von BeginnerBudget und vertrittst die Marke nach außen.

  • Du entwickelst unsere Social-Media-Präsenz weiter, planst Inhalte und setzt sie selbst um.

  • Du stehst vor der Kamera und machst private Budgetierung verständlich, persönlich und alltagsnah.

  • Du baust unsere Community aus, pflegst den Austausch und verstehst ihre Bedürfnisse.

  • Du bringst Ideen für neue Produkte, Inhalte und Aktionen ein und entwickelst sie mit dem Team weiter.

  • Du setzt Prioritäten für deinen Bereich und trägst dazu bei, dass die Marke wächst und sich wirtschaftlich weiterentwickelt.

Das bringst du mit

Eigene Budgetierungserfahrung: Du planst dein Haushaltsbudget seit mehreren Jahren und kennst die Herausforderungen aus deinem Alltag.

Freude an Social Media: Du kannst Inhalte entwickeln und umsetzen und fühlst dich vor der Kamera wohl.

Unternehmerischen Antrieb: Du möchtest als Mitinhaber:in Verantwortung tragen, Entscheidungen treffen und BeginnerBudget gemeinsam mit uns langfristig aufbauen.

Nähe zur Community: Du kannst zuhören, verständlich erklären und Menschen für das Thema begeistern.

Zeit und Verbindlichkeit: Du kannst dich zum Einstieg mindestens in Teilzeit einbringen und möchtest deine Rolle langfristig weiterentwickeln.

Deine Mitgesellschafter:innen und das Team an deiner Seite

Hinter BeginnerBudget steht ein eingespieltes, fünfköpfiges Team. Gemeinsam mit deinen Mitgesellschafter:innen übernimmt es die weiteren operativen Bereiche: Grafikdesign und gestalterische Umsetzung, Shopify, angebundene Systeme und Marktplätze sowie den Kundensupport.

Auch Produktentwicklung, Beschaffung, die Zusammenarbeit mit Lieferant:innen, Werbung und die Automatisierung interner Prozesse decken wir ab. Deine Produktideen entwickeln wir gemeinsam weiter und kümmern uns um die Umsetzung.

So kannst du dich auf deinen Verantwortungsbereich konzentrieren und auf ein bestehendes Team sowie aktive Mitgesellschafter:innen zurückgreifen. Gemeinsam bringen wir BeginnerBudget als Unternehmen voran.

Die Zusammenarbeit ist remote innerhalb Deutschlands vorgesehen.

Lass uns kennenlernen

descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

The core purpose of this role is to turn accounting firms into long-term Alan partners and advocates. title: Pentester senior
descriptionHtml:
Mobeta est une société de cybersécurité offensive qui combine pentesters humains, agents IA et éditeur de Rigma (plateforme de sécurité offensive continue).

Nous réalisons des tests d’intrusion ponctuels ou continus sur les surfaces externes et les environnements internes, avec Rigma pour piloter les vulnérabilités, suivre leur remédiation et revérifier les corrections dans le temps.

Nous recherchons un/une pentester senior afin de diriger techniquement notre équipe de pentest.

Selon le profil, ce poste peut permettre d'accéder au capital de la société via des BSPCE.

Vos missions

  • Réaliser de nombreux pentests sur divers environnements et applications : externes, web, internes, Cloud, etc. (vous n'aurez pas d'audit organisationnel) ;

  • Réaliser et encadrer nos campagnes de Red Team ;

  • Automatiser vos attaques dans notre plateforme Rigma.

Management de l'équipe pentest

  • Encadrer et faire monter en compétence les pentesters de l'équipe ;

  • Participer au recrutement des pentesters afin de construire une équipe cohérente avec notre ADN.

Rayonnement technique de Mobeta

  • Encadrer les sujets R&D de l'équipe pentest (blog posts, outils, recherche de 0-day) ;

  • Représenter Mobeta en conférences (talks).

Outillage technique & IA

  • Industrialisation et automatisation des phases répétitives du pentest ;

  • Veille active, capitalisation ;

  • Exploitation maximale de l'IA ;

  • Collaborer étroitement avec l’équipe produit et participer aux développements à intégrer dans Rigma.

La partie Missions Pentest / Red Team est prioritaire et indispensable, elle représentera, surtout au début, la majorité de votre temps de travail.

Les autres tâches seront intégrées au fur et à mesure de la montée en responsabilité.

Vos compétences

  • Expérience confirmée en pentest / Red Team ;

  • Maîtrise d’un langage de scripting ainsi que des principes de développement sécurisé ;

  • Capacité à encadrer et faire progresser une équipe ;

  • Passionné par la sécurité informatique et le pentest (challenges, CTF, etc.) ;

  • Utilisation intense de l'IA pour les usages concrets, notamment appliqués au pentest ;

  • Sens de l'organisation et de la rigueur, avec de fortes capacités d'analyse et rédactionnelles ;

  • Capacité à apprendre rapidement ;

  • Aisance à l’oral et capacité à restituer clairement des sujets techniques ;

  • Humble et fiable ;

  • Présence physique au moins partielle dans nos locaux à Paris.

Ce qui est apprécié :

  • Certifications en sécurité offensive (OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, CRTE, prolabs HTB, etc.) ;

  • Contributions publiques à l’écosystème : blog technique, outils open source, etc.

Avantages

  • Selon le profil, ce poste peut permettre d'accéder au capital de la société via des BSPCE ;

You will own the roadmap for our HR technology stack, from the HRIS transformation to integrations and data architecture, and build the analytics, dashboards and models that help our leaders understand how we hire, grow, retain and reward our people, and act on what they learn.

You will do it the Mistral way: automating people processes with our own models, workflows and agents, and partnering with HR Operations, Business Partnering, Legal, Finance and IT to turn business needs into well-designed systems.

You will lead a small team, starting with a People Tech & Analytics Engineer, alongside a large team of agents running our back-end HR processes, giving a fast-growing global company the clarity to make great people decisions at speed, with a seamless employee experience from hire to retire.

 

What You Will Do

  • Own the people-tech roadmap and the HR tech stack end to end: what we build, buy, integrate or retire, the configuration standards, workflows, roles and permissions that govern it, vendor relationships, and the data pipelines across HRIS, ATS, payroll, identity and finance so data flows reliably between systems.

  • Define the people metrics that matter and lead analysis on workforce trends, retention and organisational health, turning insight into clear recommendations and workforce planning.

  • Oversee dashboards, self-serve reporting and conversational insights, so managers get answers without waiting on a spreadsheet.

  • Drive people-data governance, partnering with Legal and Privacy to keep people data compliant and AI use on it lawful, transparent and proportionate.

  • Own the automation and AI roadmap for people processes: build agents and workflows with Mistral's own models and APIs, set the standards for how they're designed, tested and monitored, and lead cross-functional projects from scoping to rollout.

  • Manage and mentor the People Tech & Analytics Engineer, set priorities, and grow the team as needs evolve.

     

What We're Looking For

  • Deep experience in HR technology and people analytics, ideally in a high-growth tech company: expert in at least one, broad in both, and comfortable building from scratch.

  • A strong product mindset: you turn complex business and employee needs into intuitive, practical solutions, starting from the HR need, not the technology.

  • Strong workflow-automation experience (n8n or similar) and a real appetite to build with our own LLMs, agents and APIs, with the judgement to know where AI helps and where it doesn't.

  • Solid analytics foundations (forecasting, visualisation, modern data stack such as Snowflake or BigQuery), experience building people analytics and data governance on workforce data, and working knowledge of GDPR as it applies to employee data.

  • Experience presenting to senior leaders, turning data into clear, decision-ready recommendations, and managing or mentoring technical or analytical team members, with the hands-on pragmatism to prototype and review technical work yourself.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

The role

Paid acquisition is one of the biggest levers we have on growth, and it's about to get a lot bigger. We run Google Search, LinkedIn and Meta today, we're adding new formats and channels, and over the next year we'll be running paid across more markets and across both sides of Dex: the engineers who use it and the companies who hire through it.

You'll own our paid channels day to day. You'll decide where the money goes, launch and test campaigns quickly, and judge every channel on the quality of the people it brings in, not on clicks or cheap signups. Creative comes from our in-house creative lead, writers and UGC creators; your job is to brief them well, test what they make and scale what works.

This isn't a role where you sit in the ad accounts all week. Once the channels are running well, we want you to take on more: client-side acquisition, new channels, and building your own tools with AI to do the job faster.

What you'll do

  • Own Google Search, LinkedIn and Meta: structure, budgets, bidding, audiences and day-to-day optimisation.

  • Launch new campaigns in days, not weeks. Run a steady programme of tests across audiences, formats and landing pages.

  • Judge channels on what matters to Dex: good candidates and the ones who get put forward to clients. Work with our data to make sure conversion tracking and attribution are right, and push quality signals back into the platforms.

  • Brief creative. Work with our creative lead, writers and UGC creators on what to make, tell them what's working and kill what isn't.

  • Open up new channels as we grow, such as YouTube, Performance Max, retargeting and new markets.

  • Help take paid into client acquisition: getting Dex in front of heads of talent, engineering leaders and founders.

  • Manage our paid media agency and any contractors, and bring more of the work in-house over time.

  • Report clearly on spend and results each week, and say plainly what you'd change.

Who we're looking for

  • Hands on in performance marketing, managing real budgets yourself across paid search and paid social. Meta and LinkedIn experience matters most.

  • You've worked at a tech company, or you're ready for your first in-house role after a couple of years at a strong agency.

  • You care about what happens after the click. You've optimised for downstream quality, not just cost per lead, and you know how to set up tracking that you trust.

  • Comfortable with data. You can pull your own numbers, spot when something looks wrong, and explain what's going on without a dashboard doing it for you.

  • You move fast and like owning things. You'd rather ship a test today than plan it for a week.

  • You use AI tools daily, and you're happy building small tools, scripts or agents to do your job better. You don't need to be an engineer.

Strong nice-to-haves

  • You've run performance marketing for both consumer (B2C) and business (B2B) audiences, ideally at more than one tech company.

  • You've worked closely with a creative studio or run UGC at volume, so you know what a good brief looks like.

If you don't tick every box but this sounds like you, apply anyway.

Why join now

  • You'll own a channel mix that's growing fast, with the budget and freedom to try things.

  • You'll work on a product people care about. Changing jobs is one of the biggest decisions engineers make, and we want them to trust us with it.

  • You'll work closely with the founders and the Head of Growth, with a lot of room to grow your scope.

  • Everyone here builds with AI. You'll have the tools and the time to work that way.

What we offer

  • Above-market salary

  • Significant equity

  • Private healthcare and dental

  • Fertility benefits and enhanced parental support

  • Gym membership and wellness benefits

  • Claude tokens

  • Regular socials, offsites and an annual team trip

  • MacBook Pro and team equipment

  • A "whatever you need" approach to tools and support

The process

  1. Talent screen with Becca, Head of Talent (30 min)

  2. Hiring manager interview with Rob, Head of Growth (45 min)

  3. Practical task: a short paid acquisition audit and plan, done at home

  4. In person: task review with Rob and the growth team (60 min), culture and values (45 min), final interview with Paddy, CEO and founder (30 min)

title: Pre-Sales Consultant
descriptionHtml:
We are Vitesse – the treasury and payment partner of choice for insurance.

Your next adventure awaits!

Join the team who are redefining the payments space.

About Us

At Vitesse, we're more than just a payments platform – we're the trusted financial infrastructure connecting the global insurance ecosystem. Tailor-made for insurers, brokers, MGAs, and TPAs, our unified platform optimises claims funds, enables real-time global payments, and delivers full financial control. Our impact is real: over $20 billion in payments across 200+ countries, hundreds of millions returned to insurers’ balance sheets, and counting. We’re licensed in the UK (FCA), Europe (DNB), and New York (NYDFS), with over 260 amazing colleagues worldwide. With $93 million recently raised in Series C funding from KKR, our journey is just beginning, and our ambitions are sky-high.

Headquartered in the heart of London and expanding across Europe and the US, Vitesse is where your ideas power tomorrow’s insurance solutions. Are you ready to make a difference? You're in the right place.

About the Role

Reporting into our Pre-Sales Lead, you will play a pivotal role in Vitesse’s sales and product development processes. You will partner with our sales, product, and engineering teams to deliver compelling, value-driven demonstrations and technical presentations. You will be responsible for understanding customer needs, positioning our solutions effectively, and driving engagement with prospects and partners. You will also collaborate closely with the product team to establish a continuous feedback loop, aligning current product functionality, upcoming feature releases, and customer requirements to drive product improvements.

This role requires a blend of technical expertise, consultative skills, and business acumen to help prospects and customers understand how our platform can solve their unique challenges.

Responsibilities:

  • Leading discovery sessions to gain a comprehensive understanding of our customers’ needs, business objectives, and internal operations.

  • Participating in all stages of the sales lifecycle, including leading pitches, product demonstrations and technical workshops

  • Establishing continuous collaboration and feedback loops with Product Owners to ensure alignment with customer needs and product improvements.

  • Working with each product team to ensure feature demos and product collateral support your needs

  • Leveraging your deep functional and technical understanding of our products and their benefits, along with knowledge of our customers, you must be able to:

  • Carefully choose which aspects or benefits of our product to highlight/downplay in each customer engagement, ensuring the message resonates, and the customer is not overwhelmed with complexity

  • Propose (in consultation with the Product team) creative uses, adaptations, and customizations of our products to better meet individual customer needs (with a view towards reusability for future customers as well, as much as possible)

  • Manage and deliver relevant customer feedback to Product Ownership teams to aid in roadmap planning

  • Work closely with senior stakeholders to define the business value proposition, target audience, and competitive landscape

  • Ensure communications and sales collateral clearly explain the Vitesse value proposition and drive the right level of understanding and performance.

  • Contribute to proposal development, working closely with sales and product teams to draft technical responses and customize solutions for potential clients.

Role requirements:

  • Experience working for a SaaS (Software as a Service) company is essential, having served the insurance industry is highly desirable

  • Ability to demonstrate deep functional and technical understanding of an existing SaaS platform operating in the treasury, claims management, business card or high-value payments markets

  • Experience delivering value-centric presentations (virtually and in-person) directly to key decision makers

  • Experience working closely with sales teams and participating in all aspects of the sales cycle

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and key decision makers

  • Ability to work cross-functionally with product, sales, senior leadership, success, and solutions teams

  • Meticulous attention to detail, especially when creating external collateral (e.g. presentations, partner decks)

  • Stellar organizational and time management skills

  • Experience attending networking events, expos and trade shows

  • Experience presenting to large audiences and acting as an ambassador for the company and its solutions

We understand that everyone has their own work rhythm and believe in a flexible working schedule - at Vitesse you’re expected to work 35 hours a week.

Our Values – or what we call “Vitesse at Our Best”

The Vitesse values are a true reflection of what it takes to thrive in our business, so it’s important to us that any employee who joins our business is aligned with these 3 attributes

Confident Humility
We believe the best ideas come from listening and learning. We leave ego at the door, ask for help when we need it, and celebrate collective success. When one of us wins, we all do.

Driven to Succeed
We’re ambitious about the opportunity ahead and committed to achieving it together. We hold ourselves to high standards, take pride in what we deliver, and push for meaningful outcomes for our customers, our partners, and each other.

Tenacious Responsibility
We take ownership of our work, our decisions, and our results. We face challenges with resilience, learn from setbacks, and see things through to completion. Because doing the right thing matters.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer

We commit to creating an inclusive environment that enables everyone to perform at their best, where we recognise the rights of all individuals to mutual respect and where there is an unbiased acceptance of others. descriptionHtml:

Digital Asset builds the technologies that are reshaping the foundations of financial markets. Our mission is to create the world’s most trusted, privacy-enabled, and interoperable digital infrastructure for global finance.

At the heart of this mission is the Canton Network - the blockchain purpose-built for institutional finance. Uniquely combining privacy, compliance, and scalability, Canton enables real-time, secure settlement across multiple asset classes. Governed by the Canton Foundation with participation from leading financial institutions, it is the proven link between the promise of blockchain and the power of global finance.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, with offices in London, Zurich, Budapest, Hong Kong, and Sydney— we are on a mission to transform finance— and that transformation is now playing out rapidly on the Canton Network.

If you’re interested in playing a crucial role at the intersection of traditional and crypto-capital markets and want to help bring the next trillion dollars of finance on-chain, join us.

Canton Network is delivering what others promised but couldn’t: a blockchain for finance that actually works. As the only open layer 1 blockchain network with configurable privacy and controls sufficient for regulatory compliance, it is the venue where DeFi and TradFi are converging.

We are looking for a visionary Principal Product Manager to lead our Stablecoins & Onchain Payments product activation program. This is not just a "feature-owner" role, but rather you will be the architect of how stablecoins & payments move across the Canton Network.

  • Act as the primary product subject matter expert for stablecoins and payments use cases and activation within Digital Asset. 

What We're Looking For:

Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe.

Europe can reindustrialise if we bring AI, energy market opportunities and industrial processes together. Europe's largest industrial companies, together around 2% of Europe's total energy demand, already make their energy decisions with RIZMO, the AI agent in our Energy OS at RIZM.

I'm Max, Head of Engineering at RIZM. My team and I own our product: intuitive workflows, outstanding algorithms, resilient infrastructure and an AI agent layer on top of it all.

What drives me is the speed here: fast decisions, quick iterations and real responsibility for everyone. What matters most to us is high ownership, a growth mindset, trust and having each other's back, in a team where everyone can grow, thrive and have fun together along the way.

If you want to change how Europe's industry uses energy, we'd be thrilled to have you on board.

Let's make the energy transition real, together.
Max

Our stack: Vue, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud (Kubernetes, GitLab CI), LangGraph across multiple models, Julia and Python for optimisation and forecasting. You don't need to know Julia, just don't be scared of it.

Europe's energy market is going through its biggest change in decades. RIZM grew from a Stanford research project into a fast-growing company whose software runs at sites like BMW and BSH. Demand is outpacing our team and our next funding round is ahead. Join now and shape what comes next.

title: Product Frontend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app.

quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.

Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll.

The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters.

Where this is going

Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either.

That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience.

One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy.

Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled.

Why this role exists

Today, quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with.

What comes next is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. Alongside it, the frontend of Maestro, the internal tool that replaces the old admin for batch processes. The phone app is the surface that matters most, so everything is built for it from the first screen rather than adapted to it afterwards.

That is the opening.

How we work

We are AI-native, and we mean it operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how the work gets done here. It is why a small team ships like a large one, and it is a large part of how one person will be able to hold the standard we are describing.

We expect you to be at the front of that. Not to have heard of the tools, to live in them, and to build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, visual regression checks, design-token pipelines, whatever takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that has to come with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: structure that doesn't scale, patterns that fall apart three screens later, components that work once and never again. You take the speed and throw away the rest. AI never lowers the bar here. It is the reason the bar can be this high.

Tasks

What you will own

Everything on the screen:

  • The frontend of the quinn app and the web app. App first. One app for everyone who uses quinn: the employer, the employee, and our own support team working inside the customer's account.
  • The frontend of Maestro, our internal batch tool. Desktop and dense: queues, runs, tables, filters, multi-select, keyboard shortcuts. A different discipline from the app, built on the same components.
  • The component library across quinn Home and quinn Business: one frontend, one experience, every market and every device.
  • Whether the app feels native: response, scrolling, gestures, transitions, biometric login, push. Nothing that gives away it isn't native.
  • The quality of what you ship. Nothing leaves your hands half-finished.

Where design ends, engineering begins.

We have a design team, and they own how quinn looks and behaves: the flows, the visual design, the tokens, the component specs. You don't design. You own everything from there: how it is built, and everything a design file cannot reasonably specify, such as gestures, keyboard, safe areas, what happens between the drawn breakpoints, the loading, offline, pending and failed states, what a three-line German label does to a layout that was designed for English. You are in the room before design starts, saying what already exists in the library and what a new pattern costs. Not at the end, receiving a handover. When you and design disagree, they decide how it looks and behaves and you decide how it is built. Nothing enters the component library without both of you.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

You care about interfaces more than anyone else in the room. You see the two-pixel misalignment without being told, and it bothers you until it is fixed.

You build and maintain UI components and design systems, not one-off screens. You can build a mobile app that feels like one. And you can also build a desktop tool full of tables, filters and keyboard shortcuts, because Maestro is one. You understand UX and how people actually behave, not only how a screen looks. And you write code other people can take over: scalable, structured, documented. Not something that only works while you are in the building.

You are independent and decisive. Nobody will spec every detail for you and nobody will review your pixels.

You are fluent in English, no other language is required. And if you have a portfolio, a live product, or anything you have shipped that you are proud of, show it to us. Not a requirement, but it tells us more than a CV does.

Most importantly: you want this one. Not a frontend role at a company where the frontend is a chore. This one, the app nobody has built yet, the standard nobody has set yet, and a company where getting it right actually decides whether the strategy works.

The Team

We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process or a lot of hierarchy. We do have a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action.

This is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who reads this and thinks: finally.

descriptionHtml:
Product Manager – Finanzierung & Integrationen (m/w/d)

Die meisten Product-Rollen geben dir ein Backlog und ein Engineering-Team. Diese gibt dir zusätzlich einen Verhandlungstisch: Du überzeugst die Produktteams von Banken, ihr eigenes Engineering-Budget in eine Anbindung zu stecken. Danach gehört dir die Schnittstelle – auch nach dem Go-live.

Standort: Zentral in Berlin – Du arbeitest vor Ort in unserem Büro, hybrid mit 3 Tagen Office und 2 Tagen Homeoffice.

Über uns

CarOnSale ist die KI-gestützte Plattform für den B2B-Gebrauchtwagenhandel in Europa. Über 40.000 Käufer aus mehr als 20 Ländern handeln auf unserer Plattform – und 85 % des Inventars ist exklusiv bei uns. Wir verbinden Software, Pricing-Intelligenz, Logistik und Finanzierung in einer Schicht – als Betriebssystem für eine ganze Branche.

One Platform. One Profit Engine.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Anbindung unserer Finanzierungs- und Bankpartner – von der Anforderung über die Umsetzung mit Engineering bis zum Betrieb nach dem Go-live.
  • Du überzeugst die Produktteams unserer Partner, eigenes Engineering-Budget in die Integration zu investieren, und führst diese Gespräche bis zur Entscheidung.
  • Du analysierst, wo Händler zwischen Fahrzeugansicht und abgeschlossenem Gebot abspringen, und erhöhst die Conversion messbar.
  • Du ziehst deine Daten selbst, begründest jede Priorisierung damit und verfolgst die KPIs deiner Features nach dem Launch.
  • Du baust Prototypen, um eine Idee zu testen, bevor du Engineering-Zeit dafür einplanst.
  • Du sprichst regelmäßig mit Händlern, sammelst Feedback strukturiert ein und übersetzt es in konkrete Anforderungen.

Die Stelle ist eine Nachbesetzung in einer gewachsenen Produktorganisation – acht Product Manager, zehn Engineering-Teams.

Was du mitbringst

  • 3–6 Jahre im Produktmanagement in einem digitalen B2B-, Plattform- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld, mit breitem Verantwortungsbereich
  • Du hast eine Funnel- oder Conversion-Kennzahl bewegt und kannst Ausgangswert und Ergebnis nennen – mit Daten, die du selbst gezogen hast

Von Vorteil

Was du nicht brauchst: Erfahrung im Banking oder Fintech. Die Finanzierungswelt lernst du hier – das Gespür für Partner bringst du mit.

title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

Buying and selling a car should feel like one seamless motion for a dealer, not two separate systems. Right now it's the opposite: a dealer buys through us, then has to manage collection, payment and resale largely on their own, stitching together workflows across multiple platforms and channels, much of it manual.

For a dealer, speed is money. Every extra day a car sits before it's collected, priced, and paid for is a day of depreciation, tied-up capital, and a missed chance to buy the next one.If we can get a dealer from 'I've bought this car' to 'it's ready and paid for' faster through transport and collections, quicker final pricing, and Wallet, we make them more profitable. A dealer who's more profitable because of Carwow has little reason to go elsewhere: they'll lean on us more, and churn less.

This role owns that last-mile agenda: getting cars collected quickly, resolving final price without friction, and making Wallet work the way dealers expect it to. This team sits across our ambitions to make car changing a seamless journey, this role's job is the handover itself: the operational moment between buying and being ready to sell again. This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. Dealers are already asking for smarter scheduling, less manual chasing, and tools that reduce the overhead of running a business. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise. If you want to own an operational product area end to end, work with some of the most sophisticated buyers in UK retail, and build things that have a direct line to commercial outcomes, this is it.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Product Strategy & Execution:

    • Own the product direction for Carwow's dealer-facing product, defining what we build, in what order, and why

    • Lead discovery work with dealers, interviews, on-site visits, data analysis to build a precise understanding of where we can add the most value

    • Manage the backlog with commercial awareness prioritising work that drives engagement, retention, and revenue, not just activity

  • Partner Engagement & Insight:

    • Build relationships with key dealer partners and use those relationships to validate product direction before we build

    • Work with Account Management and Sales to understand what's driving churn, what's blocking adoption, and what would make carwow stickier

    • Translate qualitative partner feedback into structured product insight; don't just collect opinions, turn them into decisions

  • Cross-functional Leadership:

    • Work across product, engineering, commercial, and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently

    • Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal

    • Support the commercial team on partner conversations where product context matters: capability deep-dives, roadmap discussions, strategic accounts

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 1.5+ years of product management experience in a B2B or SaaS environment, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics

  • Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox

title: Product Manager - Security
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Security Product Manager to join our team. Security Product Manager is responsible for conveying the company’s security strengths to customers, partners and the market at large. This includes participating in relevant security partnership initiatives, influencing security positioning and branding, and working closely with internal teams to ensure company’s security posture and security products is communicated effectively to all stakeholders. By combining expertise in compliance requirements with a customer-centric approach, Security Product Manager helps position security as a competitive advantage rather than just an internal obligation. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

1. Product Management 

  • Define the vision and roadmap for Nebius’ security products. 
  • Owning the ideation, postmortem, prioritization, backlog, and customer feedback processes. 
  • Guiding new features, systems and services from inception to launch, while keeping customers at the center of everything. 

2. Customer-facing communications 

  • Lead public-facing communications around security updates or changes in compliance status. 
  • In the event of a security incident, coordinate user messaging (email notifications, press releases, FAQs) with support from the Head of Security Products and CISO. 
  • Gather user feedback on user experience and security to guide continuous improvements. 

 3. Competitive analysis and market research 

  • Conduct ongoing research on industry benchmarks, emerging security standards and technologies, and competitor certifications. 
  • Identify gaps and opportunities in organization’s product security posture; propose strategic initiatives that differentiate the company’s security story in the market. 
  • Stay informed about new regulations or frameworks that may influence future product certifications or transparency requirements (e.g., privacy laws, data sovereignty standards). 

 4. Certification and audit support, service ownership 

  • Collaborate with the CISO office to gather technical evidence or make necessary product enhancements that satisfy certification requirements. 
  • Take ownership of some security-related services of Cloud platform. 
  • Track and maintain a certification roadmap (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPPA, etc.), working closely with CISO, GRC & Compliance, Corporate Security departments. Communicate timelines, goals and status updates to leadership and sales representatives. 

5. Cross-functional collaboration 

  • Coordinate with multiple Product Managers to align security goals with other product roadmaps, ensuring a consistent narrative between product security and external messaging. 
  • Work with Platform Security, GRC & Corporate Security and legal teams to gather essential information for security products enhancements (e.g., penetration test summaries, compliance reports). 
  • Work with Customer-facing teams to address client inquiries about security posture and guide them on using security features optimally. 

We expect you to have: 

  • 3+ years of Product Management or Program Management experience with a focus on security initiatives. 
  • Basic knowledge of compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) and familiarity with how they translate into business value. 
  • Proven ability to communicate technical concepts in a clear, customer-friendly manner (e.g., writing content, speaking at webinars or conferences). 
  • Stakeholder management skills to align with other Product Managers, CISO staff, engineering, marketing, and customer-facing teams. 
  • Analytical mindset: comfortable defining success metrics (e.g., security feature adoption, NPS around trust, certification progress) and making data-driven decisions. 
  • Project management skills: demonstrated ability to manage inter-team collaboration within company-wide projects, ensuring timely delivery of cross-functional tasks and alignment with compliance goals. 

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

  •  Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or PMP; prior experience in regulated industries; prior experience working for Cloud Service Provider.

About Nebius

Nebius AI is an AI cloud platform with one of the largest GPU capacities in Europe. Launched in November 2023, the Nebius AI platform provides high-end, training-optimized infrastructure for AI practitioners. As an NVIDIA preferred cloud service provider, Nebius AI offers a variety of NVIDIA GPUs for training and inference, as well as a set of tools for efficient multi-node training. 

Nebius AI owns a data center in Finland, built from the ground up by the company’s R&D team and showcasing our commitment to sustainability. The data center is home to ISEG, the most powerful commercially available supercomputer in Europe and the 16th most powerful globally (Top 500 list, November 2023).  

Nebius’s headquarters are in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with teams working out of R&D hubs across Europe and the Middle East. 

Nebius AI is built with the talent of more than 500 highly skilled engineers with a proven track record in developing sophisticated cloud and ML solutions and designing cutting-edge hardware. This allows all the layers of the Nebius AI cloud – from hardware to UI – to be built in-house, distictly differentiating Nebius AI from the majority of specialized clouds: Nebius customers get a true hyperscaler-cloud experience tailored for AI practitioners. We’re growing and expanding our products every day. 

If you’re up to the challenge and are excited about AI and ML as much as we are, join us!

Pysae has grown from a set of products into a full platform. We now need someone to tell that story, put it in front of the right people, and turn it into growth.

  • A first experience (internships included) in product marketing, growth or digital marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS and/or in an international environment

  • A truly creative mindset: you love inventing new approaches, you are not afraid of a blank page, and you would rather test a bold idea than copy a playbook

  • An entrepreneurial, hands-on attitude: you turn ideas into experiments quickly, learn from failures and keep going

  • An international mindset: you enjoy working across countries and cultures, and adapting your message to each market

  • A strong AI user: you already use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Notion AI, Make/Zapier or similar to work faster, and you are curious about what comes next

  • Data-driven: you measure, test and iterate

  • Autonomous, organised and comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-moving scale-up

  • An interest in mobility, public transport or tech for the public good is a plus

💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.

🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.

💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.

About the role

Orbital is looking for a Product Marketing Manager to lead how our product releases are brought to market and adopted.

As our product and release cadence continue to grow, this role will turn a steady stream of new capabilities into clear, compelling stories for customers, prospects and the wider market. You’ll work across the product roadmap to understand what matters most, shape how releases are positioned, and coordinate how and when they reach the right audiences.

You’ll independently lead a broad portfolio of product and feature launches, while playing a key supporting role in Tier 1 launches alongside our Senior Product Marketing Manager. You’ll also help embed and evolve the systems that enable us to launch consistently at scale, from our existing launch framework and calendar to our changelog, in-product communications and Help Centre.

This is a high-autonomy role at the intersection of Product, Marketing and Customer Success. It’s a great opportunity for a product marketer who combines strong messaging skills with excellent execution and enjoys creating structure around a fast-moving product organisation.

What you’ll do

  • Lead product launches end to end. Own the go-to-market strategy and execution for a portfolio of product and feature launches, from defining the audience and customer value through messaging, channel strategy, timing and measurement.

  • Run and evolve our launch programme. Implement our existing launch framework across Product and Marketing, managing roadmap intake, launch tiering and a single launch calendar. You’ll help teams apply the framework consistently and iterate it over time based on what we learn from launches and adoption.

  • Develop positioning and messaging. Turn complex product capabilities into clear, compelling value propositions and messaging that resonate with customers, prospects and the wider market.

  • Drive awareness and adoption. Plan how releases are brought to market across in-product messaging, email, the changelog, website and other channels, ensuring the right audiences understand what’s new, why it matters and how it strengthens the value of Orbital.

  • Own our product changelog. Build and manage an external changelog that gives customers and prospects a clear, useful and always-current view of what’s new in Orbital.

  • Evolve our Help Centre. Partner with Product and Customer Support to keep product education accurate, useful and up to date, and improve the experience through stronger written, visual and video content.

  • Raise the quality of product marketing. Create clear standards, templates and guidance that help teams communicate new capabilities effectively across customer and market-facing channels. You’ll act as an editor and trusted partner to Product, helping turn subject-matter expertise into high-quality product marketing.

  • Measure launch impact. Define and track success metrics across awareness, activation and adoption, using the results to improve how we prioritise, plan and execute future launches.

  • Partner across go-to-market teams. Work closely with Revenue Enablement, Customer Success and the wider Marketing team to ensure launches translate into effective market education, customer adoption, campaigns and commercial readiness.

How you’ll work with the team

You’ll work closely with our Senior Product Marketing Manager, who leads overarching product positioning and Tier 1 launches. You’ll independently own a high volume of product and feature launches, while contributing to Tier 1 launches and helping ensure our overall launch programme works as one coherent system.

You’ll also partner closely with Product Managers across our UK and US products, as well as Revenue Enablement, Customer Success, Product Design and the wider Marketing team.

Your first few months

You’ll start by building a deep understanding of our product, customers, market and current launch process, working closely with Product teams and spending time with customers.

From there, you’ll embed our launch framework and calendar across the product organisation, launch our external changelog, and take ownership of your first major product launch.

You’ll also refine the playbooks and templates that help teams execute great launches consistently as Orbital continues to grow.

About you

  • 4+ years of experience in B2B SaaS product marketing, with a strong track record of leading product launches end to end.

  • A strong product storyteller. You can quickly understand a technical or complex capability, identify why it matters to the market, and turn that into clear, differentiated messaging.

  • An excellent writer and editor. You write with clarity and precision, know the difference between a feature and a benefit, and can improve other people’s work without losing the underlying expertise.

  • A strong cross-functional operator. You’re comfortable managing multiple launches, stakeholders and timelines at once, and know how to create the structure that keeps work moving.

  • Good judgement and influence. You can make clear recommendations about priorities, timing and messaging, build alignment across teams, and challenge constructively when needed.

  • Able to see the bigger picture. You can look across a portfolio of releases and understand how individual capabilities contribute to a broader product and market narrative.

  • Customer and data-led. You want to understand how customers use the product and use qualitative and quantitative signals to improve launches and adoption over time.

  • Comfortable working at pace. You enjoy working with a product that evolves quickly and can balance speed with a high standard of execution.

  • Confident using AI in your own work. You use AI tools to speed up and refine your processes, deploying it thoughtfully to work more effectively while bringing the judgement and editorial quality needed for external-facing work.

  • Experienced working across global teams and markets. This role supports both our UK and US products, so you’ll be comfortable collaborating across time zones.

  • Familiar with product adoption and customer communication tools, such as Intercom, Pendo, Appcues, Beamer or similar.

Nice to have

  • Experience in legal tech, real estate, proptech or another complex or expertise-led B2B market.

  • Experience owning or significantly contributing to a Help Centre, knowledge base or customer education programme.

  • Experience marketing AI products, particularly products that evolve quickly and where trust matters.

We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.

💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.

title: Product Owner Gemeentepas
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij maximale waarde creëren voor gemeenten, aanbieders en eindgebruikers met de Gemeentepas? Het kan als Product Owner. Je vormt de spil tussen business, technologie en operatie en is in staat om de strategische doelen van de organisiatie te vertalen naar tactische doelen en het opzetten van een duidelijke productvisie, roadmap en backlog.

Wat jij doet

Als Product Owner ontwikkel en onderhoud je een heldere productvisie en -strategie voor de stadspasoplossing, afgestemd op de behoeften van gemeenten en het portfolio van Centric. Je richt je op het bepalen van de productrichting, het vertalen van wensen en behoeften naar concrete verbeteringen en het onderhouden van sterke relaties met stakeholders.

In deze rol gaan we een maximaal beroep doen op je commerciële vaardigheden. De Gemeentepas is een nieuwe oplossing binnen ons portfolio. Dat betekent dat je veel contact met potentiële klanten zult hebben. Hun wensen weet te vertalen naar standaardoplossingen en daarvoor een marktconforme vergoeding weet te verantwoorden. Je zult actief in aanbesteding trajecten een inhoudelijk en commerciële rol gaan vervullen.

Je wordt daarin uiteraard ondersteund door onze product sales en productmanager. Wij denken dat dit een hele mooie kans is voor een zeer ondernemende product owner die in zichzelf en een nieuw product wil investeren.

Wat doe je nog meer?

  • Productstrategie en roadmap: Je stelt een roadmap op voor de doorontwikkeling van de Gemeentepas. Hierbij kijk je naar integraties met gemeentelijke systemen, waaronder Suites voor het Sociaal Domein, en onderzoek je nieuwe mogelijkheden, zoals koppelingen met Europese wallets.

  • Klant- en stakeholdermanagement: Je vertegenwoordigt de stem van de klant en zorgt ervoor dat wensen, behoeften en eisen van gemeenten, aanbieders en eindgebruikers worden vertaald naar concrete productverbeteringen.

  • Backlogbeheer en prioritering: Je beheert en prioriteert de productbacklog op basis van businesswaarde, wettelijke vereisten, strategische doelstellingen en gebruikersfeedback.

  • Samenwerking met het ontwikkelteam: Je werkt nauw samen met het scrumteam om epics en user stories op te stellen, te verfijnen en te valideren, zodat de ontwikkelwerkzaamheden aansluiten bij de productvisie.

  • Analyse en optimalisatie: Je identificeert hiaten in de functionaliteit door middel van fit-gapanalyses en initieert verbeteringen op het gebied van gebruikerservaring (UX), toegankelijkheid en systeemintegraties.

  • Markt- en trendontwikkeling: Je volgt marktontwikkelingen, relevante wet- en regelgeving en technologische innovaties en vertaalt deze naar nieuwe functionaliteiten en proposities.

  • Monitoring en waardecreatie: Je bewaakt de voortgang en de gerealiseerde waarde per sprint en release en stuurt waar nodig bij om de productdoelstellingen te behalen.

  • Rapportage en KPI’s: Je monitort en rapporteert over relevante KPI’s, zoals gebruikerstevredenheid en de adoptie van de stadspasoplossing door gemeenten en aanbieders

Dit krijg je

Bij Centric kun je als Product Owner/ Productmanager rekenen op:

  • Een brutosalaris van €4.500,- tot € 5.250,- per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

  • Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en een goede werk-privébalans doordat je de ruimte krijgt om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt

  • Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag (uitbetaling in mei) en loyaliteitsdagen: hoe langer je in dienst bent, hoe meer vrije tijd

  • Een bijdrage aan je pensioen en korting op je collectieve zorgverzekering

  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak

  • Een thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 15,- per maand plus € 2,45 netto per thuiswerkdag

  • Een mobiliteitsbudget omdat jij zelf wil bepalen hoe je van werk naar huis reist

  • Personeelsaanbiedingen bij toonaangevende merken

  • Een bonus tot € 1.500,- als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt

  • Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën?

Dit breng je mee

Je hebt strategisch inzicht, bent besluitvaardig en beschikt over sterke analytische vaardigheden. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende profiel:

  • Je hebt hbo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied.

  • Je hebt enkele jaren ervaring als Product Owner of Product Manager binnen softwareontwikkeling.

  • Je hebt ervaring binnen de publieke sector. Kennis van het Sociaal Domein is een sterke pré.

  • Je hebt kennis van systeemintegraties, security en privacy, waaronder de AVG en Secure Software Development.

Het maken van een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van deze sollicitatieprocedure.

Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric

Hier starten jouw kansen
Zonder dat je het misschien weet, ben je al eens met Centric in aanraking geweest. Als je betaalt in de winkel. Als je een glas kraanwater drinkt. Als je een paspoort aanvraagt. Duizenden organisaties en hun miljoenen klanten rekenen elke dag weer op onze 200+ technologische oplossingen, hoogwaardige IT-diensten en 3.700 gekwalificeerde professionals. Samen zorgen we dat belangrijke processen in onze samenleving altijd doordraaien.

Zodra je Centric komt versterken, omring jij jezelf met mogelijkheden. Zo kun je jouw kennis vergroten door samen te werken met de ongeveer 500 collega’s van Digitale Overheid. Als partner van meer dan 300 gemeenten zorgen wij er dagelijks voor dat de dienstverlening van decentrale overheden aan inwoners en bedrijven niet komt stil te vallen. Want wist jij dat bijna alles wat inwoners van Nederland met de overheid regelen via onze oplossingen verloopt? Denk aan lokale belastingen en vergunningen, maar ook aanvraag van reisdocumenten en een uitkeringsaanvraag. Al die gegevens zorgen voor steeds meer inzicht en daarmee voor een nog betere dienstverlening richting inwoners.

We only have positions available for Dutch-speaking applicants residing in the Netherlands.

Wil jij bouwen aan het verschil? Solliciteer via onze website naar deze vacature Product Owner Gemeentepas. Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met onze Recruiter, Danitsha Abdul via +31 6 10053663 of

Centric aanvaardt geen ongevraagde hulp van intermediairs/uitzendbureaus of andere derden voor onze vacatures. Toegestuurde cv’s (in welke vorm dan ook) door genoemde partijen aan enige medewerkers van Centric zonder geldige schriftelijke zoekopdracht van onze HR Afdeling of Recruiters, worden beschouwd als publieke informatie. Er zal aan genoemde partijen geen vergoeding zijn verschuldigd in geval dat een kandidaat wordt aangenomen van wie ongevraagd het cv en/of andere gegevens zijn toegestuurd.
