title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The DevSecOps Engineer at Shield AI is responsible for designing, building, securing, and operating the software delivery infrastructure required to develop and deploy advanced autonomous systems for defence applications.
This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, platform engineering, cyber security, and defence systems engineering. The DevSecOps Engineer works alongside autonomy, software, systems, integration, and test engineers to create secure and reliable development environments and delivery pipelines that enable teams to rapidly develop, integrate, test, and deploy mission critical software.
The ideal candidate has a strong software and platform engineering background combined with significant experience operating within UK defence environments. They have a strong understanding of the UK Ministry of Defence/NATO approach to DevSecOps, Secure by Design, cyber risk management, security assurance, and the delivery of software into classified and operational environments.
What You’ll Do
  • Design, build, and operate secure development and deployment infrastructure for Shield AI autonomy and defence programmes.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that enable rapid, repeatable, and secure delivery of autonomy and mission software.
  • Embed security throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring security controls, testing, evidence, and assurance are integrated into engineering workflows rather than treated as separate activities.
  • Apply UK MOD Secure by Design principles throughout the development lifecycle and help engineering teams understand and meet their responsibilities for cyber security and technical assurance.
  • Work closely with software, autonomy, systems, cyber security, integration, and test engineers to establish development environments that support rapid engineering while meeting defence security requirements.
  • Design and maintain development and deployment environments spanning cloud, on premises infrastructure, laboratory environments, simulation, hardware in the loop, and operational platforms.
  • Enable secure software development and deployment across different security classifications and appropriately segmented development environments.
  • Implement automated security controls within CI/CD pipelines, including static analysis, dependency scanning, container scanning, secrets detection, software composition analysis, vulnerability management, and policy enforcement.
  • Champion a DevSecOps culture where software engineers take ownership of the security, reliability, deployability, and operational performance of the systems they develop.

    • Required Qualifications
  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cyber Security, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, software engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Significant experience delivering software or digital capabilities within UK defence or another highly regulated national security environment.
  • Strong understanding of the UK Ministry of Defence/NATO approach to DevSecOps and Secure by Design, including the integration of cyber security and risk management throughout the capability lifecycle.
  • Experience applying MOD security policies, security assurance processes, and technical security requirements to software intensive defence programmes.
  • Experience developing and operating CI/CD pipelines using modern source control, build, test, artefact management, and deployment technologies.
  • Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, containerisation, and infrastructure automation
  • Experience with technologies such as Git, GitLab or GitHub, or equivalent tooling.

    • Desirable Qualifications
  • Experience supporting DevSecOps, software delivery, or digital engineering activities across NATO nations or multinational defence programmes.
  • Understanding of DevSecOps approaches, security frameworks, and software assurance practices used by other NATO nations, particularly the United States and European NATO partners.

We’re looking for a Senior Digital Marketing Manager to lead Form3’s digital growth and demand generation strategy, helping drive pipeline growth and brand development across our priority markets. Reporting to the Marketing Director, you’ll combine strategic ownership with execution across integrated campaigns, account-based marketing, digital acquisition and performance measurement. title: Senior Director, Health & Safety Operations Europe
descriptionHtml:
About the role 

Reporting to the SVP, Global Engineering and Infrastructure, the Senior Director of Health & Safety Operations Europe serves as a strategic leader driving safety excellence across our European operations. You will champion the development and implementation of robust H&S strategies, ensuring full regulatory compliance while fostering a world-class safety culture. This role demands a visionary leader capable of influencing cross-functional teams and implementing industry-best practices to minimize risk and achieve ambitious safety performance goals.

What you’ll do

  • Define and execute the European H&S strategy, aligning safety milestones with broader business objectives.
  • Cultivate a "Zero Incident" organizational culture by architecting risk-reduction programs across all operations.
  • Safeguard the business by ensuring rigorous compliance with local and international safety regulations and certifications.
  • Standardize safety processes across diverse sites using our newly developed, proprietary safety framework.
  • Partner with Supply Chain and Site Operations leadership to integrate safety into the heart of production practices.
  • Leverage data to track KPIs, providing senior leadership with actionable insights and performance reports.
  • Lead high-stakes incident investigations, ensuring deep root-cause analysis and the execution of effective corrective actions.
  • Act as the primary representative for safety matters with regulatory bodies and external stakeholders across Europe.
  • Orchestrate internal and external safety audits to ensure consistent best-practice standards across all regions.
  • Mentor and develop a high-performing team of safety experts, fostering professional growth and succession planning.
  • Pioneer the use of AI and emerging technologies as accelerators for continuous improvement and safety innovation.

What you’ll bring

  • 15+ years of safety management experience, with at least 5 years in a high-impact leadership role.
  • Subject matter expertise in European safety regulations, multi-national frameworks, and compliance standards.
  • Industry background in FMCG, Logistics, Manufacturing, or Fulfillment preferred.
  • Proven track record of implementing scalable safety strategies across complex, international geographies.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate safety data into strategic business decisions.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders at all levels.
  • A relentless passion for safety and a dedication to continuous operational improvement.
  • Strong leadership presence with a focus on empowering teams and maximizing individual potential.

What we offer

title: Senior Engineering Manager - Agents and Context - Platform
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

The Chat team, part of Elastic’s Agents and Context group, builds the conversational and agentic platform that lets customers chat with and operate on their own data in Elasticsearch. We own the conversation experience, the agent harness and tools, retrieval and citations, streaming, memory, and the evaluation layer that keeps answers grounded and reliable. Everything we ship is production software that other Elastic solutions build on.

You will directly manage the engineers on the team, act as its primary project manager, and work with the PM and Tech Lead to define and deliver the roadmap. This is a people and delivery leadership role in a fast-moving space: the right person is energized by shaping structure where there is little, and keeps a calm, direct style while priorities shift.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

 

Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.

About the role


As a Senior Frontend Engineer at Faculty, you will partner with cross-functional delivery teams in to transform cutting-edge AI and data science models into intuitive, impactful client-facing software.

You will champion modern frontend engineering practices, mentor fellow engineers, and shape our growing frontend community. In this role, you will have the autonomy to solve complex, real-world challenges through elegant interfaces, driving innovation from concept through to deployment in high-stakes environments.

What you'll be doing:

  • Building and scaling resilient, client-facing web applications that bring complex machine learning insights to life.

  • Collaborating closely with data scientists, designers, and engineers across the product lifecycle to design intuitive user experiences.

  • Architecting and maintaining reusable design systems and component libraries to accelerate development across the company.

  • Establishing and maintaining robust CI/CD, development, and deployment workflows alongside modern cloud infrastructure.

  • Championing frontend best practices, engineering standards, and technical excellence across our engineering guilds.

  • Mentoring, onboarding, and supporting team members to foster a supportive and continuous learning environment.

Who we're looking for:

  • You bring strong experience building, testing, and scaling modern web applications using React and modern JavaScript or TypeScript.

  • You have an appreciation for clean component architecture and enjoy developing design systems that work smoothly across multiple platforms.

  • You’re comfortable creating data visualisations using tools such as D3 to make sophisticated insights clear and accessible.

  • You have a solid understanding of frontend build tools (such as Webpack or Babel) and foundational familiarity with backend APIs (such as Node.js).

  • You bring exposure to modern cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and enjoy learning how deployment pipelines fit into the wider software ecosystem.

  • You thrive in an entrepreneurial, collaborative environment where you can share ideas, support peers, and turn complex problems into practical solutions.

Our Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)

  3. System Design Interview (90 minutes)

  4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

The team

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

 

About the role

  • What you'll do and for whom. You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.

  • Where you'll work. You join the Platform Team, about 10 engineers. At BLP, platform means the core of our product, not internal infrastructure: the shared services, data access layer, and design system that every product runs on. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns.

  • What success looks like. In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

 

What you'll do

  • Build the service that product teams build on. Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds.

  • Own the persistence layer. Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default.

  • Scale BLP for large enterprises. Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast.

  • Own email, in and out. Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including the audit trail and its UI.

  • Make setup self-service. Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and admin UIs that customers and project managers can run on their own.

  • Work with customers. Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling.

  • Own it end-to-end. From the Go service through the React UI to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships.

Tech stack: Go, React/TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability.

 

We're excited about you because

  • You have 4+ years of experience as a software engineer, with most of that time spent building and operating backend systems in production.

  • You have 2+ years of professional Go experience, writing services that run in production, not side projects.

  • You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew.

  • You work well across teams. You align with product, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.

  • You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it.

  • You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns.

  • You're fullstack where it counts: you build on the components and design system our frontend experts maintain to ship admin UIs quickly, even though the backend is where you do your deepest work.

  • You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live.

 

Strong plus

  • Experience with distributed systems, Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC).

  • Experience running multi-tenant systems.

  • Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills.

What you'll get

  • Ownership of visible outcomes. The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them.

  • Impact at scale. Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily.

  • Senior scope from day one. You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership.

Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

Please note: Hybrid work in London office, or remote in wider UK and Europe.

title: Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React
descriptionHtml:
Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

  • Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD
  • Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit
  • Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote
  • Standort: Berlin-Zehlendorf, direkt am S-Bahnhof Zehlendorf (S1)
  • Produkt: Konsentas, ein Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement für Behörden
  • Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle

Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen
  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen
  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln
  • Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen
  • Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden
  • Unsere zwei Auszubildenden im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)
  • Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für unsere Azubis eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)
  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID
  • Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework
  • Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.
  • JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab
  • Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL
  • Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD
  • Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1
  • Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch
  • Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.
  • Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen bei uns genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.

Dein Team

Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: Daniel (Developer Lead), Nico (Geschäftsführer & Projektmanager), der selbst aktiv mitentwickelt, ein externer Entwickler und zwei Auszubildende. Ihr stimmt euch täglich ab. Daniel und Nico übernehmen dein Onboarding persönlich.

Was wir bieten

  • Ein sinnstiftendes Produkt, das täglich in Bürgerämtern genutzt wird, in einem krisensicheren Markt
  • Echter Einfluss auf technische Entscheidungen und eine Modernisierung mit klarem Ziel
  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit ab 10 Uhr, 2 Remote-Tage pro Woche
  • Weiterbildung während der Arbeitszeit, z. B. Udemy-Kurse; eigene Vorschläge sind willkommen
  • Claude-Lizenz, offen für weitere Tools
  • Hardware: Lenovo ThinkPad, offen für Vorschläge
  • UrbanSportsClub und JobRad
  • Gute Anbindung: S1 und Busse M48, 101, 115

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

  • Kennenlerngespräch mit Sara
  • Technisches Interview mit Live-Projektarbeit mit Nico und Daniel
  • Teamgespräch vor Ort
  • Angebot

Über Girona

Seit über 25 Jahren entwickelt die Girona Softwareentwicklung GmbH in Berlin Software für die öffentliche Verwaltung. Städte wie Berlin, München, Bonn und Dessau setzen seit Jahrzehnten auf unsere Lösungen, Konsentas etwa in Bürgerämtern, Gesundheitsämtern sowie Kfz-Zulassungs- und Führerscheinstellen.

title: Senior Functional Safety Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

Join a motivating team of experts developing Electric Vehicle technology through innovative zonal architecture development.

This position is based in our Berlin office and operates on a hybrid model, requiring at least three days per week on-site.

Responsibilities

  • Establish and continuously improve the processes and technical pipelines that collect, organize, and present all traceable evidences required for Functional Safety release or sign-off reports (production and SW releases) across all FuSa domains (Dynamics, Body, Thermal, Energy, ADAS, Core).

  • Define quantitative, evidence-based release criteria for FuSa sign-off — including thresholds for requirement verification coverage, safety mechanism test pass rates, diagnostic coverage metrics, ASIL-graded open-issue limits, and residual risk acceptance.

  • Work closely with PMT to align FuSa maturity criteria to program milestones and gate reviews, providing per-domain risk profiles that surface gaps in evidence completeness and drive early visibility of domains at risk of missing gate criteria.

  • Coordinate with FuSa domain leads, test automation, SW FuSa, HW FuSa, and PMT to align evidence deliverables against release schedules, driving pipeline efficiency so that sign-off can be given with confidence and minimal overhead on technical teams.

  • Develop and maintain automated dashboarding that consolidates release readiness, requirement coverage, open safety issues, and post-release fleet safety performance — enabling data-driven release decisions and continuous calibration of release criteria over successive programs.

  • Establish and track post-release safety performance indicators — including field failure rates against safety mechanism assumptions and safety-relevant DTC rates — to close the loop between pre-release evidence confidence and real-world outcomes.

  • Coordinate with external suppliers and Brand partners to collect, validate, and integrate supplier-generated safety work products and SEooC arguments into the vehicle-level safety case.

  • Work closely with the FuSa Process team and VWG Central FuSi process team to ensure release processes align with ISO 26262 compliance expectations across Rivian and VW programs.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Degree in Electrical/Electronic, Mechanical, Software, Systems, or Computer Engineering (or similar).

  • Over 5 years of experience in the automotive industry (or equivalent), ideally at an OEM or Tier 1, with at least 2 years in functional safety, systems engineering, or release/program engineering roles.

  • Proven knowledge of ISO 26262, particularly around work product management, confirmation reviews, safety case argumentation, and evidence-based release assessment.

  • Strong experience with requirements management and traceability tools (e.g. JAMA, DOORS) and issue tracking tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence).

  • Experience defining quantitative release criteria and safety performance metrics, and building reporting pipelines or dashboards to track them.

  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g. Databricks, Tableau, Power BI); ability to present risk and safety performance metrics to technical and leadership audiences.

  • Good understanding of vehicle system functionality across multiple domains.

  • Excellent organizational and coordination skills; ability to drive cross-functional alignment under tight release schedules.

  • Good interpersonal and communication skills; ability to report clearly and concisely to senior management.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with supplier safety artifact management — SEooC arguments and supplier-provided safety cases integrated into a vehicle-level safety argument.

  • Exposure to fleet monitoring, field quality data, or post-release safety performance tracking.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and data pipeline tooling; scripting ability (e.g. Python) a plus.

Total Rewards

We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs.

External candidates can apply for this role through the Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site (https://rivianvw.tech/#careers). If you are a current employee, please apply through our internal job board.

Equal Opportunity

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are also committed to ensuring compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws regarding citizenship and immigration status.

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at ----- style="min-height:1.5em">

Candidate Data Privacy

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies” may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. title: Senior Hub Developer
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a developer to grow Ember's network of charging hubs. You'll find the sites, take them through legals and planning, manage the build and energise them. How you work and think matters more to us than which industry you've worked in. You think clearly, can run several projects at once and are as at home on a site as behind a desk.

About Ember

We're building the future of public transport — convenient, affordable, connected and zero-emission. Our goal is to make it easier and more enjoyable to get from A to B with Ember than it is with your own car.

Ember is a tech company, not a traditional bus operator. We've built a platform that coordinates our entire operation — everything from monitoring vehicles and controlling chargers to selling tickets and calculating ETAs. This allows us to use electric buses more intensively than anyone else in the world, leading to a massive reduction in emissions. It also helps us provide a much better passenger experience, with innovative features like demand-responsive stops.

We’re still tiny, with a handful of routes and ~100 buses. The challenge is to scale this 50x whilst staying lean, increasing efficiency and delivering an even better product experience. We’ve recently raised a Series A from some of Europe’s leading climate VCs and are looking for mission-driven individuals who want to get on board and help take us to the next level.

The role

Charging hubs are Ember's key growth enabler. They give us the ultra-fast charge points we need to run our network, and they act as a base for our fleet — parking, washing, driver lounges and more. We have hubs across Scotland today, with additional sites across the UK under construction or in the pipeline.

You'll join a small team of four, taking end-to-end responsibility for your own sites and helping out on others. We're typically running a handful of projects at any one time.

Step one is finding a site. You’ll need to think about where we need charging capacity to support future routes, scout industrial estates and brownfield plots and reach out to commercial agents, local authorities and landlords. Some great sites are advertised but many are not, so landing one usually means being patient and creative.

Once you've got a site, we move on to lease negotiations, design, the planning application and the power connection. You'll work with network operators to land the grid connection, and with our suppliers to procure, install and commission the charging equipment. Solicitors, architects and engineers are there to help, but the project is yours to drive — you set the direction, you ask the difficult questions and you make the trade-offs.

It’s important to be hands-on. We don't go to tender and leave the rest to an outsourced project manager — we want you on site, asking why a kerb is in the wrong place. Even after a site is live, our involvement doesn't stop. The team keeps refining and improving every site, and you'll be part of that work across the network, not just on the sites you've built yourself.

Diversity and equality

At Ember, we support diversity across our team and customers. We work to ensure every employee feels respected and able to give their best, whether temporary, part-time or full-time. We’re happy to offer flexible working patterns where they make sense, are compassionate when it comes to time off and offer enhanced maternity and paternity leave.

Read more about our approach in our Equal Opportunities Policy.

What's on offer

You'll receive a salary of £50,000–£75,000 per annum, depending on your experience and skills, plus share options. You'll be expected to work from our lovely office in central Edinburgh most days — we value in-person communication — but there's flexibility around the odd day from home, with an expectation that you'll spend some time travelling to different sites.

How do I apply?

Send your CV and a short note on why this interests you.

Applications close Friday 27 November at 5pm.


Who we're looking for

You should have a desire to get involved in the growth of a quickly scaling business, with a real opportunity to make your mark. How you work and think matters more to us than specific industry experience. The following should sound a lot like you:

  • Curious and quick to learn. You're comfortable in unfamiliar territory — new technical specs, new legal terms, new planning processes — and you treat each one as an opportunity to learn. You don't expect to know everything on day one.

  • Engineering mindset. You're the sort of person who'll happily watch YouTube videos explaining concrete reinforcement, three-phase distribution or substation transformers. You'll be excited to dive into the same level of detail on our projects.

  • A first-principles thinker. You take problems back to fundamentals rather than reaching for jargon or the way things are usually done. When you work with experts — solicitors, architects, engineers — you treat them as people you can learn from, not people you can outsource your thinking to.

  • Commercially astute. You can tell when something is worth fighting for and when it's better to redesign around a constraint, whether that's a lease, a planning condition or a contractor's quote.

  • Highly organised. Managing a pipeline of projects is complex, with many timelines, people to chase, details to look into and things that can (and will) go wrong. We want you at Inbox Zero, not in inbox hell.

  • Comfortable using AI. At a minimum you use it as part of how you work — to learn faster, draft documents and get to the bottom of unfamiliar topics. But maybe you’ll go further and build software to help the team work faster and more precisely.

  • Hands-on. Hubs are built in the real world, not behind a screen. You'll meet landlords, talk to electricians and look at drains, but you'll also need to read contracts and chase agents who've gone quiet.

  • A strong sense of what good looks like. Whatever the topic, problem or issue. You need to know how to hold yourself and others to a high standard.

title: Senior Infrastructure Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
Diabolocom is a leading European sovereign cloud contact center (CCaaS) and customer experience platform, trusted by more than 400 companies across 60+ countries for business-critical customer operations.

Our technology combines proprietary AI, a private cloud and native telecom infrastructure. Unlike many SaaS platforms built primarily on public-cloud services, we operate our own production environments and manage the underlying infrastructure across networking, connectivity, virtualization, physical infrastructure, telecom and distributed systems.

The role

We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Solutions Architect with a strong infrastructure engineering background to design end-to-end technical solutions for our largest enterprise customers.

You will work at the intersection of our Infrastructure organization and complex customer environments, translating enterprise requirements into architectures that meet demanding security, performance and connectivity needs while remaining scalable and aligned with our platform.

You will work closely with our Infrastructure engineers and technical experts to develop and validate architecture options, assess trade-offs and then explain and defend the proposed solutions with customers.

The role covers both presales and implementation phases. You will own architecture and design, while our Infrastructure teams remain responsible for implementation.

What you will do

  • Lead technical discovery and design end-to-end infrastructure solutions for complex enterprise projects

  • Develop architecture options, assess trade-offs and validate designs with our Infrastructure experts

  • Work directly with enterprise customers to understand requirements, explain and defend technical decisions, and challenge requests when a simpler or more sustainable solution is appropriate

  • Support Presales on complex technical opportunities and RFPs

  • Stay involved during implementation to ensure delivery remains aligned with the agreed architecture

  • Create clear architecture documentation, procedures and reusable technical knowledge.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for a senior infrastructure engineer or architect with deep technical expertise across complex, on-premise environments and the ability to operate confidently with enterprise customers.

You can look beyond individual technologies to understand an infrastructure landscape as a whole, identify constraints and dependencies, and design coherent end-to-end solutions. You are equally comfortable discussing architecture with engineers and presenting, defending or challenging technical decisions with senior customer stakeholders.

What you bring

  • Strong background in infrastructure engineering and architecture, with deep hands-on understanding of on-premise environments

  • Solid expertise across networking, connectivity, virtualization and physical infrastructure, combined with a broad understanding of cloud, security, integrations and distributed systems

  • Proven ability to design end-to-end infrastructure architectures, evaluate trade-offs and turn complex requirements into technically sound solutions

  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers on technical discovery, architecture and solution design

  • Ability to communicate complex technical decisions with clarity and credibility, including challenging requirements when necessary

  • Strong technical documentation skills

  • Fluent French and strong professional English.

Nice to have

  • Experience with CCaaS, contact center or enterprise communications

  • Voice or telecom expertise

  • Security and compliance knowledge

  • Experience designing solutions for large French enterprises.

Your impact

You will take technical ownership of the architecture behind some of Diabolocom’s largest enterprise projects, including environments supporting thousands of contact center agents.

Your job is to make complex requirements technically workable: understand the customer environment, identify constraints, design the architecture, evaluate trade-offs with our engineers and defend the final solution with the customer.

As you build expertise in our platform, you will independently lead architecture work across enterprise opportunities and implementations, from technical discovery and RFPs through design validation and delivery.

Your impact will be visible in the projects we win, the architectures we deploy and our ability to scale enterprise delivery without compromising the technical foundations of the platform.

Why Diabolocom?

Work on infrastructure you can actually see

Around 95% of our production infrastructure runs on our own hardware across several European data centers. We operate our own private cloud and manage the layers underneath it, from physical infrastructure and virtualization to networking, connectivity and telecom.

For an infrastructure architect, this means working with the full stack rather than designing exclusively through public-cloud abstractions.

Design for real enterprise scale

You will work on business-critical communication platforms supporting thousands of users, with demanding requirements around availability, network connectivity, security, integrations and performance.

These are not theoretical architecture exercises. The solutions you design will be built, operated and used in production by major enterprise customers.

Stay at engineering depth

The role sits within Infrastructure, not Presales.

You will design alongside the engineers who operate our platform, challenge architecture choices with people who understand the systems in depth, and stay involved as your designs move into production.

Join at a point of global expansion

Diabolocom already supports more than 400 companies across 60+ countries. As we move further into the enterprise market and expand internationally, the scale and complexity of the infrastructure problems we need to solve are increasing.

You will help define how our platform supports the next generation of large enterprise deployments while keeping the architecture scalable, secure and operationally sustainable.

🏢 Hybrid model: minimum 3 days/week onsite

💻 Equipment: choose your preferred setup (Mac/Linux + monitors)

🍽 Lunch vouchers

🚇 Navigo: 50% of the monthly pass reimbursed

One more thing

You do not need to have held the exact title of Solutions Architect before.

Some of the strongest candidates for this role may come from infrastructure engineering or architecture backgrounds and have gradually taken on broader solution design, technical ownership or customer-facing responsibilities.

If you have deep infrastructure expertise, can think beyond a single technical domain and are ready to apply that experience to complex enterprise architecture, we would like to hear from you, even if your background does not match every requirement above.

title: Senior IT Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

About the role

You’ll run Morpho’s corporate IT: accounts and access, laptops, and the SaaS tools the company runs on, all set up securely. You’ll work closely with the security team: they set policy and lead on incidents, and you put that policy in place across our tools and devices. The scope is broad and the work is hands-on. We’d rather automate repetitive work than hire for it, so expect to write scripts and build your own tooling, using AI where it helps. We’ll go through our stack with you early in the process.

Responsibilities

  • Administer SSO, the directory and the password manager. Handle onboarding and offboarding, and run regular access reviews.

  • Manage the Mac fleet: setup, MDM policies, OS and app updates, and keeping the endpoint security agent installed and working.

  • Apply the security baselines and access policies the security team defines, and keep our tools configured to match.

  • Administer our SaaS tools: setup, admin access and licences. Handle the IT side of bringing on new vendors.

  • Support the security team during incidents by isolating devices, revoking access and pulling logs.

  • Provide evidence for IT controls during audits.

  • Automate repetitive work such as onboarding, offboarding, access reviews and evidence collection.

  • Write and maintain documentation for IT procedures.

  • Take part in IT on-call.

Definition of success

  • 1 month: handles onboarding, offboarding and day-to-day account and device work without help, and knows how our tools are set up.

  • End of probation: owns our identity, device and SaaS setup, has automated at least one process that used to be manual, and is the person the security team goes to for IT changes and incident support.

  • 12 months: runs corporate IT independently. Onboarding, offboarding, access reviews and audit evidence mostly run on tooling they built.

Experience

  • 5+ years in IT, systems engineering or IT security.

  • Hands-on admin experience with an enterprise identity provider, an MDM and endpoint security tools.

  • Strong macOS management: configuration profiles, privacy preference and system extension policies.

  • Writes Python or Bash to automate work. Infrastructure as code is a plus.

  • Has supported a SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar audit.

  • Knows crypto companies are frequent targets of phishing and social engineering, and sets up systems with that in mind. Web3 or fintech experience is a plus.

  • Writes clear documentation.

  • Prefers simple setups people follow over perfect ones they work around.

  • Comfortable being part of an on-call rotation.

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

title: Senior Key Accounts Manager
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Our EMEA Key Account Management Team is growing and we want you to be part of it! 

The EMEA Key Accounts team manages the partnerships with Regional API Software providers and Enterprise Property Managers. The key goal is to grow the share of high quality stays by optimising supply at scale leveraging strategic account management, programs, incentives,  and product solutions. 

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Senior Key Accounts Manager, you will be managing partner relationships with strategic Enterprises & API Connectivity partners. You will be responsible for recruitment, enablement and optimization of our strategic partnerships and become their trusted advisor with the aim to become their number one partner and accelerate growth and performance on both sides. You will be reporting to the Key Accounts Team Lead, EMEA.

This role is based in Paris (hybrid, 2-3 days a week in the office), and is not eligible for relocation support.

A typical day: 

  • Own a portfolio of Airbnb’s key partners and act as the key representative for these partners. 
  • Execute a global win-win strategy for your portfolio that drives value to all parties and positions Airbnb as a top strategic partner across all distribution channels. 
  • Develop strong and trusting relationships with executives and decision makers/key influencers within your API & Enterprise customers portfolio, ensure that the partnership is held to the highest industry standards and that commercial agreements as well as SLAs are met.
  • Analyze data and utilize data-driven recommendations to identify and action on strategic growth opportunities 
  • Work with quarterly goals, measure success against performance KPIs, feature adoption and supply acquisition growth.
  • Support partners through deep understanding of API and technical integrations 
  • Educate clients on our product roadmap and all significant product changes to accelerate feature adoption with the aim to excel our mutual guest experience 
  • Represent Airbnb in external meetings and industry events 

Your expertise: 

  • 8+ years of professional experience in Strategic Partnership, Key Account Management and/or Connectivity role at a global technology or tech hospitality company
  • Fluent verbal/written communication and presentation skills in both English and French
  • Exceptional stakeholder management across both internal and external audiences
  • Experience with API integrations a plus
  • World class account management experience with strong track record of successfully growing a book of business/geographic area and building enduring and successful client relationships
  • Experience in the hospitality technology space, knowledge of OTA specifications
  • Experience in analyzing, structuring and negotiating complex deals that align across multiple business unit needs
  • Extremely data driven in the decision-making process to ensure timely, impactful and accurate actions are taken.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with product, tech, legal, marketing, sales operations and enablement teams.
  • Ability to manage complex projects and multi-task with excellent organizational skills, in a fast-paced, dynamic and ever changing startup environment.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to effectively influence top leaders internally and within the industry. 
  • Passion for Airbnb, travel, and the sharing economy
  • Previous experience as product manager, working with product teams is a plus
  • Ability to travel at least 25% of the time 

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

France Annual Pay Range€74.000—€92.000 EUR

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Senior Machine Learning Manager, Borrowing
descriptionHtml:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰 £138,000 to £176,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | Hear from the team ✨ 

About the role

Borrowing is one of Monzo’s most important growth engines. We’ve built strong scale in the UK, and the next phase is even more ambitious: grow in the UK, expand into new customer segments, and build the underwriting capability needed to scale into Europe.

We’re looking for a senior ML leader to help shape that next phase.

You’ll lead a high-calibre team of ML scientists and help define Borrowing’s ML roadmap across UK growth, new customer segments, and EU expansion. You’ll work across underwriting, pricing, limits, and lifecycle decisioning — improving today’s models while helping build the next generation of capability for Monzo.

This role combines near-term commercial impact with long-term strategic advantage:

  • improving performance across our range of products
  • unlocking new data and faster model development
  • helping Monzo build underwriting that scales into new markets
  • shaping how advanced ML and AI can create real value in Borrowing

You’ll partner closely with leaders across Credit Strategy, Product, Engineering, Model Validation, Data, and Platform, and influence decisions that shape both business performance and the long-term architecture of credit decisioning at Monzo. 

What you’ll own

  • Borrowing ML roadmaps across UK optimisation, new customer segments, and EU expansion
  • Faster model improvement through new data and feature engineering
  • How Monzo uses Open Banking, transaction intelligence, and external data in credit decisioning
  • More portable underwriting capabilities across products, customer segments, and markets
  • Hiring, leading, and developing a high-performing ML team
  • Raising the bar on model quality, governance, tooling, and speed of iteration

What you’ll be working on

Examples of the challenges you could help lead:

  • Improving underwriting models across Loans, Flex, and Overdrafts
  • Expand the data we use in our models
  • Building better feature engineering and model shipping capability
  • Improving transaction intelligence for credit use cases
  • Developing underwriting capabilities for new customer segments and EU markets
  • Shaping Monzo’s approach to advanced ML and AI

Our technology stack

We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies, although we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all of them:

  • Google Cloud Platform
  • BigQuery SQL and dbt
  • Python and the PyData stack
  • Google AI Platform
  • AWS
  • Python for ML services
  • Go for backend services
  • AI tooling for productivity
  • Google Workspace including Gemini
  • ChatGPT Enterprise
  • Claude Code

You should apply if

  • You want to shape the next phase of credit decisioning at one of Europe’s most ambitious fintechs
  • You enjoy combining strategic leadership with strong technical judgment
  • You’re excited by the intersection of underwriting, data, product, and platform capability
  • You like building teams as much as building models
  • You care about real customer and business impact

You must have

Credit and machine learning

  • Strong knowledge of machine learning, statistics, and decisioning systems
  • Deep experience in credit risk and lending
  • Experience building, deploying, and iterating credit models in production
  • Experience pushing the innovation frontiers of the credit industry

Leadership and delivery

  • Experience leading and developing senior ML scientists
  • Strong cross-functional leadership with Product, Credit Strategy, Engineering, and Validation
  • Track record of turning strategy into practical delivery in a regulated environment

It would be great if you also have

  • Experience across more than one market
  • Experience with advanced ML methods and AI on structured financial data

The interview process

  • 30 min Recruiter Call
  • 45 min Initial Call
  • 60 min ML technical interview
  • 60 min People Leadership interview
  • 60 min Product / Credit ML interview

All interviews will be conducted through Google Meet.

What’s in it for you

💰 £138,000 to £176,000 ➕ plus stock options & benefits

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍This role can be based in our London office with a hybrid working pattern, or fully remote within the UK with occasional travel to London.

🏡 We’ll set you up to work from home, including support for remote setups.

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work in a way that lets you do your best work.

📚 Learning budget for books, training courses and conferences

title: Senior Manager, Corporate Services Sourcing
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Finance team shapes the company's future by directing capital to high-impact investments, developing robust financial strategies, and ensuring we deliver long-term value while pursuing our ambitious mission.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Corporate Services Sourcing to join our team. This is a remote role based in Europe (preferred hubs: London, Berlin, Copenhagen, or Helsinki). In this role, you’ll help us lead the Corporate Services Sourcing team for the Deliveroo and Wolt brands, driving strategic category management and delivering commercial value across a multi-million-pound indirect spend portfolio.

Get to know our Finance team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Global Sourcing team within our Global Procurement organization, reporting into the Director, Head of Global Strategic Sourcing. You will lead a team of five (5) managing a broad portfolio across EMEA (including Professional Services, Global Security, Facilities/Real Estate, BPO, HR/Benefits, and Contingent Workforce), while partnering with the DoorDash Corporate Services team to capture global enterprise synergies.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

Category Strategy & Leadership

  • Lead and develop a high-performing sourcing team of five, setting clear goals, driving accountability, and building capability across the Corporate Services portfolio.

  • Build and execute multi-year category strategies that increase category maturity, optimise total cost of ownership (TCO), and unlock value beyond traditional cost savings.

  • Partner with DoorDash sourcing leads to align global category strategies, leverage enterprise scale across brands, and capture cross-regional synergies.

Execution & Supplier Management

  • Own the end-to-end sourcing lifecycle for high-stakes corporate procurement, including data analysis, RFx creation, proposal evaluation, and complex contract negotiations (MSAs/SOWs).

  • Act as a trusted advisor and escalation point for executive stakeholders across G&A functions (Finance, Legal, HR, Security) and core business lines.

  • Establish best-in-class supplier ecosystems, tracking performance, SLAs, and supplier risk while embedding ethical and sustainable sourcing (ESG) practices.

  • Contribute to procurement transformation initiatives, championing new tooling, AI-driven sourcing workflows, and continuous process improvements.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Significant experience in Corporate Services Sourcing, with a proven track record of developing and executing strategic category plans across indirect spend categories.

  • Demonstrated people management capability, with experience leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing sourcing professionals.

  • Strong commercial and negotiation acumen, with proven ability to structure and negotiate complex commercial agreements (MSAs, SOWs) and utilise TCO modelling.

  • Exceptional stakeholder engagement and communication skills, capable of influencing senior leaders, managing matrixed business partners, and driving cross-brand collaboration.

  • Deep risk management expertise, including third-party risk assessments, contract governance, and mitigation strategies within multi-jurisdictional environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working within the technology sector or high-growth, fast-paced marketplace environments.

  • Proficiency with modern procurement and CLM platforms (e.g., Coupa, NetSuite, Pivot) and enthusiasm for applying AI tools in day-to-day sourcing workflows.

  • Experience operating across European markets and diverse regulatory/legal structures.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. title: Senior Manager, Corporate Strategy & Development (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
The role

As a Senior Manager, Corporate Strategy & Development, you will work in a small, AI enabled team of highly driven and committed individuals, reporting to the Director Corporate Strategy & Development. This is a high-exposure role, acting as the strategic and analytical engine for our most important decisions in a team that reports directly to the Group CEO.

You will work across the team's full agenda: Group and business unit strategy, portfolio and capital allocation decisions, and M&A. You are hands-on: you build the financial models, analysis and executive-level outputs yourself. You work under the guidance of the team leadership, owning the quality of analysis and models within your workstreams as well as the respective internal stakeholder relationships.

What you’ll do

  • Corporate Strategy: Support the development of the Group's mid-term strategy by driving the process, own the underlying analysis, strategic synthesis, and preparation of strategic documents.
  • Business Unit Strategy: Act as an internal consultant, supporting our key business units across geographies on a project-by-project basis to develop their mid-term strategies and solve their most complex challenges.
  • M&A Strategy: Drive workstreams for M&A projects, building and owning financial models, analyzing targets, preparing negotiations and supporting the M&A processes the team owns.
  • Portfolio Optimization: Contribute to the strategic analysis for key portfolio decisions, including potential geo-expansions, new vertical or brand launches or divestments.
  • Capital Allocation: Develop and improve the analytical frameworks and models to support our strategic budget allocation and ROI analysis.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience: 4+ years of high-performance experience from a top-tier Management Consulting firm, Investment Banking, or a comparable in-house Strategy / Corporate Development team.
  • Toolkit: Exceptional qualitative and analytical problem-solving skills. You are hypothesis-driven and can own and structure complex analytical problems from end-to-end. You are utilizing AI tools to meaningfully improve your productivity. Ability to build applications with AI coding tools is a plus.
  • Financial Acumen: Strong financial modeling skills are required: you have built and defended models used for investment or strategic decisions. Valuation experience is a plus. You are just as comfortable building analysis and models from scratch as you are managing processes and presenting recommendations to leadership.
  • DTC economics: You are comfortable working with typical DTC KPIs like CAC, AOR, AOV, CLV, retention and understand how cohort economics build a P&L over time. DTC marketing analytics experience is a plus but not required.
  • Communication: Proactive 360° communication and excellent ability to synthesize complex analysis into clear, concise storylines, presentationsand memos for an executive audience. 
  • How you work: You take ownership of outcomes and pressure-test your own conclusions before presenting them. You go deep into the analysis to get to the right answer, and know when it is good enough to decide.

What you will get in return:

  • 70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes
  • Company pension scheme
  • Gym membership
  • Bupa private medical insurance (including dental & family cover options)
  • Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme
  • Nursery support scheme
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Group Life Assurance

Location: The HelloFresh Farm, 60 Worship Street, EC2A 2EZ, London

Hybrid Working Policy
We offer a hybrid working policy for eligible roles, allowing flexibility to work from home and in the office. For more details on eligibility and how this applies to the role you're applying for, please consult with your recruiter.

Next steps: Your application will be reviewed and if successful, a member of the Talent Acquisition Team will be in touch within 2 weeks.

To be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in the UK, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time.

You are required to cooperate with HelloFresh in all health and safety matters. You are responsible for ensuring you take reasonable care of your own health, and safety as well as others who may be affected by the work activities you undertake. You must report incidents immediately and actively raise health and safety-related concerns to your Line Manager. As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure environment, we will process Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) checks to the successful individual. Failure to disclose relevant information at application or throughout the process could affect your employment with the company.

title: Senior Manager (w/m/d) - Finance Integration & Transformation
descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Manager, GTM Partnerships, SME & growth
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You'll lead and develop a team of four partnership managers and own the partnerships strategy for France. This is a strategic, hands-on player-coach role focused on commercial partnerships and lead generation, not technical integrations.

  • Own the French partnerships strategy, prioritising Accounting and Travel & E-commerce first and aligned with the SME & Growth GTM.

  • Personally source and progress a portfolio of strategic partnerships in at least one priority vertical.

  • Build repeatable referral, reseller, co-selling and partner-led outbound motions across Accounting, Travel, Payments, E-commerce and Venture Capital.

  • Turn signed partnerships into active commercial channels, not passive logos.

  • Partner with Sales on account mapping, lead routing, qualification, follow-up and conversion of partner-sourced opportunities.

  • Track partner-sourced and influenced pipeline, conversion, time to first referral and revenue contribution, scaling what creates quality pipeline and stopping what doesn't.

  • Partner with Marketing, RevOps, Product, Solutions, Risk and Compliance to remove friction from the partner journey.

You'll work from our Paris office at least three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 8+ years in partnerships, channel sales, indirect sales, partner sales, strategic business development or a comparable commercial role.

  • A successful 0-to-1 partnership motion or vertical launch in Accounting or Travel & E-commerce, with measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Strong channel-led execution and a personal track record of partner-sourced referrals, pipeline, opportunities or revenue.

  • Commercial experience across at least two of these verticals: Accounting, Travel, Payments, E-commerce or Venture Capital.

  • A deep, activatable network in at least one priority vertical, with access to senior decision-makers.

  • Strong strategic judgement and hands-on execution: you can define the strategy, open the first doors, lead key meetings and progress strategic partnerships.

Preferred

  • Experience in accounting, payments, fintech, ERP, financial software or another competitive B2B environment.

  • Comfort with CRM, funnel metrics, partner economics and basic business cases.


You'll thrive here if

  • You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

  • You're excited by a category that hasn't been won yet, and want to be early enough to shape it.

  • You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office three days a week.

  • You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you're motivated by stretch goals.


Learn more about your team

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

Equal opportunity
