title: Senior Materials Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As Senior Materials Engineer (all genders) you will lead material selection for the propulsion battery system of VÆRIDION's CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will identify the best material for each application, from composites and metals to adhesives, gaskets, and insulation materials, and own the material requirements and evidence that support each choice. Through trade studies, characterization, and close supplier engagement, you will make sure that every material in the propulsion battery system performs safely in normal operation, under abuse, and during thermal runaway.

Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will work closely with Mechanical Design and Materials & Processes, and support the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, and Cell Technology teams wherever material choices matter, including thermal adhesives, electrical bonding, and insulation. As development matures, you will hand over qualification and process ownership to Materials & Processes while remaining the technical authority on material behaviour. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead material selection for the propulsion battery system, including composites, metals, adhesives, gaskets, seals, potting compounds, and thermal and electrical insulation materials.

  • Lead structured material trade studies that balance mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, weight, cost, and supply chain considerations.

  • Own material requirements for normal operation, abuse, and failure cases, including thermal runaway, fire, venting, crash, vibration, humidity, and fluid exposure.

  • Evaluate high-temperature and fire protection materials, such as phenolic and high-char-yield composites, silicone systems, ceramics, and intumescent materials, for thermal runaway containment.

  • Provide material property data and guidance on material-driven design features to the Mechanical Design team.

  • Support material choices for thermal adhesives, gap fillers, electrical bonding, and insulation together with the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, and Airborne Electronics teams.

  • Draft test requests (TRQs) for material characterization and work with the test team and suppliers to execute them.

  • Analyse test data and derive design-relevant material properties and conclusions.

  • Own technical relationships with material suppliers, including requirements alignment, data requests, and the evaluation of new material candidates.

  • Define material specifications and approved-material definitions together with Materials & Processes.

  • Contribute to material qualification and certification substantiation, transferring ownership to Materials & Processes as development matures.

  • Assess material compatibility and durability over the service life, including chemical compatibility with coolants and electrolytes, galvanic corrosion between dissimilar materials, moisture uptake, outgassing, and property retention after thermal cycling and accelerated aging, as well as resistance to thermal runaway vent gases and ejecta, working with the Materials & Processes Engineer where processing such as cure state or surface preparation affects the result.

  • Lead failure investigations and root cause analyses where material behaviour is a contributor.

  • Consider regulatory constraints such as REACH and RoHS in material selection.

  • Act as the technical authority on materials in design reviews and technical discussions with suppliers and partners.

  • Mentor engineers and build materials expertise across the Technology division.

 

Your Profile:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Materials Science & Engineering.

  • 5+ years of experience in materials engineering, preferably in aerospace, battery systems, or other safety-critical industries.

  • Deep understanding of structure-property-processing relationships in polymers, composites, metals, and ceramics.

  • Proven ability to select the best material for a given application, based on data and first principles.

  • Experience with material characterization methods such as mechanical testing, DSC, TGA, DMA, cone calorimetry, and microscopy.

  • Experience planning tests, interpreting results, and correlating them with design requirements.

  • Strong knowledge of thermoset and thermoplastic composites, adhesives, and elastomers.

  • Knowledge of high-temperature material performance and fire, smoke, and toxicity behaviour is desirable.

  • Experience leading technical work with material suppliers.

  • Familiarity with CS-23, DO-160, DO-311A, and CMH-17 is beneficial.

  • Working proficiency with 3D CAD, such as CATIA, SolidWorks, or Siemens NX, is beneficial.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, technical curiosity, and attention to detail.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. German is a plus.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Senior Partner Manager (German speaking)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We’re looking for an ambitious, German-speaking Senior Partner Manager (Strategic Partnerships) to build and scale Perk’s partner ecosystem across Europe, with a particular focus on the DACH region.

This is a commercial role with a clear objective: build partnerships that generate qualified sales pipeline and revenue for Perk. You’ll identify and recruit the right partners, develop joint go-to-market strategies, and turn those relationships into a repeatable growth channel. You’ll work closely with Sales and Marketing while owning partner relationships from initial outreach through launch, activation, and ongoing performance.

The ideal person combines a builder’s mindset with strong commercial instincts. You’re comfortable opening doors, creating something from scratch, and earning the trust of senior stakeholders. You’re ambitious, persistent, and focused on measurable results.

What You’ll Do

  • Build our partner ecosystem: Identify, recruit, and develop high-potential referral, reseller, technology, and strategic alliance partners across Europe, with a particular focus on DACH.

  • Generate pipeline and revenue: Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline targets, turning partnerships into a meaningful and repeatable growth channel for Perk.

  • Create joint go-to-market strategies: Build plans with priority partners across target accounts, campaigns, events, referrals, and co-selling motions.

  • Own the commercial relationship: Lead partner conversations from initial outreach through business case development, negotiation, contracting, launch, and ongoing growth.

  • Activate and enable partners: Give partners the product knowledge, sales materials, training, and support they need to confidently position Perk and identify opportunities.

  • Partner closely with Sales and Marketing: Ensure partner-generated opportunities are effectively routed, prioritised, and converted, while creating scalable ways for our commercial teams to work with partners.

  • Measure and improve performance: Set targets, forecast partner pipeline and revenue, identify what’s working, and continuously improve our partnership strategy and playbooks.

  • Bring new opportunities to Perk: Stay close to market and product developments and identify new partner models that can accelerate growth or create meaningful value for our customers.

What We’re Looking For

  • Languages: Native or near-native fluency in German and professional fluency in English.

  • Track record: Proven success in partnerships, alliances, channel sales, or business development, ideally within SaaS, fintech, travel technology, or another B2B technology environment.

  • ERP and finance technology ecosystem: Hands on experience working with ERP, accounting and finance automation vendors and their partner ecosystems (e.g Netsuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Sage, Xero, Datev).

  • Commercial performance: A history of building partnerships that generate measurable sales pipeline and revenue against targets.

  • Builder mentality: Comfortable developing new partner relationships and go-to-market motions from scratch rather than simply managing an established programme.

  • Executive presence: Strong communication and presentation skills, with the credibility to build relationships and negotiate with senior and C-level stakeholders.

  • Commercial judgment: Able to assess which opportunities are worth pursuing, structure mutually valuable partnerships, and focus time on the relationships most likely to produce meaningful results.

  • Cross-functional mindset: A low-ego, team-first approach and the ability to work effectively across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and other teams.

  • Ownership: Independent, ambitious, persistent, and comfortable being accountable for outcomes.

  • Based within commuting distance of our hub.

  • Travel: Willingness to travel regularly across Europe for partner meetings, conferences and events.

What we offer

  • 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

  • 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60mins - Virtual

  • Values interview - 30mins virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Senior Partnership Manager Payments
descriptionHtml:
Opleiding: Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur met een achtergrond in bedrijfskunde, economie, finance, commerciële economie of vergelijkbaar.
Ervaring: Minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen payments, banking, fintech, strategic partnerships of business development.
Kennis: Van card schemes, issuing, acquiring en de werking van het internationale betalingsverkeer.
Persoonlijkheid: Je bent communicatief sterk, organisatiesensitief, zelfstandig en overtuigend op senior niveau.
Salaris: € 7.000,- en € 8.000,- p/m.

WAT GA JE DOEN?

Elke dag checken 6,5 miljoen Nederlanders in om te reizen met het OV. Met de OV-chipkaart, OV-pas, betaalpas, creditcard of mobiel. En dat werkt simpel en soepel. Kaart voor de lezer en … ‘bliep’. Reizen maar! Maar achter die ‘bliep’ gaat een complexe wereld schuil. Welkom in de wereld van Translink!

Met de introductie van nieuwe betaalmogelijkheden onder de vlag OVpay is Translink dichter komen te staan bij de bredere financiële sector. In- en uitchecken met de bankpas vereist goede afstemming met banken. Maar ook de bredere inzet van EMV-technologie met OVpay maakt dat we als bedrijf te maken hebben met bestaande card schemes.

Als Senior Partnership Manager Payments - Card Schemes & Banken, ben jij het externe gezicht van Translink binnen het paymentecosysteem. Je onderhoudt strategische relaties met onder andere Visa, Mastercard, banken en andere belangrijke partijen in het betalingsverkeer. Je begrijpt hun belangen en ontwikkelingen en weet deze te verbinden met de ambities van Translink en OVpay.

Je beweegt je gemakkelijk op senior niveau en voert gesprekken met zowel inhoudelijke experts als directies en bestuurders. Daarbij begrijp je niet alleen de commerciële kant van partnerships, maar ook hoe de paymentketen inhoudelijk werkt. Je weet wat ontwikkelingen binnen issuing, acquiring en card schemes betekenen voor Translink en kunt deze vertalen naar concrete keuzes en afspraken.

Intern werk je nauw samen met onder andere Product, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations en IT. Daarnaast vorm je samen met collega’s die zich meer richten op ontwikkeling en data een sterk team: jij richt je primair op de externe relaties en strategische partnerships.

Waar ga je dagelijks mee aan de slag:

  • Je bouwt en onderhoudt strategische relaties met Visa, Mastercard, Nederlandse banken, issuers en andere relevante partijen binnen payments.

  • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor externe stakeholders en vertegenwoordigt Translink in strategische en inhoudelijke gesprekken.

  • Je ontwikkelt een duidelijke partnershipstrategie en meerjarige agenda voor de samenwerking met card schemes en banken.

  • Je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen het internationale betalingsverkeer, scheme rules en marktstandaarden en vertaalt deze naar impact en concrete acties voor Translink.

  • Je voert inhoudelijke en commerciële onderhandelingen over voorwaarden, kosten, dienstverlening en gezamenlijke verbeterinitiatieven.

  • Je verbindt externe marktontwikkelingen met interne technische, financiële en datagedreven inzichten.

  • Je adviseert management en directie over kansen, risico’s, afhankelijkheden en ontwikkelingen binnen het paymentecosysteem.

  • Je zorgt voor afstemming tussen Product, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations, IT en externe partners bij complexe trajecten rondom payments en scheme compliance.

  • Je draagt bij aan de verdere professionalisering en mogelijke organisatorische ontwikkeling van de paymentactiviteiten binnen Translink.


WIE ZOEKEN WE?

We zoeken een ervaren paymentprofessional die zijn of haar sporen in de sector heeft verdiend. Je begrijpt hoe banken, issuers, acquirers en card schemes met elkaar samenwerken en weet wat er nodig is om binnen dat complexe speelveld duurzame partnerships op te bouwen.

Je voelt je comfortabel aan tafel met senior stakeholders en bestuurders. Je kunt complexe onderwerpen helder uitleggen en weet de vertaalslag te maken tussen de buitenwereld en de interne organisatie. Tegelijkertijd ben je pragmatisch. Je bouwt niet alleen relaties, maar zorgt ook dat afspraken daadwerkelijk leiden tot resultaat.

Voor een ervaren professional biedt deze rol bovendien iets bijzonders: je werkt aan een maatschappelijk relevant betalingssysteem dat dagelijks door miljoenen reizigers wordt gebruikt.

WAT ZIT ERIN JOUW TAS?

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen payments, banking, fintech, strategic partnerships, business development of relatiemanagement.

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met partijen zoals card schemes, banken, issuers, acquirers, paymentnetwerken of andere organisaties binnen het betalingsverkeer.

  • Je hebt kennis van onderwerpen zoals scheme rules, scheme economics, fees, incentives en ontwikkelingen binnen het internationale betalingsverkeer.

  • Je bent gewend om complexe relaties en onderhandelingen op senior niveau te voeren.

  • Je kunt marktontwikkelingen, financiële belangen en inhoudelijke vraagstukken vertalen naar heldere voorstellen en concrete resultaten.

  • Je communiceert overtuigend met zowel inhoudelijke experts als senior management en externe bestuurders.

  • Je bent organisatiesensitief, analytisch en zelfstandig en weet mensen mee te krijgen zonder formele hiërarchie.

  • Je beheerst zowel het Nederlands als het Engels uitstekend.

WAT BIEDT TRANSLINK JOU?

Translink is een leuke, uitdagende werkplek. We werken in een dynamische, veelzijdige omgeving met een hoog ontwikkeltempo. Samenwerken, Wendbaarheid en Zelfregie zijn onze kernwaarden en dat proef je op de werkvloer.

Translink biedt een prettige kantooromgeving met fijne werkplekken. Onze werksfeer is informeel, open en behulpzaam. Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn aantrekkelijk. Vrij bewegen is ons motto. Je kunt in goed overleg hybride werken en we bieden bewegingsruimte om balans aan te brengen tussen je werk- en privéleven. Zo kun je met onze thuiswerkregeling ook thuis een fijne werkplek inrichten.

Voor je eigen ontwikkeling bieden wij de GoodHabitz online leeromgeving aan. Zo kun je jezelf continu blijven ontwikkelen. We hebben bij Translink ook de mogelijkheid om een (elektrische) fiets te leasen, dit kan zowel voor privé als woon-werkverkeer.

Je ontvangt een salaris tussen € 7.000,- en € 8.000,- p/m. Dit is afhankelijk van je ervaring en kwalificaties, op basis van een 40-urige werkweek. Daar bovenop ontvang je een keuzebudget van 6,94% van je salaris, dit is gemiddeld € 500,- p/m. Daarnaast krijg je 8% vakantiegeld, reiskosten en een goede pensioenregeling. Deze functie is voor minimaal 32 uur per week.

title: Senior/Principal Data Scientist (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Stenon GmbH

At Stenon we are on a mission to democratize soil data. We have become the global market leader in real-time, digital soil data. This provides farmers with essential insights to make optimal and sustainable cultivation decisions, boosting yield, crop quality, and soil health while saving money on inputs. Stenon has closed an $18 million Series B financing round to scale real-time nitrogen and soil data management and is expanding internationally.

Position

We seek a versatile and experienced Senior Data Scientist, that drives and expands our existing soil nutrient machine learning as well as new data-driven features that support our customers in making better agronomic decisions for their fields using real-time soil data.

What you will do

  • Be responsible for a core pillar of Stenon’s products

  • Scale our soil nutrient modelling to support more and more regions across the world

  • Oversee planning, execution and delivery of Data Science projects.

  • Contribute to the Data Science strategy, vision and roadmap, enhancing Stenon’s agronomy intelligence layer to support additional features and enable new data sources

  • Work with a variety of data from spectral sensor data via chemical lab analysis results to spatial fertilization maps.

What you must have

  • At least 5+ years of hands-on experience in Data Science products

  • Advanced Degree in Engineering or Science

  • Exceptional understanding of statistical and fundamental machine learning concepts

  • Experience writing and maintaining python code, incl. common libraries like scikit, pytorch as well as ML-Ops infrastructure like MLflow, DVC

  • High degree of autonomy

  • Ability to translate complex statistical or machine learning concepts into digestible information for non-technical audiences

  • Experience across the machine learning product lifecycle: defining success metrics, model evaluation and validation, deployment, monitoring and iteration, in collaboration with data engineers

  • A strong sense for data and code quality and the ability to push for high standards

  • High-dimensional sensor/signal data processing expertise

  • Proven track record of managing complex projects from start to finish in a fast paced environment

  • Experience leading or mentoring team members

  • Good communication and English language skills - verbal and written

You may have

  • Experience in geo-spatial products

  • Knowledge of agronomy or agriculture, sensor/IoT data, or field trials

  • Understanding of sensor hardware, physical measurement principles and real world noise characteristics

  • ML Ops or Data Engineering knowledge, like Docker, CI/

What we offer

  • Ownership & Growth: A key role in a fast-growing scale-up where you own your area of responsibility with flat hierarchies and fast decision-making.

  • Real-World Impact: Design products that go directly into the hands of farmers, solving global food production and climate challenges.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work in a highly productive, international team that values hands-on development and mutual support.

  • Work-Life Balance: A permanent full-time role offering adaptable schedules to accommodate your lifestyle.

  • Flexible Location: Choose between hybrid or fully remote options across Germany, featuring one mandatory monthly collaboration day in Potsdam for team cohesion and alignment.

  • Remote Setup Support: A dedicated financial allowance to help you optimize your home workspace

  • Learning Budget: Invest in your professional growth with an annual allowance dedicated to courses, conferences, books and certifications

  • Year-End Break: Enjoy a paid company-wide closure between Christmas and New Year to recharge and spend time with loved ones.

  • Seamless Commuting: Choose between an ABC Berlin/Potsdam travel pass or a Deutschland-Ticket to keep you mobile.

  • Team Spirit: Annual company retreats to warmer climates (last year we went to Gran Canaria), regular social events, and a fully stocked kitchen with coffee, tea, and snacks.

Why Us?

We are changing how farmers understand and manage their soil, moving from lab-based analysis to real-time insights directly in the field. We value transparency, ownership, and continuous improvement, and we believe great products come from teams that respect and support each other.

We set high standards, reward performance, and foster a positive, constructive feedback culture.

title: Senior Product Manager, Fisheries / IUUF
descriptionHtml:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

As Senior Product Manager, Fisheries, you will own the Fisheries product end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build a new product offering that brings together Kpler's vessel, ownership, port, and trade-flow data to address growing challenges around seafood supply chain transparency and illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing.

Your initial focus will be on building live fleet monitoring and catch and yield reporting, enabling procurement and compliance teams to monitor vessels, understand fishing activity, and access reliable information to support their due-diligence and traceability requirements.

This is a high-impact opportunity to build a new product category from the ground up. You will work directly with seafood buyers, retailers, processors, certification bodies, regulators, RFMO stakeholders, and NGOs, as well as Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing teams, to ensure the product delivers trusted and actionable intelligence.

The role is ideal for an experienced product leader who is comfortable operating in an ambiguous, early-stage environment and has a track record of taking B2B data, analytics, or SaaS products from concept through to customer adoption.


Key Responsibilities
  • Own the Fisheries product strategy, vision, and roadmap, defining what gets built and in what order while balancing customer value, commercial opportunity, technical feasibility, and time to market.
  • Lead the development and delivery of the first Fisheries product release, focused on live fleet monitoring and subsequently catch and yield reporting that procurement and compliance teams can rely on.
  • Lead market and customer discovery with seafood buyers, retailers, processors, certification bodies, regulators, RFMO stakeholders, and NGOs to understand customer needs and translate insights into product direction.
  • Define and refine the product proposition and customer experience, ensuring Kpler's data and intelligence are translated into clear, actionable outcomes for customers across the seafood supply chain.
  • Establish the vessel identity, dark-behaviour, and catch-estimation methodologies underpinning the product, working with data and domain experts to ensure the outputs are credible, transparent, and trusted.
  • Own positioning and competitive strategy, monitoring the existing commercial and NGO-adjacent landscape and clearly defining Kpler's differentiation.
  • Lead the go-to-market strategy for the product, working with Sales and Product Marketing on positioning, messaging, packaging, pricing input, launch planning, and early customer adoption.
  • Identify and develop strategic partnerships across the seafood supply chain, including data, certification, and distribution partnerships that can strengthen the product and accelerate adoption.
  • Act as the key link between Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing, creating alignment around product strategy, priorities, launch plans, and customer outcomes.
  • Track product performance, customer feedback, delivery progress, and key risks, using evidence and market insight to continuously refine the roadmap and maximise product impact.

    • Skills and Responsibilities
  • 5–7 years of Product Management or senior commercial experience, ideally within maritime data, seafood supply chains, or a related B2B data/SaaS environment.
  • Proven track record of owning products end-to-end, from strategy and customer discovery through to delivery, launch, and customer adoption.
  • Strong track record of translating complex customer needs into clear product strategy, roadmap priorities, and product requirements, working closely with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Strong understanding of the fisheries data landscape, including vessel tracking, IUU risk, catch documentation, and supply chain traceability.

title: Senior RAM Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Destinus Engineering is looking for a highly motivated and experienced Senior Reliability Engineer to ensure that our defense systems and products perform dependably in demanding operational environments. You’ll lead reliability, availability and maintainability (RAM) efforts across Destinus systems and products covering the full product lifecycle, from early design trade studies through qualification, fielding, and sustainment. You will work closely with system design, test, and supply chain teams as well as customers. The ideal candidate is a strong team player with good social and leadership skills to continuously coordinate with the peers of the respective engineering disciplines and teams.

Key Responsibilities

· Develop and execute reliability program plans in line with contract requirements and applicable standards (e.g., MIL-STD-785, MIL-HDBK-217, MIL-STD-1629, IEC 60812, FIDES, ANSI/GEIA-STD-0009, ASD S3000L or customer-specific equivalents)

· Perform reliability predictions, FMEA/FMECA, fault tree analysis, derating and worst-case analyses, and reliability block diagram modeling

· Define and run reliability test programs, including HALT/HASS, environmental stress screening, accelerated life testing, and reliability growth testing

· Contribute to design reviews (PDR, CDR) and influence design for reliability and maintainability early in development

· Support sustainment engineering, including obsolescence and parts-quality assessments, and supplier reliability oversight

· Prepare reliability documentation and present findings to internal leadership and government customers

· Availability modelling and allocating RAM requirements down from the system to subsystems

· Maintainability analysis plus testability and BIT coverage analysis

· Input to the maintenance and logistic support analysis, working with ILS

Requirements

Required Qualifications

· BSc or MSc in engineering (electrical, mechanical, systems, or related)

· [7+] years of reliability engineering experience preferably in the defense sector

· Experience in a tier 1 defense supplier company interacting directly with the military customer is a plus

· Hands-on experience with FMEA/FMECA, reliability prediction, and statistical life data analysis

· Experience with Air Defence and / or Strike systems is a plus

· Experience with modern European RAM standards: IEC 60812, FIDES, ANSI/GEIA-STD-0009, ASD S3000L

· Familiarity with military reliability and environmental standards (e.g., MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461) and DoD acquisition or equivalent processes

· Experience using RWB Isograph or similar RAMS software.

· Proactive, ownership-driven mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities

· Ability to work autonomously and as part of a fast-paced, dynamic, international and multidisciplinary development team.

· Fluency in English is required; German is a plus.

title: Senior RF Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking to add a Senior RF Hardware Engineer to our team. If you are great at what you do, enjoy working in a startup environment, and are passionate about developing leading-edge electronics for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you.

At the Senior II level, you will be tasked with full-stack hardware development for complex modules and small systems. You will have the opportunity to start at concept development and progress through detailed design, analysis, layout, build, test, and delivery, doing hands-on work at each phase. The Senior II level also introduces technical leadership opportunities, gaining responsibility for small teams of hardware engineers developing new products and systems.

At a small company and a startup, your work will make direct contributions to the success of the business. The work is challenging and impactful, requiring both breadth and depth of technical knowledge. Our products are made for high-reliability space and airborne applications, so designs require high levels of technical rigor while maintaining the agility of a startup environment.

The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.


SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Design and develop RF, mixed-signal, and digital hardware for electronically steered antenna (AESA) communication systems.
  • Support the adaptation of existing hardware designs for new customer platforms, operational environments, and regional requirements.
  • Develop RF front-end, power distribution, control, and interface circuitry for phased-array communication terminals.
  • Own the development of hardware modules and subsystems from requirements through schematic capture, layout, integration, verification, and production release.
  • Develop hardware requirements, perform trade studies, and support subsystem architecture development.
  • Perform detailed schematic design for complex RF, mixed-signal, and high-speed digital circuit boards.
  • Support PCB layout activities in Altium Designer, including stack-up definition, component placement, routing reviews, and design-for-manufacturing considerations.
  • Perform engineering analyses including worst-case circuit analysis, signal integrity, power integrity, thermal, and reliability assessments.
  • Develop and execute hardware bring-up, integration, debugging, and design verification activities.
  • Support RF characterization, system integration, troubleshooting, and root-cause investigations using laboratory test equipment.
  • Define and execute environmental, qualification, and compliance testing activities, including EMI/EMC verification.
  • Collaborate closely with all the relevant engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Support technical design reviews, engineering documentation, requirements traceability, and customer-facing technical activities.
  • Contribute to product qualification, certification, manufacturing transfer, and production support activities.
  • Provide technical support for field trials, demonstrations, customer evaluations, and deployment activities.
  • Mentor junior engineers and technicians while promoting engineering best practices and technical rigor.
  • Apply knowledge of adjacent disciplines, including software, systems, RF, and mechanical engineering, to support efficient product development and integration.

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor of Science (BS) degree or higher in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university.
  • Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in board-level electronics design, analysis, and test.
  • Direct experience designing high-reliability electronics for space or defense applications, including part derating, worst-case analysis, and thermal constraints.
  • Experience owning the design phase of complex board-level electronics, including trade studies, key part selection, and detailed design.
  • Experience delivering hardware designs through production and deployment.
  • Expertise in PCB layout, including high-density interconnect (HDI) stackup design and high-speed routing.
  • Experience running board-level signal integrity and/or power integrity simulation tools such as Ansys SIwave, ADS SIPro, or Mentor Hyperlynx.
  • Strong working knowledge of adjacent fields, such as software and mechanical, that guides hardware design and system design
  • Expert-level proficiency in electronics design tools such as Altium.
  • Extensive lab experience for bring-up and verification of new hardware.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills.

    • WHAT WE OFFER
  • Experience leading small teams of hardware engineers to develop multi-module assemblies, including hardware architecture, requirements, make/buy decisions, and interconnects.
  • Design for space radiation environments

title: Senior Security Engineer, AI Platform and Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.  

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

ROLE SUMMARY 

Firmus Technologies is seeking a Senior Security Engineer, AI Platform and Infrastructure for our Engineering and Technology team. Customers provision GPU compute through API and console, software engineers build against it, our infrastructure engineers build the bare metal, virtualisation layer and Kubernetes clusters behind it, and our operators run the platform through the same control plane. You own both layers of Firmus AI Cloud: the platform control plane that engineering teams built, and the bare-metal infrastructure it runs on. Automation is how you scale that ownership. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Automation and secure delivery 

  • Own the security controls in platform delivery pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, hardware lifecycle, and Kubernetes deployment. Ship them as paved roads that engineering teams and delivery partners inherit. 
  • Build the systems that do the repeatable work: posture management, configuration validation, firmware and attestation checks, bulletin-driven fleet upgrades, evidence collection, and infrastructure risk detection.  
  • Write and review code, infrastructure-as-code, and policy-as-code that enforce security outcomes at scale. 

Security architecture and standards 

  • Set the standard for platform identity, workload identity, privileged access, and secrets: short-lived credentials, federation, least-privilege access to infrastructure APIs and Kubernetes, and audit trails for administrative and control-plane actions. 
  • Define the security baseline for Kubernetes and the container workloads the platform admits: control-plane isolation from worker and tenant networks, admission controls, policy-as-code, network policy, encrypted cluster secrets, no privileged containers or host mounts, least-privilege service accounts, and only trusted, pinned images. 
  • Lead threat modelling and secure design review for infrastructure, platform, and shared-service changes. Define what an attacker can do and what must be true before it ships. 
  • Design isolation in layers, so a single misconfiguration or outdated component cannot yield cross-tenant data access or code execution. Cover cluster, host, network, storage, control plane, and telemetry rather than relying on containers, namespaces, or dashboard filters alone. 
  • Separate the infrastructure management plane from tenant workloads: out-of-band and BMC access, device and attached-NIC management, and shared network device administration. 
  • Define how the platform is exposed and protected: default-deny at the edge, private endpoints for administrative and cluster APIs, enforcement placed in the path so volumetric and application-layer attacks are blocked or mitigated before it reaches services, encryption in transit and at rest, and automated certificate lifecycle. 
  • Set the standard for hardware roots of trust, remote attestation, secure and measured boot, firmware lifecycle, and sanitisation of GPU, host, attached device, and storage state before hardware is reassigned. Apply those controls across sites. 

Assurance and vulnerability management 

  • Own platform and infrastructure security posture: what is covered, what is open, what is accepted with a named owner and an expiry, and what is overdue. 
  • Prioritise fixes on exploitability and exposure alongside CVSS, hold them to the Firmus vulnerability SLAs, and drive remediation with the teams that own the platform components, so issues close at the source. 
  • Extend SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 into the infrastructure lifecycle as platforms and sites grow. Evidence that a control ran should be a query, not a spreadsheet exercise. 

Enablement and escalation 

  • Coach engineers so secure infrastructure decisions get made without waiting for you. 
  • Provide platform and infrastructure security expertise during incidents and convert recurring failure modes into controls, guardrails, standards, or automation. 
  • Give engineering leadership a straight read on infrastructure risk and operational security readiness. Join customer conversations when the question is platform and infrastructure security. 

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field. 
  • 7+ years in infrastructure security, platform security, cloud security, site reliability engineering, or platform engineering with a strong security focus. 
  • Has secured production bare-metal and on-premises infrastructure used by multiple teams or customers, including Linux hosts, out-of-band management, and the hardware lifecycle from commissioning through sanitisation and reassignment. 
  • Deep, practical knowledge of Kubernetes and container security for a multi-tenant platform: control-plane isolation, admission controls, policy-as-code, network policy, cluster secrets, container privilege and host-access restrictions, and admitting only trusted images. Has threat modelled production infrastructure using STRIDE or an equivalent method. 
  • Has run platform and workload identity in production: federation, short-lived credentials, privileged access management, secrets platforms, and least-privilege access to infrastructure APIs. 
  • Has designed and tested isolation so a container or VM escape, an outdated GPU or container toolkit, or a shared control plane cannot become a cross-tenant incident. 
  • Understands hardware roots of trust, secure and measured boot, signed firmware, and remote attestation, and can specify how out-of-band and device management interfaces stay separated from tenant workloads. 
  • Has secured public network exposure and platform cryptography: default-deny edge controls, private endpoints for administrative APIs, encryption in transit and at rest, and automated certificate lifecycle. 
  • Writes production-quality code in at least one of Python or Go and has replaced manual security work with automation that engineers trusted and kept on. 
  • Has kept production host, container runtime, GPU, and firmware software current against published security bulletins. 
  • Has worked under SOC 2 Type 2 or ISO 27001 and can produce evidence that a control ran. 
  • Willing to join incident response for platform and infrastructure security. 
  • Willing to travel overseas occasionally when the role requires it. 
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication in English. 

Bonus Points 

  • Experience securing AI infrastructure platforms, GPU clusters, or large-scale compute environments, including RoCE fabrics or automated hardware sanitisation. 
  • Experience securing large scale hypervisors and the boundaries between guests, hosts, and assigned devices, including dedicated GPU-node architectures. 
  • Experience with NVIDIA BlueField DPUs and DOCA or equivalent DPU platform software, including restricted host mode and device attestation. 
  • Experience with GPU confidential computing, remote attestation, or attestation-gated workload identity. 
  • Security certifications such as CISSP, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS), or equivalent. 

LOCATION 

Singapore or Australia

title: Senior Software Engineer, Containers
descriptionHtml:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. 

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell

Chainguard Containers is our core product, and this team builds it. As a Senior Software Engineer in Container Product Engineering you will design and ship the features, services, and build systems behind Chainguard Containers, working in a small sub-team of two to four engineers that owns one project end to end.

Chainguard is growing explosively. Every line of code is now written with AI in the loop, which means the foundation it runs on has to be secure by default. You will build that foundation: the hardened container images, the registry that serves them, and the tooling that lets engineers and AI agents adopt them.

This is a product role. You will work directly with Product Managers and customers, make the trade-off calls on the features you own, and ship them.

What the team owns

  • Product features for Chainguard Containers. Letting customers push their own images to our registry, Custom Assembly (customers compose images from our hardened packages), Helm charts, notifications, and compliance views such as STIG dashboards (STIG is the US government's hardening standard).
  • The image build pipeline. The systems that turn packages from Wolfi, our Linux distribution, into signed and attested container images at scale, including moving image builds onto our own runner infrastructure.
  • Registry performance and distribution. Work such as lazy loading, so a container starts before its whole image has downloaded, and image signing with Sigstore.
  • Adoption tooling for engineers and AI agents. Migration tools that convert existing Dockerfiles to Chainguard Containers, and MCP servers (Model Context Protocol, the standard that lets AI agents call tools) so agents can discover and pull our images directly.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and ship new features and services for Chainguard Containers, from a one-page design through production and the first week of customer use.
  • Own the trade-offs on your work: scope, sequencing, what to cut, and when "good enough to ship" beats "complete". Say so clearly when a plan is at risk.
  • Work with AI coding agents as part of how you build, review, and operate, and help the team raise the bar on how it uses them safely.
  • Follow a problem wherever it goes: into another team's service, a customer call, a support ticket, or go-to-market data, rather than stopping at the edge of your own repository.
  • Keep the systems you touch healthy: observability, on-call, and the fixes that stop the same page from coming back.
  • Write clearly and often. Design notes, pull request descriptions, and status updates are how a remote team moves fast together.

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years building and operating software that paying customers use, preferably at a startup or a company in hyper-growth.
  • High agency and urgency. You find a way, you do not wait to be unblocked, and you ask for help early when you are stuck.
  • Judgment on trade-offs. You can explain why you chose speed here and rigor there, and you can change your mind when the data says to.
  • A systems thinker. You reason about how a change moves through the build pipeline, the registry, and the customer's cluster, and you anticipate what breaks next.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Managed PostgreSQL)
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role 

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help us build the best Managed PostgreSQL for AI workloads. The service is already in production; the mission now is to make it the obvious choice for teams running AI applications on Postgres — first-class vector search, painless migrations from RDS / Cloud SQL / self-managed clusters, and the operational quality of a mature managed database.

You'll work across the stack: control plane and lifecycle automation in Go, Postgres internals and performance, migration tooling, and the customer escalations where it actually matters.

You're welcome to work from our offices in Amsterdam or London, hybrid or remotely from EU timezones.

Your responsibilities: 

  • Develop the control plane and lifecycle automation for Managed PostgreSQL — provisioning, HA, failover, backups, PITR, version upgrades, zero-downtime maintenance.
  • Tune and harden PostgreSQL itself — replication, WAL, vacuum, query planner, connection pooling, extensions — and turn that into product features and sane defaults customers don't have to think about.
  • Build migration tooling that gets customers off AWS RDS, Google Cloud SQL, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, and self-managed clusters with minimal downtime.
  • Drive the AI-Postgres story end to end — vector search (pgvector, pgvectorscale), hybrid retrieval, integration with the wider Nebius AI Cloud stack.
  • Run the service like an SRE — define SLOs, build observability, lead incident response, feed every postmortem back into the platform.
  • Work directly with customers on architecture reviews, performance escalations, and the production problems that don't fit a ticket template.

Must-haves: 

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time spent building or operating production PostgreSQL at scale (TB+ datasets, replication topologies, real failure modes you've debugged in production).
  • Strong software engineering skills in Go or another backend/systems language, with a willingness to work primarily in Go.
  • Deep knowledge of PostgreSQL internals: MVCC, WAL, replication (physical and logical), vacuum, query planning, extensions, partitioning.
  • Hands-on experience with the surrounding ecosystem: Patroni / Stolon / pg_auto_failover, pgBackRest / WAL-G, pgBouncer / PgCat, logical replication tooling.
  • The instincts of an ex-DBA — you can read EXPLAIN ANALYZE fluently, reason about lock behaviour, and know how to handle database corruptions.
  • Ability to write reliable code and dig into complex problems.
  • Teamwork-oriented approach.

Nice-to-haves: 

  • Experience with pgvector and pgvectorscale — vector search at scale, index choice, recall vs. latency trade-offs.
  • Background building managed-database control planes at a cloud provider (RDS, Cloud SQL, Aiven, Crunchy, Timescale, Supabase, Neon, or similar).
  • Experience writing Kubernetes operators (Go + controller-runtime / kubebuilder).
  • Contributions to PostgreSQL itself, popular extensions, or the surrounding OSS ecosystem.
  • AI/ML workload experience — RAG pipelines, embedding stores, GPU-resident workloads.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Senior Software Engineer (Quality Engineering)
descriptionHtml:
Thought Machine's mission is bold – to properly and permanently rid the world's banks of legacy technology. To achieve this, we have developed the foundations of modern banking through core and payments technology which run natively in the cloud. What we are attempting is hard and means we need great people working together to build great technology.

We have grown rapidly in the past few years – growing our team to more than 550 individuals across offices in London, New York, Singapore, Sydney and our newly established Engineering Hub in Lisbon. We have raised more than £500m in funding and our investors include Molten Ventures, Eurazeo, Intesa Sanpaolo, Temasek, Nyca Partners, JPMorgan Chase Strategic Investments, Standard Chartered Ventures, and more.

We have created a culture that enables our team to produce the best work in the industry while ensuring we have fun along the way. We're regularly cited as having a fantastic workplace culture and have been recognised by Sifted magazine as having one of the highest Glassdoor ratings for a UK fintech company and the industry's most generous employee share package. Named one of the world's most innovative fintechs by Global Finance Magazine, we were also recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe's fastest-growing companies for two consecutive years—and a UK Best Employer for 2026.

Senior Software Engineer in Quality Engineering

Thought Machine is building the backbone of critical banking infrastructure worldwide, empowering the world’s largest financial institutions to modernise their operations. In this high-stakes environment, producing quality software isn't just a best practice, it is a fundamental imperative and the foundation of our clients' trust. We invest heavily in our testing architecture because the reliability of our software is critical to the global financial ecosystem.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to drive quality engineering excellence, modern testing architecture and practices, and scalable infrastructure across our product engineering organisation.

This is a rigorous, hands-on backend software engineering position, not a traditional QA or SDET role. We do not believe in siloed testing teams; instead, we believe in building intelligent, automated infrastructure and AI-driven developer tooling that make high-quality delivery the default.

Why Join Us?

In this role, you will have the unique opportunity to solve complex challenges at a massive scale, directly impacting the velocity of our engineering teams and the stability of global banks. We want engineers to be at the forefront of transforming our testing platforms from an internal utility into a powerful commercial asset. By providing total transparency into how we test, deepening our collaboration with clients, and exposing these capabilities externally via managed offerings like "Testing as a Service" (TaaS), you will fundamentally shift how the industry perceives software quality.

You will work at the cutting edge of infrastructure and AI, honing your skills in building agentic tooling, advanced observability pipelines, and cloud-native platforms. This is a chance to elevate your career by architecting platforms that developers love and clients trust, all while shaping the engineering culture of a hyper-growth tech company.

You will partner closely with engineering leadership, product management, and developer platform teams to design, architect, and implement industry-leading testing infrastructure. You will act as a technical leader championing testability, observability, and engineering best practices across the entire development lifecycle for all of our products.

The Mentality We Are Looking For

We value engineers who combine rigorous technical craft with ownership, continuous learning, and a relentless focus on high-quality delivery.

  • "Toil is a Defect" Mindset: You view manual testing and complex debugging not as a necessity, but as a platform defect to be automated away using intelligent tooling and AI.

  • Guardrails, Not Gates: You believe in empowering developers with speed and observability, using quantitative metrics and automated telemetry to inform risk-based decisions rather than relying on bureaucratic red tape.

  • Technical Ownership & Excellence: You take pride in end-to-end delivery, from architectural design and coding to automated testing, performance optimization, and operational monitoring.

  • Collaborative Technical Leadership: You enjoy partnering with software engineers, product managers, and client-facing teams to elevate testing standards and foster a transparent culture of quality.

Duties

  • Enablement & AI Tooling: Design, build, research, evaluate and adopt advanced engineering tools, including leveraging Agentic AI for the automated triage of performance test failures, automated test-code generation, and eliminating developer toil.

  • Governance & Observability: Develop and integrate quantitative product reliability metrics for test coverage, execution speed and defect prevention, into CI/CD pipelines. Build telemetry and infrastructure for advanced testing paradigms, including deterministic fault injection to catch concurrency and race conditions.

  • Drive Quality Engineering Initiatives: Partner with engineering teams to conduct risk analyses, implement integration and performance testing strategies, and resolve complex edge-case defects.

  • Backend Engineering Delivery: Develop high-quality, testable, and robust backend services, APIs, and microservices in alignment with architecture standards.

  • Technical Mentorship: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers in test automation patterns, backend engineering design, unit/integration testing strategies, and code hygiene.

Requirements

  • Extensive hands-on experience in backend software development using modern languages (e.g., Go, Python) and cloud-native architecture.

  • Proven track record of designing and implementing scalable backend platforms, with deep expertise in CI/CD integration, containerisation, and orchestration (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Deep understanding of complex distributed systems, API protocols (REST/gRPC), and observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, BigQuery).

  • Familiarity with leveraging modern AI-assisted tools and building agentic workflows for code generation, log analysis, and automated triage.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to advocate for quality initiatives and influence cross-functional technical teams.

If you are passionate about building robust backend infrastructure, advancing quality engineering architecture, and leading software excellence, we want to hear from you.

Benefits

  • Highly competitive salary

  • Pension plan (match up to 5%)

  • Life insurance - three times annual salary

  • Competitive maternity (six months fully paid) and paternity leave (four weeks fully paid)

  • Shared parental leave (matched to our maternity leave for the same point in time)

  • Sports and hobby clubs, subsidised by Thought Machine

title: Senior Underwriting Analyst, Quality Control
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Role purpose

The Senior Analyst, Underwriting Quality Control (QC) will establish and continually improve a consistent, risk-based quality control framework for work completed by Underwriters. The role will build on existing QC practices and tools, tailoring them to the Underwriting lifecycle, products, risk decisions and operating model.

The role provides an objective, evidence-led check that underwriting assessments and outcomes are complete, consistent, appropriately documented and aligned with internal policy, procedures and applicable requirements. It will turn review results into clear management information, actionable feedback, targeted training and measurable improvements in underwriting quality.

This is a hands-on role. The Senior Analyst will conduct QC reviews, maintain the framework and reporting, follow findings through to verified remediation, and work with Underwriters and leaders to address recurring gaps. The role reports to the Director of Underwriting and influences quality across the function without replacing the Underwriter’s decision-making accountability.

Key responsibilities

Build and own the QC framework

  • Assess existing QC materials, controls, data and workflows; identify what should be retained, improved or introduced for Underwriting.

  • Design, document and implement an Underwriting-specific QC framework, including scope, risk-based sampling, review cadence, test scripts, scoring and severity definitions, evidence standards, escalation routes, dispute handling, calibration and remediation expectations.

  • Tailor testing to the relevant underwriting stages, products, merchant and business models, risk tiers and applicable regional requirements.

  • Define practical service levels and ownership for review, feedback, acknowledgement, remediation, re-review and closure, agreeing these with Underwriting leadership.

  • Establish appropriate governance and records so that QC decisions and remediation are traceable and ready for internal or external review.

Perform and calibrate QC reviews

  • Review completed underwriting cases and test whether the case record is complete, and appropriately documented. Depending on case scope, this may include business model products, services and geographies; ownership, control and beneficial ownership; company and identity evidence; KYC/KYB and screening outcomes; licences and regulatory status; financial and operational evidence and accurate system records.

  • Identify missing, inconsistent, stale or insufficient evidence, and opportunities to improve decision quality.

Drive remediation and constructive challenge

  • Communicate findings promptly, clearly and fairly to the relevant Underwriter and manager, with evidence and an actionable explanation of what needs to change.

  • Track acknowledgement, corrective action and deadlines; proactively chase overdue responses and escalate unresolved or repeat issues.

  • Work with Underwriters and leaders to understand root causes and ensure remediation addresses the underlying issue, not only the individual case.

Reporting, insight and continuous improvement

  • Produce regular, accurate QC reporting for Underwriting leadership, with clear commentary on coverage, pass and defect rates, severity, recurring themes, remediation status, turnaround and trends by relevant team, workflow, product or risk segment.

  • Support internal audit, Compliance, Risk and other assurance requests by providing accurate QC records and explaining methodology and outcomes.

Build underwriting capability

  • Identify capability gaps from QC findings and partner with Underwriting leaders and relevant subject-matter experts to design and deliver focused training, coaching and practical guidance.

What Success Looks Like

The ideal candidate is a rigorous and constructive quality professional who can build a practical control framework, apply it consistently and influence experienced Underwriters. They combine sound KYC/KYB judgement with strong analytical and reporting skills, confidence in following through on remediation, and the ability to turn case-level observations into improvements across a regional operation.

Essential

  • Significant experience in underwriting, merchant due diligence, AML/KYC/KYB, onboarding, financial crime operations, quality control, quality assurance or a related risk function within financial services, payments or fintech.

  • Practical understanding of UK and EEA due diligence requirements, with familiarity across the US, Canada, Singapore, Hong Kong, UAE, Australia and New Zealand; ability to recognise jurisdictional differences and escalate interpretation questions appropriately.

  • Demonstrated ability to design, implement or materially improve a QC, QA, control testing or file review framework.

  • Strong reporting and data skills, including spreadsheets, pivot tables and clear management reporting; experience with Looker dashboard or business intelligence tools is an advantage. Use of AI is a plus.

  • Effective stakeholder management and influencing skills, including the persistence to chase remediation and escalate overdue or repeat issues appropriately.

  • Experience delivering training or coaching based on quality control findings.

Nice to Have

  • Direct exposure to underwriting or due diligence in a merchant acquiring setting.

  • Familiarity with case management and CRM tools,dashboard platforms.

  • A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience; recognised AML, financial crime or compliance qualifications (for example ACAMS or ICA) are beneficial but not mandatory.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Signal Processing Engineer (Radio)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role
As Signal Processing Engineer, you own the algorithmic core of our drone-to-ground radio link — the system that keeps drones connected, controllable, and streaming in contested environments. You design the waveform, the anti-jam logic, and the signal intelligence that turn radio waves into a reliable link under hostile conditions, working hand-in-hand with RF hardware, FPGA, and software engineers to bring your algorithms from theory to flight.

Responsibilities

  • Waveform Design: Design modulation, coding, and equalization schemes for a robust, low-latency radio link.

  • Anti-Jamming (ECCM): Build algorithms that keep the radio link alive under active jamming.

  • Signal Intelligence (SIGINT): Detect and characterize other radio emitters in the operating environment.

  • Mesh Networking: Optimize protocols so multiple radio units share the airwaves without collision.

  • AI-Assisted Processing: Apply machine learning to jamming detection and channel prediction where it improves field robustness.

  • Field Validation: Take algorithms from simulation to lab bench to real flight test.

  • Radio System Integration: Work daily with RF hardware and FPGA engineers to bring designs into a fielded radio.

Candidate Requirements

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

title: Software Engineer (80-100%)
descriptionHtml:
Worum geht es?

Wenn in der Schweiz eine Feuerwehr alarmiert wird, läuft die Meldung mit hoher Wahrscheinlichkeit über unsere Systeme. Rund 400 Feuerwehren in 16 Kantonen arbeiten mit unseren Lösungen, von der Alarmierung über die Einsatzführung bis zur Einsatzplanung.

Das heisst: Unsere Software muss funktionieren, auch nachts um 3 Uhr. Diese Verantwortung prägt, wie wir entwickeln.

Wir suchen dich als Software Engineer, der unsere Plattform mitträgt. Nicht als weitere Person im Team, sondern als eine tragende Säule in unserem Team.

Über uns

Die EvoSys AG wurde 2011 gegründet und entwickelt seit 2016 eigene Software für Behörden und Organisationen für Rettung und Sicherheit (BORS). Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen in Thun mit 9 Mitarbeitenden und in unserem Markt führend.

Unsere Produkte heissen AlarmHub, Intervento, FloriPlan, AlarmDisplay und SpotPilot. Sie decken den ganzen Ablauf ab, von der Alarmierung bis zur Auswertung nach dem Einsatz. 2028 kommt mit Respondo eine weitere Lösung dazu.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst unsere bestehenden Plattformen weiter und setzt neue Funktionen von der Idee bis in den Betrieb um.

  • Du prägst unsere Architektur mit. Unsere Kundenbasis wächst stark, und unsere Systeme müssen mitwachsen. Konkret bereiten wir den Schritt auf Kubernetes vor und bauen Dienste so um, dass sie zuverlässig skalieren.

  • Du arbeitest an Schnittstellen zu Einsatzzentralen, Partnersystemen und Behördenplattformen.

  • Du setzt KI-gestützte Werkzeuge im Entwicklungsalltag ein, so wie wir alle.

  • Du nimmst an Code Reviews teil und trägst zu Qualität und Dokumentation bei.

  • Du unterstützt bei anspruchsvollen technischen Fragen aus dem Betrieb.

Perspektive

Mit der Zeit kannst du die fachliche Verantwortung für einen Produktbereich übernehmen. Und wenn es für beide Seiten passt, ist längerfristig auch eine technische Führungsrolle denkbar. Solche Rollen besetzen wir aus dem Team heraus. Voraussetzung für diese Stelle ist das aber ausdrücklich nicht.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Rund 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung von Webanwendungen. Die ersten Jahre hast du hinter dir und arbeitest selbständig, ohne enge Begleitung.

  • Erfahrung mit Node.js und Vue.js, dazu Berührungspunkte mit PostgreSQL, Docker, Linux und Git.

  • Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge selbstverständlich und kannst beurteilen, wann du ihrem Ergebnis trauen kannst und wann nicht.

  • Verständnis dafür, was im Produktivsystem passiert, wenn dein Code dort ankommt.

  • Lust, Verantwortung für ein Thema zu übernehmen, statt nur Tickets abzuarbeiten.

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, gutes Englischverständnis.

  • Interesse am Blaulichtumfeld. Eigene Erfahrung in einer Feuerwehr oder im Zivilschutz ist ein Plus, aber keine Bedingung.

Unser Technologiestack

  • Node.js, TypeScript, Vue.js

  • PostgreSQL und Redis

  • Docker - auf dem Weg zu Kubernetes

  • Linux, Git, CI/CD-Pipelines

  • REST-APIs und Schnittstellen zu Drittsystemen

  • KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Kurze Wege. Ein Standort, direkter Draht zur Geschäftsleitung. Entscheide fallen am selben Tag, nicht im nächsten Gremium.

  • Sichtbare Wirkung. Was du baust, ist innert Wochen bei Feuerwehren im Einsatz. Du bekommst Rückmeldungen von Menschen, die damit arbeiten.

  • Weiterbildung, die wir ernst meinen. Wir unterstützen berufsbegleitende Studiengänge.

  • 5 Wochen Ferien, bei Teilzeit anteilig.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein modern ausgestatteter Arbeitsplatz.

  • Mitgestaltung. Technologieentscheide treffen wir gemeinsam, nicht von oben herab.

  • Thun. Arbeiten zwischen See und Bergen, 10 Minuten vom Bahnhof, 20 Minuten von Bern.

Ein Hinweis mit Ehrlichkeit

Wir arbeiten überwiegend vor Ort. Einzelne Homeoffice-Tage sind möglich, reine Remote-Arbeit passt nicht zu uns. Die kurzen Abstimmungswege in der Entwicklung gehören zu unserer DNA.

Vergütung

Der Lohn für diese Stelle liegt bei CHF 68'000-80'000 pro Jahr bei einem Pensum von 100%.

So läuft die Bewerbung ab

  1. Bewerbung über die Plattform. Lebenslauf genügt, ein Motivationsschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Links zu Projekten oder Repositories schauen wir uns gerne an.

  2. Kurzes Kennenlernen, rund 30 Minuten per Video oder Telefon.

  3. Gespräch in Thun mit dem CTO und dem Entwicklungsteam, inkl. Blick in unsere Codebasis.

  4. Fachlicher Austausch anhand einer kleinen, realistischen Aufgabe. Kein Whiteboard-Rätsel, sondern etwas aus unserem Alltag.

  5. Entscheid spätestens 7 Tage nach dem letzten Gespräch.

Wir melden uns auf jede Bewerbung zurück, auch bei einer Absage.
