title: Software Engineer (Frontend) - London
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Teton is redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology and a great product experience. As populations get older and staff shortages grow, healthcare systems are under pressure. Our mission is to decrease the cost of healthcare while improving the quality of care.

Our product enables care teams to intervene, prevent and operate more efficiently. Our ambient sensors in resident rooms capture activity, sleep, respiration, gait and more. These signals are used both to react fast to risk events, like falls, and for long-term health analysis that care teams can act on.

Teton is scaling fast, operating in the Nordics, UK, DACH and US. We recently raised a $20M Series A. Expect travel to the US to meet users and team members.

We focus relentlessly on product excellence and user experience, deploying solutions at speed that make a tangible difference for carers. We are an aspiring meritocracy biased towards action, always striving to raise the bar. If you are driven by impact, speed and leveling up, this might be the place for you.

If you are looking for a 9-17 job, perform best with structure and struggle dealing with unknowns, this is not for you. We believe close collaboration between a hard-working, high-agency team enables the fastest and most efficient iteration cycles, helping us build an impactful product that healthcare professionals truly love to use.

The Job

We're looking for an experienced Frontend Engineer to own customer-facing features from the first conversation with a care team to the feature running in production. Care workers rely on our product during every shift and care managers use it to follow up on their residents, on mobile and on the web. This isn't a ticket-taking role. You'll talk to users, cut scope, build the features, and check afterwards whether what you shipped actually made a shift easier. Alongside that, you'll help own the quality of how we build: the tests, pipelines and guardrails that let us ship fast without breaking what care teams depend on.

In this role, you will focus on:

  • Feature Development: Own features end-to-end, from design discussions through implementation to production rollout across multiple markets and languages, on the web app, the mobile app and the APIs behind them.

  • Customer Insight: Talk to care staff and our customer success team every week, visit care facilities, and turn what you hear into clearly scoped product changes. Come with ideas, sketch the solution, and push it forward.

  • Code Quality & Guardrails: Help own code quality across the frontend. Improve our CI/CD pipelines and automated tests, keep the infrastructure scalable, and build the guardrails that let AI coding agents contribute safely.

  • Backend & APIs: Work with the APIs, data models and services your features need. You will not just consume APIs, you will help shape, improve and fix the systems behind them.

  • Quality, Privacy & Safety: Ship with care for health data: sensible access control, auditability and privacy by default. Use staged rollouts so new features never get in the way of the alerts care teams depend on.

Qualifications

  • Several years of experience building production web applications.

  • Strong TypeScript skills: this is the language for everything we build.

  • Solid production experience with React on the web and/or React Native.

  • Experience with CI/CD and automated testing, and a strong sense of what good code quality looks like.

  • Great product taste and a keen eye for UX. You work well with designers and can make sensible design decisions yourself when needed.

  • Comfortable talking directly with non-technical users and turning messy feedback into concrete decisions.

  • Previous startup experience and/or shipping a product where you owned the outcome, from idea to adoption.X

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and in a team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with React Native and Expo in production.

  • Experience working with AI coding agents in a real codebase.

  • AWS or equivalent cloud platform experience.

  • Familiarity with TanStack, real-time systems or push notifications.

  • Experience with health data or other regulated, privacy-sensitive domains (e.g. GDPR).

What We Offer

title: Software Engineer, Guardian
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Guardian team builds practical safety and oversight systems for increasingly capable AI agents. Our goal is to make it possible for agents to take on longer-running, higher-autonomy work while preserving meaningful safeguards, respecting user intent, and intervening when actions could cause serious or difficult-to-reverse harm.

Auto-review is an early example of this work. When an agent reaches a permission boundary, a separate model evaluates the proposed action in context and determines whether it should proceed. The team is now extending this foundation into more capable oversight systems that account for richer user context, support a broader range of agent experiences, and integrate across OpenAI products.

Guardian sits at the intersection of engineering, alignment research, product, infrastructure, and security. The team already has a strong engineering foundation in London and will continue to grow there as a concentrated, highly collaborative group.

About the Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Guardian team in London. You will design and build production systems that evaluate agent behavior, identify risk, and take appropriate action without creating unnecessary friction for users.

This is a hands-on engineering role with substantial technical depth and ownership. You will work across architecture, implementation, evaluation, and operations, taking projects from early exploration through production deployment. The work requires strong engineering fundamentals, sound product judgment, and comfort solving problems where both the requirements and the underlying technology are evolving.

You will work closely with alignment researchers to translate emerging research into dependable systems, and with product and engineering teams to make agent safety a foundational capability across OpenAI.

This role is based in our London office.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and operate core components of Auto-review and the broader Guardian platform, balancing safety, product utility, latency, and operational reliability.

  • Build production systems that evaluate agent actions in real time, detect potentially harmful behavior, and support safe recovery or escalation paths.

  • Improve how oversight systems understand user intent, environmental context, permissions, and relevant personalization signals while protecting privacy and avoiding unnecessary friction.

  • Partner closely with alignment researchers to turn prototypes, evaluations, and new monitoring techniques into scalable product capabilities.

  • Work across Product, Security, Infrastructure, and other engineering teams to integrate Guardian capabilities into agent experiences throughout OpenAI.

  • Develop evaluations, adversarial tests, and monitoring to understand safety performance, false positives, latency, and user impact.

  • Own projects end to end, contribute to technical direction and design reviews, and investigate failures to improve system behavior and reliability.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have experience building and shipping complex production software, with ownership across design, implementation, deployment, and operation.

  • Have built with AI agents or large language models in a core product, startup, or technically serious independent project, and understand the unique challenges of agentic systems.

  • Bring strong software engineering fundamentals and can design reliable backend services, APIs, and infrastructure.

  • Exercise sound product-engineering judgment and can navigate tradeoffs across safety, usability, speed, and reliability.

  • Enjoy working closely with researchers, translating open-ended ideas into practical systems, and using experiments and evaluations to guide decisions.

  • Are comfortable with ambiguity, take initiative, and communicate clearly across technical disciplines.

  • Care deeply about building AI systems that are useful, trustworthy, and safe.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Software Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
Bouw aan de software van morgen. Ontwikkel de engineers die het mogelijk maken.

Van medische apparatuur en industriële automatisering tot semicon-oplossingen: achter ieder succesvol high-tech product schuilt sterke software. Ben jij de leider die softwareteams helpt excelleren, nieuwe technologieën zoals AI omarmt en tegelijkertijd bouwt aan de engineers van morgen? Dan komen we graag met je in contact.

Bij ons speel je een sleutelrol in de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Software Engineering-organisatie. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei, kwaliteit en prestaties van een team van circa 45 (embedded) softwareprofessionals en zorgt ervoor dat zij de juiste omgeving, richting en ondersteuning krijgen om complexe technologische uitdagingen succesvol aan te gaan.

Je beweegt je op het snijvlak van technologie, leiderschap en organisatieontwikkeling. Daarbij richt jij je niet alleen op de resultaten van vandaag, maar bouw je ook aan de softwareorganisatie van morgen. Je creëert een omgeving waarin vakmanschap, kennisdeling, innovatie en continue verbetering centraal staan. Daarnaast volg je technologische ontwikkelingen op de voet en stimuleer je de inzet van moderne technologieën om softwareontwikkeling slimmer, sneller en effectiever te maken.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je geeft leiding aan een team van ongeveer 45 embedded software engineers en ondersteunt hen in hun professionele en persoonlijke groei.

  • Je geeft richting aan AI-gedreven transformatie binnen het softwareteam én de bredere organisatie, en neemt je team en collega’s mee in nieuwe manieren van werken.

  • Je stimuleert een cultuur van technische excellentie, eigenaarschap en samenwerking.

  • Je zorgt voor de juiste balans tussen projectresultaten, de ontwikkeling van je team en langetermijndoelstellingen.

  • Je werkt samen met architecten, technical leads en projectteams aan de verdere professionalisering van softwareontwikkeling binnen Benchmark.

  • Je bewaakt de benodigde capaciteit, competenties en inzetbaarheid van de afdeling.

  • Je speelt een actieve rol in het aantrekken, ontwikkelen en behouden van softwaretalent.

  • Je versterkt de samenwerking met internationale engineeringteams binnen Benchmark.

  • Je vertegenwoordigt Software Engineering binnen het Competence Management Team en levert een actieve bijdrage aan organisatiebrede besluitvorming.

  • Je stimuleert het gebruik van moderne ontwikkelmethodieken en tooling om kwaliteit, productiviteit en innovatie te versterken.

  • Je vertaalt technologische ontwikkelingen naar concrete verbeteringen in processen, werkwijzen en engineering excellence.

Samen met de managers van Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering en Test Development Engineering werk je aan een toekomstbestendige engineeringorganisatie. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om samenwerking tussen disciplines te versterken en technologische ontwikkelingen succesvol naar de praktijk te vertalen.

Waarom deze functie?

Deze rol biedt een unieke combinatie van people leadership, technologie en strategische impact. Je krijgt de ruimte om onze softwareorganisatie verder vorm te geven, talent te ontwikkelen en invloed uit te oefenen op de manier waarop complexe high-tech producten worden ontworpen en ontwikkeld. Tegelijkertijd krijg je de mogelijkheid om de toepassing van nieuwe technologieën, waaronder AI, binnen de organisatie verder te verkennen en te helpen verankeren.

Wat biedt Benchmark?

Bij Benchmark werk je aan producten die ertoe doen! Daarnaast zijn wij bij uitstek een organisatie waar je vrijheid krijgt, waar ondernemerschap wordt beloond en waarin je de ruimte krijgt om je ideeën tot uitvoering te brengen. We bieden je een dynamische omgeving met de ruimte om snel stappen te maken, door te groeien en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Je bent onderdeel van een wereldwijd bedrijf waar de nuchtere Twentse cultuur bewaard is gebleven.

Bij ons krijg je uitdagend werk, veel vertrouwen en ruimte om jezelf te blijven

ontwikkelen. Je werkt met nuchtere collega’s in een informele cultuur, met goede

voorwaarden om duurzaam te presteren.

Daarnaast bieden wij:

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris

  • Een bonusregeling gekoppeld aan de prestaties van jouw team en de organisatie.

  • Een managementcontract met veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap, eigen verantwoordelijkheid en impact op de verdere ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

  • Persoonlijke groei en ontwikkeling, waarbij we samen een ontwikkelpad creëren dat aansluit op jouw ambities en de behoeften van de organisatie.

  • Flexibiliteit in de inrichting van je werkweek, met ruimte om werk en privé op een manier te combineren die voor jou werkt.

  • Een sterk kennisgedreven engineeringklimaat, waarin samenwerking, kennisdeling en innovatie centraal staan. Via initiatieven zoals Lunch & Learn-sessies en Pitch Discovery Sessions krijg je volop ruimte om te leren, te inspireren en nieuwe ideeën te ontwikkelen.

Wie ben jij?

Of je nu een ervaren engineering manager bent of toe bent aan je eerste grotere leiderschapsrol, jij krijgt energie van technologie én het ontwikkelen van mensen. Je weet professionals te verbinden, richting te geven en samen resultaten te behalen in een complexe high-tech omgeving. Met jouw technische achtergrond, nieuwsgierigheid en leiderschapspotentieel bouw je mee aan de volgende generatie engineers én innovaties. Herken jij jezelf hierin? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in embedded software, elektrotechniek, natuurkunde of een vergelijkbare technische richting.

  • Je hebt een stevige achtergrond in embedded systems en voldoende technische diepgang om met engineers en architecten te sparren over technische keuzes en ontwikkelrichtingen.

  • Minimaal zeven jaar ervaring binnen een hightech-ontwikkelomgeving, inclusief enkele jaren in een leidinggevende rol of een technische leiderschapsrol.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van engineeringteams binnen een complexe technische organisatie.

  • Het vermogen om technische visie, organisatiedoelstellingen en talentontwikkeling succesvol met elkaar te verbinden.

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en een goede beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal.

Serious Tech
Bij Benchmark werk je voor bedrijven die impact maken met hun innovaties. Zo ontwikkelen we nieuwe producten die de veiligheid of gezondheid verbeteren of juist het gemak vergroten. Deze producten worden geleverd vanaf het productontwerp tot en met volumeproductie en soms ook rechtstreeks aan de eindgebruiker. Dit gehele proces wordt geheel in Almelo uitgevoerd, waar we samenwerken met ongeveer 650 collega’s

We werken aan innovaties voor, onder andere, semicon, gezondheidszorg, aerospace en industrie. Van productontwerp tot volumeproductie: het hele proces komt hier samen. Technisch ligt de lat hoog, maar de cultuur blijft nuchter en dichtbij. Je werkt met mensen die verantwoordelijkheid nemen, elkaar helpen en samen willen blijven verbeteren.

Seriously you?

We zoeken mensen die energie krijgen van complexe technologie en niet terugdeinzen voor een stevige uitdaging. Mensen die verantwoordelijkheid pakken, ideeën delen en samen willen blijven verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf daarin? Dan praten we graag verder.

title: Solution Engineer
descriptionHtml:
À propos de Dastra

Dastra est une plateforme SaaS dédiée à la protection des données, à la conformité et à la gouvernance de l'IA.

Nous accompagnons des organisations de toutes tailles dans la structuration et le pilotage de leurs enjeux de conformité, avec une ambition : rendre des sujets complexes plus simples, accessibles et opérationnels.

Dans un contexte de croissance et de développement à l'international, nous renforçons notre organisation commerciale et recrutons notre PreSales Engineer pour accompagner nos opportunités stratégiques.

Ton rôle chez Dastra

À la croisée du business, de la technologie et du conseil, tu joueras un rôle clé dans nos cycles de vente complexes.

Ta mission : apporter la crédibilité et les preuves techniques qui feront de Dastra la solution de référence pour nos futurs clients.

En véritable partenaire de nos équipes Sales, tu interviendras sur les opportunités stratégiques pour comprendre les enjeux techniques des prospects, démontrer la pertinence de notre plateforme et sécuriser leur décision.

Tes missions

  • Contribuer activement aux appels d'offres (RFP) : participer à l'élaboration des réponses fonctionnelles, à la définition des plans de déploiement et à la préparation des démonstrations, jusqu'aux soutenances auprès des clients.

  • Assurer la continuité entre avant-vente et déploiement : collaborer avec les équipes Sales, Produit, Customer Success et Professional Services pour cadrer les besoins et garantir une transmission technique structurée après signature.

Tu contribueras également à l'amélioration continue de nos pratiques avant-vente, de nos démonstrations et de notre documentation technique.

Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Tu disposes d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience en avant-vente technique, idéalement en tant que PreSales Engineer, Sales Engineer ou Solution Consultant, dans un environnement SaaS B2B.

  • Tu as l'habitude d'accompagner des cycles de vente complexes auprès de grands comptes, avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques exigeants.

  • Tu combines expertise technique, sens commercial et excellente communication : tu sais vulgariser des sujets complexes, convaincre et adapter ton discours à tes interlocuteurs.

  • Tu fais preuve d'agilité intellectuelle, de pédagogie, de pragmatisme et de sang-froid, y compris lors de démonstrations en direct.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Un rôle stratégique : intervenir directement sur les opportunités à fort potentiel et contribuer à la croissance de Dastra.

title: Solutions Architect, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Exa

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike. We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

About the Role

Solutions Architects are the technical tip of the spear in Exa's presales motion. From the first call to the technical win, you're the person who shows prospects what Exa can do and proves it works for their use case. You partner with Account Executives on new accounts and new opportunities, and you're measured on technical wins, POC conversion, and pipeline velocity. You'll cover accounts across EMEA from our London office.

You'll run discovery with engineers and executives, build demos that land, design and run workshops and proofs of concept, and make the technical case for Exa against alternatives. When a deal needs specialist depth, you pull in our Forward Deployed Engineers. When a deal closes, you hand the customer off to them with everything they need to get to production fast. This is not a demo-only role. You are an engineer who sells.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead the technical side of new opportunities alongside Account Executives, from first call through technical win

  • Run discovery to understand a prospect's use case, architecture, data needs, and success criteria, and qualify where Exa fits

  • Build and deliver tailored demos, sample apps, and prototypes that show what Exa can do on the prospect's own problem

  • Design and run workshops and POCs with clear success criteria, timelines, and evaluation plans, then drive them to a decision

  • Win technical evaluations by benchmarking Exa on quality, latency, and cost, and making a clear case against alternatives

  • Handle technical objections and answer security, compliance, and architecture questions

  • Bring in Forward Deployed Engineers as specialists when a deal needs deeper expertise, and run a clean handoff to them after close

  • Feed market signal back to Product: what prospects ask for, where we lose, and what would help us win

  • Build reusable pre-sales assets such as demo environments, reference architectures, and evaluation playbooks

Requirements

  • Several years of hands-on programming experience. You can build compelling demos, implement POCs end to end, and design and run rigorous evals in head-to-head competitive scenarios

  • 2+ years of hands-on presales or technical sales experience, ideally at an AI-native or developer-first company. You've owned the technical side of deals, run discovery and demos with technical buyers, and helped carry opportunities to close

  • Strong communication skills: you can adapt your pitch to CTOs, engineers, and PMs alike, and explain complex technology simply

  • Track record of high performance in demanding environments, whether that's a top CS program, a competitive sport, a startup, or something else entirely

  • High tolerance for context-switching, ambiguity, and sustained intensity

  • Willingness to travel as needed for customer meetings and workshops

You might excel if you...

  • Have worked as a solutions architect, solutions engineer, or sales engineer at a developer-tools, API, or AI company

  • Have built with LLMs, RAG, or agents and can talk credibly about retrieval and search quality

  • Have helped close revenue or driven commercial outcomes at a previous company

  • Thrive in early-stage environments where your job description changes monthly

  • Love the moment a prospect sees a demo and gets it

  • Care deeply about the problem of organizing the world's knowledge and making it accessible to machines

This is an in-person opportunity in London.

About the Role

Decagon is seeking a Solutions Architect – Voice, a technical hire who will define how enterprises deploy Decagon's AI agents into live voice and contact center environments. This role sits at the intersection of pre-sales engineering, telephony architecture, and enterprise contact center strategy. You will act as a trusted advisor to enterprise prospects and customers, guiding them through complex, ambiguous voice deployment conversations—from SIP trunking and call routing to media handling and real-time transcription—ensuring Decagon integrates seamlessly into their existing contact center platforms while meeting latency, reliability, and compliance requirements.

As an early hire in this function, you will define best practices for voice deployment solutioning, partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering, and set the standard for how Decagon engages with enterprises running mission-critical contact center operations. You will establish technical credibility with stakeholders across the C-suite, telephony and network teams, contact center operations, and CX leadership.

In this role, you will

  • Partner with Account Executives to discover, qualify, and design voice deployment solutions that address customer telephony constraints and deliver measurable containment and CX outcomes.

  • Navigate ambiguous conversations about a customer's contact center landscape, translating diverse environments (Genesys Cloud CX & Engage, Amazon Connect, Cisco UCCE/CVP, Google CCAI) into clear integration and deployment strategies for Decagon's voice platform.

  • Design SIP integration approaches—BYOC trunking, REFER-based transfer, header propagation, and media/streaming paths (Websockets, Audio Connector, External Voice Transfer)—tailored to each customer's topology and security posture.

  • Diagnose complex, multi-leg call flows down to the packet level, and establish repeatable methods for tracing and resolving SIP and media issues in production.

  • Establish scalable pre-sales processes, deployment playbooks, and reusable reference architectures to support growth.

Your background looks something like this

  • 8–10+ years in customer-facing technical roles (Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Product Manager) with a focus on voice, telephony, or contact center platforms.

  • Deep fluency in enterprise contact center platforms—Genesys, Amazon Connect, Cisco, or Google CCAI—and the SIP/telephony fundamentals underneath them (trunking, transfer semantics, codecs, SRTP, DTMF).

  • Hands-on experience with CPaaS infrastructure such as Twilio or Telnyx, including BYOC configuration and programmable voice.

  • Demonstrated success navigating ambiguous technical conversations with enterprise customers, asking the right discovery questions, and collaborating through uncertainty.

  • Strong ability to engage diverse stakeholders—from network engineers to CX and contact center leaders—and translate voice requirements into actionable deployment strategies.

Even better if you have

  • 2+ years selling or architecting AI/ML or conversational voice solutions in enterprise environments.

  • Experience in a high-growth startup where you built pre-sales practices from the ground up.

  • Hands-on packet-level SIP diagnostics experience (pcap analysis, Wireshark/Scapy) and comfort reading raw signaling.

  • Familiarity with real-time speech stacks (STT/TTS), call recording and compliance patterns (SIPREC), and multi-leg call correlation.

These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.

descriptionHtml:
Studley Castle now has an opening for a Spa Manager to join their spa team.

Step into a reinvented castle that blends Victorian splendour with a modern heartbeat, close to Shakespeare’s birthplace in the heart of rural Warwickshire.

The Stables Spa at Studley Castle, a Warwickshire spa retreat designed for moments of calm, connection and relaxation. Salary: £30,000 up to £32,000 per year, plus a range of great benefits and development opportunities.

Working closely with the hotel leadership team and wider departments, you’ll ensure everything runs smoothly, from team performance and guest experience to standards and commercial success. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys responsibility, thrives in a guest-focused environment, and is passionate about health, wellbeing, and hospitality.

The benefits of working with us:

  • Free use of gym and leisure facilities

Role Responsibilities:

  • Oversee day-to-day spa operations, including facilities, treatments and team performance

  • Deliver a safe, clean and relaxing environment aligned with Warner Hotels’ brand

  • Drive revenue growth while maintaining strong operational standards

  • Work closely with hotel leadership to support team development and guest experience

  • Deliver seasonal campaigns, wellness initiatives and premium spa experiences

  • Drive revenue through treatments, retail and promotions

A 19TH CENTURY CASTLE HOTEL WITH A 21ST CENTURY OUTLOOK

title: Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité (Télétravail complet possible - Loudéac)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherche à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et cabinet à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.

- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

Compétences requises

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul.e et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

🤝 Process de recrutement

● Une première rencontre avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)

● Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec un(e) Associate Team Lead (1h)

● Un entretien final avec un(e) Team Lead (45 min)

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

The product portfolio mainly consists of confocal laser scanning microscopes, spinning disk and TIRF microscopes, slide scanners and SMLM systems.

You are responsible for achieving the agreed sales target for your products and territory as well as a team target. title: Staff Fraud Strategy Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design.

Partner Excellence Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls.

  • Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it?

  • A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training?

  • Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Staff Fraud Strategy Analyst at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove which fixes worked. In a year, the squad can prove every handover in the network.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned fraud, risk or trust decisions end to end: turned investigations into rules, standards or interventions, and owned their number, such as the false positive rate you were held to, rather than building the model.

  • Have run investigations in fraud, risk, financial crime or trust and safety, and decided whether a signal was real or noise.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Have worked somewhere with enough volume for a false positive rate to mean something, where your rules ran live and something happened when they were wrong.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

QA sits inside Platform, a central team that builds the tooling and standards the rest of engineering runs on. You'll design the frameworks and practices that let them test well themselves, and scale into the future. As we scale, you'll lead and develop scripts that equip engineering teams with the automation and standards to own quality themselves.

The product is built on a microservice architecture that brings real complexity to testing. You'll own the quality engineering approach as the organisation scales — setting the standards, building the tooling, and driving adoption across engineering.

What you'll work on:

  • A risk-aware CI testing standard any team can run: a dependency model that drives test selection and breaking-change detection, so most PRs get a fast targeted run with a clear confidence signal at the point of change.

  • Unit, integration, and contract testing standards with an observability layer that keeps pipelines honest and not flaky. Proven through reference test suites in real service repos, not a QA-authored checklist.

  • The quality side of canary releases: working with the wider Platform team to define automated pass/fail analysis against production traffic so deployments promote or roll back without manual sign-off.

  • AI in the quality pipeline: LLM-based change-risk classification, targeted mutation testing, test generation, and self-healing checks. We already use LLM tooling across QA and want someone to take it further.

You report to Bartek Kucharski (QA). Specialist individual contributor, no direct reports.

Requirements

  • Deep knowledge of testing across microservice or distributed systems, including API-level automation, CI/CD integration, and service-level testing strategies.

Nice to have:

  • Mutation testing, whether traditional tooling or LLM-based.

title: Staff Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Build security platforms, not security processes

We are looking for a Staff Security Engineer to strengthen the security of our products, data and engineering platform.

This is a highly technical and hands-on role. You will work closely with Engineering teams to continuously harden our systems while helping design the next generation of our security architecture.

You will operate across two horizons:

  • Strengthen security today: continuously harden our applications, access controls and data-protection mechanisms against evolving threats.

  • Build the privacy architecture of tomorrow: move beyond traditional perimeter and access-control security by designing systems where sensitive data is cryptographically isolated, minimally exposed, and increasingly usable without being directly revealed.

The ultimate objective is not simply to make Swile harder to breach. It is to make a breach increasingly uninteresting, because there is less usable data available to steal.


What you will do

We want Security Engineering to create capabilities that scale across hundreds of engineers.

You will:

  • Identify and reduce high-impact security risks across our applications, APIs and internal tools.

  • Strengthen authentication, authorization and access controls.

  • Improve the protection of sensitive and personal data.

  • Design controls that limit the blast radius of compromised accounts, services or infrastructure.

  • Improve security monitoring, auditability and detection of suspicious access patterns.

  • Perform threat modelling and targeted security reviews.

  • Build reusable security capabilities directly into our engineering platform and development lifecycle.

  • Contribute to long-term architectures around data isolation, encryption, tokenisation and privacy-preserving systems.

  • Partner with engineering teams to address systemic security risks rather than individual findings.

    • Where possible, a security requirement should become code rather than documentation.


What we are looking for

You are first and foremost a strong engineer.

You have significant experience building or securing production software and distributed systems. You are comfortable reading and writing production code, designing systems and working directly with Engineering teams.

You have deep security engineering expertise and strong experience in several of the following areas:

  • Application and Product Security

  • API Security

  • IAM, authentication and authorization

  • OAuth2 / OIDC, WebAuthn / FIDO2

  • RBAC / ABAC and privilege management

  • Cloud security

  • Cryptography, KMS / HSM and envelope encryption

  • Tokenisation and secrets management

  • Data Security and Privacy Engineering

  • Threat modelling and secure software architecture

  • Security monitoring and detection

    • Stronger attacker mindset

    You naturally ask:

  • What happens if this employee becomes malicious?

  • What happens if this backend is compromised?

  • What happens if someone dumps this database?

  • Can this endpoint be called directly?

  • How much data can one account access before we notice?

  • Where else does this information get replicated?

  • Why do we have this data at all?

    • You think in terms of attack paths, blast radius and least privilege, not just compliance requirements.

    Pragmatism

    You know that security engineering is a prioritisation problem.

    You can distinguish between:

  • something that needs to be fixed this week;

  • something that requires an architectural redesign;

  • something cryptographically elegant but operationally unnecessary.

    • You are comfortable deploying simple, high-impact controls quickly while designing stronger long-term foundations.

    What would make you stand out

    Experience with:

  • large-scale SaaS or fintech platforms;

  • highly sensitive or regulated data;

  • multi-tenant architectures;

  • insider risk or data-loss prevention;

  • advanced cryptographic or privacy-enhancing technologies.

    • What success looks like

  • Sensitive data is exposed to fewer systems and people.

  • Access to sensitive resources is increasingly scoped, attributable and auditable.

  • Compromising a single account or service has a limited blast radius.

  • Security controls are increasingly enforced by the platform rather than by process.

  • Product teams can build secure systems faster and with less friction.

    • What this role is not

    This is not primarily a GRC, SOC, compliance, policy-writing or penetration-testing role.

    Those disciplines are important, but this role exists to change how our products and systems are engineered.

    We expect this person to design systems, write code, influence architecture and ship security capabilities into production.


    Localization of this position
    This position can be based at our offices in Paris, Toulouse, or Montpellier on a flex-remote basis.

descriptionHtml:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

title: STAGE Fullstack  - Time-Travel debugger pour architecture événementielle (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Basés en plein cœur de Paris, nous faisons bouger l’industrie des jeux en ligne. Leader du poker et des paris sportifs en France avec 350 000 joueurs et 600 000 parieurs mensuels, nous sommes présents en Espagne, en Allemagne et bientôt en Italie et au Portugal. Nous offrons à nos joueurs une expérience exceptionnelle, à la fois technique, créative et qualitative. Innovation, unité et appartenance : nos valeurs façonnent une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique. Et si tu avais un futur dans le jeu ? Techniquement, Winamax c’est :
  • Un moteur de jeu puissant et innovant : adaptation dynamique de l'offre de jeu, parties de poker hautement configurables, détection de fraude
  • Une architecture distribuée et scalable conçue pour traiter en temps réel les flux de la plateforme
  • Une plateforme modulaire soumise à des contraintes de haute disponibilité et de sécurisation des données, capable de gérer de fortes audience

Contexte
Notre plateforme de jeu repose sur des microservices stateless : chaque traitement est une fonction pure appliquée à un message et à un état. Sur le papier, c'est le rêve pour débugger. En pratique, l'outillage n'existe pas, et CloudWatch devient vite chronophage dès qu'il faut analyser les interactions entre services. Comment rejouer les messages et les changements d'états pour reproduire un dysfonctionnement à l'identique ?
Objectifs du stage
Concevoir et déployer un outil réellement opérationnel, en trois briques :
  • Ingestion et indexation à l'échelle : capter les messages et les transitions d'états, définir un modèle de stockage scalable sans impacter la production
  • Générateur de tests local : isoler une séquence, reconstruire l'arbre d'états, et en sortir des tests de non-régression automatisés
  • Replayer : une API et un back-office minimaliste pour visualiser graphiquement les états et les interactions inter-services
    • Les points d'attention : la volumétrie, la fidélité de la reconstruction chronologique, la corrélation d'événements en environnement distribué, et l'industrialisation de l'outil (CI/CD, tests, documentation).
    Stack technique
    Javascript, React, DynamoDB, Kafka, S3, AWS, GitHub
    Modalités du stage

  • Opportunité de CDI à la fin du stage
  • Rémunération : 2500€ bruts / mois

title: Stagiaire Chargé de mission - Gestion de projet européen en santé numérique H/F
descriptionHtml:
L’Agence du Numérique en Santé (ANS) accompagne la transformation numérique du système de santé en France. Elle œuvre, aux côtés de ses partenaires institutionnels et professionnels, à garantir la confiance dans le numérique en santé, à sécuriser les échanges de données et à promouvoir des outils au service de la qualité des soins et du pilotage du système de santé.

Vous intégrerez le Domaine Innovation et International, au sein d’une équipe de six personnes, et assisterez la cheffe de projet Sesali. L’ANS est le point de contact national français pour la e-santé (National Contact Point for eHealth – NCPeH) au sein de l’infrastructure européenne MyHealth@EU. Elle opère le service Sesali, qui permet aux professionnel·les de santé en France de consulter de manière sécurisée la synthèse médicale de patient·es (Patient Summary) provenant d’autres pays de l’Union européenne. Le service évolue également pour intégrer la consultation des prescriptions électroniques (ePrescription). Dans la perspective de ces évolutions, de l’ouverture de nouvelles connexions avec des pays européens et de la mise en œuvre de l’Espace européen des données de santé (EHDS, European Health Data Space / EEDS), vous contribuerez au suivi du projet, à la coordination des parties prenantes et au maintien en conditions opérationnelles du service.

🎯 Missions principales

Coordination du projet européen

  • Appuyer le suivi du projet et vous familiariser avec la gestion de projets européens de grande envergure.

  • Participer à certains groupes de travail européens, représenter les positions françaises et échanger avec les homologues des autres États membres.

  • Contribuer à la coordination des parties prenantes françaises, notamment la CNAM et le ministère chargé de la Santé.

Déploiement et suivi opérationnel

  • Participer à l’ouverture de nouvelles connexions en production entre Sesali et d’autres pays : échanges avec les professionnel·les de santé, tests métier de bout en bout et coordination européenne.

  • Assurer le suivi des sprints avec les équipes de maîtrise d’œuvre : avancement, backlog et livrables.

  • Approfondir la connaissance du règlement EHDS/EEDS et analyser ses implications pour Sesali.

title: Storm Test Bench Principal Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Here at The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refuelled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We are seeking an experienced and talented Storm Test Bench Principal Engineer, to lead the development of one of the most powerful European cryogenic test bench for 2.5MN class engines.

This is a key leadership role that requires deep technical expertise in liquid-propellant propulsion systems, a proven track record managing complex engineering projects, and experience leading and mentoring technical teams. As Storm Test Bench Principal Engineer, you will ensure that test bench development is carried out safely, efficiently and with technical rigor, from design through commissioning and system-level testing. You will provide technical direction to the testing team, coordinate priorities and resources, resolve complex technical issues, and ensure the test bench meets its performance, quality, schedule and safety objectives.

The role combines technical leadership, people leadership and hands-on involvement in preparing and executing complex cryogenic propulsion test campaigns.

Key Responsibilities / Tasks:

  • Provide overall technical leadership for the test bench development

  • Define and maintain the development approach, philosophy, plans and technical execution strategy

  • Ensure that test bench capabilities are aligned with system requirements, design intent, verification objectives and programme milestones

  • Lead the technical assessment and resolution of complex test problems, including test anomalies, hardware issues, instrumentation problems and system performance deviations

  • Coordinate the investigation of anomalies and ensure that root-cause analysis, corrective actions and retest activities are properly managed

  • Ensure that the test bench design performed in accordance with applicable safety rules, operational constraints and approved procedures

  • Support the development of the teams through coaching, technical guidance and constructive feedback

  • Build a culture of ownership, disciplined execution, continuous improvement and learning from experience

  • Contribute to integrated project planning, including test schedules, resource requirements, facility usage and major test milestones

  • Identify technical, operational and schedule risks related to test activities and ensure that mitigation actions are defined and implemented

  • Ensure compliance with company processes and applicable regulatory requirements for cryogenic propulsion test activities

  • Promote a strong safety culture, particularly for activities involving cryogenic propellants, high pressure, hazardous energy and propulsion test operations

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, propulsion engineering or a related technical discipline

  • Proven professional experience (5+ years) in spacecraft, launch vehicle, aircraft, industrial gas, energy or another relevant high-technology environment

  • Experience in cryogenic propulsion systems testing

  • Proven experience leading engineering teams and coordinating multidisciplinary technical activities

  • Experience with cryogenic systems, liquid propulsion, pressurised systems, fluid systems or related test operations

  • Experience planning and executing complex test campaigns from test preparation through final reporting

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical investigations and resolve test anomalies using structured problem-solving methods

  • Experience working with test facilities, ground support equipment, instrumentation and data acquisition systems

  • Capacity to travel to test sites and partner facilities as required

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Fluent professional English. French will be an advantage

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager - Italian Speaking
descriptionHtml:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager for our Italian-speaking market, you’ll own a book of enterprise accounts across Europe, acting as a trusted advisor who drives adoption, retention and growth. You’ll partner closely with Sales to deliver a seamless onboarding experience and educate clients on a completely new way to create video content. Engaging stakeholders from day-to-day users through to the C-suite, you’ll make sure customers see clear ROI and become true champions of Synthesia.

What You'll do

  • Reporting to the Director of Customer Success of Southern EMEA and focusing on Italian accounts in Europe - you are energetic, driven, and care deeply about the success of our customers

  • As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will drive Synthesia’s future growth by building relationships with clients and turning them into happy users

  • You will be helping educate clients on a totally new way to create video content, and work very closely with sales to create a cohesive onboarding experience for new users

  • You are capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organisation, including the C-suite

  • Ideal for an individual who wants to expand their career with a fast-growing software company

We’d love to hear from you if you have

  • Customer-facing experience in Customer Success Management / Client Service / Account Management / Technical Account Management / Implementation or similar ideally in B2B SaaS

  • Experience in managing a Book of Business along with KPIs

  • A track record in managing risk, forecasting, and identifying growth opportunities

  • Establishing a trusted advisor relationship with our clients, driving value from Synthesia products and services

  • Successfully onboarding new clients and building key relationships in the first critical months and beyond

  • Coordinating and leading regular client check-ins with clear outcomes on client health and opportunities with senior stakeholder attendance

  • Light video editing using the Synthesia platform

  • Retention and growth of our enterprise clients

  • Ensuring ROI and value is understood by clients, proactively looking for risks and opportunities

  • You need to be fluent in Italian and English

  • You are based in Europe and can sit remote.

We’d be particularly excited if

  • Experience at a fast-growing technology company

  • Familiarity with AI or video tools

Compensation

We offer a competitive salary, equity and benefits. Your offer will reflect your experience, skills and the scope of the role.

title: Strategy & Operations Analyst - Germany 🇩🇪
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du den Alltag von Millionen Unternehmerinnen und Unternehmern in Frankreich und Europa nachhaltig verbessern?

Arbeitest du gerne in einem vertrauensvollen und dynamischen Umfeld?

Dann könnte Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich sein und du die perfekte Ergänzung für unser Team 🙂

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste Finanzbetriebssystem für europäische KMU werden.

Darüber hinaus unterstützen wir Steuerkanzleien. Mit Pennylane können sie manuelle und repetitive Aufgaben reduzieren und mehr Zeit darauf verwenden, ihre Mandantinnen und Mandanten zu beraten und zu begleiten.

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintech-Unternehmen Frankreichs. Derzeit beschleunigen wir unsere Expansion nach Deutschland 🇩🇪

In sechs Jahren haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als innovative Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Steuerkanzleien etabliert.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 400 Millionen Euro an Finanzierung eingeworben, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem bekannten Venture-Capital-Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe und PayPal investiert hat.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von sieben Mitgründern zu einem Team von über 1.200 zufriedenen Mitarbeitenden gewachsen. Heute gelten wir als einer der besten Arbeitgeber in Frankreich und als attraktiver Arbeitgeber für Remote-Arbeit. Auf Glassdoor haben wir eine Bewertung von 4,6 von 5.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 vertretenen Nationalitäten geschaffen. Unsere Kultur ist stark auf Remote-Arbeit ausgerichtet, und bereits 30 % unserer Mitarbeitenden arbeiten aus verschiedenen Ländern Europas.

🤝 Wir genießen das Vertrauen von Tausenden Kundinnen und Kunden sowie Steuerkanzleien und erhalten hervorragende Bewertungen.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1,3 Millionen kleine und mittlere Unternehmen sowie über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich.

Strategy & Operations bei Pennylane

Teil des Strategy-&-Operations-Teams bei Pennylane zu sein bedeutet, die operativen Realitäten genau zu verstehen. Während wir unsere deutsche Gesellschaft aufbauen, entwickeln und implementieren wir effiziente und skalierbare Lösungen, die Pennylane dabei unterstützen, seine ambitionierten Expansionsziele zu erreichen.

Deine Rolle wird entscheidend dazu beitragen, lokale Abläufe von Grund auf zu strukturieren, bestehende Prozesse zu skalieren und unser Operating Model an die Besonderheiten des deutschen Marktes anzupassen.

Um diesen Markteintritt erfolgreich zu gestalten, arbeiten unsere Strategy-&-Operations-Teams täglich eng mit den Business-Teams, beispielsweise in Sales und Customer Success, den Tech-Teams, darunter Entwicklerinnen, Entwickler und Product Managerinnen und Product Manager, sowie den Data-Teams, darunter Data Scientists und Data Analysts, zusammen.

Dein Ziel

Du steigerst die Produktivität unserer Teams deutlich, indem du die Nutzung unserer Tools optimierst, Prozesse vereinfachst und operative Strukturen aufbaust, die den Aufbau und die Expansion unserer deutschen Gesellschaft unterstützen.

Dein täglicher Beitrag

Du übernimmst Verantwortung, bist die zentrale Ansprechperson und treibst Veränderungen in den Business-Teams für den deutschen Markt voran.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit den operativen Verantwortlichen aus den Bereichen Sales, Professional Services, Customer Support und Account Management zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Transformation vorantreiben und den Status quo hinterfragen: Du beobachtest, hörst zu, stellst bestehende Strukturen infrage und schlägst kontinuierlich Optimierungen vor, um den Zeitaufwand für manuelle administrative Aufgaben und die Datensuche zu reduzieren. Du schaffst die Grundlage für nachhaltiges Wachstum in Deutschland, strukturierst die Abläufe einer neuen Gesellschaft und dokumentierst alle Prozessänderungen.

  • Operative Verbesserungen umsetzen: Du setzt lösungsorientierte Initiativen durch die Einführung neuer Informationssysteme, die Anpassung bestehender Anwendungen oder organisatorische Veränderungen um. Dabei leitest du Projekte und nutzt das Know-how verschiedener Teams, darunter Data, Sales und Finance. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehört außerdem, eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit sicherzustellen, Zeitpläne einzuhalten und die relevanten KPIs der Implementierung zu überwachen.

  • Prozesse skalieren und lokalisieren: Du passt globale operative Strukturen an die Besonderheiten des deutschen Marktes an und stellst gleichzeitig sicher, dass sie mit den zentralen Pennylane-Standards übereinstimmen.

  • Benchmarking und Innovation: Du beobachtest andere Abteilungen, trittst einen Schritt vom Tagesgeschäft zurück, führst Benchmarks durch und sammelst Erkenntnisse, um unsere operativen Strategien weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Teams befähigen und die Akzeptanz neuer Lösungen fördern: Du etablierst klare Kommunikationswege und praxisnahe Unterstützung für die deutschen Teams, damit sie sich reibungslos in neue Methoden und Arbeitsweisen einfinden, beispielsweise durch optimierte Tools, Schulungen und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen. Du stellst sicher, dass Tools im Alltag genutzt und Prozesse eingehalten werden.

  • Die Schnittstelle zwischen Operations und Unternehmensstrategie bilden: Du entwickelst ein übergreifendes Verständnis für die Herausforderungen des Unternehmens, um frühzeitig zu erkennen, wie sie sich auf unsere lokalen Aktivitäten in Deutschland auswirken. Mithilfe datenbasierter Erkenntnisse schaffst du mehr Transparenz über unsere operativen Abläufe.

Dein Profil

Wir suchen eine ambitionierte Persönlichkeit mit nachweislicher Erfahrung in der organisatorischen Transformation, der Steigerung der Produktivität, im Projektmanagement und im Aufbau operativer Strukturen in einem dynamischen Umfeld.

  • Du verfügst über mindestens vier Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Business-Transformation und in der Steigerung operativer Effizienz durch die Implementierung von Systemen und Tools.

title: System Identification Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

Every airframe Harmattan AI flies starts with a model. System identification turns flight data into the verified dynamics that guidance and control are designed, tuned and trained on. It is the foundation of an autopilot that adapts across multirotors, fixed wings, VTOLs and missiles.

As a System Identification Engineer, working out of Paris, you will own the path from flight test to identified model. You will design and run your own experiments, build a repeatable identification pipeline, and deliver models the G&C team can trust.

 

Responsibilities

  • Experiment Design & Flight Test: Plan and run your own identification tests, from excitation design to flight tests, including coordinating with the .

  • Model Identification: Identify rigid-body, aerodynamic, propulsion and actuator dynamics using frequency and time-domain methods, including closed-loop identification on vehicles flown under a controller.

  • Propulsion & Actuators: Characterize motors, ESCs, propellers and control surfaces, including bandwidth, delays, saturation, and thermal and battery effects.

  • Identification Pipeline: Build and maintain an automated, reproducible pipeline from flight logs to identified model. This covers ingestion, data-quality checks, estimation, validation and reporting.

  • Model Validation: Validate models against held-out flight data, quantify uncertainty, and make sure each model is fit for purpose: controller design, simulation, or training learned G&C.

  • New Airframes: Extend the capability from multirotors to control-surface multirotors, fixed wings, tail-sitters and missiles.

  • Simulation & G&C Support: Deliver models into simulation, SITL and HITL, and work closely with control, guidance and embedded engineers to close the loop between models and flight results.

  • Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers and interns.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, control, mechanical engineering or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree.

  • System Identification: Proven experience identifying dynamic models of flying platforms from real data, in both the frequency and time domain, including the pitfalls of closed-loop data.

  • Flight Mechanics & Control: Solid grasp of rigid-body dynamics, aerodynamic forces and moments, non-dimensionalization, stability modes and propulsion models. Also enough control background to know what the model will be used for.

  • Flight Testing: Hands-on experience planning and running flight tests and working from raw, imperfect logs.

  • Software: Strong Python and scientific computing skills, with the discipline to build tools others can rerun.

Nice to have

  • Rigorous about data quality, uncertainty and validation; skeptical of models until they are proven.

  • Autonomous and hands-on, comfortable moving between bench, field and code.

  • Communicates clearly, able to present models and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality.

  • Fixed-wing aerodynamic modeling; VTOL or tail-sitter dynamics; remote pilot certification; experience with real flight logs; structural or vibration modes; data-driven or learned dynamics models.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
