title: Talent & People Lead (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About VIA HealthTech

VIA turns a therapy session into a finished session note, and session notes into a complete psychological report. That is work which used to cost therapists hours every week.

We are the market leading AI assistant for psychotherapists. Over 4,000 psychotherapists across the DACH region use VIA every day, and we process hundreds of thousands of sessions per month. We are ISO 27001:2022 certified and hold a BSI C5 attestation.

We are a multidisciplinary team of 12 in Berlin-Mitte. Being the market leader in AI documentation is our starting position, not our goal. We are going much deeper, into the therapeutic process itself and into how a practice is run, with products that will be regulated as medical devices under EU MDR.

The role

We are 12 today and plan to roughly double in the next year, across engineering, our clinical team and go-to-market. We are bootstrapped. Every salary is paid from revenue, not from a funding round, and a wrong hire costs us a year we cannot buy back. We cannot afford that mistake, so we do not hire good. We hire exceptional.

Today, hiring lands between three founder calendars that are already full, or with agencies. Both fill roles. Neither builds anything that stays. We would rather internalise it: one person who knows our bar, owns the whole pipeline and builds the people function around it. You are not joining an HR team. You are becoming it.

Recruiting is the core of this role, and the measure in year one is simple: every role we open, filled on time with someone excellent, closed by you. Everything else in HR is yours to build lean behind that.

What you'll own

  • The whole funnel, for every role. Briefing with the hiring founder, the job ad, sourcing, screening, interview loops, references, offer, close. You are the first conversation a candidate has with VIA, and the one who gets them over the line

  • Sourcing that does not wait for applications. The people we want are rarely looking. Outbound on LinkedIn and beyond, our network, the places where therapists, engineers and salespeople actually are. We use agencies today. After you, we do not

  • The bar. A process that reliably separates excellent from good: structured interviews, take-home challenges with the hiring team, scorecards, fast decisions. You say no to candidates the founders like, and you say it with reasons

  • Candidate experience. Answers within days, not weeks. Every candidate, hired or not, leaves with a better opinion of VIA than they came with

  • Onboarding. A new engineer ships on day two, a new Sales Manager runs their first demo in week one. You build the path from signed contract to productive, together with the hiring lead

  • A lean people function. Contracts, probation reviews, feedback and performance cycles, compensation bands and the tooling behind them. Founders' time out, structure in. Our ISO 27001 and C5 frameworks carry HR controls, from joiner and leaver processes to security training, and you own those with the Security & Compliance Lead (who may be one of your first hires)

  • The team as it doubles. Rituals, offsites, the things that keep a company twice this size feeling like the 12-person one that got here

Your profile

Must-have

  • A track record of closing hard roles yourself, in-house or at an agency, with numbers you can show: hires per year, time to hire, offer acceptance. Senior engineers and salespeople at minimum

  • Real sourcing craft. You find people who are not applying and get them to take the call

  • Judgement about people. You can tell exceptional from polished in a first conversation, and explain the difference

  • Closing instinct. You know what moves a candidate who holds three offers, and you negotiate for us without losing them

  • Builder mentality. Processes, templates and tooling you set up yourself, because there is nobody else to do it

  • Working knowledge of German employment basics: contracts, probation, notice periods and the thresholds that matter as we grow. Payroll and legal are outsourced; you know when to call them

  • Hunger. You want to build the people function of a company that is going to be much bigger, not run one that already exists

  • Fluent German and English. Our candidates and contracts are in German, parts of our team work in English

Strong plus

  • You have been the first People hire somewhere and built from zero

  • Employer branding, from the careers page to events

  • AI tools as a matter of course. One person using them well replaces a recruiting team

  • You have recruited in a regulated health-tech environment

This role is not for you if

  • You want to run HR and let someone else do the hiring. Hiring is the job

  • You need an ATS, an employer brand and inbound applicants already in place. You build those

  • You hire to fill a seat. We would rather leave it empty

What we offer

  • A team that outperforms. DACH market leader for AI assistance in psychotherapy within two years, bootstrapped, with a team of 12. Our plans from here are considerably bolder, and we hire people who want to be part of it

  • Ownership of a core function from day one. Every person who joins VIA in the next year came through you. There is no clearer measure of impact

  • High autonomy. Competence and execution are what count here. We do not put obstacles in your way

  • Direct work with the founders. Decisions in hours, not weeks, including on offers

  • Competitive salary plus equity, so that you participate in the company's success

  • Office in Berlin-Mitte with flexible hours, latest equipment and any tool you need. Berlin-based hybrid is our preference for this role

We are not looking for someone to administer HR. We are looking for the person who finds the people VIA's next year depends on, and then builds the function that keeps them.

Sounds like you? A short CV or your LinkedIn profile is enough. If there is a hire you are proud of, tell us about that one.

Ben jij een leidinggevende die energie krijgt van operationele aansturing, teamontwikkeling én procesverbetering? Dan hebben wij een mooie uitdaging voor je.

Op onze locatie in Oirschot (regio Eindhoven) geef je leiding aan een team binnen onze Customs-operatie. Je zorgt ervoor dat processen soepel verlopen, medewerkers zich ontwikkelen en KPI's worden behaald. Dankzij jouw leiderschap worden duizenden internationale zendingen dagelijks tijdig en correct verwerkt binnen het DPD-netwerk.

Wat ga je doen?

Als teamleader operations customs ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse operatie en geef je leiding aan een team van customs medewerkers. Je bewaakt de voortgang, stuurt bij waar nodig en zorgt voor een optimale samenwerking.

Een gemiddelde werkdag bestaat uit het afstemmen van de planning, monitoren van resultaten, coachen van medewerkers en verbeteren van processen. Je werkt in een vast rooster in twee diensten:

  • 11:00 - 19:30 uur

  • 19:30 - 04:00 uur

Hierdoor heb je afwisseling in je werkweek en speel je een belangrijke rol binnen een operatie die vrijwel continu doorloopt.

Jouw werkzaamheden

  • Coördineren en aansturen van de dagelijkse customs-operatie;

  • Coachen, begeleiden en motiveren van medewerkers;

  • Bewaken van kwaliteit, productiviteit en operationele KPI’s;

  • Signaleren en implementeren van procesverbeteringen;

  • Opstellen en opvolgen van rapportages en analyses;

  • Afstemmen met interne stakeholders en collega teamleiders;

  • Zorgdragen voor naleving van procedures, veiligheid en wetgeving;

  • Bijdragen aan een optimale personeelsbezetting.

  • Flexibiliteit wordt gevraagd wanneer de operatie daarom vraagt.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Een salaris tussen €2.931,25 en €4.187,50 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring;

  • Een functie van 38,75 uur (1 fte) per week;

  • Opleidingskansen, ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en onbeperkt toegang tot onze Studyhub;

  • 28 vakantiedagen (+ optie tot bijkoop) en reiskostenvergoeding;

  • Veel extra’s, zoals een collectieve zorgverzekering en een aantrekkelijk pensioen;

  • Werken binnen een internationale en groeiende organisatie.


Wat neem je mee?

  • MBO+/HBO werk- en denkniveau;

  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring binnen logistiek, operations of customs;

  • Ervaring met leidinggeven aan operationele teams;

  • Ervaring binnen logistiek, transport, warehousing, operations of customs. Ervaring met customs-processen is een pré.

  • Goede beheersing van Engels en het liefst ook Nederlands;

  • Ervaring met KPI-sturing en procesoptimalisatie;

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden;

  • Een proactieve en resultaatgerichte instelling.

Over DPD Nederland

Met 12 depots in Nederland en als onderdeel van Geopost, zijn we verbonden met een internationaal netwerk dat jaarlijks 1,2 miljard pakketten verwerkt. Achter deze indrukwekkende cijfers staan duizenden collega’s die zich elke dag inzetten, straks samen met jou.

Onze cultuur is ondernemend, betrouwbaar en mensgericht. Wat ooit begon als een nuchter MKB-bedrijf leeft nog steeds voort: praktisch, sociaal en trots. We geloven in persoonlijk contact, samenwerking en zelf aanpakken. Uitdagingen gaan we niet uit de weg. Dat zit in ons DNA.

We groeien hard, hebben grote ambities en jij hoort er straks écht bij. Samen maken we het verschil.

Solliciteren

Solliciteer direct bij DPD door op de rode knop ‘solliciteren’ te klikken. Wij nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op.

Heb je eerder vragen? Neem gerust contact op met onze corporate recruiter, Jordi Ernest via +31 6 29 10 50 26.

Klik hier voor meer informatie over ons sollicitatieproces.

Acquisitie en doorplaatsing van deze vacature worden niet op prijs gesteld.

descriptionHtml:
FASTR Energy gehört zu den führenden Energiedienstleistern und Stromversorgern in

heute seinen Hauptsitz in Düsseldorf sowie Niederlassungen in Berlin,
Hamburg, München und Leipzig. Aus einem ursprünglich familiengeführten
Unternehmen ist ein dynamischer Energiepartner geworden, der sich im Mai
2025 durch die Partnerschaft mit KKR auf einen klaren Wachstumskurs
begeben hat. In einer spannenden Transformationsphase gestalten wir
aktiv die Zukunft der Energieversorgung – mit einer klaren Vision: Als
Dekarbonisierungspartner der Immobilienwirtschaft leisten wir einen
entscheidenden Beitrag zur Energiewende in Deutschland.

Aufgaben

Als Teamleiter Projektentwicklung (m/w/d) im Energiecontracting in München berichtest Du direkt an den Leiter Projektentwicklung & Realisierung. Der Teamleiter Projektentwicklung (m/w/d) verantwortet die technische und wirtschaftliche Entwicklung innovativer Energieversorgungslösungen für Wärme, Strom, Kälte und Nahwärme unter Berücksichtigung regulatorischer Anforderungen. Die Position verbindet fundierte technische Analyse, wirtschaftliche Bewertung und strategische Beratung mit der Führung und Steuerung eines Teams aus Projektentwicklern.

Ziel ist die Entwicklung nachhaltiger, wirtschaftlich tragfähiger Energiecontracting-Lösungen für Kunden aus den Segmenten Immobilienwirtschaft und Kommunen.

Darüber hinaus trägst Du in dieser Position die fachliche und disziplinarische Verantwortung für die Mitarbeitenden der Projektentwicklung für die Region Süddeutschland und stellst die Einhaltung von Termin-, Budget- und Qualitätszielen sicher.

  • Ziel der Position ist die Führung, Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung des Teams Projektentwicklung im Energiecontracting sowie die Sicherstellung einer erfolgreichen Entwicklung von Energiecontracting-Projekten hinsichtlich Qualität, Budget und Terminen.

  • Angebots- und Fördermanagement: Erstellung von
    Angebotskalkulationen für das Energieliefercontracting, Einbindung relevanter Förderprogramme sowie Berücksichtigung regulatorischer Anforderungen.

  • Kundenberatung: Unterstützung und Beratung
    unserer Kund:innen aus der Immobilienwirtschaft und Kommunen bei der

    Transformation bestehender Wärmenetze.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Versorgungs-, Energie- oder Umwelttechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Projektentwicklung, Planung oder Umsetzung von Energieversorgungsprojekten, idealerweise im Contracting- oder Quartierskontext.

  • Fundiertes technisches und kaufmännisches Verständnis sowie Erfahrung in der Bewertung von Wirtschaftlichkeit, Energieeffizienz und Förderfähigkeit von Projekten.

  • Gute Kenntnisse der regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen (z. B. GModG, KWKG, EEG, BEG, BEW) und deren Anwendung in der Projektpraxis.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Planungs- und Projektmanagementtools (z. B. AutoCAD, awork, CRM-Systeme) sowie Freude an digital unterstützten Prozessen.

  • Analytisches, lösungsorientiertes Denken kombiniert mit unternehmerischem Weitblick.

title: TECH LEAD IA H/F
descriptionHtml:
Le rôle

Équiper des équipes de LLM et de coding agents prend un après-midi. Les faire travailler en AI-Native SDLC, c'est-à-dire concevoir et livrer du logiciel avec des agents dans la boucle plutôt qu'à côté, demande de faire évoluer tout l'environnement autour : architecture, gestion du contexte, harness (la couche système qui donne à un agent ses outils, ses permissions et son contexte d'exécution), developer platforms, intégration au SI, infrastructure, sécurité, observabilité, évaluation.

Comme Tech Lead, tu aides nos clients à comprendre ces transformations, tu arbitres les décisions d'architecture qui en découlent et tu mets en place les capacités qui leur manquent. Tu conçois, tu conseilles, et tu descends dans le code quand il faut confronter une décision au réel.

Pourquoi on ouvre ce poste

Nos clients ont dépassé le stade du POC. Leur question porte maintenant sur l'intégration des agents au SI et au cycle de delivery, et sur ce qui doit être mutualisé dans une plateforme plutôt que laissé à chaque équipe. Ce sont des questions d'architecture, et on n'a personne dont c'est le métier à plein temps.


Tes missions 🎯

• comprendre le contexte Product, business et technologique du client, son SI et son environnement de delivery

• identifier ce que l'IA change et les capacités technologiques qui manquent pour y répondre

• concevoir les architectures et arbitrer les choix structurants : build ou buy, plateforme ou équipe, standardisation ou autonomie, besoin immédiat ou capacité durable

• prototyper ou implémenter certains composants quand une décision d'architecture a besoin d'être éprouvée

• accompagner les équipes client et faire monter les équipes Thiga en compétence

• intervenir en avant-vente comme garant technique, challenger les demandes et aider le client à transformer un problème flou en décision


Deux exemples de ce que ça donne concrètement 👀

Passer à l'échelle avec les coding agents

Le cas du début. Tu analyses l'existant, tu identifies les capacités manquantes et tu conçois l'architecture qui permet aux équipes et aux agents de travailler ensemble de façon observable et sécurisée. Le vrai sujet est souvent le knowledge : reconstruire un contexte exploitable à partir de repos, de docs et de conventions que personne n'a maintenus depuis trois ans.

Décider ce qui se mutualise

Cinq équipes expérimentent chacune avec leurs propres modèles, agents et outils. Tu aides le client à trancher ce qui remonte dans une plateforme, ce qui reste décentralisé et dans quel ordre y aller. La réponse est rarement la grande plateforme IA. C'est plus souvent trois capacités bien choisies qui débloquent tout le monde.


Avec qui tu travailles 🤝

  • Chez nos clients : CTO, responsables Engineering, architectes, Platform Engineers, développeurs, équipes sécurité et Product. Tu dois pouvoir passer d'une discussion d'architecture très technique à une décision avec un dirigeant dans la même journée.

  • Chez Thiga : nos Product Builders, Product Engineers et consultants Product. Ton rôle est de construire les enablers technologiques qui leur permettent de tirer parti de l'IA sur leurs missions, et de les faire progresser.


    • Ton profil 🚀

    Une culture Tech large

    Tu es d'abord un bon technologue. Tu comprends assez bien les systèmes logiciels modernes pour raisonner sur une architecture entière : software architecture, systèmes distribués, APIs, données, cloud, infrastructure, sécurité, IAM, CI/CD, developer platforms, observabilité. On cherche quelqu'un capable de repérer ce qui est structurant, de comprendre les interactions entre les couches et d'aller en profondeur quand le problème l'exige, plutôt qu'un spécialiste de chacune de ces disciplines. Tu as assez de kilomètres au compteur, souvent une dizaine d'années, pour avoir vu des architectures évoluer, atteindre leurs limites et parfois échouer.

    Une vraie profondeur IA

    Tu comprends les systèmes construits avec des LLM et des agents, ce qu'ils permettent et où ils coincent. Context engineering, retrieval, tool use, systèmes agentiques, evals, sécurité, observabilité : tu sais raisonner sur les propriétés architecturales que ces systèmes introduisent et sur ce qu'elles impliquent pour le reste du SI.

    Du jugement, et des mains

    Tu raisonnes en trade-offs, tu prends position et tu expliques pourquoi une option est préférable dans un contexte donné, sans confondre architecture et accumulation de technologies. Et tu es resté assez hands-on pour ouvrir le code, manipuler des APIs, explorer une infra ou monter un prototype quand ça devient le moyen le plus rapide de savoir.

    Une culture Product et client

    Tu cherches à comprendre le problème, les utilisateurs, les contraintes de l'organisation et le résultat attendu avant de dessiner une solution. Tu sais challenger un client, poser plusieurs options avec leurs compromis, puis l'aider à décider.

    Apprécié

    Une expérience du conseil, des transformations Product & Engineering, des developer platforms ou des systèmes IA en production. Si tu écris, contribues à de l'open source ou parles en conférence, c'est un vrai plus.


    Pourquoi Thiga 👀

    Thiga vient du Product Management, ce qui change la manière d'aborder l'AI-Native SDLC. Cette transformation touche la technologie, le produit et la façon dont les équipes travaillent en même temps, donc on refuse de la traiter comme un simple sujet d'outillage ou de plateforme.

    Tu seras rattaché à la Tribe Tech & IA, qui réunit nos Product Builders, les consultants qui déploient l'AI-Native SDLC chez nos clients et les architectes qui en construisent les enablers. Notre ambition : mener de vraies transformations chez nos clients, construire un collectif d'experts qui partage réellement ce qu'il apprend, et faire reconnaître Thiga comme un acteur de référence sur le sujet.

    Il y a donc une vraie dimension intrapreneuriale, et la liberté qui va avec.


    Process de recrutement 🎢

    1. Premier échange avec une Chargée de recrutement : ton parcours, ce que tu cherches, et une présentation précise de Thiga et du rôle.

    2. Cas et soutenance : on t'envoie un cas une semaine avant. L'exercice ne consiste pas à retrouver notre architecture ou à réciter une stack, on veut voir comment tu abordes un problème complexe, comment tu explores les options, comment tu arbitres et comment tu défends une recommandation. On évalue quatre dimensions : profondeur Tech, profondeur IA, culture Product, posture de conseil.

    3. Rencontre finale avec un.e Directeur.rice : approfondir ce qui doit l'être et valider l'envie de travailler ensemble, des deux côtés.

    Notre culture Chez Thiga, nous vivons selon des principes forts : Product first Nous pensons produit dans sa globalité, de l'expérience utilisateur jusqu'à l'infrastructure. Hands-on or nothing Notre approche est radicalement pratique. Nous croyons en la démonstration concrète plutôt qu'en la théorie. Market Maker by Design Nous repoussons les limites et partageons ouvertement nos innovations. Knowledge Open Bar Le savoir n'a de valeur que lorsqu'il est largement partagé. Nous diffusons librement nos apprentissages et nos outils. Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse

title: Tech Lead - Python & AI
descriptionHtml:
This is a full-time, permanent opportunity for candidates based in the UK and authorised to work without sponsorship.

This position also requires travel to client sites with travel expenses covered by the company.

About Nearform

Nearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart.  

As part of our Engineering function, you will work closely with clients to translate complex business requirements into innovative digital products.
Whether you are a Senior Engineer, Tech Lead, or DevOps Engineer, you will collaborate with distributed teams, leveraging cutting-edge technologies to build secure, high-performance applications. Our Nearform engineers are known for building high quality, scalable solutions that solve real world problems.

About the Technical Lead Role:

As a Technical Lead at Nearform, you will be responsible for leading and guiding development teams while working directly with clients to translate business and technical requirements into impactful applications. However, as you’ll likely work on a variety of projects in your time here, your responsibilities may also include:

  • Provide technical and line-management leadership to your development team.
  • Take responsibility for the successful delivery of projects.
  • Identify and resolve blockers before they become issues.
  • Ensure best practices in software development, DevOps, and agile methodologies are upheld within the team.
  • Work directly with clients, translating requirements into technical briefs.
  • Shape and define architectural decisions ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
  • Provide updates to client and Nearform leadership to ensure clear understanding of project status and drive good decision-making.

What we are looking for in this person:

  • Significant experience in software engineering and 2+ years of experience leading projects and mentoring as a Technical Lead. For this particular role, we are looking for professional experience Python.
  • Experience with AI application development and Agentic frameworks and platforms (e.g., LangGraph, Agentspace, etc.)
  • Experience working directly with clients or customers to understand technical requirements.
  • Proven experience working with Kubernetes for container orchestration.
  • Strong CI/CD experience, including hands-on work with Terraform, Helm, and other cloud-native IaC technologies.
  • Deep understanding of observability practices, with practical experience using OpenTelemetry (OTel) and related tooling.
  • Experience leading software engineering teams through technical delivery and either direct line management or mentoring.
  • Deep understanding of agile ways of working, best practices and design patterns.
  • Deep understanding of test-driven development and testing best practices.

title: Technical Architect
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.

THE ROLE: Technical Architect

We’re deploying large-scale NVIDIA GPU clusters, including GB200 and GB300 rack-scale systems, into live data centres on tight customer commit dates. On those schedules, a design error found on site costs weeks and real money. We need one architect per deployment who takes the high-level design and turns it into something that can actually be built, then stays with it until the customer signs off.

This is a role for someone who would rather find the problem on paper than on the data hall floor. It suits someone who will push back on an inherited design or a customer requirement that won’t perform, and who carries authority through owning the design rather than managing people.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:

  • Take each cluster from CTO handover to customer acceptance as its single design authority, so nothing is ordered or installed against a design you haven’t validated
  • Turn high-level designs and initial BOMs into build-ready low-level designs, hall layouts, rack elevations, P2P maps and cable schedules that site teams can build from without having to call you
  • Design the InfiniBand and Ethernet fabric, power, direct liquid cooling and containment to fit the real constraints of each data centre
  • Validate every BOM before it goes to procurement, and make part substitution calls knowing exactly what breaks when a line changes
  • Hold OEMs and integrators (NVIDIA, Dell, Lenovo, Supermicro and others) to their technical commitments, from FAT witness through to on-site issue resolution
  • Build the reference designs and building blocks that mean each new deployment starts from a known-good baseline rather than a blank page

ABOUT YOU

We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You’ll likely bring a combination of the following:

Essential:

  • You’ve designed and delivered large-scale GPU or HPC clusters into live data centres, and you were on site for the build
  • Deep, practical knowledge of NVIDIA platforms (GB200/GB300 rack-scale and HGX H200/B200) and what each one demands of a facility
  • Cluster-scale InfiniBand and Ethernet fabric design: topology, rail optimisation, oversubscription, and cable and optic selection
  • Physical infrastructure design across power and redundancy, direct liquid cooling and CDUs, containment and achievable cable lengths
  • You know part numbers, what’s optional and what isn’t, and you can hold an OEM to account when their commitments slip

Nice to Have:

  • Factory integration and FAT experience, including holding a dispatch gate
  • Storage design for AI workloads (WEKA, VAST, DDN, Ceph or similar)
  • Deployments across multiple geographies and data centre operators, including sites requiring fit-out
  • Neocloud or hyperscale experience on compressed schedules

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme
  • Employee wellbeing benefits
  • 25 days holiday, plus public holidays
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Enhanced Pension Scheme
  • Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)
  • Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment
  • Visible, meaningful impact as we scale
  • Clear career progression in a high-growth company
  • A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership
  • The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud’s team, culture, and future

WHY APPLY

We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we’d like to hear from you.

MORE INFORMATION

Visit our careers page to learn more about us or follow us on LinkedIn and X to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.

title: Technical Product Manager, Developer Experience & Product-Led Growth
descriptionHtml:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

The Role

We're looking for a highly technical Product Manager to own how developers discover, build on and grow with Telnyx.

Telnyx operates a global infrastructure platform spanning communications, AI inference, GPUs, edge compute, databases and real-time applications. We've invested heavily in building the underlying infrastructure. Now we want to make it dramatically easier for developers to understand what's possible, build useful applications and get into production.

This is a hands-on product role leading a small team of six engineers across Developer Relations and Product-Led Growth. We aren't looking for a traditional DevRel leader or someone whose primary skill is managing people. We want a strong engineer with excellent product judgment who understands developer experience, builds things personally and knows how to turn developer adoption into revenue. 

The Team

You'll lead a team of six: three DevRel engineers (sample apps, open source, technical content and demos) and three PLG engineers (activation, AI agents and automation, self-service conversion and expansion). You'll report to the Chief Operating Officer. 

What you'll own

  • Build applications developers actually want to use — Lead the DevRel team in building production-quality sample applications, integrations, templates and reference implementations on Telnyx. Publish them on GitHub, maintain them and make them easy for developers to deploy and extend. Turn those applications into compelling technical content, live demos and developer distribution.
  • Drive product-led growth — Own the PLG operation responsible for moving developers from signup to meaningful usage and revenue. Use product telemetry, behavioral signals, AI agents and human intervention to identify friction, accelerate onboarding, improve conversion and expand self-service usage.
  • Make the developer experience better — Get hands-on with our APIs, SDKs, documentation and infrastructure. Work directly with product engineering to identify and resolve the issues that make products difficult to use. Our reference applications should continuously test whether our products are genuinely ready for developers.
  • Build AI-native growth systems — Work with Growth Engineering and RevOps to develop automated workflows for developer acquisition, onboarding, account intelligence, technical assistance and expansion. We believe small teams of excellent technical people supervising powerful automation can outperform much larger traditional GTM organizations.
  • Connect the entire developer journey — Applications attract developers. Developers experiment with the platform. PLG helps them succeed. Production usage generates revenue. The feedback from that process improves our products and informs what we build next. You'll be accountable for making that system work. .

What we're looking for

  • A strong software engineering background. You should be comfortable building and debugging real applications, working with APIs, reading code and understanding complex infrastructure.
  • Experience as a Technical Product Manager, founding engineer, technical founder or similar role with substantial personal responsibility for shipping software.
  • Exceptional product judgment, particularly around developer tools, APIs, documentation, onboarding and usability.
  • Familiarity with AI infrastructure, LLMs, inference, cloud platforms, real-time systems or developer infrastructure.
  • Understanding of product-led growth, including developer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention and monetization.
  • Ability to work with AI coding agents, automation frameworks, product analytics and modern developer tooling.
  • Strong technical communication skills. You can explain complicated technologies clearly and recognize what makes a useful demonstration or reference application.
  • Comfortable leading a small technical team while remaining deeply involved in the actual work.

Experience at a developer infrastructure company is valuable. Experience personally building and growing something developers love is more important.

How we'll measure success

Your primary objective is growing developer-led revenue on Telnyx.

We'll look at activated developers, production applications deployed, self-service conversion, usage expansion and retention. We'll also measure the adoption of our reference applications, how effectively our developer content attracts users and how quickly developers can get from signup to a working application.

We care about applications developers actually use, not demos shipped for the sake of demos. We care about developers reaching production, not just generating signups. And we care about revenue, not vanity metrics.

Who will thrive here

Someone who would rather build a working prototype than spend a week debating a roadmap. Someone who notices a broken onboarding experience and immediately starts fixing it. Someone who understands both what makes infrastructure technically excellent and what makes developers want to use it.

You should be capable of leading six very technical people because you have the engineering ability, product instincts and judgment to make everyone around you more effective.

This is a builder's job, not a professional management job.

We're looking for someone who can make Telnyx a platform developers genuinely love building on, and turn that into a meaningful business.

title: Technical Project Manager
descriptionHtml:
Certa (certa.ai) is an AI-native third-party risk management platform that unifies the full third-party lifecycle, from onboarding through continuous monitoring and offboarding. Enterprises from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups use our no-code platform to manage vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. Trusted by Honeywell, Uber, MARS, and Boeing, we've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries.

We're looking for a Technical Project Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of complex enterprise software implementations. This is a client-facing role at the center of every engagement: you'll translate what a customer needs into a plan, drive a cross-functional team to build it, and keep both sides aligned from kickoff to go-live and beyond. You won't just track tasks, you'll understand the product deeply, engage in technical conversations with solution architects and engineers, lead the business requirement sessions, and make the decisions that keep delivery on track. The best person for this role thinks like an owner of the account, not a coordinator of it.

What You'll Do

  • Own delivery end to end: Run enterprise implementation projects from kickoff through go-live and stabilization, accountable for scope, timeline, budget, quality, and client satisfaction on every engagement you lead.

  • Build & manage the plan: Break down complex, ambiguous requirements into a clear project plan with phases, milestones, dependencies, and owners, keeping it current and making trade-offs visible when reality shifts.

  • Lead requirements gathering: Own the business requirement sessions end to end, facilitating discovery workshops that surface what the client actually needs, documenting requirements in a structured, unambiguous format, managing sign-off, and keeping them traceable through design, build, and testing.

  • Run the cross-functional team: Coordinate solution architects, engineers, QA, and client stakeholders toward a shared outcome, removing blockers, resolving conflicts, and making sure everyone knows what they own and by when.

  • Own the client relationship: Be the client's primary point of contact, leading status meetings, steering committee updates, and escalations, setting expectations early, and protecting the relationship even during hard conversations.

  • Manage scope, risk & change: Hold the line on scope creep, documenting and quantifying changes before work starts, and manage risks and issues proactively with a live view of mitigation plans and early escalation.

  • Stay technical, report & improve: Understand the architecture, integrations, and configuration decisions well enough to challenge estimates and speak credibly with engineers and technical buyers, produce honest, easy-to-read status reports and executive updates, and feed lessons learned back into delivery methodology.

What Success Looks Like

  • On-target delivery: Projects land on time, on budget, and within scope, with a clear plan stakeholders trust.

  • Trusted clients: Clients feel informed and in control throughout the engagement, and would take your call for the next one.

  • Managed risk: Risks surface early and get managed, so escalations are rare and never a surprise.

  • Aligned team & clean handoffs: The delivery team is aligned, unblocked, and clear on priorities, and handoffs to support and account teams are clean, with nothing left undocumented.

What You'll Need

  • Experience: 5+ years managing technical or software implementation projects, ideally in enterprise SaaS, professional services, or a client-facing delivery environment, with a track record of delivering complex, multi-stakeholder projects on time and within budget as the primary delivery owner for enterprise clients.

  • Technical fluency: You can read a solution design, understand integrations and data flows, and hold your own in a technical discussion without being the engineer.

  • Requirements & delivery craft: Proven ability to run requirements and discovery sessions and translate them into clear, documented business requirements, plus solid command of project management fundamentals (planning, estimation, dependency management, risk and issue tracking, and change control).

  • Stakeholder management: Excellent communication, comfort presenting to senior and executive audiences, and the ability to manage scope, timelines, and difficult conversations without losing the relationship.

  • Ways of working: Organized and calm under pressure, you over-communicate rather than under-communicate, you're direct when a project needs a hard truth and diplomatic when a relationship needs care, and you own outcomes rather than pointing to a process.

  • Preferred: An earlier technical role (engineering, solution architecture, or implementation consulting); experience delivering configurable enterprise platforms or workflow/automation software; fluency in both agile and traditional delivery and the judgment to know when to use which; experience in a regulated or risk-sensitive domain; PMP, PRINCE2, PSM, or equivalent certification; and exposure to AI-assisted or modern delivery tooling.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Compensation: Top of market salary + bonuses and equity

  • Time off: 49 days paid time off

  • Benefits: PTO, full benefits, retirement and wellness plans

  • Growth: Professional development support, remote workspace setup bonus

  • Team building: Annual company offsites in exciting locations around the world

Location

Certa is a remote-first company and we hire globally. We believe strongly in each team member working from the location that they choose. Should Certers wish to meet and work in person, they have 3 lively office locations they can travel to:

  • London

  • San Francisco

  • Jaipur

The perfect place for Certers to collaborate, co-work, and have face-to-face meetings.

Why Certa

  • Category leadership. Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools - recognition that we're defining the category, not following it.

  • Industry recognition. We've been honored across the analyst and awards landscape, including Top Tech and Customer Value distinctions in The Hackett Group's 2026 Risk Management SolutionMap, the ProcureTech100 (Advanced AI and Risk Management categories), and Best Overall eProcurement Software in the FinTech Breakthrough Awards.

  • A top place to work. Certa was named one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers in the US. We're a fast-growing company where you'll wear many hats, ship quickly, and shape decisions that matter.

  • Real scale with strong backing. We've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries. We're well-funded by leading investors including Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures, on the back of an oversubscribed Series B, headed towards Series C.

title: Triage audicien - Drachten, Friesland
descriptionHtml:
Bouw mee aan hoogwaardige hoorzorg binnen een zelfstandige optiekwinkel

Ben jij audicien en wil je méér dan alleen hoortoestellen aanpassen? Zoek je een plek waar je de tijd krijgt voor je klant, kwaliteit vooropstaat en je tegelijkertijd de ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan een succesvolle audiotak?

Dan is dit misschien wel jouw volgende stap.

Premium hoorzorg, zoals het bedoeld is

Binnen onze zelfstandige optiekwinkels staat persoonlijke aandacht centraal. Onze klanten kennen ons vanwege onze deskundigheid, kwaliteit en service. Diezelfde benadering willen we verder uitbouwen binnen horen.

Daarom zoeken we een audicien die samen met ons wil bouwen aan een sterke audiotak. Afhankelijk van de situatie gaat het om het verder ontwikkelen van een bestaande klantenkring of het opbouwen van een nieuwe activiteit binnen een winkel waar al een vertrouwde klantenbasis aanwezig is.

Je krijgt daarbij de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen zoals jij vindt dat goede hoorzorg hoort te zijn: met tijd voor de klant, persoonlijke aandacht en premium hooroplossingen.

Wat maakt deze functie anders?

Je werkt in een professionele, persoonlijke omgeving waar niet de snelle verkoop, maar de beste oplossing voor de klant centraal staat.

Je kunt rekenen op:

· Premium hooroplossingen

· Ruim voldoende tijd en aandacht voor iedere klant

· Een bestaand klantenbestand vanuit de optiek

· Warme leads via onze partner Audibene

· Professionele ondersteuning en coaching vanuit de organisatie

· Ruimte voor jouw ideeën en vakmanschap

· De kans om daadwerkelijk mee te bouwen aan de audiotak

· Dagen en uren in overleg, met aandacht voor een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé

Voor wie is dit een mooie stap?

Misschien werk je nu bij een grotere keten en zoek je meer persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en betrokkenheid. Of je bent toe aan een omgeving waarin je niet alleen audicien bent, maar ook kunt meedenken over hoe we de beste hoorzorg voor onze klanten organiseren.

Ruime ervaring is voor ons niet het belangrijkste. Veel belangrijker is dat je passie hebt voor horen én voor mensen.

Je bent iemand die kwaliteit belangrijk vindt, graag persoonlijk contact heeft met klanten en energie krijgt van samen iets moois opbouwen. Je wilt onderdeel zijn van een professioneel en kundig team, maar vindt het tegelijkertijd leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor je eigen vakgebied.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een zelfstandige functie met veel ruimte voor vakmanschap en persoonlijke aandacht, maar mét een professioneel team en organisatie achter je.

Geen omgeving waarin iedere minuut wordt gestuurd door targets en agenda’s, maar een plek waar we geloven dat tevreden klanten en goede hoorzorg de basis zijn voor duurzaam succes.

En minstens zo belangrijk: werk moet passen bij je leven. Daarom bespreken we graag samen welke dagen en uren het beste aansluiten. Of je nu een aantal dagen per week wilt werken of juist een volgende stap zoekt met meer verantwoordelijkheid: we kijken vooral naar wat bij elkaar past.

Zin om samen iets moois op te bouwen?

Ben jij audicien en spreekt de combinatie van kwaliteit, persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en bouwen je aan?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Ook als je nog niet jarenlang ervaring hebt, maar wel gepassioneerd bent over het vak, nodigen we je van harte uit om te reageren.

title: UAV / Robotics Integration Field Engineer - Hardware
descriptionHtml:
🚀 Join SE3 Labs as (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Field Engineer - Hardware

Be the person who makes advanced autonomous systems work in the real world. Move across the full stack: drones, sensors, calibration, autonomy software, perception, networking, payloads, field operations, and partner environments. When the system is not mission-ready, you create clarity, find the root cause, and help make it robust.

 

About SE3

SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models. We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defence.

Now, we’re bringing Spatial AI into the sky through high-performance UAVs that can perceive, localize, coordinate, and act in the real world. This requires more than strong algorithms and good hardware. It requires systems that can be configured, calibrated, tested, deployed, demonstrated, debugged, and improved under real field conditions.

We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who wants to work close to the product, close to the field, and close to the full autonomy stack. Someone who is not limited to one layer, but follows the problem wherever it leads.

 

About the Role

As (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Engineer, you will be the part of SE3’s engineering team to bring our technology into real-world use. You will bring together UAVs, payloads, sensors, onboard compute, autonomy software, operator tools, and partner environments into systems that are ready to fly, test, demonstrate, and deploy.

This is a highly hands-on, end-to-end prototyping and field engineering role. You will work directly with other startups, prime contractors, and military institutions, translating their requirements into practical mechanical and electrical designs building on our existing technology. When something is not working, you go where the evidence leads: recalibrate a sensor, debug a radio link, inspect a wiring harness, analyse a flight log, fix a configuration issue, improve a checklist, or bring the right evidence back to the software development team.

The problems you will work on are complex, dynamic, and multivariable. You will often have partial information, limited time, and a system where hardware, software, environment, and operator behavior interact in non-obvious ways. Your job is to create clarity, choose the right debugging path, and drive the system toward a robust long-term solution. You will not just operate systems. You will make them better.

 

What You’ll Work On

  • Own the integration project: Consult with partners, clarify requirements, agree interfaces and test criteria, and drive technical decisions and milestones to a working joint system.

  • Cross-Stack Engineering: Design integration concepts, CAD models, electrical circuits and system integration and bring together sensors, enclosures, calibration, compute, mechanisms, power electronics, controls, networking, autonomy software, and operator workflows.

  • Validation & Fieldability Ownership: Put your system through its paces: on test stands and in the field. Spot design flaws, integration gaps, recurring failure modes, and process bottlenecks. And establish confidence in mission-readiness as the maturity is realized.

  • Create clarity in complex situations: Separate symptoms from root causes, devise efficient debugging workflows, reproduce failures and drive lasting solutions that make the system more robust long term. When the root cause requires it, contribute directly to the layer that matters, drawing directly from the experts who develop core components of your system.

  • Acceptance & Testing Automation: Define and run acceptance tests for platforms, payloads, and deployment configurations. Own readiness checks across calibration, software flashing, networking, sensors, and pre-mission setup. Make readiness measurable and repeatable.

  • Field Deployment & End-User Interface: Install, configure, maintain, and support SE3 systems at test ranges, customer sites, partner demonstrations, exercises, and real-world deployments. Make sure our autonomous platforms perform reliably where it matters, enable end-users to succeed in their missions and represent SE3 with technical credibility outside the lab.

     
 

Your Profile

  • Most importantly, you’re structured, fast-moving, and mission-driven. You don’t wait for perfect information. You create clarity, iterate fast, and prefer finding and fixing root causes over applying patches.

  • You hold a B.Sc., M.Sc. or similar degree in Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, or a related field.

  • You bring multiple years of hands-on experience integrating, testing, operating, and troubleshooting complex robotic, UAV, embedded, automotive, industrial automation, or defence systems.

  • You are proficient in using CAD software, creating wiring diagrams, building electromechanic prototypes and defining and executing test campaigns across hardware disciplines.

  • You are familiar with soldering, crimping, using multimeters, oscilloscopes, serial consoles, or other lab and field equipment, with at least basic experience in command line, data analysis tools and Linux usage.

  • You are proactive, hands-on and able to find effective solutions also under the constraints of field-campaigns and willing to travel and deploy across Europe.

  • You enjoy working directly with partners, operators, and end users. You can explain technical problems clearly, build trust in stressful situations, and represent SE3 professionally outside the lab.

  • You speak fluent English; German is a strong plus. A driving license is required. Given the nature of SE3’s work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance.

     
 

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Specific knowledge in UAVs, PX4, ArduPilot, QGroundControl, Mission Planner, MAVLink, flight log analysis, mission planning, and airspace coordination.

  • Proficiency in PCBA and electronics circuit design and prototyping, especially targeting high-speed data interfaces and sensors

  • Experience with development on ROS2, Docker, Linux, edge compute devices, C++/Python, Bash, Git, or deployment automation.

  • Experience with networking and radio systems, including WiFi networks, LTE/5G modems, VPNs, telemetry links, antenna placement, RF interference, tactical communication links, and debugging connectivity issues in the field.

  • Experience with perception or measurement systems, camera/IMU calibration, sensor synchronization, image processing, or mission autonomy.

  • Skills interpreting sensor data, robot logs, flight logs, frequency-domain data, vibration issues, EMI issues, thermal issues, or intermittent hardware failures.

  • Experience with environmental testing such as vibration, thermal, ingress protection, EMI/EMC, or MIL-STD-style qualification workflows.

  • Experience creating acceptance tests, runbooks, troubleshooting- or training guides, fleet dashboards, release checklists, or field-support processes.

 

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Get equity early, real stock options to participate directly in SE3’s growth

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you. We are an AI-first company empowering every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge.

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

 

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (20 min): Let’s get to know each other

  2. Technical Screen (30 min): First overview of your abilities in system integration, field testing and debugging

  3. Technical Interview (45 min): We dive deeper into your hardware design skills and ability to iterate based on first principle reasoning.

  4. Onsite Trial/Case (1.5-2 hrs): We’ll integrate, diagnose, debug, or test something together, just like on the job.

  5. Team Dinner/Lunch: See if it’s a culture fit on both sides

title: UX/UI Designer (m/w/d) mit Projektverantwortung
descriptionHtml:

UI/UX Design:

Qualität:

  • Du testest neue Funktionen gegen das Design und die Akzeptanzkriterien und wirkst an Usability-Evaluationen mit

Was du mitbringst

Design:

  • Sehr sicherer Umgang mit einem professionellen UI-Design-Tool, inklusive Komponenten und Prototyping

Verantwortung und Kommunikation:

  • Du hast mindestens ein Projekt selbst koordiniert, nicht nur daran mitgearbeitet

  • Du kannst Designentscheidungen gegenüber Partnern, Entwicklung und Geschäftsführung klar begründen

  • Du gehst offen mit Feedback um und bleibst trotzdem bei deiner Linie, wo sie für Nutzer:innen richtig ist

  • Erfahrung in regulierten Branchen (Medizintechnik, Pharma, Automotive o. ä.)

Sprachkenntnisse:

  • Gestaltung mit Wirkung: Deine Designs werden in der medizinischen Diagnostik eingesetzt, und du hast spürbaren Einfluss auf ihre Richtung.

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege: Ein Team aus knapp 20 Leuten, flache Hierarchien und direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Entwicklung: Du arbeitest täglich direkt mit unseren Web- und Mobile-Entwickler:innen zusammen, ohne lange Abstimmungsketten.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

Wir legen Wert auf einen transparenten und respektvollen Prozess:

  1. Screening-Gespräch (ca. 30 Min., remote)
    Gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, Rahmenbedingungen, erste fachliche Einordnung

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

descriptionHtml:

Jurata entwickelt den Jurata Legal Agent (www.jurata.ai), die juristische KI der nächsten Generation. Entwickelt in der Schweiz, von Juristen für Juristen.

Sales-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind deine Persönlichkeit, Tech-Affinität, Lernbereitschaft und dein juristisches Verständnis.
